```ts
// Technical names, not translated (proper nouns).
export const SUPPORT_MODEL_NAMES = {
  speakerId: "3D-Speaker CAM++",
  semanticSearch: "all-MiniLM-L6-v2",
} as const;

// Mirrors PROVIDERS in src/helpers/personalInference.js minus its internal
// "lan"/"local" ids (self-hosted and the built-in runtime). A text provider
// outside this list is refused by main ("Choose a supported text provider.").
export const TEXT_PROVIDER_IDS: readonly string[] = [
  "openai",
  "anthropic",
  "gemini",
  "groq",
  "openrouter",
  "custom",
  "tinfoil",
  "corti",
  "mistral",
  "xai",
  "codex",
  "bedrock",
  "azure",
  "vertex",
];

const ENTERPRISE_PROVIDER_IDS: readonly string[] = ["bedrock", "azure", "vertex"];

// @ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock 5.0.94, resolveAmazonBedrockBaseURL
// (dist/index.js:3105-3135): https://bedrock-runtime.<region>.<partition suffix>.
const AWS_PARTITION_DNS_SUFFIXES: readonly (readonly [string, string])[] = [
  ["cn-", "amazonaws.com.cn"],
  ["us-iso-", "c2s.ic.gov"],
  ["us-isob-", "sc2s.sgov.gov"],
  ["eu-isoe-", "cloud.adc-e.uk"],
  ["us-isof-", "csp.hci.ic.gov"],
  ["eusc-", "amazonaws.eu"],
];

function bedrockBaseUrl(region: string): string {
  const suffix =
    AWS_PARTITION_DNS_SUFFIXES.find(([prefix]) => region.startsWith(prefix))?.[1] ?? "amazonaws.com";
  return `https://bedrock-runtime.${region}.${suffix}`;
}

// @ai-sdk/google-vertex 5.0.93, createGoogleVertex loadBaseURL
// (dist/index.js:1619, 1653-1669). The persisted apiKey source selects express mode.
function vertexBaseUrl(apiKeyMode: boolean, project: string, location: string): string {
  if (apiKeyMode) return "https://aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/publishers/google";
  const host =
    location === "global"
      ? "aiplatform.googleapis.com"
      : location === "eu" || location === "us"
        ? `aiplatform.${location}.rep.googleapis.com`
        : `${location}-aiplatform.googleapis.com`;
  return `https://${host}/v1beta1/projects/${project}/locations/${location}/publishers/google`;
}

// The host a URL built like the SDK's really reaches; null when it cannot be
// parsed or carries credentials (fetch refuses both).
function requestHost(url: string): string | null {
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(url);
    return parsed.username || parsed.password ? null : parsed.host || null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// Where enterpriseAiProviders.js and the AI SDK would send this request, or
// null when the executor refuses the configuration. Mirrors the helper exactly,
// including its `||` defaults and untrimmed values; the agreement test runs
// the real helper and SDK against the same inputs.
export function enterpriseRequestHost(
  providerId: EnterpriseProviderId,
  enterprise: EnterpriseRouteSettings,
  main: EnterpriseMainFacts
): string | null {
  switch (providerId) {
    case "bedrock":
      // An endpoint override in main's environment wins over the region
      // (resolveAmazonBedrockBaseURL, dist/index.js:3120-3129).
      if (main.bedrockEndpoint.set) return main.bedrockEndpoint.host;
      return requestHost(bedrockBaseUrl(enterprise.bedrockRegion || "us-east-1"));
    case "azure": {
      // createAzureModel (:73-77): required, parsable, HTTPS, no embedded credentials.
      const endpoint = enterprise.azureEndpoint;
      if (!endpoint) return null;
      try {
        const url = new URL(endpoint);
        if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.username || url.password) return null;
        return url.host || null;
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    }
    case "vertex":
      return requestHost(
        vertexBaseUrl(
          enterprise.vertexAuthSource === "apiKey",
          enterprise.vertexProject,
          enterprise.vertexLocation || "us-central1"
        )
      );
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

const KEYED_PROVIDER_IDS: readonly string[] = [
  "openai",
  "anthropic",
  "gemini",
  "groq",
  "xai",
  "mistral",
  "openrouter",
  "tinfoil",
  "deepgram",
  "assemblyai",
  "codex",
  "bedrock",
  "azure",
  "vertex",
];

type ModelFamily = "whisper" | "sherpa" | "llm";

// Whisper files and the sherpa-onnx family (Parakeet, Nemotron, Cohere) are
// listed by different main-process calls, so the key carries the family.
function sttFamily(localProvider: string): ModelFamily {
  return localProvider === "whisper" ? "whisper" : "sherpa";
}

export function localSttModelKey(localProvider: string, modelId: string): string {
  return `${sttFamily(localProvider)}:${modelId}`;
}

// Spec §5.4 + Plan 07 CCR-1: sealed mode blocks everything that leaves this
// device, LAN servers included.
export function isSealedLocality(locality: Locality): boolean {
  return locality !== "device";
}

// The credential a route authenticates with. Corti speech uses the client
// id/secret pair (ipcHandlers.js:1105-1121, audioManager.js:3223); Corti text
// uses the API key. Custom endpoints and unknown ids have no tracked credential.
export function routeCredentialId(
  id: RouteId,
  providerId: string | null | undefined
): CredentialId | null {
  const p = (providerId ?? "").trim();
  if (p === "corti") return ROUTE_KIND[id] === "speech" ? "corti:speech" : "corti:text";
  return KEYED_PROVIDER_IDS.includes(p) ? (p as CredentialId) : null;
}

const HOSTED_HOST = /(^|\.)openwhispr\.(com|app)$/i;

// The main process's rule for custom/self-hosted text endpoints
// (personalInference.js validateRequest): http(s) only, no embedded
// credentials, HTTPS unless the host is private, never the retired hosted
// service. Runs before any loopback decision: an invalid URL is never "device".
export function isValidTextEndpoint(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  const raw = (url ?? "").trim();
  if (!raw || !isSecureHttpEndpoint(raw)) return false;
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(raw);
    return !parsed.username && !parsed.password && !HOSTED_HOST.test(parsed.hostname);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function urlHost(url: string): string | null {
  try {
    return new URL(url.trim()).host || null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

const READY: RouteState = { status: "ready" };
const OFF: RouteState = { status: "off" };
const UNKNOWN: RouteState = { status: "unknown" };
const NEEDS_URL: RouteState = { status: "needsUrl" };
const UNSUPPORTED: RouteState = { status: "unreachable", detail: "unsupported" };
const RETIRED: RouteState = { status: "unreachable", detail: "retired" };
const SEALED: RouteState = { status: "unreachable", detail: "sealed" };
const CHOOSE_PROVIDER: RouteState = { status: "needsKey", provider: "" };

interface Destination {
  locality: Locality;
  providerId: string | null;
  host: string | null;
  model: string | null;
  state: RouteState;
}

function providerHost(s: RouteSettingsSnapshot, providerId: string): string | null {
  const hosts = s.capabilities.providerHosts;
  return Object.hasOwn(hosts, providerId) ? hosts[providerId] : null;
}

function cloudModelName(
  s: RouteSettingsSnapshot,
  providerId: string,
  modelId: string
): string | null {
  const id = modelId.trim();
  if (!id) return null;
  const key = `cloud:${providerId}:${id}`;
  return Object.hasOwn(s.models, key) ? s.models[key].name : id;
}

function credentialState(s: RouteSettingsSnapshot, id: RouteId, providerId: string): RouteState {
  const credential = routeCredentialId(id, providerId);
  if (credential === null) return UNSUPPORTED;
  if (s.facts.credentials === null) return UNKNOWN;
  if (s.facts.credentials.get(credential) !== true || s.facts.rejected.has(credential)) {
    return { status: "needsKey", provider: providerDisplayName(providerId) };
  }
  return READY;
}

function keyPresence(
  s: RouteSettingsSnapshot,
  id: RouteId,
  providerId: string
): boolean | undefined {
  const credential = routeCredentialId(id, providerId);
  if (credential === null || s.facts.credentials === null) return undefined;
  return s.facts.credentials.get(credential) === true && !s.facts.rejected.has(credential);
}

// hostKey defaults to the provider id; Corti text routes pass "corti:text"
// because their requests go to a different host than Corti speech.
function remote(
  s: RouteSettingsSnapshot,
  providerId: string,
  model: string | null,
  state: RouteState,
  hostKey?: string
): Destination {
  const id = providerId.trim();
  return {
    locality: "remote",
    providerId: id || null,
    host: id ? providerHost(s, hostKey ?? id) : null,
    model,
    state,
  };
}

// Corti text requests always go to ai.eu.corti.app (personalInference.js:78),
// while Corti speech follows the region; every other provider has one host.
function textHostKey(providerId: string): string {
  return providerId === "corti" ? "corti:text" : providerId;
}

function retired(s: RouteSettingsSnapshot, providerId: string, model: string | null): Destination {
  // The retired hosted service still names a provider (never "Unknown provider").
  return remote(s, providerId.trim() || "openwhispr", model, RETIRED);
}

function localDestination(
  s: RouteSettingsSnapshot,
  family: ModelFamily,
  modelId: string
): Destination {
  const id = modelId.trim();
  const key = `${family}:${id}`;
  const info = id && Object.hasOwn(s.models, key) ? s.models[key] : undefined;
  const installed = s.facts.installed[family];
  let state: RouteState = READY;
  if (!id) {
    state = { status: "needsModel" }; // a settings fact, known without main
  } else if (installed === null) {
    state = UNKNOWN;
  } else if (!installed.has(id)) {
    state = info?.sizeBytes
      ? { status: "needsModel", sizeBytes: info.sizeBytes }
      : { status: "needsModel" };
  }
  return {
    locality: "device",
    providerId: null,
    host: null,
    model: id ? (info?.name ?? id) : null,
    state,
  };
}

// An endpoint the user typed. Loopback is decided only after validation.
function endpointDestination(
  url: string,
  valid: boolean,
  providerId: "custom" | null,
  model: string | null,
  invalidState: RouteState
): Destination {
  if (valid && isLoopbackUrl(url)) {
    // The request still targets a user-configured endpoint. Keep its host so
    // Plan 07 can distinguish it from a built-in engine (device + host:null).
    return { locality: "device", providerId: null, host: urlHost(url), model, state: READY };
  }
  return {
    locality: providerId === "custom" ? "remote" : "network",
    providerId,
    host: valid ? urlHost(url) : null,
    model,
    state: valid ? READY : invalidState,
  };
}

// Error codes from resolveTranscriptionRoute → route state. null = the
// executor refuses the batch request but the live dictation path runs it.
function transcriptionErrorState(
  code: string | undefined,
  id: RouteId,
  mode: string,
  providerId: string
): RouteState | null {
  switch (code) {
    case "UNSUPPORTED_TRANSCRIPTION_MODE":
      return mode === "openwhispr" ? RETIRED : UNSUPPORTED;
    case "UNSUPPORTED_TRANSCRIPTION_PROVIDER":
      return providerId ? UNSUPPORTED : CHOOSE_PROVIDER;
    case "CUSTOM_ENDPOINT_INVALID":
      return NEEDS_URL;
    case "API_KEY_MISSING":
      return { status: "needsKey", provider: providerDisplayName(providerId) };
    case "STREAMING_ONLY_PROVIDER":
      return id === "dictationStt" ? null : UNSUPPORTED;
    case undefined:
      // The executor's code-less errors are all endpoint errors: self-hosted URL
      // invalid or not configured, and Tinfoil behind a Custom URL.
      return NEEDS_URL;
    default:
      return UNSUPPORTED;
  }
}

function batchSttDestination(
  s: RouteSettingsSnapshot,
  id: RouteId,
  input: SttRouteInput
): Destination {
  const mode = input.mode.trim();
  const providerId = input.cloudProvider.trim();
  const remoteUrl = input.remoteUrl.trim();
  const route = resolveTranscriptionRoute({
    settings: {
      transcriptionMode: mode,
      useLocalWhisper: false,
      remoteTranscriptionUrl: remoteUrl,
      remoteTranscriptionModel: input.remoteModel,
      cloudTranscriptionProvider: providerId,
      cloudTranscriptionModel: input.cloudModel,
      cloudTranscriptionBaseUrl: input.cloudBaseUrl,
    },
    providers: s.capabilities.transcriptionProviderBaseUrls,
    // The executor reads key presence only for live-only providers, and only
    // the dictation recorder has a live path (upload and retry omit it).
    hasProviderKey: id === "dictationStt" ? keyPresence(s, id, providerId) : undefined,
  });
  const ok = route.transport === "http-batch" || route.transport === "proxied";
  const errorState =
    route.transport === "error" ? transcriptionErrorState(route.code, id, mode, providerId) : null;
  const endpoint = route.transport === "http-batch" ? route.endpoint : "";

  if (mode === "self-hosted" && remoteUrl) {
    return endpointDestination(
      endpoint,
      ok,
      null,
      input.remoteModel.trim() || null,
      errorState ?? NEEDS_URL
    );
  }
  const model = cloudModelName(s, providerId, input.cloudModel);
  if ((mode === "providers" || mode === "self-hosted") && providerId === "custom") {
    return endpointDestination(endpoint, ok, "custom", model, errorState ?? NEEDS_URL);
  }
  if (mode === "self-hosted") {
    return {
      locality: "network",
      providerId: null,
      host: null,
      model: input.remoteModel.trim() || null,
      state: NEEDS_URL,
    };
  }
  if (errorState) return remote(s, providerId, model, errorState);
  return remote(s, providerId, model, credentialState(s, id, providerId));
}

// Mirrors resolveMeetingTranscriptionOptions (meetingTranscriptionRouting.js):
// no self-hosted path, and only the streaming table's providers run.
function meetingDestination(s: RouteSettingsSnapshot, input: SttRouteInput): Destination {
  const mode = input.mode.trim();
  const providerId = input.cloudProvider.trim();
  if (mode === "self-hosted") {
    const url = input.remoteUrl.trim();
    const where = endpointDestination(
      url,
      isValidTextEndpoint(url),
      null,
      input.remoteModel.trim() || null,
      NEEDS_URL
    );
    return { ...where, state: UNSUPPORTED };
  }
  const model = cloudModelName(s, providerId, input.cloudModel);
  if (mode !== "providers") return remote(s, providerId, model, UNSUPPORTED);
  if (!providerId) return remote(s, providerId, model, CHOOSE_PROVIDER);
  if (!s.capabilities.meetingProviders.includes(providerId)) {
    return remote(s, providerId, model, UNSUPPORTED);
  }
  return remote(s, providerId, model, credentialState(s, "noteRecordingStt", providerId));
}

function sttDestination(s: RouteSettingsSnapshot, id: RouteId, input: SttRouteInput): Destination {
  const mode = input.mode.trim();
  const providerId = input.cloudProvider.trim();
  if (mode === "local") {
    return localDestination(s, sttFamily(input.localProvider), input.localModel);
  }
  if (mode === "openwhispr") {
    return retired(s, providerId, cloudModelName(s, providerId, input.cloudModel));
  }
  if (id === "noteRecordingStt") return meetingDestination(s, input);
  return batchSttDestination(s, id, input);
}

// Bedrock, Azure and Vertex (R2-1/R3-1/R3-3). The host comes from the enterprise
// slice, never providerHosts. A configuration the executor refuses is needsUrl
// before credential facts. Vertex's host follows its persisted auth source, not
// key presence; only apiKey readiness waits for the key facts.
function enterpriseDestination(
  s: RouteSettingsSnapshot,
  id: RouteId,
  providerId: EnterpriseProviderId,
  model: string | null
): Destination {
  const at = (host: string | null, state: RouteState): Destination => ({
    locality: "remote",
    providerId,
    host,
    model,
    state,
  });
  // Main is the source of truth: until Task 3 has synced the slice from main
  // and read main's environment overrides, the destination is not known.
  const main = s.facts.enterpriseMain;
  if (main === null) return at(null, UNKNOWN);
  const host = enterpriseRequestHost(providerId, s.enterprise, main);
  if (host === null) return at(null, NEEDS_URL);
  // Recipient settings pick the host independently of credentials. Preserve
  // that host while main-confirmed credential facts are still loading.
  if (providerId === "vertex" && s.enterprise.vertexAuthSource === "apiKey" &&
      (s.facts.credentials === null || s.facts.credentialFields === null)) return at(host, UNKNOWN);
  if (providerId === "bedrock" && !main.bedrockProfile && s.facts.credentialFields === null) return at(host, UNKNOWN);
  if (providerId === "bedrock") {
    const fields = s.facts.credentialFields?.get("bedrock");
    const completeStaticPair = fields?.accessKeyId === true && fields?.secretAccessKey === true;
    const ready = main.bedrockProfile || completeStaticPair;
    return at(host, ready && !s.facts.rejected.has("bedrock")
      ? READY
      : { status: "needsKey", provider: providerDisplayName(providerId) });
  }
  if (providerId === "vertex") {
    if (s.enterprise.vertexAuthSource === "apiKey") {
      const storedKey = s.facts.credentialFields?.get("vertex")?.key === true;
      const effectiveKey = storedKey || main.vertexApiKeyEnv;
      return at(host, effectiveKey && !s.facts.rejected.has("vertex")
        ? READY
        : { status: "needsKey", provider: providerDisplayName(providerId) });
    }
    // ADC must not inherit either explicit or ambient API keys. A project is
    // required by createVertex({ apiKey: "", project, location }).
    return at(host, s.enterprise.vertexProject.trim()
      ? READY
      : { status: "needsKey", provider: providerDisplayName(providerId) });
  }
  return at(host, credentialState(s, id, providerId));
}

function llmDestination(s: RouteSettingsSnapshot, id: RouteId, input: LlmRouteInput): Destination {
  const mode = input.mode.trim();
  const providerId = input.provider.trim();
  const modelId = input.model.trim();
  if (mode === "local") return localDestination(s, "llm", modelId);
  if (mode === "openwhispr") return retired(s, providerId, cloudModelName(s, providerId, modelId));

  let dest: Destination;
  if (mode === "self-hosted") {
    const url = input.remoteUrl.trim();
    dest = endpointDestination(url, isValidTextEndpoint(url), null, modelId || null, NEEDS_URL);
  } else if (mode === "providers" && providerId === "custom") {
    const url = input.cloudBaseUrl.trim();
    dest = endpointDestination(
      url,
      isValidTextEndpoint(url),
      "custom",
      cloudModelName(s, providerId, modelId),
      NEEDS_URL
    );
  } else if (mode === "providers" || mode === "enterprise") {
    const supported = mode === "enterprise" ? ENTERPRISE_PROVIDER_IDS : TEXT_PROVIDER_IDS;
    const model = cloudModelName(s, providerId, modelId);
    if (!providerId) dest = remote(s, providerId, model, CHOOSE_PROVIDER);
    else if (!supported.includes(providerId)) dest = remote(s, providerId, model, UNSUPPORTED);
    else if (ENTERPRISE_PROVIDER_IDS.includes(providerId)) {
      // Also reached in "providers" mode: the vision override is provider-only.
      dest = enterpriseDestination(s, id, providerId as EnterpriseProviderId, model);
    } else {
      dest = remote(s, providerId, model, credentialState(s, id, providerId), textHostKey(providerId));
    }
  } else {
    dest = remote(s, providerId, cloudModelName(s, providerId, modelId), UNSUPPORTED);
  }
  // Main refuses a text request without a model ("Choose a text model."), and
  // text providers have no implicit default, unlike speech providers.
  if (dest.state.status === "ready" && !modelId) {
    return { ...dest, state: { status: "needsModel" } };
  }
  return dest;
}

function supportDestination(
  s: RouteSettingsSnapshot,
  id: "speakerId" | "semanticSearch"
): Destination {
  const ready = id === "speakerId" ? s.facts.speakerIdModelsReady : s.facts.searchModelReady;
  const state: RouteState = ready === null ? UNKNOWN : ready ? READY : { status: "needsModel" };
  return {
    locality: "device",
    providerId: null,
    host: null,
    model: SUPPORT_MODEL_NAMES[id],
    state,
  };
}

const ROUTE_STT_CONTEXT: Partial<Record<RouteId, SttContext>> = {
  dictationStt: "dictation",
  noteRecordingStt: "meeting",
  uploadStt: "upload",
};

const ROUTE_SCOPE: Partial<Record<RouteId, LlmRouteScope>> = {
  dictationCleanup: "dictationCleanup",
  voiceAssistant: "dictationAgent",
  assistantVision: "dictationAgentVision",
  translation: "dictationTranslation",
  noteFormatting: "noteFormatting",
  chat: "chatIntelligence",
};

// Without the override, screenshots go to the assistant's own model.
function effectiveScope(s: RouteSettingsSnapshot, id: RouteId): LlmRouteScope {
  if (id === "assistantVision" && !s.enabled.visionOverride) return "dictationAgent";
  return ROUTE_SCOPE[id] as LlmRouteScope;
}

function isOff(s: RouteSettingsSnapshot, id: RouteId): boolean {
  switch (id) {
    case "dictationCleanup":
      return !s.enabled.cleanup;
    case "voiceAssistant":
      return !s.enabled.voiceAssistant;
    case "assistantVision":
      return !s.enabled.voiceAssistant || !s.enabled.screenContext;
    case "translation":
      return !s.enabled.translation;
    case "speakerId":
      return !s.enabled.speakerId;
    default:
      return false;
  }
}

// What a request on this route carries (Appendix B). Conservative: a part
// that may be sent under conditions the snapshot cannot see is listed.
// Computing it never triggers a request.
export function routePayloadParts(id: RouteId, s: RouteSettingsSnapshot): PayloadPart[] {
  const dictionary = s.dictionaryInUse;
  switch (id) {
    case "dictationStt":
      return dictionary ? ["audio", "dictionary"] : ["audio"];
    case "noteRecordingStt":
      // Only Corti's realtime options carry the dictionary as keyterms.
      return dictionary && s.stt.meeting.cloudProvider.trim() === "corti"
        ? ["meetingAudio", "dictionaryWords"]
        : ["meetingAudio"];
    case "uploadStt":
      return ["audioFile"];
    case "dictationCleanup":
    case "translation":
      return dictionary ? ["transcript", "dictionary"] : ["transcript"];
    case "voiceAssistant":
    case "assistantVision": {
      const parts: PayloadPart[] = ["request", "selectedText", "history", "lookups"];
      if (dictionary) parts.push("dictionary");
      if (id === "assistantVision" || (s.enabled.screenContext && !s.enabled.visionOverride)) {
        parts.push("screenshot");
      }
      if (s.llm[effectiveScope(s, id)].providerSearch) parts.push("webSearch");
      return parts;
    }
    case "noteFormatting":
      return dictionary
        ? ["noteText", "meetingTranscript", "participants", "dictionaryWords"]
        : ["noteText", "meetingTranscript", "participants"];
    case "chat": {
      const parts: PayloadPart[] = ["messages", "history", "lookups"];
      if (dictionary) parts.push("dictionary");
      if (s.llm.chatIntelligence.providerSearch) parts.push("webSearch");
      return parts;
    }
    default:
      return []; // support routes never leave the device
  }
}

export function resolveRoute(s: RouteSettingsSnapshot, id: RouteId): ResolvedRoute {
  const kind = ROUTE_KIND[id];
  let dest: Destination;
  if (id === "speakerId" || id === "semanticSearch") {
    dest = supportDestination(s, id);
  } else if (kind === "speech") {
    dest = sttDestination(s, id, s.stt[ROUTE_STT_CONTEXT[id] as SttContext]);
  } else {
    dest = llmDestination(s, id, s.llm[effectiveScope(s, id)]);
  }

  const off = isOff(s, id);
  let state = dest.state;
  if (off) state = OFF;
  else if (s.sealed && isSealedLocality(dest.locality)) state = SEALED;

  const parts = off || dest.locality === "device" ? [] : routePayloadParts(id, s);
  return {
    id,
    kind,
    locality: dest.locality,
    provider: dest.providerId ? providerDisplayName(dest.providerId) : null,
    providerId: dest.providerId,
    // Built-in engines already have dest.host === null. Preserve the host for
    // configured loopback endpoints: device locality still permits them in
    // Sealed mode, while the host distinguishes them from Loqui's own engines.
    host: dest.host,
    model: dest.model,
    state,
    sends: parts.length ? s.copy.list(parts.map((p) => s.copy.parts[p])) : null,
    settingsPath: ROUTE_SETTINGS_PATH[id],
  };
}

export function resolveRoutes(s: RouteSettingsSnapshot): ResolvedRoute[] {
  return ROUTE_IDS.map((id) => resolveRoute(s, id));
}
```

Create `src/helpers/enterpriseRouteFacts.js` (main process; Task 3 registers it as the `enterprise-route-facts` IPC):

```js
// What main's own environment does to enterprise requests (R2-1), as facts the
// route graph can disclose. Hosts and booleans only: never a value, so no key,
// token or credential-bearing URL leaves main. Reads process.env; no network.
//
// Precedence mirrors the installed SDKs on the enterpriseAiProviders.js path:
// - @ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock resolveAmazonBedrockBaseURL (dist/index.js:3113-3129):
//   AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_BEDROCK_RUNTIME, else AWS_ENDPOINT_URL, else the region.
//   loadOptionalSetting (provider-utils dist/index.js:1720-1735) accepts any
//   string, "" included, and the base URL loses one trailing slash.
// - @ai-sdk/google-vertex (dist/index.js:1637-1640, 1814-1820): a truthy
//   GOOGLE_VERTEX_API_KEY is the legacy fallback only in persisted apiKey mode.
//   ADC mode passes apiKey: "" explicitly, suppressing this SDK fallback.
// GOOGLE_VERTEX_PROJECT/LOCATION and AWS_REGION never apply here: the helper
// always passes string settings, which loadSetting returns as they are.

function requestHost(url) {
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(url);
    return parsed.username || parsed.password ? null : parsed.host || null; // fetch refuses credentials
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function enterpriseRouteFacts(env = process.env) {
  const runtime = env.AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_BEDROCK_RUNTIME;
  const raw = typeof runtime === "string" ? runtime : env.AWS_ENDPOINT_URL;
  return {
    bedrockEndpoint:
      typeof raw === "string"
        ? { set: true, host: requestHost(`${raw.replace(/\/$/, "")}/model/fixture/converse`) }
        : { set: false, host: null },
    bedrockProfile: Boolean(env.BEDROCK_PROFILE),
    vertexApiKeyEnv: Boolean(env.GOOGLE_VERTEX_API_KEY),
    vertexProjectEnv: typeof env.GOOGLE_VERTEX_PROJECT === "string",
  };
}

module.exports = { enterpriseRouteFacts };
```

### Task 2: Credential authority in main: acknowledged saves, presence, change events, undoable removal

Closes I3 (saved-key readiness becomes a main-acknowledged fact: renderer setters await main, the raw value never enters zustand, `flushSecretSaves()`, `credentials-changed` events update every window, `ApiKeyInput` clears its draft only after a successful save and keeps it with an error otherwise, legacy save channels return `{ success, error? }`), I4 main side (removal returns an opaque, generation-bound undo token; the removed value lives only in main memory for 8 s; reset invalidates every token), I2 (Codex presence is a `stat` of `<userData>/codex/auth.json`, so listing credentials never starts the Codex app server or touches the network) and the credential half of I10 (Corti is two identities: `corti:text` is `cortiApiKey`, `corti:speech` is the client id plus secret pair).

Today `_saveKey` (`src/helpers/environment.js:249-264`) returns `{ success: true }` before the encrypted write finishes and only logs a failure, and the renderer puts the raw key into zustand before a 250 ms debounced IPC (`src/stores/settingsStore.ts:1280-1297`, `:1363-1366`). This task moves the authority to main: main persists, acknowledges, bumps a per-identity generation and broadcasts presence; the renderer stores only `"__stored__"` or `""`, and only after the acknowledgement. The UI for undoable removal (the toast Undo and the deletion of the empty-save Remove) is Task 12. This task ships the main contract it calls and declares the `credentialId?: CredentialSlot` prop, so Tasks 8 and 9 can pass identities before Task 12 gives the prop its behaviour.

**Vertex source migration gate (R3-1, spec §5.1).** Add the non-secret setting `vertexAuthSource: "adc" | "apiKey"`, persisted as `VERTEX_AUTH_SOURCE`. In `main.js` `startApp()`, capture one main-only `hasExistingSettingsProfile` fact before calling `initializeCoreManagers()`, because that function and `environmentManager.init()` can create files. The fact is true when a selected pre-existing marker exists: `userData/.env`, `userData/secure-keys/.migrated`, or the selected database (`transcriptions-dev.db` in development, otherwise `transcriptions.db`). Check only marker existence; never read contents. Ignore `ENOENT`, but fail startup on any other stat error rather than guessing fresh. A fresh profile defaults to `adc` even when ambient `GOOGLE_VERTEX_API_KEY` exists. An existing install with no valid persisted source migrates once from its committed effective credential source. After managers and queues exist, await `environmentManager.init()` and then call `ipcHandlers.initializeVertexAuthSource(hasExistingSettingsProfile)` before `registerSidecars`, CLI/provider bridges, renderer creation, or provider-request admission. The migration first waits for `environmentManager.drainEnvWrites()` and the Vertex credential slot queue to settle, then uses internal `captureCommitted("vertex")`; its main-only `values.key` is the committed stored `VERTEX_API_KEY`, or the supported committed legacy fallback only when the stored key is absent. This preserves the current executor's stored-key-before-SDK-environment precedence without reading mutable renderer state or returning a secret. Main writes the selected source once through the same reset-fenced `.env` writer and materializes it before public route-setting/source getters, credential mutations, or provider requests are admitted. It never re-derives the source from later key presence. Existing valid source values are preserved. In the `IPCHandlers` constructor, establish the shared `vertexAuthSourceReady` admission barrier before registering handlers. Public route-setting getters, the source getter/saver, credential mutation handlers, route-facts getter, and provider requests await this barrier; internal `captureCommitted("vertex")` and the single internal migration write bypass it so migration cannot wait on itself. Raw committed secret getters and capture remain usable while the source barrier is closed. If migration cannot persist, keep public admissions closed and surface the failure instead of choosing a source silently. Capture `envWriteEpoch` before waiting for either queue; the private migration source saver requires that captured epoch and rejects if reset advanced it, even if the reset has already reopened the environment fence. A normal user source saver captures the current epoch at entry. Thus a migration paused between capture and persistence cannot recreate `VERTEX_AUTH_SOURCE` after reset returns.

Create `src/helpers/settingsProfile.js` and use its production detector at the first line of `startApp()`, before sidecar reaping or manager construction. It receives injected `fs.promises`, `userDataPath` and `development`, and checks all selected markers in parallel; each `stat` treats only `ENOENT` as absent and propagates every other error:

```js
const path = require("node:path");

async function hasExistingSettingsProfile({ fs, userDataPath, development }) {
  const database = development ? "transcriptions-dev.db" : "transcriptions.db";
  const markers = [
    path.join(userDataPath, ".env"),
    path.join(userDataPath, "secure-keys", ".migrated"),
    path.join(userDataPath, database),
  ];
  const exists = await Promise.all(markers.map(async (marker) => {
    try {
      const stat = await fs.stat(marker); // existence only: never open or read the marker
      return stat.isFile();
    } catch (error) {
      if (error?.code === "ENOENT") return false;
      throw error;
    }
  }));
  return exists.some(Boolean);
}

module.exports = { hasExistingSettingsProfile };
```

`main.js` imports that helper once and captures its boolean before any sidecar or manager work:

```js

    fs: require("node:fs/promises"),
    userDataPath: app.getPath("userData"),
    development: process.env.NODE_ENV === "development",
  });
  await reapStaleSidecars();
  initializeCoreManagers();
  await environmentManager.init();
  await ipcHandlers.initializeVertexAuthSource(existingSettingsProfile);
  registerSidecars();
  // Continue with CLI/provider/window admission only after the source is materialized.
```

The existing `startApp()` body keeps all of its current startup calls in place around the new lines.

Create `src/helpers/vertexAuthSourceMigration.js`; `IPCHandlers` owns the one-shot initializer and calls this main-only helper. It reads the source only after `.env` and credential queues have settled. The epoch is captured before the first await so reset invalidates this operation even if it resumes after the environment fence reopens:

```js
async function initializeVertexAuthSource({ hasExistingSettingsProfile, environment, credentials }) {
  const migrationEpoch = environment.getEnvWriteEpoch();
  await environment.drainEnvWrites();
  // Always join the Vertex slot queue, even when a valid source is already
  // stored. This makes the migration boundary follow any admitted credential
  // save; a valid source is preserved and is never re-derived from that save.
  const capture = await credentials.captureCommitted("vertex");
  if (!capture) throw new Error("Vertex credentials are unavailable during source migration");
  const storedSource = environment.getVertexAuthSource();
  // Fresh profiles always start in ADC, including when an ambient API key or
  // inherited VERTEX_AUTH_SOURCE exists. Existing valid persisted choices win.
  let source = hasExistingSettingsProfile && storedSource ? storedSource : null;
  if (source === null) {
    source = "adc";
    if (hasExistingSettingsProfile) {
      // captureCommitted is main-only and queued behind any already-admitted
      // save. Its effective value checks VERTEX_API_KEY before legacy env.
      source = capture.values.key ? "apiKey" : "adc";
    }
  }
  // getVertexAuthSource also sees process.env inherited at launch. Persist an
  // accepted source even when already valid so the next launch cannot choose a
  // different recipient merely because that ambient variable disappeared.
  const saved = await environment.saveVertexAuthSource(source, { expectedEpoch: migrationEpoch });
  if (!saved?.success) throw new Error("Could not persist Vertex auth source");
  return source;
}

module.exports = { initializeVertexAuthSource };
```

In the `IPCHandlers` constructor, create `this.vertexAuthSourceReady` as an unresolved promise and store its resolver before `setupHandlers()`. The `IPCHandlers.initializeVertexAuthSource(existingProfile)` method memoizes one call to this helper and resolves the barrier only after the helper returns successfully. Every public route-setting/source getter, public source saver, credential mutation handler, route-facts handler and enterprise provider request awaits the barrier. On failure the initializer rejects, startup fails, and the promise stays unresolved; raw committed secret getters and `captureCommitted` do not await it. The internal source saver accepts `expectedEpoch`; the public IPC accepts only the enum value, awaits the barrier, and then calls the saver without an override, so a renderer cannot submit an epoch or bypass admission.

Implement the `IPCHandlers` seam as follows (the `await this.vertexAuthSourceReady` check belongs before each listed public operation reads settings or mutates credentials):

```js
const { initializeVertexAuthSource } = require("./vertexAuthSourceMigration");

// Constructor, before setupHandlers():
this.vertexAuthSourceReady = new Promise((resolve) => {
  this.resolveVertexAuthSourceReady = resolve;
});
this.vertexAuthInitialization = null;

async initializeVertexAuthSource(hasExistingSettingsProfile) {
  if (!this.vertexAuthInitialization) {
    this.vertexAuthInitialization = initializeVertexAuthSource({
      hasExistingSettingsProfile,
      environment: this.environmentManager,
      credentials: this.credentials,
    });
    // Keep the public promise closed on failure; startApp receives and reports
    // the rejected initializer promise before it admits any renderer/provider.
    this.vertexAuthInitialization.then(() => this.resolveVertexAuthSourceReady(), () => {});
  }
  return this.vertexAuthInitialization;
}

ipcMain.handle("get-vertex-auth-source", async () => {
  await this.vertexAuthSourceReady;
  return this.environmentManager.getVertexAuthSource();
});
ipcMain.handle("save-vertex-auth-source", async (_event, source) => {
  await this.vertexAuthSourceReady;
  if (source !== "adc" && source !== "apiKey") throw new Error("Invalid Vertex auth source");
  return this.environmentManager.saveVertexAuthSource(source); // no renderer-supplied epoch
});

// Before each public credentials.save/remove/undo handler and before each
// route-setting getter, route-facts getter, or enterprise inference admission:
await this.vertexAuthSourceReady;
```

Keep `credentials.captureCommitted("vertex")`, the migration helper's call to `saveVertexAuthSource(source, { expectedEpoch })`, and raw EnvironmentManager secret getters outside that public gate. The startup helper is the only caller allowed to pass an epoch.

```js
test("the production profile detector recognizes each selected marker without reading it", async () => {
  const userDataPath = "/profile";
  const markers = [
    "/profile/.env",
    "/profile/secure-keys/.migrated",
    "/profile/transcriptions.db",
    "/profile/transcriptions-dev.db",
  ];
  for (const marker of markers) {
    let statCalls = 0;
    const fs = {
      async stat(path) {
        statCalls++;
        if (path === marker) return { isFile: () => true };
        throw Object.assign(new Error("missing"), { code: "ENOENT" });
      },
      readFile() { assert.fail("profile detection must not read marker contents"); },
    };
    const existing = await hasExistingSettingsProfile({
      fs,
      userDataPath,
      development: marker.endsWith("transcriptions-dev.db"),
    });
    assert.equal(existing, true, marker);
    assert.equal(statCalls, 3);
  }
  const fresh = await hasExistingSettingsProfile({
    fs: { stat: async () => { throw Object.assign(new Error("missing"), { code: "ENOENT" }); } },
    userDataPath,
    development: false,
  });
  assert.equal(fresh, false);
  await assert.rejects(
    hasExistingSettingsProfile({
      fs: { stat: async () => { throw Object.assign(new Error("EACCES"), { code: "EACCES" }); } },
      userDataPath,
      development: false,
    }),
    { code: "EACCES" },
    "an unreadable profile fails closed instead of being classified fresh"
  );
});

  hold.release();
  assert.deepEqual(await saving, { ok: true, generation: 1 });
  assert.equal(await migration, "apiKey");
});

test("reset invalidates a migration paused after capture and before its source write", async (t) => {
  const fixture = migrationEnv(t, { VERTEX_API_KEY: "fixture-stored-key" }, { encryptionAvailable: false });
  const realSave = fixture.env.saveVertexAuthSource.bind(fixture.env);
  let reachedSave;
  const reached = new Promise((resolve) => (reachedSave = resolve));
  let releaseSave;
  const saveGate = new Promise((resolve) => (releaseSave = resolve));
  fixture.env.saveVertexAuthSource = async (source, options) => {
    reachedSave({ source, options });
    await saveGate;
    return realSave(source, options);
  };
  const migration = initializeVertexAuthSource({
    hasExistingSettingsProfile: true,
    environment: fixture.env,
    credentials: fixture.credentials,
  });
  const pendingWrite = await reached;
  assert.equal(pendingWrite.source, "apiKey");
  assert.equal(typeof pendingWrite.options.expectedEpoch, "number");
  await fixture.credentials.reset(fixture.erase);
  releaseSave();
  await assert.rejects(migration, { code: "ENV_RESET" });
  assert.equal(fixture.env.getVertexAuthSource(), null);
  assert.equal(fixture.env.getVertexApiKey(), "");
  assert.equal(
    [...fixture.fs.files.keys()].some((file) => file.endsWith("/.env") || file.endsWith("/.env.tmp")),
    false,
    "neither the source nor a secret is recreated after reset returns"
  );
});
```

Round-2 revisions (Codex R2-2, R2-3, R2-4 and the Task 2 half of R2-5):
- **Reset barrier (R2-2/R3-2).** `reset(erase)` is authority-wide and async. It raises a fence that refuses new credential mutations, and it bumps an epoch so queued mutations return without writing. It then drops every undo token and bumps every generation, discarding verifications already in flight. After draining credential-slot writes, it calls `erase`; `clearAllPersistedData()` raises a second fence beneath every `.env` persistence entry point, invalidates queued module-level `envWriteQueue` work, drains a currently active atomic write, then deletes `.env` and encrypted files while the fence remains up. `saveAllKeysToEnvFile()` checks its captured queue epoch before `dotenv.config`, so an invalidated writer cannot reload an old secret into memory after erasure. Every environment writer refuses while the erase fence is raised. A save, removal or Undo requested before credential reset resolves as a failure, never success. `cleanup-app` calls `this.credentials.reset(() => this.environmentManager?.clearAllPersistedData())` in place of the bare erase.
- **Committed snapshots (R2-4/R3-1).** The real `_saveSecretKey` sets `process.env` before its awaited write (`src/helpers/environment.js:155`, then `:157-165`), and getters read `process.env` (`:245-246`). While a slot is being written, the authority answers `present`/`list`/`fields` from the snapshot it took just before the write. It publishes new presence only after persistence succeeds. `captureCommitted(id)` is main-only and queued behind slot mutations. For Vertex, its `values.key` is the committed stored key first, otherwise the supported main-only legacy `GOOGLE_VERTEX_API_KEY` fallback; the presence fields still report only stored slot fields. Thus migration and Verify consume the same committed effective credential snapshot without reading mutable renderer state or exposing a value over IPC. Tests use the real `EnvironmentManager` method bodies over a deferred fake filesystem (`test/helpers/harness/realCredentialEnv.js`).
- **Shared slot type and acknowledged-save type (R2-5, R2-3).** The new pure module `src/lib/credentialSlots.ts` exports `CredentialSlot` (the 16 `CredentialId`s plus seven custom-endpoint slots), `MULTI_FIELD_CREDENTIALS` (`corti:speech` and `bedrock`; Remove takes the whole credential), the store-key→slot table and `credentialSlotForRef`. `ApiKeyInput.tsx` exports `AcknowledgedSecretSave` and types `setApiKey` with it. Every caller passes a real acknowledged save, with no casts. The repo's `src/tsconfig.json` has `"strict": false`, but a `void`-returning callback is still not assignable to `Promise<SecretSaveResult>`. Step 3.13 therefore fixes the four places that would fail `npm run typecheck`.

  ```js
  const UNDO_MS = 8000;
  const CREDENTIAL_IDS; // the 16 CredentialId values, in routeGraph order
  function byokSlotId(base): string;            // "corti" → "corti:text"; "*-custom" → "custom:<scope>"; else base
  function slotForCredentialRef(ref): { id: string; field: "key" } | null; // personal-inference refs → slots
  function hasStoredAccount({ fs, codexHome }): boolean; // fs.statSync(<codexHome>/auth.json): isFile && size > 2; never reads it
  function createCredentialAuthority({ env, codexHome, fs, broadcast, now, undoMs, setTimer, randomToken }) → {
    list(): Array<{ id: CredentialId; present: boolean; generation: number; fields: Record<string, boolean> }>; // committed state only
    present(id): boolean;                         // committed: never true for a write main has not acknowledged
    generation(id): number;
    save(id, field, value): Promise<{ ok: true; generation: number } | { ok: false; error: CredentialError }>;
    remove(id): Promise<{ ok: true; undoToken: string; expiresAt: number; generation: number } | { ok: false; error: CredentialError }>; // every field of the slot
    undoRemove(token): Promise<{ ok: true; generation: number } | { ok: false; reason: "expired" | "replaced" | "unknown" | "persistFailed" }>;
    captureCommitted(id): Promise<{ generation: number; present: boolean; values: Record<string, string> } | null>; // MAIN ONLY (Task 11 Verify); null for an unknown slot or during a reset
    reset(erase?: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<void>; // barrier: fence, cancel queued work, drop tokens, bump generations, drain, then erase; rethrows erase's error after unfencing
    refresh(id): void;                            // re-broadcast presence after a non-secret input (Bedrock profile, Vertex project) changed
    subscribe(listener: (change: CredentialChange & { cause: "save" | "remove" | "undo" | "reset" | "refresh" }) => void): () => void;
  }
  // CredentialError = "unknownCredential" | "unknownField" | "invalidValue" | "persistFailed" | "unsupported" | "notStored" | "reset"
  ```

  Reset contract (R2-2):
  - Once `reset` starts, any `save`/`remove` resolves `{ ok: false, error: "reset" }`, and any `undoRemove` resolves `{ ok: false, reason: "unknown" }`. This includes calls made during the reset and calls queued or running when it began.
  - A running write stops before its next field. A two-field removal never writes the removed values back.
  - `erase` runs only after every slot queue has settled.

  Committed-state contract (R2-4):
  - While a slot is being written, `present`, `list`, `fields` and broadcasts use the snapshot taken just before the write.
  - A broadcast happens only after a successful write.
  - `captureCommitted` runs in the slot's queue, so it sees neither a pending write nor a write that failed and was rolled back.

  Slot ids are the 16 `CredentialId`s plus seven custom-endpoint slots named like personal-inference credential refs (`main.js:493-506`): `custom:transcription`, `custom:dictationCleanup`, `custom:noteFormatting`, `custom:dictationTranslation`, `custom:dictationAgent`, `custom:dictationAgentVision`, `custom:chatIntelligence`. `list()` reports only the 16 `CredentialId`s; events are broadcast for every slot. Fields: `key` everywhere except `corti:speech` (`clientId`, `clientSecret`) and `bedrock` (`accessKeyId`, `secretAccessKey`, `sessionToken`). Presence: `corti:speech` needs both fields; `bedrock` is profile or access key id and `vertex` is API key or project (both mirror `personal-inference:credential-status`, `src/helpers/personalInference.js:268-279`); `codex` is `hasStoredAccount`; everything else is "any field stored".
- Produces (main, `src/helpers/environment.js`): `async persistSecret(envVarName, value): Promise<void>`. Resolves only after the encrypted file was written or removed (or, without encryption, after `.env` was rewritten); rejects on failure and restores the previous in-memory value.
- Produces (IPC/preload, `window.electronAPI.credentials`): `list()`, `save(id, field, value)`, `remove(id)`, `undoRemove(token)`, `onChanged(cb) → unsubscribe` over channels `credentials-list`, `credentials-save`, `credentials-remove`, `credentials-undo-remove` and the broadcast `credentials-changed` `{ id, present, generation, fields }`. Every legacy secret save channel resolves to `{ success: boolean; error?: CredentialError }`. No result or event ever contains secret material.
- Produces (renderer, `src/stores/settingsStore.ts`):

```js
const { BYOK_API_KEYS } = require("../../../src/config/secretKeys");

// An in-memory stand-in for EnvironmentManager's credential surface: every
// getter the credential authority reads plus an awaitable persistSecret whose
// timing and failure a test controls through persistImpl. It records only the
// names it persisted, never the values.
const GETTERS = {
  ...Object.fromEntries(BYOK_API_KEYS.map((k) => [k.get, k.env])),
  getCortiClientId: "CORTI_CLIENT_ID",
  getCortiClientSecret: "CORTI_CLIENT_SECRET",
  getCustomTranscriptionKey: "CUSTOM_TRANSCRIPTION_API_KEY",
  getCleanupCustomKey: "CUSTOM_CLEANUP_API_KEY",
  getBedrockAccessKeyId: "BEDROCK_ACCESS_KEY_ID",
  getBedrockSecretAccessKey: "BEDROCK_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY",
  getBedrockSessionToken: "BEDROCK_SESSION_TOKEN",
  getBedrockProfile: "BEDROCK_PROFILE",
  getAzureApiKey: "AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY",
  getVertexApiKey: "VERTEX_API_KEY",
  getVertexProject: "VERTEX_PROJECT",
};

function fakeCredentialEnv(initial = {}) {
  const values = new Map(Object.entries(initial));
  const env = { values, persisted: [], persistImpl: null };
  for (const [getter, name] of Object.entries(GETTERS)) env[getter] = () => values.get(name) || "";
  env.getVertexAuthSource = () => {
    const source = values.get("VERTEX_AUTH_SOURCE");
    return source === "adc" || source === "apiKey" ? source : null;
  };
  // Main-only legacy SDK fallback. Credential presence still reports only the
  // stored VERTEX_API_KEY field; committed captures apply this fallback later.
  env.getLegacyVertexApiKey = () => values.get("GOOGLE_VERTEX_API_KEY") || "";
  env.persistSecret = async (name, value) => {
    env.persisted.push(name);
    if (env.persistImpl) await env.persistImpl(name, value);
    if (value) values.set(name, value);
    else values.delete(name);
  };
  return env;
}

// fs double for Codex presence: stat answers from `size` (null = no file) and
// any attempt to read the credential file fails the test.
function fakeCodexFs({ size = null } = {}) {
  const calls = [];
  return {
    calls,
    statSync(file) {
      calls.push(file);
      if (size === null) throw Object.assign(new Error("ENOENT"), { code: "ENOENT" });
      return { isFile: () => true, size };
    },
    readFileSync() {
      throw new Error("credential presence must never read auth.json");
    },
    promises: {
      readFile() {
        throw new Error("credential presence must never read auth.json");
      },
    },
  };
}

module.exports = { fakeCredentialEnv, fakeCodexFs };
```

```js
  const { CodexAppServer } = require("../../src/helpers/codexAppServer.js");
  const forbidden = [];
  const trap = (name) => () => {
    forbidden.push(name);
    throw new Error(`${name} must not run while listing credentials`);
  };
  const saved = {
    start: CodexAppServer.prototype.start,
    status: CodexAppServer.prototype.status,
    request: CodexAppServer.prototype.request,
    fetch: globalThis.fetch,
    spawn: childProcess.spawn,
    execFile: childProcess.execFile,
  };
  CodexAppServer.prototype.start = trap("CodexAppServer.start");
  CodexAppServer.prototype.status = trap("CodexAppServer.status");
  CodexAppServer.prototype.request = trap("CodexAppServer.request");
  globalThis.fetch = trap("fetch");
  childProcess.spawn = trap("spawn");
  childProcess.execFile = trap("execFile");
  t.after(() => {
    CodexAppServer.prototype.start = saved.start;
    CodexAppServer.prototype.status = saved.status;
    CodexAppServer.prototype.request = saved.request;
    globalThis.fetch = saved.fetch;
    childProcess.spawn = saved.spawn;
    childProcess.execFile = saved.execFile;
  });

  const authFile = path.join("/profile/codex", "auth.json");
  for (const [size, expected] of [
    [null, false],
    [2, false],
    [512, true],
  ]) {
    const { authority, fs } = setup({ codexSize: size });
    assert.equal(presence(authority.list()).codex, expected, `auth.json size ${size}`);
    assert.equal(authority.present("codex"), expected);
    assert.ok(fs.calls.length > 0 && fs.calls.every((file) => file === authFile));
    assert.equal(hasStoredAccount({ fs, codexHome: "/profile/codex" }), expected);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(forbidden, []);
});

// change-driving (I3): today _saveKey answers before the encrypted write.
test("a save resolves only after main persisted it, then bumps the generation and broadcasts", async () => {

  assert.deepEqual(broadcasts, []);

  assert.deepEqual(broadcasts, [

  ]);
});

test("undo after expiry, replacement or reset is refused and never resurrects the old key", async () => {

    assert.equal(env.values.has("OPENAI_API_KEY"), false);

    assert.equal(timers[0].ms, 8_000);
    timers[0].fn(); // the purge timer drops the value even if no clock check ever runs
    assert.deepEqual(await authority.undoRemove(undoToken), { ok: false, reason: "expired" });
  }

    const { authority, env } = setup({ initial: { OPENAI_API_KEY: SECRETS[0] } });

    assert.equal(env.values.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"), SECRETS[1]);

    await authority.reset();

    assert.equal(authority.generation("groq"), 1, "reset bumps every generation");
  }

    const { authority } = setup();
    assert.deepEqual(await authority.undoRemove("not-a-token"), { ok: false, reason: "unknown" });
  }
});

test("subscribers learn the cause of each change and can unsubscribe", async () => {
  const { authority } = setup({ initial: { OPENAI_API_KEY: SECRETS[0] } });

  await authority.undoRemove(undoToken);

});
```

Create `test/helpers/harness/realCredentialEnv.js`. R2-2/R2-4/R3-2 are races inside the real `EnvironmentManager` bodies. `_saveSecretKey` sets `process.env` first and then awaits `mkdir`/`writeFile`/`rename` (`src/helpers/environment.js:149-166`); `_deleteSecretKey` deletes and then awaits `unlink` (`:168-175`); `saveAllKeysToEnvFile` snapshots the environment, writes `.env.tmp`, renames it, then calls `dotenv.config` (`:482-487`); `clearAllPersistedData` clears `process.env` and then awaits `rm` (`:489-499`). This harness runs those exact method bodies in both encrypted and supported non-encrypted modes. It swaps the module's `fs/promises`, `electron`, `dotenv`, `./secretCrypto` and `./debugLogger`, and the swap applies to `environment.js` alone. No real profile, keychain or disk is touched.

```js
const Module = require("node:module");
const path = require("node:path");
const { deferred } = require("./deferred");

const ENV_MODULE = require.resolve("../../../src/helpers/environment.js");
// A path that is never created: every filesystem call goes to the fake below.
const USER_DATA = path.join(path.sep, "loqui-test-profile-never-on-disk");
const SECURE_KEYS = path.join(USER_DATA, "secure-keys");

// An in-memory fs/promises whose operations a test can hold (one at a time)
// and then release or fail, to stop the real persistence code mid-write.
function createDeferredFs() {
  const files = new Map();
  const log = [];
  const holds = [];
  let holdNext = null;
  const enoent = (file) => Object.assign(new Error(`ENOENT: ${file}`), { code: "ENOENT" });
  async function gate(op, file) {
    const name = path.basename(file);
    log.push(`${op} ${name}`);
    if (holdNext && holdNext(op, name)) {
      holdNext = null;
      const gateway = deferred();
      let rejectGate;
      const failed = new Promise((_resolve, reject) => (rejectGate = reject));
      holds.push({ op, name, release: () => gateway.resolve(), fail: (error) => rejectGate(error) });
      await Promise.race([gateway.promise, failed]);
    }
  }
  return {
    files,
    log,
    holdNext(predicate) {
      holdNext = predicate;
    },
    async nextHold() {
      while (holds.length === 0) await new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
      return holds.shift();
    },
    promises: {
      mkdir: async (dir) => gate("mkdir", dir),
      writeFile: async (file, data) => {
        await gate("writeFile", file);
        files.set(file, Buffer.from(data));
      },
      rename: async (from, to) => {
        await gate("rename", to);
        if (!files.has(from)) throw enoent(from);
        files.set(to, files.get(from));
        files.delete(from);
      },
      unlink: async (file) => {
        await gate("unlink", file);
        if (!files.delete(file)) throw enoent(file);
      },
      rm: async (target) => {
        await gate("rm", target);
        for (const file of [...files.keys()]) {
          if (file === target || file.startsWith(target + path.sep)) files.delete(file);
        }
      },
      readFile: async (file) => {
        if (!files.has(file)) throw enoent(file);
        return files.get(file);
      },
    },
  };
}

function loadEnvironmentManager(fakeFs, { encryptionAvailable = true } = {}) {
  const originalLoad = Module._load;
  Module._load = function loadForEnvironment(request, parent, isMain) {
    if (parent?.filename === ENV_MODULE) {
      if (request === "fs/promises") return fakeFs.promises;
      if (request === "electron") return { app: { getPath: () => USER_DATA } };
      if (request === "dotenv") {
        return {
          config: ({ path: envPath }) => {
            fakeFs.dotenvLoads.push(envPath);
            const bytes = fakeFs.files.get(envPath);
            if (!bytes) return {};
            for (const line of bytes.toString("utf8").split("\n")) {
              const match = line.match(/^([A-Z0-9_]+)=(.*)$/);
              if (match && process.env[match[1]] === undefined) process.env[match[1]] = match[2];
            }
            return {};
          },
        };
      }
      // Encryption "available", and ciphertext that never contains the value.
      if (request === "./secretCrypto") {
        return {
          isAvailable: () => encryptionAvailable,
          encrypt: (value) => Buffer.from(`sealed:${value.length}`),
          decrypt: () => {
            throw new Error("not used by these tests");
          },
        };
      }
      if (request === "./debugLogger") return new Proxy({}, { get: () => () => {} });
    }
    return originalLoad.call(this, request, parent, isMain);
  };
  try {
    delete require.cache[ENV_MODULE];
    return require(ENV_MODULE);
  } finally {
    Module._load = originalLoad;
    delete require.cache[ENV_MODULE];
  }
}

// The real EnvironmentManager prototype (persistSecret, _saveSecretKey,
// _deleteSecretKey, clearAllPersistedData and every getter) over the deferred
// fs. The constructor is skipped: it only loads dotenv files from disk.
function realCredentialEnv(t, initial = {}, options = {}) {
  const savedEnv = { ...process.env };
  t.after(() => {
    for (const name of Object.keys(process.env)) if (!(name in savedEnv)) delete process.env[name];
    Object.assign(process.env, savedEnv);
  });
  const fs = createDeferredFs();
  fs.dotenvLoads = [];
  const EnvironmentManager = loadEnvironmentManager(fs, options);
  const env = Object.create(EnvironmentManager.prototype);
  const secretFile = (name) => path.join(SECURE_KEYS, `${name}.enc`);
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(initial)) {
    process.env[name] = value;
    fs.files.set(secretFile(name), Buffer.from("sealed:initial"));
  }
  return {
    env,
    fs,
    dotenvLoads: fs.dotenvLoads,
    stored: (name) => fs.files.has(secretFile(name)),
    erase: () => env.clearAllPersistedData(),
  };
}

module.exports = { realCredentialEnv };
```

Create `test/helpers/credentialAuthorityRealEnv.test.js`:

```js
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const test = require("node:test");
const { realCredentialEnv } = require("./harness/realCredentialEnv");
const { fakeCodexFs } = require("./harness/fakeCredentialEnv");
const { createCredentialAuthority } = require("../../src/helpers/credentialAuthority.js");

const tick = () => new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
const isRename = (name) => (op, file) => op === "rename" && file === name;

function setup(t, initial, environmentOptions = {}) {
  const real = realCredentialEnv(t, initial, environmentOptions);
  const broadcasts = [];
  const authority = createCredentialAuthority({
    env: real.env,
    fs: fakeCodexFs(),
    codexHome: "/profile/codex",
    broadcast: (_channel, payload) => broadcasts.push(payload),
    setTimer: () => {},
  });
  return { ...real, authority, broadcasts };
}

// change-driving (R2-4): the real _saveSecretKey puts the value in process.env
// before its write (environment.js:155), and presence read process.env.
test("a first save that is still being written is not present anywhere", async (t) => {
  const { authority, env, fs, broadcasts, stored } = setup(t);
  fs.holdNext(isRename("OPENAI_API_KEY.enc"));
  const saving = authority.save("openai", "key", "sk-first-SECRET");
  const hold = await fs.nextHold();
  assert.equal(env.getOpenAIKey(), "sk-first-SECRET", "the real window: process.env already has it");
  assert.equal(authority.present("openai"), false);
  const row = authority.list().find((entry) => entry.id === "openai");
  assert.deepEqual([row.present, row.fields, row.generation], [false, { key: false }, 0]);
  assert.equal(stored("OPENAI_API_KEY"), false);
  assert.deepEqual(broadcasts, []);
  hold.release();
  assert.deepEqual(await saving, { ok: true, generation: 1 });
  assert.equal(authority.present("openai"), true);
  assert.equal(stored("OPENAI_API_KEY"), true);
  assert.deepEqual(broadcasts, [{ id: "openai", present: true, generation: 1, fields: { key: true } }]);
});

// change-driving (R2-4): a replacement that fails must never be what presence,
// a broadcast or a verification capture sees.
test("a failed replacement never shows the attempted key and keeps the committed one", async (t) => {
  const { authority, env, fs, broadcasts } = setup(t, { GROQ_API_KEY: "gsk-committed-SECRET" });
  fs.holdNext(isRename("GROQ_API_KEY.enc"));
  const replacing = authority.save("groq", "key", "gsk-attempt-SECRET");
  const hold = await fs.nextHold();
  assert.equal(env.getGroqKey(), "gsk-attempt-SECRET");
  const capture = authority.captureCommitted("groq"); // queued behind the write
  hold.fail(Object.assign(new Error("EIO"), { code: "EIO" }));
  assert.deepEqual(await replacing, { ok: false, error: "persistFailed" });
  assert.equal(env.getGroqKey(), "gsk-committed-SECRET", "persistSecret restored process.env");
  const captured = await capture;
  assert.equal(captured.generation, 0);
  assert.equal(captured.values.key, "gsk-committed-SECRET", "Verify tests the committed key");
  assert.equal(authority.present("groq"), true);
  assert.deepEqual(broadcasts, []);
});

// change-driving (R2-4): a capture waits for a pending replacement and then
// pairs the new value with the new generation.
test("a capture requested during a replacement tests the replacement under its own generation", async (t) => {
  const { authority, fs } = setup(t, { GROQ_API_KEY: "gsk-old-SECRET" });
  fs.holdNext(isRename("GROQ_API_KEY.enc"));
  const replacing = authority.save("groq", "key", "gsk-new-SECRET");
  const hold = await fs.nextHold();
  let settled = false;
  const capture = authority.captureCommitted("groq").then((value) => ((settled = true), value));
  await tick();
  assert.equal(settled, false, "no value is captured while a write is pending");
  hold.release();
  await replacing;
  assert.deepEqual(await capture, {
    generation: 1,
    present: true,
    values: { key: "gsk-new-SECRET" },
  });
});

// change-driving (R2-2): reset did not fence a write that was already running.
test("reset during a first save: the save fails, reset waits for it, and no key survives", async (t) => {
  const { authority, env, fs, stored, erase } = setup(t);
  fs.holdNext(isRename("OPENAI_API_KEY.enc"));
  const saving = authority.save("openai", "key", "sk-first-SECRET");
  const hold = await fs.nextHold();
  let erased = false;
  const resetting = authority.reset(async () => {
    await erase();
    erased = true;
  });
  await tick();
  assert.equal(erased, false, "nothing is erased while a write is still running");
  assert.deepEqual(await authority.save("groq", "key", "gsk-SECRET"), { ok: false, error: "reset" });
  hold.release();
  assert.deepEqual(await saving, { ok: false, error: "reset" }, "never reported as saved");
  await resetting;
  assert.equal(erased, true);
  assert.equal(stored("OPENAI_API_KEY"), false);
  assert.equal(env.getOpenAIKey(), "");
  assert.equal(authority.present("openai"), false);
  assert.ok(!fs.log.includes("writeFile GROQ_API_KEY.enc.tmp"), "a save during reset never writes");
});

// change-driving (R3-1/R3-2): the source itself is persisted through the same
// environment queue. A source save already in flight must not restore its old
// value from its rejection handler after reset erases process.env and `.env`.
test("reset during a pending Vertex source save never resurrects the prior source", async (t) => {
  const { authority, env, fs, erase } = setup(
    t,
    { VERTEX_AUTH_SOURCE: "apiKey", VERTEX_API_KEY: "fixture-vertex-key" },
    { encryptionAvailable: false }
  );
  fs.holdNext((op, name) => op === "writeFile" && name === ".env.tmp");
  const saving = env.saveVertexAuthSource("adc");
  const hold = await fs.nextHold();
  assert.equal(env.getVertexAuthSource(), "adc", "the pending source is materialized before its write");
  const resetting = authority.reset(erase);
  await tick();
  hold.release();
  await assert.rejects(saving, { code: "ENV_RESET" });
  await resetting;
  assert.equal(env.getVertexAuthSource(), null);
  assert.equal(process.env.VERTEX_AUTH_SOURCE, undefined, "the rejected source handler cannot restore the old mode");
  assert.equal(env.getVertexApiKey(), "");
  assert.equal(
    [...fs.files.keys()].some((file) => file.endsWith("/.env") || file.endsWith("/.env.tmp")),
    false,
    "the source and secret are absent from persisted files after reset returns"
  );
});

// change-driving (R3-2): the production `save-all-keys-to-env` channel bypasses
// credentialAuthority's per-slot queues. In the supported non-encrypted mode,
// saveAllKeysToEnvFile snapshots the secret into .env.tmp before its first await.
test("reset fences and drains the independent plaintext .env writer", async (t) => {
  const { authority, env, fs, erase, dotenvLoads } = setup(
    t,
    { OPENAI_API_KEY: "sk-env-queued-SECRET" },
    { encryptionAvailable: false }
  );
  fs.holdNext((op, name) => op === "writeFile" && name === ".env.tmp");
  const writing = env.saveAllKeysToEnvFile(); // same body as save-all-keys-to-env IPC
  const hold = await fs.nextHold();
  const queued = env.saveAllKeysToEnvFile();
  const queuedRefused = assert.rejects(queued, { code: "ENV_RESET" });
  let resetSettled = false;
  const resetting = authority.reset(erase).then(() => (resetSettled = true));
  await tick();
  assert.equal(resetSettled, false, "reset waits for the active non-authority writer");
  await assert.rejects(env.saveAllKeysToEnvFile(), { code: "ENV_RESET" }, "new .env writes are fenced");
  await assert.rejects(env.removeKeyFromEnvFile("OPENAI_API_KEY"), { code: "ENV_RESET" });
  hold.release();
  await assert.rejects(writing, { code: "ENV_RESET" }, "invalidated write cannot report success or reload dotenv");
  await resetting;
  await queuedRefused;
  assert.equal(fs.log.filter((entry) => entry === "writeFile .env.tmp").length, 1,
    "the queued independent writer never starts");
  assert.equal(process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY, undefined);
  assert.equal(authority.present("openai"), false);
  assert.deepEqual(dotenvLoads, [], "an invalidated .env snapshot is never loaded back into process.env");
  assert.equal(
    [...fs.files.keys()].some((file) => file.endsWith("/.env") || file.endsWith("/.env.tmp")),
    false,
    "neither the old .env snapshot nor its temp file survives reset"
  );
});

// change-driving: a failed atomic rename can leave plaintext in the temp file.
test("reset removes plaintext .env.tmp left by a failed active rename", async (t) => {
  const { authority, env, fs, erase, dotenvLoads } = setup(
    t, { OPENAI_API_KEY: "sk-temp-SECRET" }, { encryptionAvailable: false }
  );
  fs.holdNext((op, name) => op === "rename" && name === ".env");
  const writing = env.saveAllKeysToEnvFile();
  const rejected = assert.rejects(writing, /rename failed/);
  const hold = await fs.nextHold();
  assert.equal([...fs.files.keys()].some((file) => file.endsWith("/.env.tmp")), true);
  const resetting = authority.reset(erase);
  hold.fail(new Error("rename failed"));
  await rejected;
  await resetting;
  assert.equal([...fs.files.keys()].some((file) => file.endsWith("/.env.tmp")), false);
  assert.equal(env.getOpenAIKey(), "");
  assert.deepEqual(dotenvLoads, []);
});

// change-driving: a second reset cannot release the first reset's fence.
test("overlapping credential resets refuse the second caller and keep writes fenced", async (t) => {
  const { authority, erase } = setup(t);
  let releaseErase;
  let enteredErase;
  const entered = new Promise((resolve) => (enteredErase = resolve));
  const held = new Promise((resolve) => (releaseErase = resolve));
  const first = authority.reset(async () => {
    enteredErase();
    await held;
    await erase();
  });
  await entered;
  await assert.rejects(authority.reset(), /reset already in progress/);
  assert.deepEqual(await authority.save("groq", "key", "gsk-refused"), { ok: false, error: "reset" });
  releaseErase();
  await first;
  assert.deepEqual(await authority.save("groq", "key", "gsk-after"), { ok: true, generation: 2 });
});

// change-driving: an erase failure must still await every other erase operation.
test("failed environment erase holds the write fence until every deletion settles", async (t) => {
  const { env, fs } = setup(t);
  const rm = fs.promises.rm;
  fs.promises.rm = async (target, options) => {
    if (target.endsWith("/.env")) throw new Error("EACCES: .env");
    return rm(target, options);
  };
  fs.holdNext((op, name) => op === "rm" && name === "secure-keys");
  let settled = false;
  const resetting = env.clearAllPersistedData();
  const rejected = assert.rejects(resetting, /Environment erase failed/).then(() => (settled = true));
  const hold = await fs.nextHold();
  await tick();
  assert.equal(settled, false);
  await assert.rejects(env.saveAllKeysToEnvFile(), { code: "ENV_RESET" });
  hold.release();
  await rejected;
  assert.equal((await env.saveAllKeysToEnvFile()).success, true, "the fence is released after all erases settle");
});

// change-driving (R2-2): a queued replacement used to run after the erase.
test("reset during a queued replacement: the queued write never starts and nothing survives", async (t) => {
  const { authority, env, fs, stored, erase } = setup(t, { OPENAI_API_KEY: "sk-old-SECRET" });
  fs.holdNext(isRename("OPENAI_API_KEY.enc"));
  const first = authority.save("openai", "key", "sk-one-SECRET");
  const hold = await fs.nextHold();
  const second = authority.save("openai", "key", "sk-two-SECRET");
  const resetting = authority.reset(erase);
  hold.release();
  assert.deepEqual(await first, { ok: false, error: "reset" });
  assert.deepEqual(await second, { ok: false, error: "reset" });
  await resetting;
  assert.equal(
    fs.log.filter((entry) => entry === "writeFile OPENAI_API_KEY.enc.tmp").length,
    1,
    "only the first write ever started"
  );
  assert.equal(stored("OPENAI_API_KEY"), false);
  assert.equal(env.getOpenAIKey(), "");
});

// change-driving (R2-2): an Undo that passed its token check could restore the
// key after Reset Loqui deleted it, and report success.
test("reset during Undo of a two-field credential: Undo fails and neither field comes back", async (t) => {
  const { authority, env, fs, stored, erase } = setup(t, {
    CORTI_CLIENT_ID: "cid-SECRET",
    CORTI_CLIENT_SECRET: "csec-SECRET",
  });
  const removed = await authority.remove("corti:speech");
  assert.equal(removed.ok, true);
  fs.holdNext(isRename("CORTI_CLIENT_ID.enc"));
  const undoing = authority.undoRemove(removed.undoToken);
  const hold = await fs.nextHold();
  const mark = fs.log.length;
  const resetting = authority.reset(erase);
  hold.release();
  assert.deepEqual(await undoing, { ok: false, reason: "unknown" });
  await resetting;
  assert.ok(
    !fs.log.slice(mark).includes("writeFile CORTI_CLIENT_SECRET.enc.tmp"),
    "the second field is never written after the reset began"
  );
  assert.equal(stored("CORTI_CLIENT_ID"), false);
  assert.equal(stored("CORTI_CLIENT_SECRET"), false);
  assert.equal(env.getCortiClientId(), "");
  assert.equal(authority.present("corti:speech"), false);
  assert.deepEqual(await authority.undoRemove(removed.undoToken), { ok: false, reason: "unknown" });
});

// change-driving (R2-2): a failed erase is reported, and the fence comes down.
test("a failed erase rejects reset and leaves the authority usable", async (t) => {
  const { authority } = setup(t);
  await assert.rejects(
    authority.reset(async () => {
      throw new Error("rm failed");
    }),
    /rm failed/
  );
  assert.deepEqual(await authority.save("groq", "key", "gsk-after"), { ok: true, generation: 2 });
});
```

`generation: 2` in the last test is right: `reset` bumps every slot once (to 1), and the save bumps `groq` to 2.

```js
const test = require("node:test");
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const { createRendererServer, installBrowserGlobals } = require("../lib/rendererTestHarness");
const { deferred } = require("../helpers/harness/deferred");

const SECRET = "sk-live-SECRET-value";

function fakeCredentials() {
  const calls = [];
  let respond = () => ({ ok: true, generation: 1 });
  let listener = null;
  return {
    calls,
    respond(fn) {
      respond = fn;
    },
    emit(change) {
      listener(change);
    },
    api: {
      save: async (id, field, value) => {
        calls.push([id, field, value]);
        return respond(id, field, value);
      },
      onChanged(callback) {
        listener = callback;
        return () => {
          listener = null;
        };
      },
    },
  };
}

test("secret setters wait for main's acknowledgement", async (t) => {
  const creds = fakeCredentials();
  installBrowserGlobals(t, {
    window: { electronAPI: { credentials: creds.api }, dispatchEvent() {} },
  });
  const vite = await createRendererServer(t, {
    cachePrefix: "loqui-secret-ack-test-",
    mockModules: {
      "/services/ReasoningService": "export default { clearApiKeyCache() {} };",
    },
  });
  const load = async () => {
    vite.moduleGraph.invalidateAll();
    return vite.ssrLoadModule("/stores/settingsStore.ts");
  };

  // change-driving: today the setter writes the raw key into zustand at once.
  await t.test("a slow save keeps the raw key out of the store until main acknowledges", async () => {
    const { useSettingsStore } = await load();
    const gate = deferred();
    creds.respond(() => gate.promise);
    const seen = [];
    const stop = useSettingsStore.subscribe((state) => seen.push(state.openaiApiKey));
    const pending = useSettingsStore.getState().setOpenaiApiKey(SECRET);
    assert.equal(useSettingsStore.getState().openaiApiKey, "");
    gate.resolve({ ok: true, generation: 1 });
    assert.deepEqual(await pending, { ok: true });
    assert.equal(useSettingsStore.getState().openaiApiKey, "__stored__");
    assert.ok(!seen.includes(SECRET), "the raw key never entered renderer state");
    assert.deepEqual(creds.calls.at(-1), ["openai", "key", SECRET]);
    stop();
  });

  // change-driving: today failures are only logged and the setter returns nothing.
  await t.test("a failed save keeps the previous presence and returns the error", async () => {
    const { useSettingsStore } = await load();
    useSettingsStore.setState({ groqApiKey: "__stored__" });
    creds.respond(() => ({ ok: false, error: "persistFailed" }));
    assert.deepEqual(await useSettingsStore.getState().setGroqApiKey("gsk-new"), {
      ok: false,
      error: "persistFailed",
    });
    assert.equal(useSettingsStore.getState().groqApiKey, "__stored__");
    creds.respond(() => Promise.reject(new Error("ipc down")));
    assert.deepEqual(await useSettingsStore.getState().setGroqApiKey(""), {
      ok: false,
      error: "persistFailed",
    });
    assert.equal(useSettingsStore.getState().groqApiKey, "__stored__");
  });

  // change-driving: an older acknowledgement must not overwrite a newer save.
  await t.test("a replacement save is not undone by a slower earlier acknowledgement", async () => {
    const { useSettingsStore } = await load();
    const removal = deferred();
    const replacement = deferred();
    creds.respond((_id, _field, value) => (value === "" ? removal.promise : replacement.promise));
    const removing = useSettingsStore.getState().setMistralApiKey("");
    const replacing = useSettingsStore.getState().setMistralApiKey("mk-new");
    replacement.resolve({ ok: true, generation: 2 });
    await replacing;
    assert.equal(useSettingsStore.getState().mistralApiKey, "__stored__");
    removal.resolve({ ok: true, generation: 1 });
    await removing;
    assert.equal(useSettingsStore.getState().mistralApiKey, "__stored__");
  });

  // change-driving: flushSecretSaves does not exist.
  await t.test("flushSecretSaves waits for every pending save", async () => {
    const { useSettingsStore, flushSecretSaves } = await load();
    const gate = deferred();
    creds.respond(() => gate.promise);
    void useSettingsStore.getState().setAnthropicApiKey("sk-ant");
    let flushed = false;
    const flushing = flushSecretSaves().then(() => (flushed = true));
    await new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
    assert.equal(flushed, false);
    gate.resolve({ ok: true, generation: 1 });
    await flushing;
    assert.equal(flushed, true);
    await flushSecretSaves();
  });

  // change-driving (I10): Corti text and speech are separate main identities.
  await t.test("each secret field is saved to its own main credential slot", async () => {
    const { useSettingsStore } = await load();
    creds.respond(() => ({ ok: true, generation: 1 }));
    for (const [setter, id, field] of [
      ["setCortiApiKey", "corti:text", "key"],
      ["setCortiClientId", "corti:speech", "clientId"],
      ["setCortiClientSecret", "corti:speech", "clientSecret"],
      ["setCustomTranscriptionApiKey", "custom:transcription", "key"],
      ["setCleanupCustomApiKey", "custom:dictationCleanup", "key"],
      ["setChatAgentCustomApiKey", "custom:chatIntelligence", "key"],
      ["setBedrockAccessKeyId", "bedrock", "accessKeyId"],
      ["setBedrockSessionToken", "bedrock", "sessionToken"],
      ["setAzureApiKey", "azure", "key"],
      ["setVertexApiKey", "vertex", "key"],
    ]) {
      assert.deepEqual(await useSettingsStore.getState()[setter]("v"), { ok: true }, setter);
      assert.deepEqual(creds.calls.at(-1), [id, field, "v"], setter);
    }
  });

  // change-driving: other windows learn about saves and removals from main.
  await t.test("credentials-changed from main updates every matching sentinel", async () => {
    const { useSettingsStore, subscribeCredentialChanges } = await load();
    useSettingsStore.setState({ cortiClientId: "", cortiClientSecret: "__stored__" });
    const stop = subscribeCredentialChanges();
    creds.emit({
      id: "corti:speech",
      present: false,
      generation: 4,
      fields: { clientId: true, clientSecret: false },
    });
    assert.equal(useSettingsStore.getState().cortiClientId, "__stored__");
    assert.equal(useSettingsStore.getState().cortiClientSecret, "");
    creds.emit({ id: "corti:text", present: true, generation: 1, fields: { key: true } });
    assert.equal(useSettingsStore.getState().cortiApiKey, "__stored__");
    const before = useSettingsStore.getState();
    creds.emit({ id: "codex", present: true, generation: 0, fields: {} });
    assert.equal(useSettingsStore.getState(), before, "no store slot for codex");
    stop();
  });
});
```
