   ```ts
   import type { CredentialId } from "./routeGraph";

   // Main's credential slots (src/helpers/credentialAuthority.js): the 16
   // CredentialIds plus the seven custom-endpoint keys, named like the
   // personal-inference credential refs (main.js credentialSlot).
   export type CustomCredentialSlot =
     | "custom:transcription"
     | "custom:dictationCleanup"
     | "custom:noteFormatting"
     | "custom:dictationTranslation"
     | "custom:dictationAgent"
     | "custom:dictationAgentVision"
     | "custom:chatIntelligence";
   export type CredentialSlot = CredentialId | CustomCredentialSlot;
   export type CredentialField =
     | "key"
     | "clientId"
     | "clientSecret"
     | "accessKeyId"
     | "secretAccessKey"
     | "sessionToken";

   /** What an acknowledged secret save resolves to (Task 2). */
   export interface SecretSaveResult {
     ok: boolean;
     error?: string;
   }

   export const CUSTOM_CREDENTIAL_SLOTS: readonly CustomCredentialSlot[] = [
     "custom:transcription",
     "custom:dictationCleanup",
     "custom:noteFormatting",
     "custom:dictationTranslation",
     "custom:dictationAgent",
     "custom:dictationAgentVision",
     "custom:chatIntelligence",
   ];

   // One credential stored in several fields. Remove takes the whole credential
   // (main's remove clears every field) and Undo restores every field. There is
   // no per-field removal: half a Corti client pair or half a Bedrock key pair
   // is not a usable credential.
   export const MULTI_FIELD_CREDENTIALS: ReadonlySet<CredentialSlot> = new Set<CredentialSlot>([
     "corti:speech",
     "bedrock",
   ]);

   // Store field → main slot and field. Corti text and speech are separate
   // identities: different credentials.
   export const SECRET_STORE_SLOTS = {
     openaiApiKey: ["openai", "key"],
     anthropicApiKey: ["anthropic", "key"],
     geminiApiKey: ["gemini", "key"],
     groqApiKey: ["groq", "key"],
     xaiApiKey: ["xai", "key"],
     mistralApiKey: ["mistral", "key"],
     openrouterApiKey: ["openrouter", "key"],
     tinfoilApiKey: ["tinfoil", "key"],
     deepgramApiKey: ["deepgram", "key"],
     assemblyaiApiKey: ["assemblyai", "key"],
     cortiApiKey: ["corti:text", "key"],
     cortiClientId: ["corti:speech", "clientId"],
     cortiClientSecret: ["corti:speech", "clientSecret"],
     customTranscriptionApiKey: ["custom:transcription", "key"],
     cleanupCustomApiKey: ["custom:dictationCleanup", "key"],
     noteFormattingCustomApiKey: ["custom:noteFormatting", "key"],
     translationCustomApiKey: ["custom:dictationTranslation", "key"],
     dictationAgentCustomApiKey: ["custom:dictationAgent", "key"],
     dictationAgentVisionCustomApiKey: ["custom:dictationAgentVision", "key"],
     chatAgentCustomApiKey: ["custom:chatIntelligence", "key"],
     bedrockAccessKeyId: ["bedrock", "accessKeyId"],
     bedrockSecretAccessKey: ["bedrock", "secretAccessKey"],
     bedrockSessionToken: ["bedrock", "sessionToken"],
     azureApiKey: ["azure", "key"],
     vertexApiKey: ["vertex", "key"],
   } as const satisfies Record<string, readonly [CredentialSlot, CredentialField]>;

   export type SecretStoreKey = keyof typeof SECRET_STORE_SLOTS;

   export function credentialSlotForStoreKey(storeKey: string): CredentialSlot | undefined {
     return Object.hasOwn(SECRET_STORE_SLOTS, storeKey)
       ? SECRET_STORE_SLOTS[storeKey as SecretStoreKey][0]
       : undefined;
   }

   export function isSecretStoreKey(key: string): key is SecretStoreKey {
     return Object.hasOwn(SECRET_STORE_SLOTS, key);
   }

   const REF_SLOTS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set<string>([
     ...Object.values(SECRET_STORE_SLOTS).map(([slot]) => slot),
     ...CUSTOM_CREDENTIAL_SLOTS,
   ]);

   // A personal-inference credential ref (OpenAICompatiblePanel's credentialRef,
   // main.js credentialSlot) → its slot. "corti" is the Corti text key, as in
   // the BYOK table; anything unknown has no slot, so it gets no Remove.
   export function credentialSlotForRef(ref: string | undefined): CredentialSlot | undefined {
     if (!ref) return undefined;
     if (ref === "corti") return "corti:text";
     return REF_SLOTS.has(ref) ? (ref as CredentialSlot) : undefined;
   }

   // For a key field whose owner has nowhere to save it (an optional callback
   // that was not passed). Never writes; the field keeps the draft and says so.
   export const unavailableSecretSave = async (_value: string): Promise<SecretSaveResult> => ({
     ok: false,
     error: "unavailable",
   });
   ```

1. Create `src/helpers/credentialAuthority.js`:

   ```js
   const path = require("node:path");
   const crypto = require("node:crypto");
   const { BYOK_API_KEYS } = require("../config/secretKeys");

   // Main-owned credential authority (Plan 03 Task 2). Main persists, then
   // acknowledges; renderers only ever learn presence, a per-identity generation
   // and an opaque undo token. Secret values leave this module only toward the
   // environment manager that stores them and, through captureCommitted, toward
   // main's keyring Verify (Task 11). Neither path crosses IPC.

   const UNDO_MS = 8000;
   const MAX_SECRET_LENGTH = 8192; // same cap as personal-inference:credential-save
   const STORED_SENTINEL = "__stored__";

   // The identities route facts reason about (CredentialId in src/lib/routeGraph.ts).
   const CREDENTIAL_IDS = [
     "openai",
     "anthropic",
     "gemini",
     "groq",
     "xai",
     "mistral",
     "openrouter",
     "tinfoil",
     "deepgram",
     "assemblyai",
     "corti:text",
     "corti:speech",
     "codex",
     "bedrock",
     "azure",
     "vertex",
   ];

   // Per-scope custom-endpoint keys use the personal-inference credential ref
   // names (main.js credentialSlot), so one slot id means one secret everywhere.
   const BYOK_CUSTOM_SLOTS = {
     "note-formatting-custom": "custom:noteFormatting",
     "translation-custom": "custom:dictationTranslation",
     "dictation-agent-custom": "custom:dictationAgent",
     "dictation-agent-vision-custom": "custom:dictationAgentVision",
     "chat-agent-custom": "custom:chatIntelligence",
   };

   function byokSlotId(base) {
     if (base === "corti") return "corti:text";
     return BYOK_CUSTOM_SLOTS[base] || base;
   }

   const field = (env, get) => ({ env, get });

   const SLOTS = {
     ...Object.fromEntries(
       BYOK_API_KEYS.map((k) => [byokSlotId(k.base), { fields: { key: field(k.env, k.get) } }])
     ),
     "corti:speech": {
       fields: {
         clientId: field("CORTI_CLIENT_ID", "getCortiClientId"),
         clientSecret: field("CORTI_CLIENT_SECRET", "getCortiClientSecret"),
       },
       // Speech authenticates with the client-credentials pair (_mintStoredCortiToken).
       present: (stored) => stored.clientId && stored.clientSecret,
     },
     bedrock: {
       fields: {
         accessKeyId: field("BEDROCK_ACCESS_KEY_ID", "getBedrockAccessKeyId"),
         secretAccessKey: field("BEDROCK_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY", "getBedrockSecretAccessKey"),
         sessionToken: field("BEDROCK_SESSION_TOKEN", "getBedrockSessionToken"),
       },
       // The SDK factory requires both static fields; profile auth is independent.
       present: (stored, env) =>
         !!env.getBedrockProfile() || (stored.accessKeyId && stored.secretAccessKey),
     },
     azure: { fields: { key: field("AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY", "getAzureApiKey") } },
     vertex: {
       fields: { key: field("VERTEX_API_KEY", "getVertexApiKey") },
       // This is readiness only. It never selects the request host: the
       // persisted source does. ADC needs a project; apiKey uses the committed
       // stored value before the legacy GOOGLE_VERTEX_API_KEY fallback.
       present: (stored, env) => env.getVertexAuthSource() === "apiKey"
         ? !!stored.key || Boolean(env.getLegacyVertexApiKey())
         : Boolean(env.getVertexProject().trim()),
     },
     "custom:transcription": {
       fields: { key: field("CUSTOM_TRANSCRIPTION_API_KEY", "getCustomTranscriptionKey") },
     },
     "custom:dictationCleanup": {
       fields: { key: field("CUSTOM_CLEANUP_API_KEY", "getCleanupCustomKey") },
     },
   };

   function slotForCredentialRef(ref) {
     if (typeof ref !== "string") return null;
     if (ref === "azure" || ref === "vertex") return { id: ref, field: "key" };
     if (ref.startsWith("custom:")) return SLOTS[ref] ? { id: ref, field: "key" } : null;
     const byok = BYOK_API_KEYS.find((k) => k.base === ref);
     return byok ? { id: byokSlotId(byok.base), field: "key" } : null;
   }

   // Codex keeps its sign-in in <CODEX_HOME>/auth.json (cli_auth_credentials_store
   // "file", codexAppServer.js). Presence is a stat: no read, no app server, no
   // release verification, no network.
   function hasStoredAccount({ fs, codexHome }) {
     try {
       const stat = fs.statSync(path.join(codexHome, "auth.json"));
       return stat.isFile() && stat.size > 2;
     } catch {
       return false;
     }
   }

   // Thrown inside a write to stop it once a reset began; never leaves the module.
   class ResetBarrier extends Error {}

   function createCredentialAuthority({
     env,
     codexHome,
     fs,
     broadcast = () => {},
     now = Date.now,
     undoMs = UNDO_MS,
     setTimer = (fn, ms) => setTimeout(fn, ms).unref?.(),
     randomToken = () => crypto.randomBytes(18).toString("base64url"),
   }) {
     const generations = new Map();
     const queues = new Map();
     const undoEntries = new Map(); // token → { id, generation, values | null, expiresAt }
     const listeners = new Set();
     // R2-4. EnvironmentManager._saveSecretKey sets process.env before its
     // awaited mkdir/write/rename (environment.js:155-165), and every getter
     // reads process.env. While a slot is being written, presence and values
     // come from the snapshot taken just before the write, so nothing sees a
     // key main has not acknowledged. persistSecret restores process.env when a
     // write fails, so between writes the live getters are the committed state.
     const committed = new Map(); // slot id → { [field]: value }, main memory only
     // R2-2. reset() raises the fence and moves the epoch. Work requested while
     // fenced is refused; work queued or running under an older epoch returns a
     // failure, and a running write stops before its next field.
     let epoch = 0;
     let fenced = false;

     const generation = (id) => generations.get(id) || 0;
     const bump = (id) => {
       const next = generation(id) + 1;
       generations.set(id, next);
       return next;
     };
     const liveValues = (id) =>
       Object.fromEntries(
         Object.entries(SLOTS[id].fields).map(([name, f]) => [name, env[f.get]() || ""])
       );
     // Main-only effective snapshot for migration and Verify. The persisted
     // slot key wins; only its absence allows the supported legacy SDK fallback.
     // `fieldsOf` remains stored-slot presence, so renderers never mistake the
     // fallback for a saved credential field.
     const committedValues = (id) => {
       const values = liveValues(id);
       if (id === "vertex" && !values.key) {
         const fallback = env.getLegacyVertexApiKey?.() || "";
         if (fallback) return { ...values, key: fallback };
       }
       return values;
     };
     const fieldsOf = (id) =>
       Object.fromEntries(
         Object.entries(committed.get(id) || liveValues(id)).map(([name, value]) => [name, !!value])
       );
     const present = (id) => {
       if (id === "codex") return hasStoredAccount({ fs, codexHome });
       if (!SLOTS[id]) return false;
       const stored = fieldsOf(id);
       return SLOTS[id].present
         ? !!SLOTS[id].present(stored, env)
         : Object.values(stored).some(Boolean);
     };
     const snapshot = (id) => ({
       id,
       present: present(id),
       generation: generation(id),
       fields: id === "codex" ? {} : fieldsOf(id),
     });
     const emit = (id, cause) => {
       const change = snapshot(id);
       broadcast("credentials-changed", change);
       for (const listener of listeners) {
         try {
           listener({ ...change, cause });
         } catch {}
       }
     };
     // A write succeeded: drop the pre-write snapshot first, so the broadcast
     // and every later read show the newly committed state.
     const publish = (id, cause) => {
       committed.delete(id);
       const next = bump(id);
       emit(id, cause);
       return next;
     };
     // One task at a time per slot, in call order, so a replacement save can
     // never be overtaken by the save it replaces.
     const enqueue = (id, task) => {
       const run = (queues.get(id) || Promise.resolve()).then(task);
       queues.set(id, run.catch(() => {}));
       return run;
     };
     // A mutation of one slot. Resolves null when a reset began after it was
     // requested; `stale()` turns true from that moment.
     const mutate = (id, task) => {
       if (fenced) return Promise.resolve(null);
       const taskEpoch = epoch;
       const stale = () => taskEpoch !== epoch;
       return enqueue(id, async () => {
         if (stale()) return null; // queued before the reset: never written
         committed.set(id, liveValues(id));
         try {
           return await task(stale);
         } finally {
           committed.delete(id);
         }
       });
     };
     const persist = async (id, values, stale) => {
       for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
         if (stale()) throw new ResetBarrier();
         await env.persistSecret(SLOTS[id].fields[name].env, value);
       }
     };
     const fail = (error) => ({ ok: false, error });
     const slotError = (id) => (id === "codex" ? "unsupported" : "unknownCredential");

     function save(id, fieldName, value) {
       if (!SLOTS[id]) return Promise.resolve(fail(slotError(id)));
       if (!SLOTS[id].fields[fieldName]) return Promise.resolve(fail("unknownField"));
       if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length > MAX_SECRET_LENGTH) {
         return Promise.resolve(fail("invalidValue"));
       }
       // The renderer echoes the sentinel back for an unchanged key; never store it.
       if (value === STORED_SENTINEL) return Promise.resolve({ ok: true, generation: generation(id) });
       return mutate(id, async (stale) => {
         try {
           await persist(id, { [fieldName]: value.trim() }, stale);
         } catch {
           return stale() ? null : fail("persistFailed");
         }
         // Persisted, but a reset began meanwhile and will erase it: not a save.
         if (stale()) return null;
         return { ok: true, generation: publish(id, "save") };
       }).then((result) => result || fail("reset"));
     }

     // Removes every field of the slot (a two-field credential is removed whole)
     // and keeps the values in main memory for the Undo window.
     function remove(id) {
       if (!SLOTS[id]) return Promise.resolve(fail(slotError(id)));
       return mutate(id, async (stale) => {
         const values = {};
         for (const [name, stored] of Object.entries(committed.get(id))) {
           if (stored) values[name] = stored;
         }
         if (Object.keys(values).length === 0) return fail("notStored");
         const cleared = {};
         try {
           for (const name of Object.keys(values)) {
             if (stale()) throw new ResetBarrier();
             await env.persistSecret(SLOTS[id].fields[name].env, "");
             cleared[name] = values[name];
           }
         } catch {
           // A reset is erasing everything: never write a removed value back.
           if (stale()) return null;
           await persist(id, cleared, stale).catch(() => {});
           return fail("persistFailed");
         }
         if (stale()) return null;
         const undoToken = randomToken();
         const expiresAt = now() + undoMs;
         const entry = { id, generation: generation(id) + 1, values, expiresAt };
         undoEntries.set(undoToken, entry);
         // The removed value must not outlive the Undo window in memory.
         setTimer(() => {
           entry.values = null;
         }, undoMs);
         const next = publish(id, "remove");
         return { ok: true, undoToken, expiresAt, generation: next };
       }).then((result) => result || fail("reset"));
     }

     function undoRemove(token) {
       const entry = typeof token === "string" ? undoEntries.get(token) : undefined;
       if (!entry) return Promise.resolve({ ok: false, reason: "unknown" });
       return mutate(entry.id, async (stale) => {
         if (undoEntries.get(token) !== entry) return { ok: false, reason: "unknown" };
         if (!entry.values || now() >= entry.expiresAt) {
           entry.values = null;
           return { ok: false, reason: "expired" };
         }
         if (generation(entry.id) !== entry.generation) {
           entry.values = null;
           return { ok: false, reason: "replaced" };
         }
         try {
           await persist(entry.id, entry.values, stale);
         } catch {
           return stale() ? null : { ok: false, reason: "persistFailed" };
         }
         if (stale()) return null; // restored, but the reset erases it: Undo failed
         undoEntries.delete(token);
         entry.values = null;
         return { ok: true, generation: publish(entry.id, "undo") };
       }).then((result) => result || { ok: false, reason: "unknown" });
     }

     // Task 11 Verify (R2-4). Queued behind every save, removal and Undo already
     // requested for the slot, so it reads the committed value together with the
     // generation that value belongs to. Main-only: the values never cross IPC.
     function captureCommitted(id) {
       if (!SLOTS[id] || fenced) return Promise.resolve(null);
       const taskEpoch = epoch;
       return enqueue(id, async () => {
         if (taskEpoch !== epoch) return null;
         return { generation: generation(id), present: present(id), values: committedValues(id) };
       });
     }

     // R2-2. Reset Loqui must leave no credential behind. Fence new work and
     // move the epoch (queued work returns without writing); forget every Undo
     // value; bump every generation, which discards verifications in flight
     // (Task 11); wait for the write in flight; and only then erase.
     async function reset(erase = async () => {}) {
       // A second caller must not lower the first reset's fence in its finally.
       if (fenced) throw new Error("Credential reset already in progress");
       fenced = true;
       epoch += 1;
       for (const entry of undoEntries.values()) entry.values = null;
       undoEntries.clear();
       const ids = [...Object.keys(SLOTS), "codex"];
       for (const id of ids) bump(id);
       let failure = null;
       try {
         await Promise.allSettled([...queues.values()]);
         await erase();
       } catch (error) {
         failure = error;
       } finally {
         committed.clear();
         fenced = false;
       }
       for (const id of ids) emit(id, "reset");
       if (failure) throw failure;
     }

     function refresh(id) {
       if (id === "codex" || SLOTS[id]) emit(id, "refresh");
     }

     return {
       list: () => CREDENTIAL_IDS.map(snapshot),
       present,
       generation,
       save,
       remove,
       undoRemove,
       captureCommitted,
       reset,
       refresh,
       subscribe(listener) {
         listeners.add(listener);
         return () => listeners.delete(listener);
       },
     };
   }

   module.exports = {
     UNDO_MS,
     CREDENTIAL_IDS,
     byokSlotId,
     slotForCredentialRef,
     hasStoredAccount,
     createCredentialAuthority,
   };
   ```

2. In `src/helpers/environment.js`, replace the module-level `.env` queue (`:64`) with an epoch-aware admission fence, and route every `.env` writer through it:

   Add `const dotenv = require("dotenv");` beside the imports and replace every `require("dotenv").config(...)` with `dotenv.config(...)`. Capturing the dependency when the module loads lets the real-environment harness replace it for the lifetime of the instance, including calls made after `Module._load` is restored.

   ```js
   let envWriteQueue = Promise.resolve();
   let envWriteEpoch = 0;
   let envWriteFenced = false;

   function environmentResetError() {
     return Object.assign(new Error("Environment persistence is resetting"), { code: "ENV_RESET" });
   }

   function enqueueEnvWrite(write) {
     if (envWriteFenced) return Promise.reject(environmentResetError());
     const epoch = envWriteEpoch;
     const queued = envWriteQueue.catch(() => {}).then(async () => {
       if (envWriteFenced || epoch !== envWriteEpoch) return false; // invalidated while queued
       await write();
       return true;
     });
     envWriteQueue = queued;
     return queued;
   }

   const ENTERPRISE_ROUTE_ENV_KEYS = Object.freeze({
     bedrockRegion: "BEDROCK_REGION",
     azureEndpoint: "AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT",
     vertexProject: "VERTEX_PROJECT",
     vertexLocation: "VERTEX_LOCATION",
     vertexAuthSource: "VERTEX_AUTH_SOURCE",
   });
   const ENTERPRISE_ROUTE_KEYS = Object.keys(ENTERPRISE_ROUTE_ENV_KEYS);

   function isEnterpriseRouteSettings(value) {
     return value !== null && typeof value === "object" &&
       ENTERPRISE_ROUTE_KEYS.every((key) =>
         Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(value, key) &&
         typeof value[key] === "string" &&
       !/[\r\n\0]/.test(value[key]) &&
         (key !== "vertexAuthSource" || value[key] === "adc" || value[key] === "apiKey")
       ) &&
       Object.keys(value).every((key) => ENTERPRISE_ROUTE_KEYS.includes(key));
   }
   ```

   `_writeEnvFileAtomic(envPath)` becomes `return enqueueEnvWrite(() => this._writeEnvFile(envPath));`. Extend `_writeEnvFile(envPath, explicitValues = {})` so each persisted key uses an own property from `explicitValues` when present, otherwise `process.env[key]`; an explicit empty string omits that key from the file:

   ```js
   async _writeEnvFile(envPath, explicitValues = {}) {
     // Only strip plaintext secrets once migration has fully completed —
     // otherwise partial-migration recovery could lose unencrypted secrets.
     const stripSecrets =
       this._encryptionAvailable() && fs.existsSync(this._getMigrationSentinelPath());
     let envContent = "# OpenWhispr Environment Variables\n";
     for (const key of PERSISTED_KEYS) {
       if (stripSecrets && SECRET_KEY_SET.has(key)) continue;
       const value = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(explicitValues, key)
         ? explicitValues[key]
         : process.env[key];
       if (value) envContent += `${key}=${value}\n`;
     }
     const tmpPath = `${envPath}.tmp`;
     await fsPromises.writeFile(tmpPath, envContent, "utf8");
     await fsPromises.rename(tmpPath, envPath);
   }
   ```

   Keep the existing `stripSecrets` calculation from `_writeEnvFile`. `removeKeyFromEnvFile(key)` returns `enqueueEnvWrite(() => this._removeKeyLine(envPath, key))`; do not append directly to `envWriteQueue` anywhere. `saveAllKeysToEnvFile({ expectedEpoch } = {})` captures the current epoch before enqueueing when no epoch is supplied; with an internal `expectedEpoch`, it rejects unless that epoch still matches before and after the queue wait. After awaiting the writer it rejects with `ENV_RESET` unless the writer returned `true`, the fence is still down, and the selected epoch equals `envWriteEpoch`; only after those checks may it call `dotenv.config`. Thus queued work invalidated by reset is skipped, and an active writer cannot reload its captured contents after reset begins.

   Wrap `clearAllPersistedData()` in the same module-wide fence: synchronously reject a second reset if already fenced, set `envWriteFenced = true`, increment `envWriteEpoch`, then await `envWriteQueue.catch(() => {})` before clearing `process.env` or removing files. Hold the fence while removing `.env` and the encrypted-key directory; release it in `finally` after deletion finishes or fails. Every new environment write rejects with `ENV_RESET` for that whole interval. This is below the credential authority because `save-all-keys-to-env` uses a separate IPC and currently bypasses the slot queues.

   Use these method bodies:

   ```js
   _writeEnvFileAtomic(envPath) {
     return enqueueEnvWrite(() => this._writeEnvFile(envPath));
   }

   async saveAllKeysToEnvFile({ expectedEpoch } = {}) {
     if (envWriteFenced) throw environmentResetError();
     const epoch = expectedEpoch ?? envWriteEpoch;
     if (epoch !== envWriteEpoch) throw environmentResetError();
     const envPath = path.join(app.getPath("userData"), ".env");
     const written = await this._writeEnvFileAtomic(envPath);
     if (!written || envWriteFenced || epoch !== envWriteEpoch) throw environmentResetError();
     dotenv.config({ path: envPath, quiet: true });
     return { success: true, path: envPath };
   }

   async clearAllPersistedData() {
     if (envWriteFenced) throw environmentResetError();
     envWriteFenced = true;
     envWriteEpoch += 1;
     try {
       await envWriteQueue.catch(() => {});
       for (const envVarName of PERSISTED_KEYS) delete process.env[envVarName];
       delete process.env.CUSTOM_REASONING_API_KEY;
       const erased = await Promise.allSettled([
         fsPromises.rm(path.join(app.getPath("userData"), ".env"), { force: true }),
         fsPromises.rm(path.join(app.getPath("userData"), ".env.tmp"), { force: true }),
         fsPromises.rm(this._getSecureKeysDir(), { recursive: true, force: true }),
       ]);
       const failures = erased.filter((result) => result.status === "rejected");
       if (failures.length > 0) {
         throw new AggregateError(failures.map((result) => result.reason), "Environment erase failed");
       }
       return { success: true };
     } finally {
       envWriteFenced = false;
     }
   }

   removeKeyFromEnvFile(key) {
     const envPath = path.join(app.getPath("userData"), ".env");
     return enqueueEnvWrite(() => this._removeKeyLine(envPath, key));
   }

   getEnvWriteEpoch() {
     return envWriteEpoch;
   }

   drainEnvWrites() {
     return envWriteQueue.catch(() => {});
   }

   getEnterpriseRouteSettings() {
     return {
       bedrockRegion: this.getBedrockRegion() || "us-east-1",
       azureEndpoint: this.getAzureEndpoint(),
       vertexProject: this.getVertexProject(),
       vertexLocation: this.getVertexLocation() || "us-central1",
       vertexAuthSource: this.getVertexAuthSource(),
     };
   }

   saveEnterpriseRoutePatch(patch, { expected } = {}) {
     // Renderer/public callers must compare the complete committed base.
     // Only the internal startup migration calls _commitEnterpriseRoutePatch
     // without expected (and supplies its captured epoch instead).
     if (!isEnterpriseRouteSettings(expected)) throw new Error("Expected enterprise route settings are required");
     return this._commitEnterpriseRoutePatch(patch, { expected });
   }

   // Main-only transaction used by startup migration and Task 6's public IPC.
   async _commitEnterpriseRoutePatch(patch, { expected, expectedEpoch } = {}) {
     if (!patch || typeof patch !== "object" || Array.isArray(patch)) throw new Error("Invalid enterprise route patch");
     for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(patch)) {
       if (!ENTERPRISE_ROUTE_KEYS.includes(key) || typeof value !== "string") throw new Error("Invalid enterprise route patch");
       if (/[\r\n\0]/.test(value)) throw new Error("Invalid enterprise route value");
       if (key === "vertexAuthSource" && value !== "adc" && value !== "apiKey") throw new Error("Invalid Vertex auth source");
     }
     if (Object.keys(patch).length === 0) throw new Error("Enterprise route patch is empty");
     if (expected !== undefined && !isEnterpriseRouteSettings(expected)) throw new Error("Invalid expected enterprise route settings");
     const epoch = expectedEpoch ?? envWriteEpoch;
     if (envWriteFenced || epoch !== envWriteEpoch) throw environmentResetError();

     let outcome;
     const envPath = path.join(app.getPath("userData"), ".env");
     const written = await enqueueEnvWrite(async () => {
       if (envWriteFenced || epoch !== envWriteEpoch) throw environmentResetError();
       const current = this.getEnterpriseRouteSettings();
       if (expected && ENTERPRISE_ROUTE_KEYS.some((key) => current[key] !== expected[key])) {
         outcome = { success: false, conflict: true, current };
         return;
       }
       const next = { ...current, ...patch };
       const explicitValues = Object.fromEntries(
         ENTERPRISE_ROUTE_KEYS.map((key) => [ENTERPRISE_ROUTE_ENV_KEYS[key], next[key]])
       );
       await this._writeEnvFile(envPath, explicitValues);
       // This check and the complete RAM commit stay inside the shared queue:
       // a following save-all cannot snapshot stale values after the rename.
       if (envWriteFenced || epoch !== envWriteEpoch) throw environmentResetError();
       for (const key of ENTERPRISE_ROUTE_KEYS) {
         const envKey = ENTERPRISE_ROUTE_ENV_KEYS[key];
         if (next[key]) process.env[envKey] = next[key];
         else delete process.env[envKey];
       }
       outcome = { success: true, current: next };
     });
     if (!written || envWriteFenced || epoch !== envWriteEpoch) throw environmentResetError();
     return outcome;
   }

   // Replace the existing one-field saver bodies at :304, :336, :362 and
   // :368. They share the same serialized durable path.
   saveBedrockRegion(value) {
     return this._commitEnterpriseRoutePatch({ bedrockRegion: value }, { expected: this.getEnterpriseRouteSettings() });
   }
   saveAzureEndpoint(value) {
     return this._commitEnterpriseRoutePatch({ azureEndpoint: value }, { expected: this.getEnterpriseRouteSettings() });
   }
   saveVertexProject(value) {
     return this._commitEnterpriseRoutePatch({ vertexProject: value }, { expected: this.getEnterpriseRouteSettings() });
   }
   saveVertexLocation(value) {
     return this._commitEnterpriseRoutePatch({ vertexLocation: value }, { expected: this.getEnterpriseRouteSettings() });
   }

   getVertexAuthSource() {
     const source = process.env.VERTEX_AUTH_SOURCE;
     return source === "adc" || source === "apiKey" ? source : null;
   }

   // Main-only. The shared transaction validates and persists the explicit
   // prospective tuple before changing process.env. An expected epoch is
   // supplied only by startup migration.
   saveVertexAuthSource(source, { expectedEpoch } = {}) {
     if (source !== "adc" && source !== "apiKey") throw new Error("Invalid Vertex auth source");
     return this._commitEnterpriseRoutePatch(
       { vertexAuthSource: source },
       { expectedEpoch } // migration only; omitted by public IPC
     ).then(() => ({ success: true }));
   }
   ```

   Add `persistSecret` right after `_saveKey` (after `:264`):

   ```js
     // Awaitable twin of _saveKey for acknowledged saves (credentialAuthority.js):
     // resolves only once the encrypted file is written or removed (or, without
     // OS encryption, once .env is rewritten) and rejects on failure, restoring
     // the previous in-memory value so presence never claims an unsaved key.
     async persistSecret(envVarName, value) {
       if (!SECRET_KEY_SET.has(envVarName)) throw new Error(`${envVarName} is not a secret key`);
       const previous = process.env[envVarName];
       try {
         if (this._encryptionAvailable()) {
           await this._saveSecretKey(envVarName, value);
         } else {
           if (value) process.env[envVarName] = value;
           else delete process.env[envVarName];
           await this.saveAllKeysToEnvFile();
         }
       } catch (error) {
         if (previous === undefined) delete process.env[envVarName];
         else process.env[envVarName] = previous;
         throw error;
       }
     }
   ```

   ```ts
     "dictationAgentVisionCustomApiKey",
     "chatAgentCustomApiKey",
     "bedrockAccessKeyId",
     "bedrockSecretAccessKey",
     "bedrockSessionToken",
     "azureApiKey",
     "vertexApiKey",
   ] as const;

   function invalidateApiKeyCaches(
     provider?:
       | "openai"
       | "anthropic"
       | "gemini"
       | "groq"
       | "mistral"
       | "tinfoil"
       | "custom"
       | "openrouter"
       | "corti",
     { persistEnv = true }: { persistEnv?: boolean } = {}
   ) {
     if (provider) {
       if (_ReasoningService) {
         _ReasoningService.clearApiKeyCache(provider);
       } else {
         import("../services/ReasoningService")
           .then((mod) => {
             _ReasoningService = mod.default;
             _ReasoningService.clearApiKeyCache(provider);
           })
           .catch(() => {});
       }
     }
     if (isBrowser) window.dispatchEvent(new Event("api-key-changed"));
     if (persistEnv) debouncedPersistToEnv();
   }

   const pendingSecretSaves = new Set<Promise<SecretSaveResult>>();
   const latestSecretSave: Partial<Record<SecretStoreKey, number>> = {};
   let secretSaveSequence = 0;

   // Acknowledged secret save (I3). The raw value goes to main and nowhere
   // else; the store field becomes "__stored__" or "" only after main confirms
   // it persisted, and an older acknowledgement never overwrites a newer save.
   export function saveSecret(storeKey: SecretStoreKey, value: string): Promise<SecretSaveResult> {
     const sequence = ++secretSaveSequence;
     latestSecretSave[storeKey] = sequence;
     const run = (async (): Promise<SecretSaveResult> => {
       const credentials = isBrowser ? window.electronAPI?.credentials : undefined;
       if (!credentials?.save) return { ok: false, error: "unavailable" };
       const [id, field] = SECRET_SLOTS[storeKey];
       let result: CredentialSaveResult;
       try {
         result = await credentials.save(id, field, value);
       } catch {
         result = { ok: false, error: "persistFailed" };
       }
       if (result.ok === false) {
         logger.warn("Failed to persist secret", { storeKey, error: result.error }, "settings");
         return { ok: false, error: result.error };
       }
       if (latestSecretSave[storeKey] === sequence && value !== "__stored__") {
         useSettingsStore.setState({
           [storeKey]: value.trim() ? "__stored__" : "",
         } as Partial<SettingsState>);
       }
       // Main already persisted (persistSecret); no .env rewrite from here.
       invalidateApiKeyCaches(SECRET_CACHE[storeKey], { persistEnv: false });
       return { ok: true };
     })();
     pendingSecretSaves.add(run);
     void run.finally(() => pendingSecretSaves.delete(run));
     return run;
   }

   // Route Apply (Task 7) and Verify (Task 12) await this, so they always act on
   // what main has stored rather than on a save still in flight.
   export async function flushSecretSaves(): Promise<void> {
     while (pendingSecretSaves.size > 0) {
       await Promise.allSettled([...pendingSecretSaves]);
     }
   }

   // Main broadcasts credentials-changed after every save, removal, undo and
   // reset; each window mirrors the per-field presence into its sentinels.
   export function subscribeCredentialChanges(): () => void {
     const credentials = isBrowser ? window.electronAPI?.credentials : undefined;
     if (!credentials?.onChanged) return () => {};
     return credentials.onChanged((change) => {
       const patch: Record<string, string> = {};
       const caches = new Set<Parameters<typeof invalidateApiKeyCaches>[0]>();
       for (const [storeKey, [id, field]] of Object.entries(SECRET_SLOTS) as [
         SecretStoreKey,
         readonly [CredentialSlot, CredentialField],
       ][]) {
         const stored = change.fields[field];
         if (id !== change.id || stored === undefined) continue;
         patch[storeKey] = stored ? "__stored__" : "";
         caches.add(SECRET_CACHE[storeKey]);
       }
       if (Object.keys(patch).length === 0) return;
       useSettingsStore.setState(patch as Partial<SettingsState>);
       for (const provider of caches) invalidateApiKeyCaches(provider, { persistEnv: false });
     });
   }

   function createSecretSetter(storeKey: SecretStoreKey) {
     return (key: string) => saveSecret(storeKey, key);
   }
   ```

   ```ts
   // Legacy plaintext scope keys move into main's store. Renderer state only
   // receives the presence sentinel; a copy main did not acknowledge stays in
   // localStorage (the sweep below skips it) so nothing the user typed is lost.
   const unmigratedLegacySecrets = new Set<string>();
   async function migrateScopeCustomKeys(
     entries: ReadonlyArray<[SecretStoreKey, string | null | undefined]>
   ): Promise<Partial<SettingsState>> {
     const updates: Record<string, string> = {};
     for (const [storeKey, secureValue] of entries) {
       let present = !!secureValue;
       if (!present) {
         const legacy = localStorage.getItem(storeKey)?.trim() || "";
         if (legacy) {
           const result = await saveSecret(storeKey, legacy);
           present = result.ok;
           if (!result.ok) unmigratedLegacySecrets.add(storeKey);
         }
       }
       updates[storeKey] = present ? "__stored__" : "";
     }
     return updates as Partial<SettingsState>;
   }
   ```

   ```tsx
     const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
     const [draft, setDraft] = useState("");
     const [draftTouched, setDraftTouched] = useState(false);
     const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
     const [failure, setFailure] = useState<"save" | "remove" | null>(null);
     const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
     const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
     const hasKey = apiKey.length > 0;
     const variantClasses = variant === "purple" ? "border-primary focus:border-primary" : "";

     useEffect(() => {
       if (isEditing) {
         requestAnimationFrame(() => {
           inputRef.current?.focus();
           inputRef.current?.select();
         });
       }
     }, [isEditing]);

     const enterEdit = () => {
       setDraft("");
       setDraftTouched(false);
       setFailure(null);
       setIsEditing(true);
     };

     const commit = async (value: string): Promise<boolean> => {
       try {
         const result = await setApiKey(value);
         return result?.ok === true;
       } catch (err) {
         logger.warn("Failed to save API key", { error: (err as Error).message }, "settings");
         return false;
       }
     };

     // The editor stays open until main acknowledges the key; a refused save
     // keeps the draft so nothing the user pasted is lost.
     const save = useCallback(async () => {
       if (saving) return;
       if (!draftTouched) {
         setIsEditing(false);
         return;
       }
       setSaving(true);
       setFailure(null);
       const ok = await commit(draft.trim());
       setSaving(false);
       if (!ok) {
         setFailure("save");
         return;
       }
       setDraft("");
       setDraftTouched(false);
       setIsEditing(false);
     }, [draft, draftTouched, saving, setApiKey]);

     // Today's Remove (an empty save), unchanged in this task. Task 12 replaces
     // it with main's undoable token removal and deletes this path (R2-5).
     const remove = async () => {
       setFailure(null);
       if (!(await commit(""))) setFailure("remove");
     };

     const cancel = () => {
       setDraft("");
       setFailure(null);
       setIsEditing(false);
     };

     const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
       if (e.key === "Enter") {
         e.preventDefault();
         void save();
       }
       if (e.key === "Escape") {
         e.preventDefault();
         cancel();
       }
     };

     // Commit the draft instead of discarding it — users paste a key and click
     // the next field expecting it to stick (Escape or ✕ still cancels).
     useEffect(() => {
       if (!isEditing) return;
       const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
         if (containerRef.current?.contains(e.target as Node)) return;
         void save();
       };
       document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
       return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
     }, [isEditing, save]);
   ```

11. In `docs/PRIVACY.md`, after the paragraph at `:34` ("Provider credentials saved by the application …"), add:

    ```markdown
    Settings windows never hold a saved credential. They learn only whether a slot is stored, and a key counts as saved only after the main process has written it to the credential store. When you remove a key, it is deleted from the credential store at once and kept only in main-process memory for 8 seconds so **Undo** can restore it; replacing the key, the 8 seconds passing, or resetting the app discards it. Resetting the app first stops every key save, removal and Undo still in progress, and only then deletes the credential store, so none of them can bring a key back. Codex sign-in presence is detected by checking that `auth.json` exists in Loqui's Codex profile; its contents are not read and no Codex process is started.
    ```

### Task 3: Route facts, sealed store, hooks and route copy (§5.1)

This task completes the §5.1 contract on top of Task 1's pure graph. `src/lib/routes.ts` re-exports `routeGraph.ts` unchanged and adds the snapshot builder, translated route copy, the imperative `routeSnapshotFromSettings`, and the hooks `useResolvedRoutes()` / `useResolvedRoute(id)`. Readiness facts come from a network-free store that publishes each fact family on its own, and sealed state comes from one store that every Plan 03 reader shares. The task also adds the i18n merge script and the `withI18nMock` test helper that every later task uses.

Closes **I2** (the facts loader never calls `codexStatus`, discovery or verification; Codex presence comes from Task 2's `credentials.list`; a mounted test proves the forbidden calls never run), **I3** (key readiness comes only from main's `credentials.list` presence, refreshed on `credentials.onChanged` and `keyring.onChanged`; renderer key fields are never read), **I9** (per-family facts, independent publication, per-key generations, last-known values kept across transient errors, `null` only before the first answer), **I14** (`src/stores/sealedStore.ts` is the single sealed authority; event-versus-fetch ordering and a seal change during an outstanding facts load are tested), **M5** (`routes.ts` = `export * from "./routeGraph.ts"` plus the renderer-only additions; the pure graph stays Node-loadable), and the **I15** inputs (`dictionaryInUse` from `getDictionaryHintWords`, `providerSearch` from `isProviderSearchEnabled`, capabilities from the registry and `MEETING_STREAMING_PROVIDER_IDS`, Appendix B agreement tests 2 and 3, translated payload parts and `metadataNote`). Round 2/3 adds the facts-and-snapshot half of **R2-1/R3-1**: `buildRouteSnapshot` fills the non-secret `enterprise` slice from the settings store, including the authoritative `vertexAuthSource`; the facts store keeps main's per-field credential presence from `credentials.list`/`onChanged`. Main is the source of truth for the enterprise destination. The facts loader's network-free `enterprise` fact is admitted only after Task 2's Vertex source migration gate:
- Once per window it reads main's five getters (`get-bedrock-region`, `get-azure-endpoint`, `get-vertex-project`, `get-vertex-location`, `get-vertex-auth-source`) and reconciles the settings store's five fields. Main's source migration completes before these getters can answer; main wins, except over a newer local apply that has already reached main.
- Every load re-reads the new `enterprise-route-facts` IPC, which returns main's environment overrides as hosts and booleans only (Bedrock endpoint, Bedrock profile presence, and legacy Vertex key/project presence; no values).
- `facts.enterpriseMain` publishes only after both, so until the sync lands every enterprise route is `unknown`, never `ready`.

`routeSnapshotFromSettings` still makes no IPC call and no subscription: it reads only the facts store, `getSealed()` and i18n. The hooks still subscribe only to the settings, facts and sealed stores.

```js
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const test = require("node:test");
const { installBrowserGlobals, createRendererServer } = require("../lib/rendererTestHarness");

const flush = () => new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
function deferred() {
  let resolve;
  const promise = new Promise((r) => (resolve = r));
  return { promise, resolve };
}
const fail = () => Promise.reject(new Error("Available in the Loqui desktop app"));
const models = (...downloaded) => ({
  success: true,
  models: [...downloaded.map((model) => ({ model, downloaded: true })), { model: "large", downloaded: false }],
});
const sorted = (set) => (set === null ? null : [...set].sort());

function api(over = {}) {
  return {
    listWhisperModels: async () => models("base"),
    listParakeetModels: async () => models("parakeet-unified-en-0.6b"),
    modelGetAll: async () => [
      { id: "qwen3.5-2b-q4_k_m", isDownloaded: true },
      { id: "qwen3.5-9b-q4_k_m", isDownloaded: false },
    ],
    getDiarizationModelStatus: async () => ({ available: true, modelsDownloaded: true }),
    getSearchModelStatus: async () => ({ downloaded: false }),
    credentials: {
      list: async () => [
        { id: "openai", present: true, generation: 3 },
        { id: "groq", present: false, generation: 0 },
        { id: "codex", present: true, generation: 1 },
      ],
    },
    keyring: {
      list: async () => [
        { id: "openai", status: "verified" },
        { id: "corti:speech", status: "rejected" },
      ],
    },
    ...over,
  };
}

// Each scenario gets a fresh module instance: generations and subscriptions are module state.
async function freshStore(t, windowProps = {}, initialStorage = {}) {
  const { storage } = installBrowserGlobals(t, { window: windowProps, initialStorage });
  const vite = await createRendererServer(t, { cachePrefix: "loqui-route-facts-test-" });
  const store = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/stores/routeFactsStore.ts");
  return { vite, storage, store, facts: () => store.useRouteFactsStore.getState().facts };
}

// R2-1/R3-1: main's five enterprise settings (including the migrated auth source) and its
// environment facts (enterprise-route-facts), each call recorded.
const NO_OVERRIDES = { bedrockEndpoint: { set: false, host: null }, bedrockProfile: false, vertexApiKeyEnv: false, vertexProjectEnv: false };
function enterpriseApi(calls, main = {}, envFacts = NO_OVERRIDES) {
  const answer = (name, value) => () => {
    calls.push(name);
    return typeof value === "function" ? value() : Promise.resolve(value);
  };
  return {
    getBedrockRegion: answer("getBedrockRegion", main.bedrockRegion ?? ""),
    getAzureEndpoint: answer("getAzureEndpoint", main.azureEndpoint ?? ""),
    getVertexProject: answer("getVertexProject", main.vertexProject ?? null),
    getVertexLocation: answer("getVertexLocation", main.vertexLocation ?? ""),
    getVertexAuthSource: answer("getVertexAuthSource", main.vertexAuthSource ?? "adc"),
    enterpriseRouteFacts: answer("enterpriseRouteFacts", envFacts),
  };
}

test("cold start: every fact is unknown until main answers, then each family is filled", async (t) => {
  // I9: unknown is null, never an empty "nothing installed".
  const { store, facts } = await freshStore(t);
  assert.deepEqual(facts().installed, { whisper: null, sherpa: null, llm: null });
  assert.equal(facts().credentials, null);
  assert.equal(facts().speakerIdModelsReady, null);
  assert.equal(facts().searchModelReady, null);
  assert.equal(facts().rejected.size, 0);

  await store.loadRouteFacts(undefined);
  await store.loadRouteFacts({});
  assert.deepEqual(facts().installed, { whisper: null, sherpa: null, llm: null }, "missing calls stay unknown");

  await store.loadRouteFacts(api());
  const f = facts();
  assert.deepEqual(sorted(f.installed.whisper), ["base"]);
  assert.deepEqual(sorted(f.installed.sherpa), ["parakeet-unified-en-0.6b"]);
  assert.deepEqual(sorted(f.installed.llm), ["qwen3.5-2b-q4_k_m"]);
  assert.deepEqual([...f.credentials.entries()].sort(), [
    ["codex", true],
    ["groq", false],
    ["openai", true],
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual([...f.rejected], ["corti:speech"]);
  assert.equal(f.speakerIdModelsReady, true);
  assert.equal(f.searchModelReady, false);
});

test("a failed Whisper inventory leaves only Whisper unknown; an empty LLM inventory is known-empty", async (t) => {

  assert.equal(facts().installed.whisper, null);

});

test("a transient failure keeps the last known value and a later answer replaces it", async (t) => {
  // I9: error recovery.
  const { store, facts } = await freshStore(t);
  await store.loadRouteFacts(api());
  await store.loadRouteFacts(
    api({
      listWhisperModels: fail,
      getDiarizationModelStatus: fail,
      credentials: { list: fail },
      keyring: { list: fail },

  assert.deepEqual(sorted(facts().installed.whisper), ["base"]);
  assert.equal(facts().speakerIdModelsReady, true);

  await store.loadRouteFacts(

  assert.deepEqual(sorted(facts().installed.whisper), ["small"]);
  assert.equal(facts().speakerIdModelsReady, false);
});

test("support-model failures on a cold start stay unknown, never ready", async (t) => {

test("each family publishes as soon as its own call resolves", async (t) => {
  // I9: independent publication; I2: one slow call never holds the others back.
  const { store, facts } = await freshStore(t);
  const whisper = deferred();
  const pending = store.loadRouteFacts(api({ listWhisperModels: () => whisper.promise }));
  await flush();
  assert.equal(facts().installed.whisper, null);
  assert.deepEqual(sorted(facts().installed.llm), ["qwen3.5-2b-q4_k_m"]);
  assert.equal(facts().credentials.get("codex"), true);
  whisper.resolve(models("base"));
  await pending;
  assert.deepEqual(sorted(facts().installed.whisper), ["base"]);
});

test("an older, slower response never overwrites a newer one", async (t) => {
  // I9: per-key generation.
  const { store, facts } = await freshStore(t);
  const older = deferred();
  const first = store.loadRouteFacts(api({ listWhisperModels: () => older.promise }));
  await store.loadRouteFacts(api({ listWhisperModels: async () => models("small") }));
  older.resolve(models("base"));
  await first;
  assert.deepEqual(sorted(facts().installed.whisper), ["small"]);
});

test("credential presence follows main's generations, not arrival order", async (t) => {
  // I3: readiness comes from main, refreshed by credentials.onChanged.
  let changed;
  let listCalls = 0;
  const slowList = deferred();
  const { store, facts } = await freshStore(t);
  await store.loadRouteFacts(api());
  globalThis.window.electronAPI = api({
    credentials: {
      list: () => (++listCalls === 1 ? slowList.promise : Promise.resolve([])),
      onChanged: (cb) => {
        changed = cb;
        return () => {};
      },
    },
  });
  store.ensureRouteFactsSubscribed();
  changed({ id: "openai", present: false, generation: 4 });
  assert.equal(facts().credentials.get("openai"), false, "the event applies at once");
  slowList.resolve([{ id: "openai", present: true, generation: 3 }]);
  await flush();
  assert.equal(facts().credentials.get("openai"), false, "a list read before the save cannot undo it");
  changed({ id: "groq", present: true, generation: 1 });
  assert.equal(facts().credentials.get("groq"), true);
});

test("credential field presence comes from the same rows and generations as presence", async (t) => {
  // R3-1: Vertex's persisted source selects the host. These rows carry readiness
  // only; saving/removing/Undoing a key cannot change the committed host.
  let changed;
  const { store, facts } = await freshStore(t);
  assert.equal(facts().credentialFields, null, "unknown until main answers");
  await store.loadRouteFacts(
    api({
      credentials: {
        list: async () => [
          { id: "vertex", present: true, generation: 2, fields: { key: false } },
          { id: "openai", present: true, generation: 1, fields: { key: true } },
        ],
      },
    })
  );
  assert.deepEqual(facts().credentialFields.get("vertex"), { key: false }, "present through the project only");
  assert.equal(facts().credentials.get("vertex"), true);
  globalThis.window.electronAPI = api({
    credentials: {
      list: async () => [],
      onChanged: (cb) => {
        changed = cb;
        return () => {};
      },
    },
  });
  store.ensureRouteFactsSubscribed();
  changed({ id: "vertex", present: true, generation: 3, fields: { key: true } });
  assert.deepEqual(facts().credentialFields.get("vertex"), { key: true }, "the event applies at once");
  changed({ id: "vertex", present: true, generation: 2, fields: { key: false } });
  assert.deepEqual(facts().credentialFields.get("vertex"), { key: true }, "an older generation is ignored");
  changed({ id: "groq", present: true, generation: 1 });
  assert.deepEqual(facts().credentialFields.get("groq"), {}, "a row without fields has no field present");
});

test("a credential event before the first list re-reads the list instead of inventing a partial map", async (t) => {
  // I3: no presence is assumed for credentials main has not listed.
  let changed;
  let listCalls = 0;

    electronAPI: api({
      credentials: {
        list: () => (++listCalls === 1 ? fail() : Promise.resolve([{ id: "openai", present: true, generation: 2 }])),
        onChanged: (cb) => {
          changed = cb;
          return () => {};
        },
      },
    }),
  });
  store.ensureRouteFactsSubscribed();
  await flush();
  assert.equal(facts().credentials, null);
  changed({ id: "openai", present: true, generation: 2 });
  assert.equal(facts().credentials, null, "still unknown until the list answers");
  await flush();
  assert.equal(listCalls, 2);
  assert.equal(facts().credentials.get("openai"), true);
});

  const calls = [];
  const slowEndpoint = deferred();
  const proxy = { bedrockEndpoint: { set: true, host: "bedrock-proxy.corp.example:8443" }, bedrockProfile: false, vertexApiKeyEnv: false, vertexProjectEnv: true };
  const pending = store.loadRouteFacts(
    api(enterpriseApi(calls, { bedrockRegion: "eu-west-1", azureEndpoint: () => slowEndpoint.promise }, proxy)),
    ["enterprise"]
  );
  await flush();
  assert.equal(facts().enterpriseMain, null, "still unknown while main's settings are in flight");
  slowEndpoint.resolve("https://main.example.com/openai");
  await pending;
  const settings = useSettingsStore.getState();
  assert.equal(settings.azureEndpoint, "https://main.example.com/openai", "main wins");
  assert.equal(settings.bedrockRegion, "eu-west-1");
  assert.equal(settings.vertexProject, "", "a null answer is an empty setting");
  assert.equal(settings.vertexLocation, "", "main's empty value replaces the renderer default");
  assert.equal(settings.vertexAuthSource, "adc", "source is synced from main after migration");
  assert.equal(storage.getItem("azureEndpoint"), "https://main.example.com/openai");
  assert.deepEqual(facts().enterpriseMain, proxy);

  // Later loads re-read main's environment only: the settings sync runs once per window.
  await store.loadRouteFacts(api(enterpriseApi(calls, {}, NO_OVERRIDES)), ["enterprise"]);
  assert.equal(calls.filter((c) => c === "getAzureEndpoint").length, 1);
  assert.equal(calls.filter((c) => c === "enterpriseRouteFacts").length, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(facts().enterpriseMain, NO_OVERRIDES);
  assert.equal(useSettingsStore.getState().azureEndpoint, "https://main.example.com/openai", "not re-synced");
});

test("enterprise: a failed or malformed answer is not a sync, and a local write during the sync is kept", async (t) => {
  const failing = await freshStore(t);
  const calls = [];
  await failing.store.loadRouteFacts(api(enterpriseApi(calls, { azureEndpoint: fail })), ["enterprise"]);
  assert.equal(failing.facts().enterpriseMain, null, "a failed getter leaves the slice unknown");
  await failing.store.loadRouteFacts(api({ ...enterpriseApi(calls), enterpriseRouteFacts: async () => ({ bedrockEndpoint: "https://x" }) }), ["enterprise"]);
  assert.equal(failing.facts().enterpriseMain, null, "a malformed environment answer is not a fact");
  await failing.store.loadRouteFacts(api({ getBedrockRegion: async () => "" }), ["enterprise"]);
  assert.equal(failing.facts().enterpriseMain, null, "a build without the calls cannot confirm main");

  const racing = await freshStore(t);
  const { useSettingsStore } = await racing.vite.ssrLoadModule("/stores/settingsStore.ts");
  const slow = deferred();
  const pending = racing.store.loadRouteFacts(
    api(enterpriseApi([], { azureEndpoint: () => slow.promise })),
    ["enterprise"]
  );
  await flush();
  useSettingsStore.getState().setAzureEndpoint("https://typed.example.com/openai"); // also sent to main
  slow.resolve("https://old.example.com/openai");
  await pending;
  assert.equal(useSettingsStore.getState().azureEndpoint, "https://typed.example.com/openai", "the newer write is kept");
  assert.notEqual(racing.facts().enterpriseMain, null, "the window counts as synced");
});

test("rejected keys come from keyring.list and refresh on keyring.onChanged", async (t) => {
  // I3: a stale rejected verdict is re-read when main's keyring changes.
  let keyringChanged;
  let rows = [{ id: "groq", status: "rejected" }];
  const { store, facts } = await freshStore(t, {
    electronAPI: api({
      keyring: {
        list: async () => rows,
        onChanged: (cb) => {
          keyringChanged = cb;
          return () => {};
        },
      },
    }),
  });
  store.ensureRouteFactsSubscribed();
  await flush();
  assert.deepEqual([...facts().rejected], ["groq"]);
  rows = [{ id: "groq", status: "unverified" }];

  await flush();
  assert.deepEqual([...facts().rejected], []);
});

test("focus and local-model events refresh the facts, once per window", async (t) => {
  const listeners = {};
  let whisperCalls = 0;
  const { store } = await freshStore(t, {
    addEventListener: (type, fn) => (listeners[type] ??= []).push(fn),
    electronAPI: api({
      listWhisperModels: async () => {
        whisperCalls++;
        return models("base");
      },
    }),
  });
  store.ensureRouteFactsSubscribed();
  store.ensureRouteFactsSubscribed();
  await flush();
  assert.equal(whisperCalls, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(listeners).sort(), [
    "focus",
    "openwhispr-local-models-changed",
    "openwhispr-models-cleared",
  ]);
  for (const type of Object.keys(listeners)) {
    assert.equal(listeners[type].length, 1, `${type} registered once`);
    listeners[type][0]();
  }
  await flush();
  assert.equal(whisperCalls, 4);
});
```

Create `test/stores/sealedStore.test.js`:

```js
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const test = require("node:test");
const { installBrowserGlobals, createRendererServer } = require("../lib/rendererTestHarness");

const flush = () => new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
function deferred() {
  let resolve;
  let reject;
  const promise = new Promise((res, rej) => {
    resolve = res;
    reject = rej;
  });
  return { promise, resolve, reject };
}

async function freshSealed(t, electronAPI) {
  installBrowserGlobals(t, { window: { electronAPI } });
  const vite = await createRendererServer(t, { cachePrefix: "loqui-sealed-store-test-" });
  return vite.ssrLoadModule("/stores/sealedStore.ts");
}

function privacy(getSealed) {
  const handle = { emit: null, fetches: 0, subscriptions: 0 };
  handle.api = {
    privacy: {
      getSealed: () => {
        handle.fetches++;
        return getSealed();
      },
      onSealedChange: (cb) => {
        handle.subscriptions++;
        handle.emit = cb;
        return () => {};
      },
    },
  };
  return handle;
}

test("a seal event that arrives while the first fetch is in flight wins over the fetch", async (t) => {
  // I14: event version versus fetch ordering.
  const fetch = deferred();
  const p = privacy(() => fetch.promise);
  const sealed = await freshSealed(t, p.api);
  assert.deepEqual(sealed.useSealedStore.getState(), { sealed: false, known: false });
  sealed.ensureSealedSubscribed();
  p.emit(true);
  fetch.resolve(false);
  await flush();
  assert.equal(sealed.getSealed(), true);
  assert.deepEqual(sealed.useSealedStore.getState(), { sealed: true, known: true });
  p.emit(false);
  assert.equal(sealed.getSealed(), false);
});

test("the fetch applies when no event arrived, and the store subscribes once", async (t) => {
  const p = privacy(async () => true);
  const sealed = await freshSealed(t, p.api);
  sealed.ensureSealedSubscribed();
  sealed.ensureSealedSubscribed();
  await flush();
  assert.deepEqual(sealed.useSealedStore.getState(), { sealed: true, known: true });
  assert.equal(p.fetches, 1);
  assert.equal(p.subscriptions, 1);
});

test("a failed fetch leaves the seal unknown until an event says otherwise", async (t) => {
  const p = privacy(() => Promise.reject(new Error("privacy unavailable")));
  const sealed = await freshSealed(t, p.api);
  sealed.ensureSealedSubscribed();
  await flush();
  assert.deepEqual(sealed.useSealedStore.getState(), { sealed: false, known: false });
  p.emit(true);
  assert.deepEqual(sealed.useSealedStore.getState(), { sealed: true, known: true });
});

test("without a privacy API nothing can be sealed, and that is known", async (t) => {
  const sealed = await freshSealed(t, {});
  sealed.ensureSealedSubscribed();
  await flush();
  assert.deepEqual(sealed.useSealedStore.getState(), { sealed: false, known: true });
});
```

```js
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const test = require("node:test");
const { installBrowserGlobals, createRendererServer } = require("./rendererTestHarness");

const flush = () => new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
const FACTS = Object.freeze({
  installed: { whisper: new Set(["base"]), sherpa: new Set(), llm: new Set(["qwen3.5-2b-q4_k_m"]) },
  credentials: new Map([
    ["openai", true],
    ["groq", true],
  ]),
  credentialFields: new Map([
    ["openai", { key: true }],
    ["groq", { key: true }],
  ]),
  // Synced from main, no environment override (R2-1).
  enterpriseMain: { bedrockEndpoint: { set: false, host: null }, bedrockProfile: false, vertexApiKeyEnv: false, vertexProjectEnv: false },
  rejected: new Set(),
  speakerIdModelsReady: true,
  searchModelReady: true,
});

async function load(t, windowProps = {}, initialStorage = {}) {
  const { storage } = installBrowserGlobals(t, { window: windowProps, initialStorage });
  const vite = await createRendererServer(t, { cachePrefix: "loqui-routes-snapshot-test-" });
  const routes = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/lib/routes.ts");
  const { useSettingsStore } = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/stores/settingsStore.ts");
  // Payload copy that names its key, so assertions can read which parts were listed.
  const copy = routes.routeCopy((key) => key.replace("routes.payload.", "P:"), "en");
  return { vite, routes, storage, copy, base: useSettingsStore.getState() };
}

test("routes.ts re-exports the pure graph unchanged", async (t) => {

  const { vite, routes } = await load(t);

  for (const name of ["resolveRoutes", "resolveRoute", "ROUTE_IDS", "ROUTE_KIND", "ROUTE_SETTINGS_PATH", "localSttModelKey", "isSealedLocality"]) {
    assert.equal(routes[name], graph[name], name);
  }
});

test("the enterprise slice is the store's raw enterprise settings, and their hosts follow edits", async (t) => {

  const { routes, copy, base } = await load(t);
  assert.deepEqual(
    routes.buildRouteSnapshot(base, FACTS, copy, false).enterprise,

  );

    chatAgentProvider: "azure",

  });

  const chat = (state) => routes.resolveRoute(routes.buildRouteSnapshot(state, facts, copy, false), "chat");
  const missing = chat(azureChat(""));
  assert.deepEqual(missing.state, { status: "needsUrl" }, "a saved key without an endpoint is not ready");
  assert.equal(missing.host, null);
  const first = chat(azureChat("https://myres.openai.azure.com/openai"));
  assert.equal(first.host, "myres.openai.azure.com");
  assert.deepEqual(first.state, { status: "ready" });

  assert.equal(
    routes.buildRouteSnapshot(azureChat("  https://x.example.com "), facts, copy, false).enterprise.azureEndpoint,

  );
  const bedrock = {

  });
  const vertexHost = (authSource, keyPresent) =>

  assert.equal(vertexHost("adc", true), "europe-west4-aiplatform.googleapis.com", "stored API key does not switch the source");
  assert.equal(vertexHost("apiKey", false), "aiplatform.googleapis.com", "persisted apiKey source selects express mode");
  const s = routes.buildRouteSnapshot(base, FACTS, copy, false);
  assert.equal(s.enterprise.vertexAuthSource, "adc");
  assert.equal(Object.keys(s.enterprise).some((key) => /secret|token|profile|apiKey$/i.test(key)), false, "no secret or credential-value field");
});

});

test("a seal change during an outstanding facts load reaches every reader and survives the load", async (t) => {

  assert.equal(routes.routeSnapshotFromSettings(state).sealed, true, "the facts load does not touch the seal");
});
```

Create `test/lib/routesHooks.test.js`. It mounts the hooks with the personalWorkspace pattern (`test/components/personalWorkspace.test.js:18-41`): a probe calls the hooks and returns `null`, so no host element is committed.

```js
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const test = require("node:test");
const React = require("react");
const { createRoot } = require("react-dom/client");
const { createRendererServer, installBrowserGlobals, installHookDom } = require("./rendererTestHarness");
const { withI18nMock } = require("./i18nTestMock");

const flush = () => new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));

const ALLOWED = [
  "credentials.list",
  "enterpriseRouteFacts",
  "getAzureEndpoint",
  "getBedrockRegion",
  "getDiarizationModelStatus",
  "getSearchModelStatus",
  "getVertexAuthSource",
  "getVertexLocation",
  "getVertexProject",
  "keyring.list",
  "listParakeetModels",
  "listWhisperModels",
  "modelGetAll",
  "privacy.getSealed",
];

// Every preload call the hooks may make answers locally. Everything that can reach
// the network, start Codex or send a credential throws if called, and records it.
function recordingApi() {
  const calls = [];
  const subscriptions = {};
  const ok = (name, value) => async () => {
    calls.push(name);
    return value;
  };
  const forbidden = (name) => () => {
    calls.push(name);
    throw new Error(`${name} must not run while loading route facts`);
  };
  const subscribe = (name) => (cb) => {
    subscriptions[name] = cb;
    return () => {};
  };
  const api = {
    listWhisperModels: ok("listWhisperModels", { success: true, models: [{ model: "base", downloaded: true }] }),
    listParakeetModels: ok("listParakeetModels", { success: true, models: [] }),
    modelGetAll: ok("modelGetAll", []),
    getDiarizationModelStatus: ok("getDiarizationModelStatus", { available: true, modelsDownloaded: true }),
    getSearchModelStatus: ok("getSearchModelStatus", { downloaded: true }),
    // R2-1: main's enterprise settings and environment facts are local reads.
    getBedrockRegion: ok("getBedrockRegion", ""),
    getAzureEndpoint: ok("getAzureEndpoint", ""),
    getVertexProject: ok("getVertexProject", ""),
    getVertexLocation: ok("getVertexLocation", ""),
    getVertexAuthSource: ok("getVertexAuthSource", "adc"),
    enterpriseRouteFacts: ok("enterpriseRouteFacts", {
      bedrockEndpoint: { set: false, host: null }, bedrockProfile: false,
      vertexApiKeyEnv: false,
      vertexProjectEnv: false,
    }),
    // The sync never writes main and never tests a connection.
    saveBedrockRegion: forbidden("saveBedrockRegion"),
    saveAzureEndpoint: forbidden("saveAzureEndpoint"),
    saveVertexProject: forbidden("saveVertexProject"),
    saveVertexLocation: forbidden("saveVertexLocation"),
    saveVertexAuthSource: forbidden("saveVertexAuthSource"),
    testEnterpriseConnection: forbidden("testEnterpriseConnection"),
    credentials: {
      list: ok("credentials.list", [{ id: "openai", present: true, generation: 1 }]),
      onChanged: subscribe("credentials"),
      save: forbidden("credentials.save"),
      remove: forbidden("credentials.remove"),
    },
    keyring: {
      list: ok("keyring.list", []),
      onChanged: subscribe("keyring"),
      verify: forbidden("keyring.verify"),
    },
    personalInference: {
      codexStatus: forbidden("personalInference.codexStatus"),
      codexModels: forbidden("personalInference.codexModels"),
      codexRateLimits: forbidden("personalInference.codexRateLimits"),
      credentialStatus: forbidden("personalInference.credentialStatus"),
      models: forbidden("personalInference.models"),
    },
    listBedrockModels: forbidden("listBedrockModels"),
    getTinfoilChatModels: forbidden("getTinfoilChatModels"),
    privacy: { getSealed: ok("privacy.getSealed", false), onSealedChange: subscribe("sealed") },
  };
  return { api, calls, subscriptions };
}

async function mount(t) {
  const recording = recordingApi();
  const listeners = {};
  let root;
  t.after(async () => {
    if (root) await React.act(async () => root.unmount());
  });
  installBrowserGlobals(t, {
    window: {
      electronAPI: recording.api,
      addEventListener: (type, fn) => (listeners[type] ??= new Set()).add(fn),
      removeEventListener: (type, fn) => listeners[type]?.delete(fn),
    },
  });
  const container = installHookDom(t);
  const vite = await createRendererServer(t, withI18nMock({ cachePrefix: "loqui-routes-hooks-test-" }));
  const routes = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/lib/routes.ts");
  const { useSettingsStore } = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/stores/settingsStore.ts");
  const { useRouteFactsStore } = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/stores/routeFactsStore.ts");
  const { PROVIDER_SEARCH_CHANGED_EVENT } = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/utils/providerSearch.ts");
  let list;
  let chat;
  function Probe() {
    list = routes.useResolvedRoutes();
    chat = routes.useResolvedRoute("chat");
    return null;
  }
  root = createRoot(container);
  await React.act(async () => {
    root.render(React.createElement(Probe));
    await flush();
  });
  const act = (fn) =>
    React.act(async () => {
      fn();
      await flush();
    });
  return {
    ...recording,
    routes,
    useSettingsStore,
    useRouteFactsStore,
    PROVIDER_SEARCH_CHANGED_EVENT,
    list: () => list,
    chat: () => chat,
    act,
    fire: (type) => act(() => [...(listeners[type] ?? [])].forEach((fn) => fn(new Event(type)))),
    count: (name) => recording.calls.filter((call) => call === name).length,
  };
}

test("mounting the route hooks loads facts from local calls only and never starts Codex", async (t) => {
  // I2: v1 called personalInference.codexStatus() on every mount (personalInference.js:248-251 → codex.status()).
  const h = await mount(t);
  assert.deepEqual(h.list().map((route) => route.id), [...h.routes.ROUTE_IDS]);
  assert.deepEqual([...new Set(h.calls)].sort(), ALLOWED);

  await h.fire("focus");
  await h.fire("openwhispr-models-cleared");
  await h.fire("openwhispr-local-models-changed");
  assert.equal(h.count("listWhisperModels"), 4);
  assert.equal(h.count("enterpriseRouteFacts"), 4, "main's environment is re-read with every refresh");
  assert.equal(h.count("getAzureEndpoint"), 1, "main's enterprise settings sync once per window");
  const keyringReads = h.count("keyring.list");
  await h.act(() => h.subscriptions.keyring());
  assert.equal(h.count("keyring.list"), keyringReads + 1);
  await h.act(() => h.subscriptions.credentials({ id: "openai", present: false, generation: 2 }));
  assert.equal(h.useRouteFactsStore.getState().facts.credentials.get("openai"), false);
  assert.deepEqual([...new Set(h.calls)].sort(), ALLOWED, "no refresh path reaches a forbidden call");
});

    h.useSettingsStore.setState({ chatAgentMode: "providers", chatAgentProvider: "openai", chatAgentModel: "gpt-5.6-sol" })
  );

  await h.act(() => h.subscriptions.sealed(false));

  await h.act(() => h.subscriptions.credentials({ id: "openai", present: false, generation: 2 }));
  assert.equal(h.chat().state.status, "needsKey");
  assert.deepEqual(h.list().find((route) => route.id === "chat"), h.chat());
});
```

Create `test/scripts/mergeLocaleKeys.test.js`:

```js
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const fs = require("node:fs");
const os = require("node:os");
const path = require("node:path");
const test = require("node:test");
const { spawnSync } = require("node:child_process");

test("merges nested keys into every locale and refuses incomplete fragments", (t) => {
  const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "loqui-merge-locales-"));
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  for (const lang of ["en", "de"]) {
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(root, lang));
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, lang, "translation.json"), JSON.stringify({ a: { keep: lang } }, null, 2) + "\n");
  }
  const script = path.join(__dirname, "../../scripts/merge-locale-keys.js");
  const fragment = path.join(root, "frag.json");

  fs.writeFileSync(fragment, JSON.stringify({ en: { a: { add: "x" } } }));
  const bad = spawnSync(process.execPath, [script, fragment, root], { encoding: "utf8" });
  assert.notEqual(bad.status, 0);
  assert.match(bad.stderr, /Missing locales in fragment: de/);

  fs.writeFileSync(fragment, JSON.stringify({ en: { a: { add: "x" } }, de: { a: { add: "y" } } }));
  const ok = spawnSync(process.execPath, [script, fragment, root], { encoding: "utf8" });
  assert.equal(ok.status, 0, ok.stderr);
  const de = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, "de", "translation.json"), "utf8"));
  assert.deepEqual(de, { a: { keep: "de", add: "y" } });
});
```

Create `test/helpers/enterpriseRouteFactsIpc.test.js`. It registers the **production** handlers with `IPCHandlers.prototype.setupHandlers` (the harness of `test/helpers/bedrockEnterpriseIpc.test.js:1-140`), backs `this.environmentManager` with the real `EnvironmentManager` prototype (whose getters read `process.env`, `src/helpers/environment.js:245-247`), and injects the environment; it never reads the developer's own:

```js
const test = require("node:test");
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const Module = require("node:module");

const handlersModulePath = require.resolve("../../src/helpers/ipcHandlers");
const originalLoad = Module._load;
const handlers = new Map();

const electronStub = {
  app: { getPath: () => "/tmp", getName: () => "test", getVersion: () => "0.0.0", isPackaged: false, on: () => {}, requestSingleInstanceLock: () => true },
  ipcMain: { handle: (channel, fn) => handlers.set(channel, fn), on: () => {}, removeHandler: () => {} },
  net: { fetch: async () => { throw new Error("no network in route facts"); } },
  BrowserWindow: class BrowserWindow {
    static getAllWindows() {
      return [];
    }
    static fromWebContents() {
      return null;
    }
  },
  shell: {},
  dialog: {},
  screen: { getPrimaryDisplay: () => ({ workAreaSize: { width: 0, height: 0 } }) },
  systemPreferences: { getMediaAccessStatus: () => "granted" },
  session: { fromPartition: () => ({}) },
  clipboard: {},
  nativeImage: {},
  globalShortcut: {},
  utilityProcess: {},
  MessageChannelMain: class {},
};

Module._load = function loadWithMocks(request, parent, isMain) {
  if (request === "electron") return electronStub;
  if (parent?.filename === handlersModulePath) {
    if (request === "./debugLogger") return new Proxy({}, { get: () => () => {} });
    if (request === "./windowBroadcast") return { broadcastToWindows: () => {} };
  }
  return originalLoad.call(this, request, parent, isMain);
};

function anything() {
  return new Proxy(function () {}, {
    get: (target, property) => {
      if (property === Symbol.toPrimitive || property === "toString") return () => "";
      if (property === "then") return undefined;
      return anything();
    },
    apply: () => anything(),
  });
}

const ENV = [
  "AWS_ENDPOINT_URL",
  "AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_BEDROCK_RUNTIME",
  "GOOGLE_VERTEX_API_KEY",
  "GOOGLE_VERTEX_PROJECT",
  "BEDROCK_REGION",
  "AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT",
  "VERTEX_PROJECT",
  "VERTEX_LOCATION",
];
const savedEnv = new Map(ENV.map((name) => [name, process.env[name]]));
function injectEnv(values) {
  for (const name of ENV) delete process.env[name];
  Object.assign(process.env, values);
}

test.before(() => {
  delete require.cache[handlersModulePath];
  const IPCHandlers = require(handlersModulePath);
  const Ctor = IPCHandlers.default || IPCHandlers;
  const EnvironmentManager = require("../../src/helpers/environment");
  // The real getters over an injected environment; the constructor only loads dotenv files.
  const target = { environmentManager: Object.create(EnvironmentManager.prototype) };
  Ctor.prototype.setupHandlers.call(
    new Proxy(target, { get: (value, property) => (property in value ? value[property] : anything()) })
  );
});

test.after(() => {
  Module._load = originalLoad;
  for (const [name, value] of savedEnv) {
    if (value === undefined) delete process.env[name];
    else process.env[name] = value;
  }
});

test("enterprise-route-facts reports main's overrides as hosts and booleans, never a value", async () => {
  // R2-1, change-driving: the channel does not exist yet.
  const facts = () => handlers.get("enterprise-route-facts")({});
  assert.ok(handlers.get("enterprise-route-facts"), "registered by the production setupHandlers");
  injectEnv({});

  });
  injectEnv({

  for (const result of [withOverrides, credentialUrl]) {
    const text = JSON.stringify(result);
    for (const secret of ["fixture-env-key", "fixture-project", "fixture-pass", "user:"]) {
      assert.equal(text.includes(secret), false, `no value leaves main: ${secret}`);
    }

});
```

Expected: FAIL.

- `routeFactsStore`, `sealedStore` and `routesSnapshot` tests fail with `Failed to load url /stores/routeFactsStore.ts`, `/stores/sealedStore.ts` and `/lib/routes.ts`.

1. Create `test/lib/i18nTestMock.js`. Vite externalises node_modules in SSR, which bypasses `mockModules`, and any module graph that reaches `src/i18n.ts` needs `initReactI18next`:

   ```js
   // react-i18next stub for Vite SSR renderer tests. noExternal makes Vite run
   // the package through its plugin pipeline so the mock applies;
   // initReactI18next keeps src/i18n.ts's i18n.use(...) working.
   const T_KEYS = "(k) => k";
   const T_WITH_OPTIONS = "(k, o) => (o ? `${k}${JSON.stringify(o)}` : k)";

   function reactI18nextMock({ withOptions = false, t } = {}) {
     const fn = t ?? (withOptions ? T_WITH_OPTIONS : T_KEYS);
     return [
       `export const useTranslation = () => ({ t: ${fn}, i18n: { language: "en", dir: () => "ltr" } });`,
       'export const initReactI18next = { type: "3rdParty", init() {} };',
       "export const Trans = ({ children }) => children ?? null;",
     ].join("\n");
   }

   function withI18nMock(serverOptions = {}, mockOpts = {}) {
     const noExternal = Array.isArray(serverOptions.noExternal) ? serverOptions.noExternal : [];
     return {
       ...serverOptions,
       noExternal: [...noExternal, "react-i18next"],
       mockModules: { ...(serverOptions.mockModules ?? {}), "react-i18next": reactI18nextMock(mockOpts) },
     };
   }

   module.exports = { reactI18nextMock, withI18nMock };
   ```
