   ```tsx
   import { useEffect, useId, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
   import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
   import { providerDisplayLabel } from "../../../lib/locality";
   import type { CredentialId, RouteId } from "../../../lib/routes";
   import type { RouteTarget } from "../../../lib/routePlanner";
   import { useRouteDraftStore } from "../../../stores/routeDraftStore";
   import { saveSecret, useSettingsStore, type SettingsState } from "../../../stores/settingsStore";
   import ApiKeyInput, { type AcknowledgedSecretSave } from "../../ui/ApiKeyInput";
   import { Button } from "../../ui/button";
   import { Input } from "../../ui/input";
   import { EndpointDraft } from "./EndpointDraft";
   import {
     capabilityOf,
     credentialFor,
     hasSavedCredential,
     modelsForRoute,
     providersForRoute,
     setsUpInEditor,
     type StagedModelOption,
   } from "./providerCatalog";
   import { useRouteChange } from "./useRouteChange";

   export interface StagedProviderOption {
     id: string;
     name: string;
     key: "saved" | "missing" | "none";
   }
   export interface StagedCredentialInput {
     storeKey: string;
     label: string;
     value: string;
     // R2-3: the exact ApiKeyInput callback type. Never cast, never dropped.
     save: AcknowledgedSecretSave;
   }
   export interface StagedRoutePanelViewProps {
     routeId: RouteId;
     target: RouteTarget;
     providers: StagedProviderOption[];
     credential: { credentialId: CredentialId; inputs: StagedCredentialInput[] } | null;
     models: StagedModelOption[];
     sharedServerUrl: string | null;
     onTarget: (target: RouteTarget) => void;
     // R2-9: provider setup that readiness needs (Task 9: Codex sign-in, enterprise fields).
     setup?: ReactNode;
   }

   // A typed model id for providers without a registry list (OpenRouter, Codex,
   // enterprise deployments). A local draft until "Use this model".
   function ModelIdDraft({ value, onUse }: { value: string; onUse: (model: string) => void }) {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     const id = useId();
     const [draft, setDraft] = useState(value);
     useEffect(() => setDraft(value), [value]);
     return (
       <div className="space-y-1.5">
         <label htmlFor={id} className="block text-xs font-medium text-foreground">
           {t("staging.modelId")}
         </label>
         <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
           <Input id={id} dir="ltr" value={draft} onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)} className="h-8 max-w-xs text-sm" />
           <Button
             type="button"
             size="sm"
             variant="outline"
             data-action="use-model"
             disabled={!draft.trim() || draft.trim() === value}
             onClick={() => onUse(draft.trim())}
           >
             {t("staging.useModel")}
           </Button>
         </div>
       </div>
     );
   }

   export function StagedRoutePanelView({
     routeId,
     target,
     providers,
     credential,
     models,
     sharedServerUrl,
     onTarget,
     setup,
   }: StagedRoutePanelViewProps) {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     if (target.mode === "local") return null;
     const task = t(`routes.names.${routeId}`);
     const chosen = target.mode === "providers" ? target.provider : "";
     const text = capabilityOf(routeId) !== "speech";
     const model = target.model ?? "";
     return (
       <section
         aria-label={t("staging.region")}
         className="space-y-3 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-locality-remote/70 bg-locality-remote/5 px-4 py-3 text-xs"
       >
         <div>
           <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">
             {target.mode === "self-hosted" ? t("staging.server.title", { task }) : t("staging.cloud.title", { task })}
           </p>
           <p className="mt-1 text-muted-foreground">
             {target.mode === "self-hosted" ? t("staging.server.body") : t("staging.cloud.body")}
           </p>
         </div>
         {target.mode === "providers" && (
           <div role="group" aria-label={t("staging.provider")} className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
             {providers.map((option) => (
               <button
                 key={option.id}
                 type="button"
                 aria-pressed={chosen === option.id}
                 onClick={() => onTarget({ mode: "providers", provider: option.id })}
                 className={`inline-flex h-7 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-2.5 text-xs font-medium focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ring ${
                   chosen === option.id ? "border-ring bg-background ring-1 ring-ring" : "border-border bg-background"
                 }`}
               >
                 {option.name}
                 {option.key !== "none" && (
                   <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                     {option.key === "saved" ? t("staging.keySaved") : t("staging.noKey")}
                   </span>
                 )}
               </button>
             ))}
           </div>
         )}
         {target.mode === "providers" && setsUpInEditor(chosen) && (
           <p className="text-muted-foreground">
             {t("staging.setupHere", { provider: providerDisplayLabel(chosen, t) })}
           </p>
         )}
         {setup}
         {credential?.inputs.map((input) => (
           <ApiKeyInput
             key={input.storeKey}
             apiKey={input.value}
             setApiKey={input.save}
             label={input.label}
           />
         ))}
         {/* R2-9: the model is chosen here, before Apply; picking one re-plans the draft and commits nothing. */}
         {target.mode === "providers" && chosen && chosen !== "custom" && models.length > 0 && (
           <div role="radiogroup" aria-label={t("staging.model")} className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
             {models.map((option) => (
               <button
                 key={option.id}
                 type="button"
                 role="radio"
                 aria-checked={model === option.id}
                 onClick={() => onTarget({ mode: "providers", provider: chosen, model: option.id })}
                 className={`inline-flex h-7 items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 text-xs font-medium focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ring ${
                   model === option.id ? "border-ring bg-background ring-1 ring-ring" : "border-border bg-background"
                 }`}
               >
                 {option.name}
               </button>
             ))}
           </div>
         )}
         {/* The enterprise clouds take their deployment or model id in Task 9's setup slot. */}
         {target.mode === "providers" && chosen && chosen !== "custom" && models.length === 0 && (chosen === "codex" || !setsUpInEditor(chosen)) && (
           <ModelIdDraft value={model} onUse={(next) => onTarget({ mode: "providers", provider: chosen, model: next })} />
         )}
         {target.mode === "providers" && chosen === "custom" && (
           <EndpointDraft
             label={t("staging.endpointUrl")}
             url={target.baseUrl ?? ""}
             urlPlaceholder="https://your-endpoint.example/v1"
             model={model}
             modelLabel={t("staging.modelId")}
             modelPlaceholder={text ? "gpt-4o-mini" : "whisper-1"}
             useLabel={t("staging.useEndpoint")}
             onUse={({ url, model: next }) =>
               onTarget({ mode: "providers", provider: "custom", baseUrl: url, ...(next ? { model: next } : {}) })
             }
           />
         )}
         {target.mode === "self-hosted" && sharedServerUrl !== null && (
           <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("staging.sharedWithDictation", { url: sharedServerUrl || "—" })}</p>
         )}
         {target.mode === "self-hosted" && sharedServerUrl === null && (
           <EndpointDraft
             label={t("staging.serverUrl")}
             url={target.remoteUrl}
             urlPlaceholder={capabilityOf(routeId) === "speech" ? "http://localhost:8178" : "http://localhost:11434/v1"}
             model={model}
             modelLabel={t("staging.modelId")}
             modelPlaceholder={text ? "llama3" : "whisper-large-v3-turbo"}
             useLabel={t("staging.useServer")}
             onUse={({ url, model: next }) =>
               onTarget({ mode: "self-hosted", remoteUrl: url, ...(next ? { model: next } : {}) })
             }
           />
         )}
       </section>
     );
   }

   export function StagedRoutePanel({ routeId }: { routeId: RouteId }) {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     const draft = useRouteDraftStore((s) => s.draft);
     const settings = useSettingsStore();
     const { request } = useRouteChange();
     if (!draft || draft.routeId !== routeId || draft.kind !== "target" || draft.target.mode === "local") return null;
     const target = draft.target;
     const providers = providersForRoute(routeId).map((id): StagedProviderOption => {
       const spec = credentialFor(routeId, id);
       return {
         id,
         name: providerDisplayLabel(id, t),
         key: spec === null ? "none" : hasSavedCredential(spec, settings as SettingsState) ? "saved" : "missing",
       };
     });
     const chosen = target.mode === "providers" ? target.provider : "";
     const spec = chosen ? credentialFor(routeId, chosen) : null;
     return (
       <StagedRoutePanelView
         routeId={routeId}
         target={target}
         providers={providers}
         credential={
           spec
             ? {
                 credentialId: spec.credentialId,
                 inputs: spec.fields.map((field) => ({
                   storeKey: field.storeKey as string,
                   label: t(field.labelKey),
                   value: String(settings[field.storeKey as keyof SettingsState] ?? ""),
                   // I3, R2-3: the acknowledged save's promise is returned to ApiKeyInput unchanged.
                   save: (value: string) => saveSecret(field.storeKey, value),
                 })),
               }
             : null
         }
         models={modelsForRoute(routeId, chosen)}
         sharedServerUrl={routeId === "uploadStt" ? settings.remoteTranscriptionUrl : null}
         // Every choice re-plans: a device result applies now, anything else re-stages
         // (keeping setup typed for the same provider, Task 7).
         onTarget={(next) => void request(routeId, next)}
       />
     );
   }
   ```

   Saving a key here never changes a route. When main acknowledges it, Task 3's facts refresh and the bar's blocker clears; Apply still awaits `flushSecretSaves` (Task 7). Choosing a model re-stages the draft with that model (R2-9); the bar's `needsModel` blocker clears without committing. Task 9 fills the `setup` slot for Codex and the enterprise clouds.

#### Enable switches through the planner (I1 follow-up)

The page switches that turn a route on (cleanup, translation, assistant, screen context, the vision override) and the provider web-search toggle wrote the store or `localStorage` directly, so turning on a route that already pointed at a cloud provider, or switching web search on, sent new data with no review. They now commit through `useRouteChange().requestPatch`, which is Task 7's `requestRoutePatch`. Off is always instant, because an off route sends nothing. On is instant when the route resolves to this device and staged when it leaves the device. The vision override is planned like any recipient change. Each switch shows the live value, so a staged "on" stays off until Apply, and the Apply bar lists the change.

   ```tsx
   import type { RouteSwitchKey, SettingsPatch } from "../../../lib/providerSwitchPlans";
   import type { RouteId } from "../../../lib/routes";
   import { useSettingsStore } from "../../../stores/settingsStore";
   import { Toggle } from "../../ui/toggle";
   import { useRouteChange } from "./useRouteChange";

   export interface RouteSwitchProps {
     routeId: RouteId;
     settingKey: RouteSwitchKey;
     disabled?: boolean;
     /** Runs after the change is committed, never while it waits for Apply. */
     onApplied?: (enabled: boolean) => void;
   }

   // A switch that turns a route on or off. The planner decides (Task 6):
   // off, or on for a route that stays on this device, applies at once with
   // Undo; on for a route that leaves the device waits in the Apply bar. The
   // switch shows the live value, so a staged "on" stays off until Apply.
   export function RouteSwitch({ routeId, settingKey, disabled, onApplied }: RouteSwitchProps) {
     const checked = useSettingsStore((s) => s[settingKey]);
     const { requestPatch } = useRouteChange();
     return (
       <Toggle
         checked={checked}
         disabled={disabled}
         onChange={async (next) => {
           const outcome = await requestPatch(routeId, { [settingKey]: next } as SettingsPatch);
           if (outcome !== "staged" && outcome !== "superseded" && outcome !== "save-failed" && outcome.applied) onApplied?.(next);
         }}
       />
     );
   }
   ```

     ```tsx
     // The preference lives in localStorage (personalWebSearch:<scope>). Task 6's
     // writer announces every change; "storage" covers other windows.
     function subscribeProviderSearch(onChange: () => void): () => void {
       window.addEventListener(PROVIDER_SEARCH_CHANGED_EVENT, onChange);
       window.addEventListener("storage", onChange);
       return () => {
         window.removeEventListener(PROVIDER_SEARCH_CHANGED_EVENT, onChange);
         window.removeEventListener("storage", onChange);
       };
     }

     // Web search adds the webSearch payload part (Appendix B), so turning it on
     // for a provider is a new payload: the planner stages it. Off is instant.
     function ProviderSearchPreference({ scope }: { scope: ProviderSearchScope }) {
       const { t } = useTranslation();
       const enabled = useSyncExternalStore(
         subscribeProviderSearch,
         () => readProviderSearchPreference(scope),
         () => false
       );
       const { requestPatch } = useRouteChange();
       return (
         <SettingsRow
           label={t("personal.providerSearch")}
           description={t("personal.providerSearchDescription")}
         >
           <Toggle
             checked={enabled}
             onChange={(next) =>
               void requestPatch(SCOPE_ROUTE[scope], { [`providerSearch:${scope}`]: next } as SettingsPatch)
             }
           />
         </SettingsRow>
       );
     }
     ```

An invalid persisted selection is shown and left for the resolver to report as not ready; the picker no longer rewrites it.
- **Corti region (I1 follow-up).** The region `Select` and tenant field in `TranscriptionModelPicker`'s Corti credentials (`:301-315`, rendered at `:1249-1272`) called `setCortiEnvironment`/`setCortiTenant`. The region picks the receiving host (`api.<region>.corti.app`, `cortiTranscription.js:39`, `cortiStreaming.js:48`), so both now commit through Task 8's `useRouteChange().requestPatch` (Task 7's `requestRoutePatch`): a region switch is staged when a speech route uses Corti (Corti text always calls `ai.eu.corti.app`, Task 1's `providerHosts["corti:text"]`, so it is not moved), and the tenant (same host) applies at once. The tenant is a local draft committed on leave or Enter, never per keystroke.
- **C1/I2 (Codex connection).** `CodexConnection` (`src/components/CodexConnection.tsx:60-62`) runs `refresh()` on mount. That calls `codexStatus()`, which starts the Codex app server (`src/helpers/codexAppServer.js:359-367` → `start()` `:116-181`). The first start in a session may also ask GitHub to verify the release (`verifyOfficialCodex`, `src/helpers/codexCli.js:309-340`). When the account is signed in, it then calls `codexRateLimits()` (`:35`, `:44-48`). `CodexModelPicker` renders it (`ReasoningModelSelector.tsx:789`), so opening the Codex tab started Codex. In Settings it now runs nothing on mount. Signed-in presence comes from Task 2's main-confirmed `credentials.list` row for `"codex"`, a stat of `auth.json` with no process and no network, read through Task 3's `useRouteFactsStore`. Status and quota are read only by an explicit **Check ChatGPT status** button whose tooltip names ChatGPT via the Codex app. Account events still refresh, because they follow an explicit sign-in or sign-out. Onboarding (`OnboardingFlow.tsx:546`) is Plan 05's concern. It opts into the old mount read with `checkStatusOnMount`, so its behaviour and tests stay as they are, and Plan 05 decides whether to keep it.
- **R2-1 (enterprise recipients, UI side).** `EnterpriseProviderConfig` wrote its route fields directly. That covered the Bedrock region (`:114-118`, `settings.setBedrockRegion` plus a per-keystroke model rewrite), the Azure endpoint (`:145-148`, `settings.setAzureEndpoint`) and the Vertex project, location and auth source (`:166-174`). Main reads these for requests (`main.js:447-457` → `enterpriseAiProviders.js:26,73-81,90-91`), so typing an Azure endpoint could redirect content and its key without review. Each field is now a local draft committed through the route planner; Apply waits for one expected-tuple `saveEnterpriseRoutePatch` ACK before updating main and renderer:
  - for the route being edited: through `requestRoutePatch({ <field>: value })` (Task 8's `requestPatch`), which Task 6 plans with its coupled changes (Bedrock's `adjustBedrockModelForRegion` model update) and stages when a host changes;
  - inside the staged panel: through Task 7's `stageDraftSetup`, which writes nothing.
  The component no longer calls any store setter for these fields. Task 6's `applyRoutePatch` is the only writer, and it tells main.
- **R2-9 (staged editor setup).** Task 8's staged panel gets Codex sign-in (`CodexConnection`, explicit Connect) and the enterprise fields and credentials in its `setup` slot. The route is not committed, and Apply stays blocked until the route is ready.
- **R2-6 (enterprise Test connection).** Before, the button (`:195-206`) sent a credential-bearing `textGenerate` (`:86-100`) behind a generic label. Its label now names the host and the credential fields from main's `keyring.describeVerify(provider)` (Task 11), which main computes from the same committed configuration the request uses. The panel re-queries whenever the committed endpoint, region, project or location changes, and on `credentials-changed`. It is disabled while main names no host.
- **R2-3 / R2-5.** `OpenAICompatiblePanel.saveApiKey` and `ReasoningModelSelector.saveCustomReasoningApiKey` have the exact type `AcknowledgedSecretSave` (Task 2). The panel passes `credentialId={credentialSlotForRef(credentialRef)}` to `ApiKeyInput`, so OpenRouter's identity (`credentialRef="openrouter"`, `ReasoningModelSelector.tsx:577-590`) and each custom slot reach `ApiKeyInput`. Task 12 turns that identity into an undoable token removal with a toast and tests it.
- **SET-Q19.** Self-hosted inputs are labelled (`htmlFor`/`useId` via Task 8's `EndpointDraft`) and get an unauthenticated **Test** that calls a new main probe, `src/helpers/selfHostedProbe.js` (no headers; `GET <base>/models`; plain http only for private hosts using the now-exported `isPrivateHost`), exposed as `window.electronAPI.probeSelfHosted`. Upload's panel is read-only, because it shares dictation's URL.

```js
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const test = require("node:test");
const { probeSelfHosted } = require("../../src/helpers/selfHostedProbe.js");

test("the probe lists models without sending any header", async () => {
  const calls = [];
  const fetchImpl = async (url, init) => {
    calls.push({ url, init });
    return { ok: true, status: 200, json: async () => ({ data: [{ id: "a" }, { id: "b" }] }) };
  };
  assert.deepEqual(await probeSelfHosted("http://192.168.1.20:11434/v1/", fetchImpl), { ok: true, count: 2 });
  assert.equal(calls.length, 1);
  assert.equal(calls[0].url, "http://192.168.1.20:11434/v1/models");
  assert.equal("headers" in calls[0].init, false, "no Authorization, ever");
  assert.equal(calls[0].init.redirect, "error");
  await probeSelfHosted("http://localhost:8178", fetchImpl);
  assert.equal(calls[1].url, "http://localhost:8178/models");
});

test("the probe classifies failures and refuses plain http to public hosts", async () => {
  const never = async () => {
    throw new Error("must not be called");
  };
  assert.deepEqual(await probeSelfHosted("not a url", never), { ok: false, code: "invalidUrl" });
  assert.deepEqual(await probeSelfHosted("ftp://192.168.1.2/", never), { ok: false, code: "invalidUrl" });
  assert.deepEqual(await probeSelfHosted("http://user:pass@192.168.1.2/", never), { ok: false, code: "invalidUrl" });
  assert.deepEqual(await probeSelfHosted("http://example.com/v1", never), { ok: false, code: "httpsRequired" });
  assert.deepEqual(
    await probeSelfHosted("http://localhost:8178", async () => ({ ok: false, status: 404, json: async () => ({}) })),
    { ok: false, code: "http", status: 404 }
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    await probeSelfHosted("http://localhost:8178", async () => {
      throw new Error("ECONNREFUSED");
    }),
    { ok: false, code: "network" }
  );
});

test("the probe and the connection test share one private-host rule", () => {
  const { isPrivateHost } = require("../../src/helpers/providerConnectionTest.js");
  assert.equal(isPrivateHost("192.168.1.20"), true);
  assert.equal(isPrivateHost("example.com"), false);
});
```

```js
// Source guard, change-driving: each of these names is a direct write or a discovery side path today.
test("pickers no longer write provider, model or endpoint fields themselves", () => {
  const banned = {
    "components/TranscriptionModelPicker.tsx": [/switchCloudTranscriptionProvider/, /setCloudTranscriptionBaseUrl/, /onCloudModelSelect/, /onLocalModelSelect/, /validateAndSelectModel/, /setCortiEnvironment/, /setCortiTenant/],
    // checkStatusOnMount is onboarding's opt-in; Settings (and NotesOnboarding, via the selector) never passes it.
    "components/ReasoningModelSelector.tsx": [/setReasoningModel\(/, /setLocalReasoningProvider/, /setCloudReasoningBaseUrl/, /setReasoningModeProp/, /llamaServerStop/, /checkStatusOnMount/],
    "components/OpenAICompatiblePanel.tsx": [/getModelListBaseCandidates/, /setBaseUrl/, /onBlur/],
    "components/SelfHostedPanel.tsx": [/onUrlChange/, /onModelChange/],
    "components/settings/UploadSettings.tsx": [/setRemoteTranscriptionUrl/, /setUploadCloudTranscriptionProvider/],
    // C1/I2: the unconditional mount read (:60-62), the double read behind Refresh (action(refresh)
    // reads twice) and Connect gated on a status read that never ran.
    "components/CodexConnection.tsx": [/useEffect\(\(\) => \{\s*void refresh\(\)/, /action\(refresh\)/, /!status\?\.available/],
    // R2-3: no dropped acknowledgement; R2-1: no direct enterprise writer.
    "components/ReasoningModelSelector.tsx#saves": [/saveApiKey=\{[^}]*\(\) => (undefined|\{\})/, /\|\| \(\(\) => \{\}\)/],
    "components/EnterpriseProviderConfig.tsx": [/settings\.set(BedrockRegion|AzureEndpoint|VertexProject|VertexLocation)/],
  };
  for (const [entry, patterns] of Object.entries(banned)) {
    const file = entry.split("#")[0];
    const source = fs.readFileSync(path.join(SRC, file), "utf8");
    for (const pattern of patterns) assert.doesNotMatch(source, pattern, `${file} still matches ${pattern}`);
  }
  const panel = fs.readFileSync(path.join(SRC, "components/OpenAICompatiblePanel.tsx"), "utf8");
  assert.equal((panel.match(/personalInference\.models\(/g) ?? []).length, 1, "one discovery call site");
  const codex = fs.readFileSync(path.join(SRC, "components/CodexConnection.tsx"), "utf8");
  assert.equal((codex.match(/codexStatus\(/g) ?? []).length, 1, "one status call site, inside refresh");
  assert.match(codex, /if \(checkStatusOnMount\) void refresh\(\)/, "the mount read is opt-in");
  assert.match(codex, /s\.facts\.credentials\?\.get\("codex"\)/, "stored sign-in comes from main's credential list");
});
```

Create `test/components/enterpriseRoutes.test.js` (R2-1, R2-6, R2-9). It mounts the production wiring that `InferenceConfigEditor` uses (`ReasoningModelSelector` → `EnterpriseProviderConfig`, with `onCommit = useRouteCommit(routeId)` and `onRoutePatch = (patch) => void requestPatch(routeId, patch)`, pinned by the source guard at the end), the real stores and planner, and a fake main whose committed enterprise configuration is written only through the preload savers that Task 6's `applyRoutePatch` calls:

```js
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const test = require("node:test");
const React = require("react");
const { renderToStaticMarkup } = require("react-dom/server");
const { installBrowserGlobals } = require("../lib/rendererTestHarness");
const { createProbeRoot, findElement } = require("../lib/probeRoot");
const { SRC, primeRouteFacts, rendererServer, routeTestApi, toastCapture } = require("../lib/routeTestApi");
const { TEST_COPY } = require("../lib/routeStateFixture");

const EAST = "https://east.openai.azure.com/openai";
const WEST = "https://west.openai.azure.com/openai";

test("enterprise recipients go through the planner (R2-1, R2-6, R2-9)", async (t) => {
  // Main's committed enterprise configuration (main.js:447-457). Only the
  // expected-tuple transaction changes it; no individual saver is exposed.
  const main = {
    azureEndpoint: EAST,
    bedrockRegion: "us-east-1",
    vertexProject: "acme-prod",
    vertexLocation: "europe-west4",
    vertexAuthSource: "adc",
  };
  const writes = [];
  const saveEnterpriseRoutePatch = async ({ patch, expected }) => {
    writes.push({ patch: { ...patch }, expected: { ...expected } });
    if (Object.keys(main).some((key) => expected[key] !== main[key])) {
      return { success: false, conflict: true, current: { ...main } };
    }
    Object.assign(main, patch);
    return { success: true, current: { ...main } };
  };
  // One host rule for both the disclosure and the request, as main uses one configuration for both.
  let vertexKeyPresent = false;
  const hostsFor = (provider) => {
    if (provider === "bedrock") return [`bedrock-runtime.${main.bedrockRegion || "us-east-1"}.amazonaws.com`];
    if (provider === "vertex") {
      if (main.vertexAuthSource === "apiKey") return ["aiplatform.googleapis.com"];
      const location = main.vertexLocation || "us-central1";
      return [location === "global" ? "aiplatform.googleapis.com" : `${location}-aiplatform.googleapis.com`];
    }
    if (provider !== "azure") return [];
    try {
      const url = new URL(main.azureEndpoint);
      return url.protocol === "https:" && !url.username && !url.password ? [url.host] : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  };
  const describeCalls = [];
  const captured = [];
  const codexCalls = [];
  const credentialListeners = new Set();
  let credentialGeneration = 1;
  const CREDENTIAL_IDS = [
    "openai", "anthropic", "gemini", "groq", "xai", "mistral", "openrouter", "tinfoil",
    "deepgram", "assemblyai", "corti:text", "corti:speech", "codex", "bedrock", "azure", "vertex",
  ];
  const emitVertexPresence = () => {
    const change = { id: "vertex", present: vertexKeyPresent, generation: ++credentialGeneration, fields: { key: vertexKeyPresent } };
    credentialListeners.forEach((listener) => listener(change));
    globalThis.window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("credentials-changed", { detail: change }));
  };
  const codex = (name, value) => async () => {
    codexCalls.push(name);
    return value;
  };
  const api = routeTestApi({
    present: ["openai", "azure", "bedrock"],
    extra: {
      saveEnterpriseRoutePatch,
      getBedrockRegion: async () => main.bedrockRegion,
      getAzureEndpoint: async () => main.azureEndpoint,
      getVertexProject: async () => main.vertexProject,
      getVertexLocation: async () => main.vertexLocation,
      getVertexAuthSource: async () => main.vertexAuthSource,
      enterpriseRouteFacts: async () => ({
        bedrockEndpoint: { set: false, host: null },
        bedrockProfile: false,
        vertexApiKeyEnv: false,
        vertexProjectEnv: false,
      }),
      credentials: {
        list: async () => CREDENTIAL_IDS.map((id) => ({
          id,
          present: id === "vertex" ? vertexKeyPresent : ["openai", "azure", "bedrock"].includes(id),
          generation: credentialGeneration,
          fields: id === "vertex" ? { key: vertexKeyPresent } : {},
        })),
        save: async (id, field) => {
          if (id === "vertex" && field === "key") vertexKeyPresent = true;
          emitVertexPresence();
          return { ok: true, generation: credentialGeneration };
        },
        remove: async (id) => {
          if (id !== "vertex") return { ok: false, error: "unused" };
          vertexKeyPresent = false;
          emitVertexPresence();
          return { ok: true, undoToken: "vertex-undo-token", expiresAt: Date.now() + 8000, generation: credentialGeneration };
        },
        undoRemove: async (token) => {
          if (token !== "vertex-undo-token") return { ok: false, reason: "unknown" };
          vertexKeyPresent = true;
          emitVertexPresence();
          return { ok: true, generation: credentialGeneration };
        },
        onChanged: (listener) => {
          credentialListeners.add(listener);
          return () => credentialListeners.delete(listener);
        },
      },
      keyring: {
        describeVerify: async (identity) => {
          describeCalls.push(identity);
          return {
            hosts: hostsFor(identity),
            fields: identity === "vertex" ? (main.vertexAuthSource === "adc" ? [] : vertexKeyPresent ? ["key"] : ["key"])
              : identity === "azure" ? ["key"] : ["accessKeyId", "secretAccessKey"],
          };
        },
      },

  installBrowserGlobals(t, {

      bedrockRegion: state.bedrockRegion ?? "us-east-1",

      vertexLocation: state.vertexLocation ?? "europe-west4",
      vertexAuthSource: state.vertexAuthSource ?? "adc",

    vertexKeyPresent = Boolean(state.vertexApiKey);
    useSettingsStore.setState({ azureEndpoint: "", bedrockRegion: "us-east-1", vertexApiKey: vertexKeyPresent ? "__stored__" : "", useCleanupModel: false, ...state });
    writes.length = 0;

  const typeAndLeave = async (element, text) => {

    const input = () => findElement(view(), (node) => typeof node.props?.onBlur === "function");

  // Change-driving: the endpoint Field called settings.setAzureEndpoint per keystroke
  // (EnterpriseProviderConfig.tsx:145-148), which persisted to main at once (settingsStore.ts:2060-2063).
  await t.test("an active Azure endpoint edit changes no committed destination before Apply", async () => {
    reset({
      chatAgentMode: "enterprise",
      chatAgentProvider: "azure",
      chatAgentModel: "gpt-4o-deploy",
      cleanupMode: "enterprise",
      cleanupProvider: "azure",
      cleanupModel: "gpt-4o-mini-deploy",
      useCleanupModel: true,
      azureEndpoint: EAST,
    });
    const config = await mountEnterprise("chat", "azure", "gpt-4o-deploy");
    await typeAndLeave(field(config(), "reasoning.enterprise.endpoint"), WEST);
    assert.deepEqual(draft(), { routeId: "chat", kind: "patch", patch: { azureEndpoint: WEST } });
    assert.equal(live().azureEndpoint, EAST, "the store is unchanged");
    assert.deepEqual(writes, [], "main still sends to the old endpoint");
    assert.equal(main.azureEndpoint, EAST);

    // The review is accurate: both routes that share the endpoint, the second marked coupled.
    const plan = drafts.planDraft(draft(), TEST_COPY);
    const byId = Object.fromEntries(plan.changes.map((change) => [change.id, change]));
    assert.equal(byId.chat.coupled, false);
    assert.equal(byId.dictationCleanup.coupled, true);
    for (const change of [byId.chat, byId.dictationCleanup]) {
      assert.equal(change.before.host, "east.openai.azure.com");
      assert.equal(change.after.host, "west.openai.azure.com");

    assert.match(html, /data-route="dictationCleanup"/);
    assert.equal((html.match(/>west\.openai\.azure\.com</g) ?? []).length, 2);

    assert.equal(live().azureEndpoint, WEST);
    assert.equal((await drafts.applyDraft(TEST_COPY)).applied, true);
```

1. **Main probe.** Create `src/helpers/selfHostedProbe.js`:

   ```js
   const { isPrivateHost } = require("./providerConnectionTest");

   // "Test" for a self-hosted server: one GET <base>/models with no headers at
   // all, so no saved key can reach an address the user is still typing.
   async function probeSelfHosted(baseUrl, fetchImpl = globalThis.fetch, timeoutMs = 8000) {
     let url;
     try {
       url = new URL(String(baseUrl ?? "").trim());
     } catch {
       return { ok: false, code: "invalidUrl" };
     }
     if (!["http:", "https:"].includes(url.protocol) || url.username || url.password) {
       return { ok: false, code: "invalidUrl" };
     }
     if (url.protocol === "http:" && !isPrivateHost(url.hostname)) return { ok: false, code: "httpsRequired" };
     const endpoint = `${url.origin}${url.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, "")}/models`;
     const controller = new AbortController();
     const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
     try {
       const response = await fetchImpl(endpoint, { method: "GET", redirect: "error", signal: controller.signal });
       if (!response.ok) return { ok: false, code: "http", status: response.status };
       const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
       return { ok: true, count: Array.isArray(body?.data) ? body.data.length : 0 };
     } catch (error) {
       return { ok: false, code: error?.name === "AbortError" ? "timeout" : "network" };
     } finally {
       clearTimeout(timer);
     }
   }

   module.exports = { probeSelfHosted };
   ```

   ```tsx
     /** Main-confirmed presence sentinel, never a raw key. */
     apiKey: string;
     /** R2-3: Task 2's exact acknowledged-save type, handed to ApiKeyInput unchanged. */
     saveApiKey: AcknowledgedSecretSave;
     model: string;
     onSelectModel: (model: string) => void;
     defaultBaseUrl?: string;
     baseUrlPlaceholder?: string;
     helpExamples?: ReactNode;
     // Hide the endpoint editor when the URL is fixed by the caller (e.g. OpenRouter).
     lockedBaseUrl?: boolean;
     // Providers whose /models is public but whose inference needs a key.
     apiKeyRequired?: boolean;
     getKeyUrl?: string;
   }

   type Listing = { base: string } & (
     | { kind: "loading" }
     | { kind: "done"; models: ModelOption[] }
     | { kind: "error"; message: string }
   );

   type TranslateFn = (key: string, options?: Record<string, unknown>) => string;

   function credentialSlotLabel(credentialRef: string, t: TranslateFn): string {
     if (credentialRef.startsWith("custom:")) {
       const scope = credentialRef.slice(7) as LlmRouteScope;
       const route = SCOPE_ROUTE[scope];
       return t("reasoning.custom.slotCustom", { task: route ? t(`routes.names.${route}`) : scope });
     }
     return t("reasoning.custom.slotProvider", { provider: providerDisplayLabel(credentialRef, t) });
   }

   function endpointHost(base: string): string | null {
     try {
       return new URL(base).host || null;
     } catch {
       return null;
     }
   }

   // Non-conformant endpoints may return numeric ids or object descriptions.
   function toModelOptions(data: unknown, t: TranslateFn): ModelOption[] {
     const rows = Array.isArray(data) ? (data as Array<Record<string, unknown>>) : [];
     return rows
       .map((item) => {
         const rawValue = item?.id ?? item?.name;
         if (rawValue === undefined || rawValue === null || rawValue === "") return null;
         const value = String(rawValue);
         const ownedBy = typeof item?.owned_by === "string" ? item.owned_by : undefined;
         const description =
           typeof item?.description === "string" && item.description
             ? item.description
             : ownedBy
               ? t("reasoning.custom.ownerLabel", { owner: ownedBy })
               : undefined;
         return { value, label: value, description, ownedBy } as ModelOption;
       })
       .filter(Boolean) as ModelOption[];
   }

   export default function OpenAICompatiblePanel({
     credentialRef = "custom:dictationCleanup",
     baseUrl,
     onUseEndpoint,
     apiKey,
     saveApiKey,
     model,
     onSelectModel,
     defaultBaseUrl,
     baseUrlPlaceholder = "https://api.openai.com/v1",
     helpExamples,
     lockedBaseUrl = false,
     apiKeyRequired = false,
     getKeyUrl,
   }: OpenAICompatiblePanelProps) {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     const sealed = useSealedStore((s) => s.sealed);
     const [listing, setListing] = useState<Listing | null>(null);
     const committedBase = normalizeBaseUrl(baseUrl);
     const host = endpointHost(committedBase);
     const hasKey = apiKey.trim().length > 0;
     const slot = credentialSlotLabel(credentialRef, t);
     // A list belongs to the endpoint it came from; a committed change hides it, without refetching.
     const current = listing && listing.base === committedBase ? listing : null;
     const models = current?.kind === "done" ? current.models : [];

     // C1: the only discovery path. It runs on this click, against the committed
     // host, with the slot the button names (main resolves it, personalInference.js:286-301).
     const listModels = async () => {
       const base = committedBase;
       if (!base.includes("://")) {
         setListing({ base, kind: "error", message: t("reasoning.custom.endpointWithProtocol") });
         return;
       }
       if (!isSecureHttpEndpoint(base)) {
         setListing({ base, kind: "error", message: t("reasoning.custom.httpsRequired") });
         return;
       }
       setListing({ base, kind: "loading" });
       try {
         const payload = await window.electronAPI.personalInference.models({
           provider: credentialRef === "openrouter" ? "openrouter" : "custom",
           baseUrl: base,
           credentialRef,
           inferenceScope: credentialRef.startsWith("custom:") ? credentialRef.slice(7) : undefined,
         });
         setListing({ base, kind: "done", models: toModelOptions(payload?.data, t) });
       } catch (error) {
         const message = (error as Error).message || t("reasoning.custom.unableToLoadModels");
         const unauthorized = /\b(401|403)\b/.test(message);
         setListing({
           base,
           kind: "error",
           message: unauthorized && !hasKey ? t("reasoning.custom.endpointUnauthorized") : message,
         });
       }
     };

     const disclosure = !host
       ? t("reasoning.custom.listModelsNeedsEndpoint")
       : hasKey
         ? t("reasoning.custom.listModelsSendsKey", { host, slot })
         : t("reasoning.custom.listModelsNoKey", { host });

     return (
       <>
         {!lockedBaseUrl && (
           <EndpointDraft
             label={t("reasoning.custom.endpointTitle")}
             url={baseUrl}
             urlPlaceholder={baseUrlPlaceholder}
             useLabel={t("staging.useEndpoint")}
             onUse={({ url }) => onUseEndpoint?.(normalizeBaseUrl(url))}
             help={
               helpExamples ?? (
                 <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                   {t("reasoning.custom.endpointExamples")}{" "}
                   <code dir="ltr" className="text-primary">
                     https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
                   </code>{" "}
                   (OpenRouter),{" "}
                   <code dir="ltr" className="text-primary">
                     https://api.together.xyz/v1
                   </code>{" "}
                   (Together).
                 </p>
               )
             }
             actions={() =>
               defaultBaseUrl !== undefined && normalizeBaseUrl(defaultBaseUrl) !== committedBase ? (
                 <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="ghost" className="text-xs" onClick={() => onUseEndpoint?.(defaultBaseUrl)}>
                   {t("reasoning.custom.useDefault")}
                 </Button>
               ) : null
             }
           />
         )}

         <div className="space-y-2 pt-3">
           <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between">
             <h4 className="font-medium text-foreground">
               {t(apiKeyRequired ? "common.apiKey" : "reasoning.custom.apiKeyOptional")}
             </h4>
             {getKeyUrl && <GetApiKeyLink url={getKeyUrl} />}
           </div>
           {/* R2-5: the slot identity ("openrouter" or "custom:<scope>") reaches ApiKeyInput; Task 12 makes its Remove undoable. */}
           <ApiKeyInput
             apiKey={apiKey}
             credentialId={credentialSlotForRef(credentialRef)}
             setApiKey={saveApiKey}
             label=""
             helpText={apiKeyRequired ? "" : t("reasoning.custom.apiKeyHelp")}
           />
           {apiKeyRequired && !hasKey && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("reasoning.custom.keyRequiredHint")}</p>}
         </div>

         <div className="space-y-2 pt-3">
           <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
             <h4 className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">{t("reasoning.availableModels")}</h4>
             <Button
               type="button"
               size="sm"
               variant="outline"
               className="text-xs"
               data-action="list-models"
               title={disclosure}
               disabled={!host || sealed || current?.kind === "loading"}
               onClick={() => void listModels()}
             >
               {current?.kind === "loading" ? (
                 t("common.loading")
               ) : host ? (
                 <BidiInterpolatedText text={t("reasoning.custom.listModels", { host: BIDI_VALUE_TOKEN })} value={host} />
               ) : (
                 t("reasoning.custom.listModelsNeedsEndpoint")
               )}
             </Button>
           </div>
           <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
             {host ? (
               <BidiInterpolatedText
                 text={
                   hasKey
                     ? t("reasoning.custom.listModelsSendsKey", { host: BIDI_VALUE_TOKEN, slot })
                     : t("reasoning.custom.listModelsNoKey", { host: BIDI_VALUE_TOKEN })
                 }
                 value={host}
               />
             ) : (
               disclosure
             )}
           </p>
           {sealed && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("reasoning.custom.listModelsSealed")}</p>}
           {current?.kind === "error" && (
             <p role="alert" className="text-xs text-destructive">
               {current.message}
             </p>
           )}
           {current?.kind === "done" && models.length === 0 && (
             <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("reasoning.custom.noModels")}</p>
           )}
           {!current && model && (
             <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
               <BidiInterpolatedText text={t("reasoning.custom.currentModel", { model: BIDI_VALUE_TOKEN })} value={model} />
             </p>
           )}
           {models.length > MODEL_SEARCH_THRESHOLD ? (
             <SearchableModelList models={models} selectedModel={model} onModelSelect={onSelectModel} />
           ) : (
             <ModelCardList models={models} selectedModel={model} onModelSelect={onSelectModel} truncateDescription />
           )}
         </div>
       </>
     );
   }
   ```

   Removed with this rewrite: the mount effect, blur commit, Apply & Refresh, Reset-as-write and the sibling-base loop (`getModelListBaseCandidates`), which both made extra credentialed calls and silently adopted a different base URL.

4. **`src/components/CodexConnection.tsx`** (rendered by `CodexModelPicker`, `ReasoningModelSelector.tsx:789`, and by onboarding, `OnboardingFlow.tsx:546`). Replace the whole file:

   ```tsx
   import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
   import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
   import { Button } from "./ui/button";
   import type { PersonalInferenceAPI } from "../services/ai/personalInferenceTypes";
   import codexPolicy from "../config/codex.json";
   import { ensureRouteFactsSubscribed, useRouteFactsStore } from "../stores/routeFactsStore";

   type Status = Awaited<ReturnType<PersonalInferenceAPI["codexStatus"]>>;
   export default function CodexConnection({
     onSignedInChange,
     checkStatusOnMount = false,
   }: {
     /** Called when a later status refresh finds the ChatGPT account signed in or out. */
     onSignedInChange?: (signedIn: boolean) => void;
     /**
      * Read status when mounted. Only onboarding opts in (OnboardingFlow.tsx; Plan 05
      * owns that step). Settings never does: codexStatus starts the Codex app server
      * (codexAppServer.js:359-367) and may ask GitHub to verify the release (codexCli.js:309-340).
      */
     checkStatusOnMount?: boolean;
   } = {}) {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     // Main-confirmed presence (Task 2 stats the Codex profile's auth.json: no
     // process, no network). null until main has listed credentials.
     const storedAccount = useRouteFactsStore((s) => s.facts.credentials?.get("codex") ?? null);
     const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status | null>(null);
     const [loginId, setLoginId] = useState<string | null>(null);
     const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
     const [error, setError] = useState("");
     const [remaining, setRemaining] = useState<number | null>(null);
     const api = window.electronAPI?.personalInference;
     const signedInRef = useRef<boolean | null>(null);
     const onSignedInChangeRef = useRef(onSignedInChange);
     onSignedInChangeRef.current = onSignedInChange;
     const mountedRef = useRef(false);
     const refreshSeqRef = useRef(0);
     useEffect(() => {
       mountedRef.current = true;
       return () => {
         mountedRef.current = false;
       };
     }, []);
     useEffect(() => {
       ensureRouteFactsSubscribed();
     }, []);
     const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
       if (!api) return;
       const seq = ++refreshSeqRef.current;
       const next = await api.codexStatus();
       // A read that finishes after unmount, or after a newer read began, is stale:
       // it must not update state or tell the owner about an account change.
       if (!mountedRef.current || seq !== refreshSeqRef.current) return;
       setStatus(next);
       const signedIn = next.account?.type === "chatgpt";
       // The first read only establishes the baseline; later changes are reported.
       if (signedInRef.current !== null && signedInRef.current !== signedIn)
         onSignedInChangeRef.current?.(signedIn);
       signedInRef.current = signedIn;
       if (signedIn) {
         setLoginId(null);
         try {
           const limits = await api.codexRateLimits();
           if (!mountedRef.current || seq !== refreshSeqRef.current) return;
           const percentages = [
             limits.rateLimits?.primary?.usedPercent,
             limits.rateLimits?.secondary?.usedPercent,
           ].filter((value) => typeof value === "number") as number[];
           setRemaining(percentages.length ? Math.max(0, 100 - Math.max(...percentages)) : null);
         } catch {
           if (mountedRef.current && seq === refreshSeqRef.current) setRemaining(null);
         }
       } else setRemaining(null);
     }, [api]);
     // Onboarding only; see checkStatusOnMount.
     useEffect(() => {
       if (checkStatusOnMount) void refresh().catch((error) => setError(error.message));
     }, [checkStatusOnMount, refresh]);
     // Account events follow an explicit sign-in or sign-out (the app server runs
     // only after one of the buttons below), so they still refresh.
     useEffect(
       () =>
         api?.onTextEvent((event) => {
           if (event.type !== "account") return;
           if (event.method === "account/login/completed" && event.params?.success === false) {
             setLoginId(null);
             setError(String(event.params.error || t("codexConnection.loginFailed")));
           }
           void refresh().catch((error) => setError(error.message));
         }),
       [api, refresh, t]
     );
     const run = async (fn: () => Promise<unknown>) => {
       setBusy(true);
       setError("");
       try {
         await fn();
       } catch (error) {
         setError((error as Error).message);
       } finally {
         setBusy(false);
       }
     };
     // Sign-in and sign-out are explicit, so the status read that follows them is too.
     const action = (fn: () => Promise<unknown>) =>
       run(async () => {
         await fn();
         await refresh();
       });
     // A read status wins over the stored presence (a stale auth.json reads as signed out).
     const signedIn = status ? status.account?.type === "chatgpt" : storedAccount === true;
     return (
       <div className="space-y-3 rounded-lg border p-4">
         <div className="font-medium">{t("codexConnection.title")}</div>
         <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
           {t("codexConnection.description", { minimumVersion: codexPolicy.minimumVersion })}
         </p>
         {signedIn ? (
           <>
             <p className="text-sm">
               {status?.account?.type === "chatgpt"
                 ? t("codexConnection.connected", {
                     account: status.account.email || status.account.planType || "ChatGPT",
                   })
                 : t("codexConnection.signedInStored")}
             </p>
             {remaining !== null && (
               <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                 {t("codexConnection.remaining", { percent: Math.round(remaining) })}
               </p>
             )}
             <Button variant="outline" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void action(() => api.codexLogout())}>
               {t("codexConnection.disconnect")}
             </Button>
           </>
         ) : loginId ? (
           <>
             <p className="text-sm">{t("codexConnection.waiting")}</p>
             <Button
               variant="outline"
               disabled={busy}
               onClick={() =>
                 void action(async () => {
                   await api.codexCancelLogin(loginId);
                   setLoginId(null);
                 })
               }
             >
               {t("codexConnection.cancel")}
             </Button>
           </>
         ) : (
           // Connect is the explicit action that starts Codex; only a status read that
           // found Codex unavailable disables it.
           <Button
             disabled={busy || status?.available === false}
             onClick={() =>
               void action(async () => {
                 const login = await api.codexLogin();
                 setLoginId(login.loginId);
               })
             }
           >
             {t("codexConnection.connect")}
           </Button>
         )}
         <Button
           className="ms-2"
           variant="ghost"
           disabled={busy}
           data-action="codex-check-status"
           title={t("codexConnection.checkStatusTitle")}
           onClick={() => void run(refresh)}
         >
           {t("codexConnection.checkStatus")}
         </Button>
         {(error || status?.error) && (
           <p className="text-sm text-destructive" role="alert">
             {error || status.error}
           </p>
         )}
       </div>
     );
   }
   ```

   - The check button replaces Refresh, which ran `action(refresh)` and so read status twice per click. `codexConnection.refresh` stays in the locale files unused; `check-i18n.js` does not flag unused keys.
   - `src/components/OnboardingFlow.tsx:546`: change `<CodexConnection onSignedInChange={() => onChoice("codex")} />` to `<CodexConnection checkStatusOnMount onSignedInChange={() => onChoice("codex")} />`. Onboarding keeps today's mount read, its first-read baseline for `onSignedInChange`, and `onboardingCleanupWiring.test.js`. Whether the first-run step should also wait for a click is Plan 05's call.

5a. **`src/components/EnterpriseProviderConfig.tsx`** (R2-1, R2-6, R2-9). Replace the whole file. Task 2's acknowledged `saveSecret` and its five `setApiKey={(value) => saveSecret(…)}` call sites are kept as they are; Task 12 adds `credentialId` under the Azure and Vertex `apiKey` lines.

   ```tsx
   import { useEffect, useId, useState } from "react";
   import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
   import type { SettingsPatch } from "../lib/providerSwitchPlans";
   import { saveSecret as saveStoredSecret, useSettingsStore } from "../stores/settingsStore";
   import ApiKeyInput from "./ui/ApiKeyInput";
   import { BIDI_VALUE_TOKEN, BidiInterpolatedText } from "./ui/BidiInterpolatedText";
   import { Button } from "./ui/button";
   import { Input } from "./ui/input";

   type EnterpriseProvider = "bedrock" | "azure" | "vertex";
   type RouteField = "bedrockRegion" | "azureEndpoint" | "vertexProject" | "vertexLocation" | "vertexAuthSource";
   type Translate = (key: string, options?: Record<string, unknown>) => string;
   export interface VerifyTarget {
     hosts: string[];
     fields: string[];
   }

   interface EnterpriseProviderConfigProps {
     provider: EnterpriseProvider;
     reasoningModel: string;
     /** The deployment or model id, committed through the route planner (onCommit / the staged draft). */
     onSelectModel: (model: string) => void;
     /**
      * R2-1: the route fields main sends requests with (main.js:447-457). The active
      * editor passes requestRoutePatch for its route; the staged panel passes
      * stageDraftSetup. This component never writes them itself.
      */
     onRoutePatch: (patch: SettingsPatch) => void;
     /** Staged setup shown over the live values (staged panel only). */
     pending?: SettingsPatch;
     /** Default true. The staged panel hides it: nothing is committed there to test. */
     testConnection?: boolean;
   }

   // Typed text stays local until the field is left or Enter is pressed; then
   // it commits once. Never a write per keystroke.
   function DraftField({ label, value, onCommit }: { label: string; value: string; onCommit: (value: string) => void }) {
     const id = useId();
     const [draft, setDraft] = useState(value);
     useEffect(() => setDraft(value), [value]);
     const commit = () => {
       if (draft.trim() !== value) onCommit(draft.trim());
     };
     return (
       <div className="space-y-1">
         <label htmlFor={id} className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
           {label}
         </label>
         <Input
           id={id}
           dir="ltr"
           value={draft}
           onChange={(event) => setDraft(event.target.value)}
           onBlur={commit}
           onKeyDown={(event) => {
             if (event.key === "Enter") commit();
           }}
           className="h-8 text-sm"
           autoComplete="off"
         />
       </div>
     );
   }

   // R2-6: the button names the host main will send to and the credential
   // fields it sends, both from main's describeVerify (Task 11). Main computes
   // them from the committed configuration the test request reads.
   export function enterpriseTestDisclosure(target: VerifyTarget | null, t: Translate): string {
     const host = target?.hosts[0];
     if (!host) return t("reasoning.enterprise.testHostUnknown");
     if (target.fields.length === 0) return t("reasoning.enterprise.testSendsNoKey", { host });
     const fields = target.fields.map((field) => t(`reasoning.enterprise.field.${field}`)).join(", ");
     return t("reasoning.enterprise.testSends", { host, fields });
   }

   /** Direct credentials are saved in main; renderer state contains only presence markers. */
   export default function EnterpriseProviderConfig({
     provider,
     reasoningModel,
     onSelectModel,
     onRoutePatch,
     pending,
     testConnection = true,
   }: EnterpriseProviderConfigProps) {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     const settings = useSettingsStore();
     const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
     const [error, setError] = useState("");
     const [connected, setConnected] = useState(false);
     const [target, setTarget] = useState<VerifyTarget | null>(null);
     const [credentialEvents, setCredentialEvents] = useState(0);
     const value = (field: RouteField): string => String((pending as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.[field] ?? settings[field] ?? "");
     const routeField = (field: RouteField) => (next: string) => onRoutePatch({ [field]: next } as SettingsPatch);

     // Main stores the credential and acknowledges it; ApiKeyInput shows the
     // outcome, and renderer state only ever holds the presence sentinel.
     const saveSecret = (
       field: "bedrockAccessKeyId" | "bedrockSecretAccessKey" | "bedrockSessionToken" | "azureApiKey" | "vertexApiKey",
       value: string
     ) => {
       setError("");
       setConnected(false);
       return saveStoredSecret(field, value);
     };

     // Re-query whenever the committed configuration the test reads changes
     // (a staged edit does not change it until Apply), and on credentials-changed.
     const committed =
       provider === "azure"
         ? settings.azureEndpoint
         : provider === "bedrock"
           ? `${settings.bedrockRegion}|${settings.bedrockProfile}`
           : `${settings.vertexProject}|${settings.vertexLocation}|${settings.vertexAuthSource}`;
     useEffect(
       () => window.electronAPI?.credentials?.onChanged?.(() => setCredentialEvents((n) => n + 1)),
       []
     );
     useEffect(() => {
       if (!testConnection) return;
       let current = true;
       setTarget(null);
       const describe = window.electronAPI?.keyring?.describeVerify;
       if (!describe) return;
       window.electronAPI.keyring
         .describeVerify(provider)
         .then((next) => {
           if (current) setTarget(next);
         })
         .catch(() => {
           if (current) setTarget({ hosts: [], fields: [] });
         });
       return () => {
         current = false;
       };
     }, [provider, committed, credentialEvents, testConnection]);

     const host = target?.hosts[0] ?? null;
     const testConnectionNow = async () => {
       setBusy(true);
       setError("");
       setConnected(false);
       try {
         await window.electronAPI.personalInference.textGenerate({
           requestId: crypto.randomUUID(),
           provider,
           model: reasoningModel,
           credentialRef: provider,
           inferenceScope: "noteFormatting",
           messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Reply with hello." }],
           maxTokens: 32,
           timeoutMs: 30000,
         });
         setConnected(true);
       } catch (error) {
         setError((error as Error).message);
       } finally {
         setBusy(false);
       }
     };

     return (
       <div className="space-y-3">
         {provider === "bedrock" && (
           <>
             {/* The region picks the receiving host; Task 6 adjusts the model's geo prefix in the same patch. */}
             <DraftField label={t("reasoning.enterprise.region")} value={value("bedrockRegion")} onCommit={routeField("bedrockRegion")} />
             <DraftField
               label={t("reasoning.enterprise.profile")}
               value={settings.bedrockProfile}
               onCommit={settings.setBedrockProfile}
             />
             <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("personal.directAwsCredentials")}</p>
             <ApiKeyInput
               label={t("reasoning.enterprise.accessKeyId")}
               apiKey={settings.bedrockAccessKeyId}
               setApiKey={(value) => saveSecret("bedrockAccessKeyId", value)}
             />
             <ApiKeyInput
               label={t("reasoning.enterprise.secretAccessKey")}
               apiKey={settings.bedrockSecretAccessKey}
               setApiKey={(value) => saveSecret("bedrockSecretAccessKey", value)}
             />
             <ApiKeyInput
               label={t("reasoning.enterprise.sessionToken")}
               apiKey={settings.bedrockSessionToken}
               setApiKey={(value) => saveSecret("bedrockSessionToken", value)}
             />
           </>
         )}
         {provider === "azure" && (
           <>
             <DraftField label={t("reasoning.enterprise.endpoint")} value={value("azureEndpoint")} onCommit={routeField("azureEndpoint")} />
             <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("reasoning.enterprise.azure.endpointHelp")}</p>
             <DraftField
               label={t("reasoning.enterprise.apiVersion")}
               value={settings.azureApiVersion}
               onCommit={settings.setAzureApiVersion}
             />
             <ApiKeyInput
               apiKey={settings.azureApiKey}
               setApiKey={(value) => saveSecret("azureApiKey", value)}
             />
           </>
         )}
         {provider === "vertex" && (
           <>
             <DraftField label={t("reasoning.enterprise.projectId")} value={value("vertexProject")} onCommit={routeField("vertexProject")} />
             <DraftField label={t("reasoning.enterprise.location")} value={value("vertexLocation")} onCommit={routeField("vertexLocation")} />
             <label className="block space-y-1 text-sm">
               <span>{t("reasoning.enterprise.vertex.authSource")}</span>
               <select
                 aria-label={t("reasoning.enterprise.vertex.authSource")}
                 data-route-field="vertexAuthSource"
                 value={value("vertexAuthSource") || "adc"}
                 onChange={(event) => routeField("vertexAuthSource")(event.currentTarget.value)}
                 className="h-9 w-full rounded-md border bg-background px-3"
               >
                 <option value="adc">{t("reasoning.enterprise.vertex.authSourceAdc")}</option>
                 <option value="apiKey">{t("reasoning.enterprise.vertex.authSourceApiKey")}</option>
               </select>
             </label>
             <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("reasoning.enterprise.vertex.adcHelp")}</p>
             <ApiKeyInput
               apiKey={settings.vertexApiKey}
               setApiKey={(value) => saveSecret("vertexApiKey", value)}
               helpText={t("reasoning.enterprise.vertex.apikeyHelp")}
             />
           </>
         )}
         <DraftField
           label={t(provider === "azure" ? "reasoning.enterprise.deploymentName" : "reasoning.enterprise.customModelId")}
           value={reasoningModel}
           onCommit={onSelectModel}
         />
         {testConnection && (
           <>
             <Button
               variant="outline"
               data-action="enterprise-test"
               data-host={host ?? ""}
               title={enterpriseTestDisclosure(target, t)}
               disabled={busy || !reasoningModel.trim() || !host}
               onClick={() => void testConnectionNow()}
             >
               {busy ? (
                 t("reasoning.enterprise.testing")
               ) : connected ? (
                 t("reasoning.enterprise.testSuccess")
               ) : host ? (
                 <BidiInterpolatedText text={t("reasoning.enterprise.testConnectionAt", { host: BIDI_VALUE_TOKEN })} value={host} />
               ) : (
                 t("reasoning.enterprise.testConnection")
               )}
             </Button>
             <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{enterpriseTestDisclosure(target, t)}</p>
           </>
         )}
         {error && (
           <p role="alert" className="text-xs text-destructive">
             {error}
           </p>
         )}
       </div>
     );
   }
   ```

   - `settingsStore`'s `setBedrockRegion`, `setAzureEndpoint`, `setVertexProject`, `setVertexLocation` and `setVertexAuthSource` (`src/stores/settingsStore.ts:2033-2105`) each persist to main at once. No Settings UI calls them any more. The only writer of these five route fields is Task 6's `applyRoutePatch`, which mirrors their storage and main calls for a committed patch. The Vertex source selector uses `routeField("vertexAuthSource")` and never saves while typing/selecting; its staged patch is reviewed with every active Vertex recipient. This task's source guard pins the component and Task 18's route-write guard lists all five setters, so no direct writer can return.
   - `adjustBedrockModelForRegion` is no longer imported here. Task 6's `planPatch` (`planEnterpriseCoupling`) adds the model update to the same patch, so the review shows it and Undo restores it.
   - The disclosure and button host come from main. The renderer never derives a host from the endpoint field: a staged edit doesn't change where Test sends until Apply commits it.

     ```tsx
     // Typed text stays local until the field is left or Enter is pressed, then
     // commits once through the route planner (never one request per keystroke).
     function CommitOnLeaveInput({
       value,
       placeholder,
       onCommit,
     }: {
       value: string;
       placeholder?: string;
       onCommit: (value: string) => void;
     }) {
       const [draft, setDraft] = useState(value);
       useEffect(() => setDraft(value), [value]);
       const commit = () => {
         if (draft !== value) onCommit(draft);
       };
       return (
         <Input
           dir="ltr"
           value={draft}
           onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
           onBlur={commit}
           onKeyDown={(e) => {
             if (e.key === "Enter") commit();
           }}
           placeholder={placeholder}
           className="h-8 text-sm"
         />
       );
     }
     ```

8. **`src/components/SelfHostedPanel.tsx`.** Replace the whole file:

   ```tsx
   import { useState } from "react";
   import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
   import { EndpointDraft, type EndpointDraftValue } from "./settings/routing/EndpointDraft";
   import { Button } from "./ui/button";

   interface SelfHostedPanelProps {
     service: "transcription" | "reasoning";
     /** The committed server address and model. */
     url: string;
     model?: string;
     /** Commit through the route planner. Without it the panel is read-only (upload shares dictation's server). */
     onUse?: (next: EndpointDraftValue) => void;
   }

   type ProbeState =
     | { kind: "idle" }
     | { kind: "testing"; host: string }
     | { kind: "ok"; host: string; count: number }
     | { kind: "fail"; host: string; code: string };

   function hostOf(url: string): string | null {
     try {
       return new URL(url.trim()).host || null;
     } catch {
       return null;
     }
   }

   export default function SelfHostedPanel({ service, url, model, onUse }: SelfHostedPanelProps) {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     // No sealed check here: spec §5.4 has main gate the probe as providerCheck (loopback stays
     // testable while sealed) and answer { ok: false, code: "sealed" } otherwise.
     const [probe, setProbe] = useState<ProbeState>({ kind: "idle" });
     const placeholderUrl = service === "transcription" ? "http://localhost:8178" : "http://localhost:11434/v1";

     const runTest = async (address: string) => {
       const host = hostOf(address);
       if (!host) return;
       setProbe({ kind: "testing", host });
       // Main's probe sends no headers (selfHostedProbe.js), so no saved key can reach this address.
       let result: Awaited<ReturnType<NonNullable<Window["electronAPI"]["probeSelfHosted"]>>> | null = null;
       try {
         result = (await window.electronAPI?.probeSelfHosted?.(address.trim())) ?? null;
       } catch {
         result = null;
       }
       if (result && result.ok === true) setProbe({ kind: "ok", host, count: result.count });
       else setProbe({ kind: "fail", host, code: result && result.ok === false ? result.code : "network" });
     };

     const testButton = (address: string) => {
       const host = hostOf(address);
       return (
         <Button
           type="button"
           size="sm"
           variant="outline"
           data-action="probe-self-hosted"
           title={host ? t("settingsPage.selfHosted.testTitle", { host }) : undefined}
           disabled={!host || probe.kind === "testing"}
           onClick={() => void runTest(address)}
         >
           {probe.kind === "testing" ? t("settingsPage.selfHosted.testing") : t("settingsPage.selfHosted.test")}
         </Button>
       );
     };

     const status = (
       <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
         {probe.kind === "ok"
           ? t("settingsPage.selfHosted.testOk", { count: probe.count, host: probe.host })
           : probe.kind === "fail"
             ? probe.code === "sealed"
               ? t("routes.state.sealed")
               : probe.code === "httpsRequired"
                 ? t("settingsPage.selfHosted.testHttpsRequired")
                 : t("settingsPage.selfHosted.testFail", { host: probe.host })
             : ""}
       </p>
     );

     if (!onUse) {
       return (
         <div className="space-y-2 rounded-lg border border-border p-3">
           <p className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground">{t("settingsPage.selfHosted.serverUrl")}</p>
           <p dir="ltr" className="font-mono text-xs text-foreground">
             {url || t("settingsPage.selfHosted.notSet")}
           </p>
           {model && (
             <p dir="ltr" className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
               {model}
             </p>
           )}
           <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("settingsPage.selfHosted.sharedReadOnly")}</p>
           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">{testButton(url)}</div>
           {status}
         </div>
       );
     }

     return (
       <div className="space-y-2.5 rounded-lg border border-border p-3">
         <EndpointDraft
           label={t("settingsPage.selfHosted.serverUrl")}
           url={url}
           urlPlaceholder={placeholderUrl}
           model={service === "transcription" ? (model ?? "") : undefined}
           modelLabel={t("common.model")}
           modelPlaceholder="whisper-large-v3-turbo"
           useLabel={t("staging.useServer")}
           onUse={onUse}
           actions={(draft) => testButton(draft.url)}
         />
         {status}
       </div>
     );
   }
   ```

   A whisper.cpp server may not implement `/models`; the failure copy says it couldn't list models at that host, without claiming the server is down.

### Task 10: Routing page and the Patchbay switchboard (SET-R1 B)

Closes I7 (destination identity comes from `route.providerId` and `route.host`, never from settings; one network destination per distinct effective host; inactive and loopback URLs are never shown as a network destination), the Patchbay half of I1 (every pick goes through `requestRouteChange`, with targets built from the destination), the Patchbay half of I6 (the outcome line lists every coupled route the plan changed), I10 (Corti's speech and text credentials are different key slots), I14 (sealed state is read from `useSealedStore` and nothing else), and M3 (logical properties only; motion through `--motion-*` tokens).

The page shows 11 task jacks on the left and destinations on the right.

A change that adds a recipient is staged, and Task 8's `StagedRoutePanel` appears under the board for that draft. Nothing is sent until Apply.
- A footer meter counts what stays on this device.
- Below 720px of board width the cables hide and the columns stack.

  ```ts
  // destinations.ts
  export type DestinationKind = "device" | "server" | "addServer" | "custom" | "provider";
  export type TaskKind = "speech" | "text";
  export type KeyState = "saved" | "missing" | "rejected" | "unknown" | "none";
  export interface RouteDestination {
    id: string;                 // "device" | "network:<host>" | "network:new" | "custom:<host>" | provider id
    kind: DestinationKind;
    locality: Locality;
    providerId: string | null;  // providers and custom endpoints only
    host: string | null;        // normalized host:port; null for device, addServer and hosted providers with no known host
    urls: { speech: string | null; text: string | null }; // known endpoint URLs at this host, by task kind (server and custom only)
  }
  export type Compatibility =
    | { ok: true }
    | { ok: false; reasonKey: string; params?: { provider?: string; server?: string; kind?: TaskKind } };
  export interface CompatContext { sealed: boolean; providersFor: (id: RouteId) => readonly string[]; dictationServerHost: string | null }
  export const ADD_SERVER_ID = "network:new";
  export function destinationKeyOf(route: Pick<ResolvedRoute, "locality" | "providerId" | "host" | "state">): string | null;
  export function buildDestinations(snapshot: RouteSettingsSnapshot, routes: readonly ResolvedRoute[]): RouteDestination[];
  export function compatContext(snapshot: RouteSettingsSnapshot, sealed: boolean, providersFor: CompatContext["providersFor"]): CompatContext;
  export function checkCompatibility(routeId: RouteId, dest: RouteDestination, ctx: CompatContext): Compatibility;
  export function compatReason(compat: Extract<Compatibility, { ok: false }>, t: Translate): string;
  export function targetForDestination(routeId: RouteId, dest: RouteDestination): RouteTarget;
  export function credentialIdFor(providerId: string | null, kind: ResolvedRoute["kind"] | TaskKind): CredentialId | null;
  export function destinationKeyState(dest: RouteDestination, facts: RouteFacts, kind: TaskKind | null): KeyState;
  export function destinationLabel(dest: RouteDestination, t: Translate): string;
  export function routeDestinationLabel(route: ResolvedRoute, t: Translate): string;
  export function destinationPlace(dest: RouteDestination, t: Translate): string; // "on this device", "on OpenAI" (status line)
  export function routePlace(route: ResolvedRoute, t: Translate): string;
  export function taskKind(routeId: RouteId): TaskKind;
  export function privacyTally(routes: readonly ResolvedRoute[]): { total: number; stay: number; network: number; remote: number };
  export function cablePath(from: { x: number; y: number }, to: { x: number; y: number }): string;
  // usePatchbayBoard.ts
  export function usePatchbayBoard(deps: PatchbayBoardDeps): PatchbayBoard;
  // Patchbay.tsx
  export function PatchbayView(props: PatchbayViewProps): JSX.Element;   // presentational, SSR-testable
  export function Patchbay(props: { onNavigateToPath?: (path: string) => void }): JSX.Element;
  // RoutingSection.tsx
  export function RoutingSection(props: { onNavigateToPath?: (path: string) => void }): JSX.Element;
  // escapeClaim.ts
  export const ESCAPE_CLAIM_SELECTOR: string;
  export function dialogEscapeClaimed(doc: EscapeDoc): boolean;
  ```

  The escape rule: while focus is inside an element with `data-escape-active="true"`, Escape belongs to that element and the dialog stays open; the existing `[data-capturing]` hotkey guard is kept. Task 16's search field reuses the attribute.

**Why destinations come from the resolved route (I7).** v1 re-derived the destination from settings (`targetFromSnapshot`), which read the vision scope even when the vision override was off, and it collapsed every self-hosted URL into one "network" card showing the first configured URL. Task 1 now puts `providerId` and the effective `host` on every `ResolvedRoute`. `destinationKeyOf` reads only those fields, so it cannot disagree with the pill, the editors or the planner. A route with no usable destination (retired service, or a server route whose address is missing or invalid) has no card and no cable; its chip already says why.

```js
];

const creds = (present = []) => new Map(CREDENTIAL_IDS.map((id) => [id, present.includes(id)]));
// Whole-input replacements start from Task 1's all-local defaults (Whisper "base", local Qwen; both installed).
const BASE = makeSnapshot();
const stt = (o = {}) => ({ ...BASE.stt.dictation, ...o });

const LAN_B = "http://192.168.1.30:8178";

// The default board: upload on OpenAI, translation on a LAN server, chat on Groq;
// cleanup and screen context off; OpenAI, Anthropic (rejected) and the Corti text key saved.

    llm: {
      dictationTranslation: { mode: "self-hosted", remoteUrl: LAN_A, model: "llama3.1:8b" },
      chatIntelligence: { mode: "providers", provider: "groq", model: "openai/gpt-oss-120b" },
    },
    enabled: { cleanup: false, screenContext: false },
    facts: { credentials: creds(["openai", "anthropic", "corti:text"]), rejected: new Set(["anthropic"]) },
  });
}

const SPEECH = ["openai", "groq", "corti", "deepgram", "custom"];

  id === "assistantVision" ? ["openai", "anthropic"]
    : id === "noteRecordingStt" ? ["openai", "corti", "deepgram"]
      : id === "dictationStt" || id === "uploadStt" ? SPEECH
        : TEXT;

let graph;

function board(s) {
  const routes = graph.resolveRoutes(s);
  const dests = d.buildDestinations(s, routes);
  const route = (id) => routes.find((r) => r.id === id);
  const key = (id) => d.destinationKeyOf(route(id));
  const byId = Object.fromEntries(dests.map((x) => [x.id, x]));
  return { routes, dests, byId, route, key, ids: dests.map((x) => x.id) };
}
const ctx = (s, sealed = false) => d.compatContext(s, sealed, providersFor);

  const s = snapshot();

  assert.equal(

    'patchbay.place.endpoint{"name":"locality.customEndpoint","host":"192.168.1.50:1234"}'
  );
  const refusal = d.checkCompatibility("dictationStt", b.byId.anthropic, ctx(s));
  assert.equal(d.compatReason(refusal, t), 'patchbay.no.capability{"provider":"Anthropic"}');
});
```

```js
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const test = require("node:test");

const load = () => import("../../src/components/ui/escapeClaim.ts");

const doc = ({ capturing = false, active = null } = {}) => ({
  querySelector: (selector) => (selector === "[data-capturing]" && capturing ? {} : null),
  activeElement: active,
});
const inside = (claimed) => ({ closest: (selector) => (claimed && selector === '[data-escape-active="true"]' ? {} : null) });

// baseline guard: the hotkey-capture rule that SidebarModal already had (SidebarModal.tsx:123-125).
test("Escape stays with an active hotkey capture", async () => {

  assert.equal(dialogEscapeClaimed(doc({ capturing: true })), true);
  assert.equal(dialogEscapeClaimed(doc()), false);
});

// change-driving: the escape-claim rule does not exist yet.
test("Escape stays with a widget that claims it while focus is inside that widget", async () => {
  const { dialogEscapeClaimed, ESCAPE_CLAIM_SELECTOR } = await load();
  assert.equal(ESCAPE_CLAIM_SELECTOR, '[data-escape-active="true"]');
  assert.equal(dialogEscapeClaimed(doc({ active: inside(true) })), true);
  assert.equal(dialogEscapeClaimed(doc({ active: inside(false) })), false, "an unclaimed widget lets the dialog close");
  assert.equal(dialogEscapeClaimed(doc({ active: null })), false, "no focused element");
  assert.equal(dialogEscapeClaimed(doc({ active: {} })), false, "a node without closest() never claims");
});
```
