const CREDENTIAL_IDS = [
  "openai", "anthropic", "gemini", "groq", "xai", "mistral", "openrouter", "tinfoil",
  "deepgram", "assemblyai", "corti:text", "corti:speech", "codex", "bedrock", "azure", "vertex",
];
const creds = (present = []) => new Map(CREDENTIAL_IDS.map((id) => [id, present.includes(id)]));
// The same default board as patchbayDestinations.test.js, on Task 1's shared fixture.
function snapshot() {
  return makeSnapshot({
    stt: { upload: { mode: "providers", cloudProvider: "openai", cloudModel: "gpt-4o-mini-transcribe" } },
    llm: {
      dictationTranslation: { mode: "self-hosted", remoteUrl: "http://192.168.1.20:11434/v1", model: "llama3.1:8b" },
      chatIntelligence: { mode: "providers", provider: "groq", model: "openai/gpt-oss-120b" },
    },
    enabled: { cleanup: false, screenContext: false },
    facts: { credentials: creds(["openai", "anthropic", "corti:text"]), rejected: new Set(["anthropic"]) },
  });
}
const SPEECH = ["openai", "groq", "corti", "deepgram", "custom"];
const TEXT = ["openai", "anthropic", "groq", "corti", "custom"];
const providersFor = (id) =>
  id === "assistantVision" ? ["openai", "anthropic"]
    : id === "noteRecordingStt" ? ["openai", "corti", "deepgram"]
      : id === "dictationStt" || id === "uploadStt" ? SPEECH
        : TEXT;
const tr = (key, options) => (options ? `${key}${JSON.stringify(options)}` : key);

const defer = () => {
  let resolve;
  const promise = new Promise((r) => (resolve = r));
  return { promise, resolve };
};
const tick = () => React.act(async () => { await new Promise((r) => setImmediate(r)); });
function find(node, predicate) {
  if (Array.isArray(node)) return node.map((item) => find(item, predicate)).find(Boolean);
  if (!node || typeof node !== "object") return null;
  return predicate(node) ? node : find(node.props?.children, predicate);
}

function mountHook(st, useHook, getProps) {
  const container = globalThis.document.documentElement;
  let latest;
  function Probe() {
    latest = useHook(getProps());
    return null;
  }
  const root = createRoot(container);
  st.after(async () => React.act(async () => root.unmount()));
  return {
    current: () => latest,
    render: () => React.act(async () => root.render(React.createElement(Probe))),
  };
}

test("patchbay", async (t) => {

  installHookDom(t);
  const vite = await createRendererServer(t, withI18nMock({ cachePrefix: "loqui-patchbay-test-" }, { withOptions: true }));

      copy: snap.copy,

      request: async (id, target) => {
        calls.push({ id, target });
        return typeof state.next === "function" ? state.next() : state.next;

      ...over,
    };
    return { deps, calls, state };

  const change = (id, after, coupled = false) => ({ id, before: after, after, coupled });
  const deviceAs = (id) => ({ ...baseRoutes.find((r) => r.id === "dictationStt"), id });
  const pick = async (b, id) => React.act(async () => b.current().pickDestination(b.current().destinations.find((x) => x.id === id)));
  const selectTask = (b, id) => React.act(async () => b.current().selectTask(id));

  await t.test("the view: every task and destination is a real button; cables are hidden from assistive tech", () => {

    assert.equal((html.match(/data-destination="/g) ?? []).length, dests.length);
    assert.match(html, /role="group"[^>]*aria-label="patchbay\.tasks"/);
    assert.match(html, /role="group"[^>]*aria-label="patchbay\.destinations"/);
    assert.match(html, /<svg[^>]*aria-hidden="true"[^>]*class="patchbay-cables"/);
    assert.match(html, /data-task="speakerId"[^>]*aria-disabled="true"/);
    assert.match(html, /patchbay\.locked\.speakerId/);
    assert.match(html, /data-destination="network:192\.168\.1\.20:11434"/);
    assert.match(html, /<span[^>]*dir="ltr"[^>]*>192\.168\.1\.20:11434<\/span>/, "the card names the host that receives the data");
    assert.match(html, /data-escape-active="false"/);

Notes on the test file:
- `makeDeps` returns the recording `request` and a mutable `state.next` (`"staged"`, an outcome object, or a function returning a promise).
- The `RoutingSection` test calls the component as a function inside a probe that returns `null`, so no host element is ever committed.

Expected: FAIL.
- `patchbayDestinations.test.js`: `Cannot find module .../destinations.ts` (change-driving: the module is new). The final source-guard test fails the same way.
- `patchbay.test.js`: `Failed to load url /components/settings/routing/destinations.ts` (the first missing module in the SSR load order; it throws before any subtest runs).
- `escapeClaim.test.js`: both tests fail with `Cannot find module .../escapeClaim.ts`; the hotkey-capture test is a baseline guard for behaviour the dialog already has inline, and starts passing as soon as the extracted helper exists.
- `settingsPathsRouting.test.js`: the routing test fails on the `indexOf` assertion (`-1 !== 2`: Task 4 lists no `"routing"`); the `stt` alias test passes (baseline guard).

1. Add `export const Waypoints = createIcon("waypoints", Lucide.Waypoints);` to `src/components/icons/index.ts`, immediately before `export const Wrench` (`:104`). Lucide ships `waypoints`.

2. Create `src/components/ui/escapeClaim.ts`:

   ```ts
   // Escape belongs to the innermost thing that is mid-gesture. The Settings
   // dialog keeps two such claims: a hotkey field that is capturing, and a
   // widget that marks itself with data-escape-active="true" while it holds a
   // transient state (a Patchbay selection, a search query). A claimed Escape
   // is left to that widget; the next press closes the dialog.
   export const ESCAPE_CLAIM_SELECTOR = '[data-escape-active="true"]';

   export interface EscapeDoc {
     querySelector(selector: string): unknown;
     activeElement: { closest?: (selector: string) => unknown } | null;
   }

   export function dialogEscapeClaimed(doc: EscapeDoc): boolean {
     if (doc.querySelector("[data-capturing]")) return true;
     const active = doc.activeElement;
     return !!active && typeof active.closest === "function" && !!active.closest(ESCAPE_CLAIM_SELECTOR);
   }
   ```

3. In `src/components/ui/SidebarModal.tsx`:
   - Import: `import { dialogEscapeClaimed } from "./escapeClaim";`
   - Replace the handler at `:123-125` (pre-Plan-03 numbering; Task 8 adds `data-settings-dialog=""` to the same `DialogPrimitive.Content`, so locate it by its body `if (document.querySelector("[data-capturing]")) e.preventDefault();`):

     ```tsx
     onEscapeKeyDown={(e) => {
       // Radix runs this in the capture phase, before the widget's own React
       // handler, so a claimed Escape is still unconsumed here. The widget
       // clears its state; the dialog closes on the next press.
       if (dialogEscapeClaimed(document)) e.preventDefault();
     }}
     ```

   - On the `className` of `DialogPrimitive.Content` (`:132`), change `max-w-4xl` to `max-w-5xl`. Change nothing else in that string.

   ```ts
   import { providerDisplayLabel, providerDisplayName, type Locality } from "../../../lib/locality.ts";
   import {
     ROUTE_KIND,
     type CredentialId,
     type ResolvedRoute,
     type RouteFacts,
     type RouteId,
     type RouteSettingsSnapshot,
   } from "../../../lib/routeGraph.ts";
   import type { RouteTarget } from "../../../lib/routePlanner.ts";

   type Translate = (key: string, options?: Record<string, unknown>) => string;

   export type DestinationKind = "device" | "server" | "addServer" | "custom" | "provider";
   export type TaskKind = "speech" | "text";
   export type KeyState = "saved" | "missing" | "rejected" | "unknown" | "none";

   export interface RouteDestination {
     id: string;
     kind: DestinationKind;
     locality: Locality;
     providerId: string | null;
     host: string | null;
     urls: { speech: string | null; text: string | null };
   }

   export type Compatibility =
     | { ok: true }
     | {
         ok: false;
         reasonKey: string;
         params?: { provider?: string; server?: string; kind?: TaskKind };
       };

   export interface CompatContext {
     sealed: boolean;
     providersFor: (id: RouteId) => readonly string[];
     dictationServerHost: string | null;
   }

   export const ADD_SERVER_ID = "network:new";

   const NO_URLS = { speech: null, text: null } as const;

   function hostOf(url: string | null | undefined): string | null {
     if (!url || !url.trim()) return null;
     try {
       return new URL(url.trim()).host || null;
     } catch {
       return null;
     }
   }

   export function taskKind(routeId: RouteId): TaskKind {
     return ROUTE_KIND[routeId] === "speech" ? "speech" : "text";
   }

   // Identity is a function of the resolved route alone. A retired service and
   // a server route with no usable address have no destination: their chip
   // already says why, and a card for them would invent a recipient.
   export function destinationKeyOf(
     route: Pick<ResolvedRoute, "locality" | "providerId" | "host" | "state">
   ): string | null {
     if (route.state.status === "unreachable" && route.state.detail === "retired") return null;
     if (route.locality === "device") return "device";
     if (route.locality === "network") return route.host ? `network:${route.host}` : null;
     if (!route.providerId) return null;
     if (route.providerId === "custom") return route.host ? `custom:${route.host}` : null;
     return route.providerId;
   }

   // Corti has two credential slots: speech uses the client pair, text uses the
   // API key (Task 1). Every other provider is its own slot; "custom" has none.
   export function credentialIdFor(
     providerId: string | null,
     kind: ResolvedRoute["kind"] | TaskKind
   ): CredentialId | null {
     if (!providerId || providerId === "custom") return null;
     if (providerId === "corti") return kind === "speech" ? "corti:speech" : "corti:text";
     return providerId as CredentialId;
   }

   function providerOfCredential(id: string): string {
     return id.startsWith("corti:") ? "corti" : id;
   }

   // The first URL of this kind that points at this host. Scan order is fixed
   // (dictation, upload, meeting; then the LLM scopes in declaration order), so
   // the result never depends on object iteration luck.
   function knownUrl(
     snapshot: RouteSettingsSnapshot,
     host: string,
     kind: TaskKind,
     field: "remoteUrl" | "cloudBaseUrl"
   ): string | null {
     const inputs: Array<{ remoteUrl?: string; cloudBaseUrl?: string }> =
       kind === "speech"
         ? [snapshot.stt.dictation, snapshot.stt.upload, snapshot.stt.meeting]
         : Object.values(snapshot.llm);
     for (const input of inputs) {
       const url = (input[field] ?? "").trim();
       if (url && hostOf(url) === host) return url;
     }
     return null;
   }

   export function buildDestinations(
     snapshot: RouteSettingsSnapshot,
     routes: readonly ResolvedRoute[]
   ): RouteDestination[] {
     const serverHosts = new Set<string>();
     const customHosts = new Set<string>();
     const providerIds = new Set<string>();
     // Hosts the provider's in-use routes actually resolve to (Corti text and
     // speech differ, Task 1's textHostKey).
     const routeHosts = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
     // For a provider listed only through a saved credential: the providerHosts
     // key of that credential's slot. corti:speech wins over corti:text.
     const credentialHostKey = new Map<string, string>();
     // Off routes keep the destination they would use, but they send nothing, so
     // they do not create cards.
     for (const route of routes) {
       if (route.state.status === "off") continue;
       if (destinationKeyOf(route) === null) continue;
       if (route.locality === "network") serverHosts.add(route.host as string);
       else if (route.locality === "remote" && route.providerId === "custom") {
         customHosts.add(route.host as string);
       } else if (route.locality === "remote") {
         const id = route.providerId as string;
         providerIds.add(id);
         if (route.host) routeHosts.set(id, (routeHosts.get(id) ?? new Set<string>()).add(route.host));
       }
     }
     for (const [id, present] of snapshot.facts.credentials ?? []) {
       if (!present) continue;
       const provider = providerOfCredential(id);
       providerIds.add(provider);
       if (id === "corti:speech") credentialHostKey.set(provider, "corti");
       else if (!credentialHostKey.has(provider)) credentialHostKey.set(provider, id);
     }

     const hosts = snapshot.capabilities.providerHosts;
     const hostAt = (key: string) => (Object.hasOwn(hosts, key) ? hosts[key] : null);
     // One distinct in-use host: that host. Several: the provider's own entry.
     // None: the host of the saved credential's slot.
     const providerCardHost = (id: string): string | null => {
       const inUse = routeHosts.get(id);
       if (inUse && inUse.size === 1) return [...inUse][0];
       if (inUse && inUse.size > 1) return hostAt(id);
       return hostAt(credentialHostKey.get(id) ?? id);
     };
     const device: RouteDestination = {
       id: "device", kind: "device", locality: "device", providerId: null, host: null, urls: { ...NO_URLS },
     };
     const servers = [...serverHosts].sort().map<RouteDestination>((host) => ({
       id: `network:${host}`,
       kind: "server",
       locality: "network",
       providerId: null,
       host,
       urls: {
         speech: knownUrl(snapshot, host, "speech", "remoteUrl"),
         text: knownUrl(snapshot, host, "text", "remoteUrl"),
       },
     }));
     const addServer: RouteDestination = {
       id: ADD_SERVER_ID, kind: "addServer", locality: "network", providerId: null, host: null, urls: { ...NO_URLS },
     };
     const customs = [...customHosts].sort().map<RouteDestination>((host) => ({
       id: `custom:${host}`,
       kind: "custom",
       locality: "remote",
       providerId: "custom",
       host,
       urls: {
         speech: knownUrl(snapshot, host, "speech", "cloudBaseUrl"),
         text: knownUrl(snapshot, host, "text", "cloudBaseUrl"),
       },
     }));
     const providers = [...providerIds]
       .sort((a, b) => providerDisplayName(a).localeCompare(providerDisplayName(b)) || a.localeCompare(b))
       .map<RouteDestination>((id) => ({
         id,
         kind: "provider",
         locality: "remote",
         providerId: id,
         host: providerCardHost(id),
         urls: { ...NO_URLS },
       }));
     return [device, ...servers, addServer, ...customs, ...providers];
   }

   export function compatContext(
     snapshot: RouteSettingsSnapshot,
     sealed: boolean,
     providersFor: CompatContext["providersFor"]
   ): CompatContext {
     return { sealed, providersFor, dictationServerHost: hostOf(snapshot.stt.dictation.remoteUrl) };
   }

   export function checkCompatibility(
     routeId: RouteId,
     dest: RouteDestination,
     ctx: CompatContext
   ): Compatibility {
     if (routeId === "speakerId" || routeId === "semanticSearch") {
       return { ok: false, reasonKey: `patchbay.locked.${routeId}` };
     }
     if (ctx.sealed && dest.kind !== "device") return { ok: false, reasonKey: "patchbay.no.sealed" };
     // Screenshots go to a cloud vision model; the vision scope has no server URL of its own.
     if (routeId === "assistantVision" && dest.locality !== "remote") {
       return { ok: false, reasonKey: "patchbay.no.visionCloudOnly" };
     }
     if (dest.kind === "device") return { ok: true };
     const kind = taskKind(routeId);
     if (dest.kind === "addServer" || dest.kind === "server") {
       // Note recording's self-hosted option is not available (MeetingSettings.tsx:89).
       if (routeId === "noteRecordingStt") return { ok: false, reasonKey: "patchbay.no.meetingServer" };
       // Upload reads dictation's server and never writes it, so it can only go
       // to the server dictation already points at.
       if (routeId === "uploadStt") {
         return dest.kind === "server" && dest.host !== null && dest.host === ctx.dictationServerHost
           ? { ok: true }
           : { ok: false, reasonKey: "patchbay.no.uploadServer" };
       }
       if (dest.kind === "addServer" || dest.urls[kind] !== null) return { ok: true };
       return { ok: false, reasonKey: "patchbay.no.serverKind", params: { server: dest.host ?? "", kind } };
     }
     if (dest.providerId === null || !ctx.providersFor(routeId).includes(dest.providerId)) {
       return { ok: false, reasonKey: "patchbay.no.capability", params: { provider: dest.providerId ?? "" } };
     }
     if (dest.kind === "custom" && dest.urls[kind] === null) {
       return { ok: false, reasonKey: "patchbay.no.serverKind", params: { server: dest.host ?? "", kind } };
     }
     return { ok: true };
   }

   export function compatReason(compat: Extract<Compatibility, { ok: false }>, t: Translate): string {
     const p = compat.params ?? {};
     const options = {
       ...(p.provider !== undefined ? { provider: providerDisplayLabel(p.provider, t) } : {}),
       ...(p.server !== undefined ? { server: p.server } : {}),
       ...(p.kind !== undefined ? { kind: t(`patchbay.kind.${p.kind}`) } : {}),
     };
     return Object.keys(options).length > 0 ? t(compat.reasonKey, options) : t(compat.reasonKey);
   }

   // The target is built from the destination alone. "Add a server" starts with
   // an empty address, which the planner reports as needsUrl and Task 8's staged
   // panel asks for; no other task's URL is ever reused.
   export function targetForDestination(routeId: RouteId, dest: RouteDestination): RouteTarget {
     const kind = taskKind(routeId);
     switch (dest.kind) {
       case "device":
         return { mode: "local" };
       case "addServer":
         return { mode: "self-hosted", remoteUrl: "" };
       case "server":
         return { mode: "self-hosted", remoteUrl: dest.urls[kind] ?? "" };
       case "custom":
         return { mode: "providers", provider: "custom", baseUrl: dest.urls[kind] ?? "" };
       default:
         return { mode: "providers", provider: dest.providerId as string };
     }
   }

   // Key readiness for a provider card, from main-confirmed presence only
   // (rule 5). null kind (no task selected) is treated as text; callers do not
   // show a key line without a selection.
   export function destinationKeyState(
     dest: RouteDestination,
     facts: RouteFacts,
     kind: TaskKind | null
   ): KeyState {
     if (dest.kind !== "provider" || dest.providerId === null) return "none";
     if (facts.credentials === null) return "unknown";
     const id = credentialIdFor(dest.providerId, kind ?? "text");
     if (id === null || !facts.credentials.has(id)) return "none";
     if (facts.rejected.has(id)) return "rejected";
     return facts.credentials.get(id) === true ? "saved" : "missing";
   }

   export function destinationLabel(dest: RouteDestination, t: Translate): string {
     switch (dest.kind) {
       case "device":
         return t("locality.device");
       case "addServer":
         return t("patchbay.dest.addServer");
       case "server":
         return t("patchbay.dest.serverAt", { host: dest.host });
       case "custom":
         return t("patchbay.dest.endpointAt", { name: providerDisplayLabel("custom", t), host: dest.host });
       default:
         return providerDisplayLabel(dest.providerId, t);
     }
   }

   // A resolved route's destination in words, for status lines and the footer.
   export function routeDestinationLabel(route: ResolvedRoute, t: Translate): string {
     if (route.locality === "device") return t("locality.device");
     if (route.locality === "network") {
       return route.host ? t("patchbay.dest.serverAt", { host: route.host }) : t("locality.network");
     }
     if (route.providerId === "custom" && route.host) {
       return t("patchbay.dest.endpointAt", { name: providerDisplayLabel("custom", t), host: route.host });
     }
     return providerDisplayLabel(route.providerId, t);
   }

   // A destination as a phrase inside a sentence ("on this device", "on OpenAI",
   // "on your server at 192.168.1.20:11434"), for the status line. Labels such as
   // "On this device" are headings and do not read inside "now runs …".
   export function destinationPlace(dest: RouteDestination, t: Translate): string {
     switch (dest.kind) {
       case "device":
         return t("patchbay.place.device");
       case "addServer":
         return t("patchbay.place.anyServer");
       case "server":
         return t("patchbay.place.server", { host: dest.host });
       case "custom":
         return t("patchbay.place.endpoint", { name: providerDisplayLabel("custom", t), host: dest.host });
       default:
         return t("patchbay.place.provider", { provider: providerDisplayLabel(dest.providerId, t) });
     }
   }

   export function routePlace(route: ResolvedRoute, t: Translate): string {
     if (route.locality === "device") return t("patchbay.place.device");
     if (route.locality === "network") {
       return route.host ? t("patchbay.place.server", { host: route.host }) : t("patchbay.place.anyServer");
     }
     if (route.providerId === "custom" && route.host) {
       return t("patchbay.place.endpoint", { name: providerDisplayLabel("custom", t), host: route.host });
     }
     return t("patchbay.place.provider", { provider: providerDisplayLabel(route.providerId, t) });
   }

   export function privacyTally(routes: readonly ResolvedRoute[]) {
     let stay = 0;
     let network = 0;
     let remote = 0;
     for (const r of routes) {
       if (r.sends === null) stay++;
       else if (r.locality === "network") network++;
       else remote++;
     }
     return { total: routes.length, stay, network, remote };
   }

   export function cablePath(from: { x: number; y: number }, to: { x: number; y: number }): string {
     return `M ${from.x} ${from.y} C ${from.x + 120} ${from.y}, ${to.x - 120} ${to.y}, ${to.x} ${to.y}`;
   }
   ```

5. Create `src/components/settings/routing/usePatchbayBoard.ts`. It takes everything as arguments (no store or i18n imports), so tests drive it with fakes:

   ```ts
   import { useCallback, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
   import type { ResolvedRoute, RouteCopy, RouteId, RouteSettingsSnapshot } from "../../../lib/routeGraph.ts";
   import type { RouteChangeOutcome, RouteRequestResult } from "../../../stores/routeDraftStore.ts";
   import type { RouteTarget } from "../../../lib/routePlanner.ts";
   import {
     buildDestinations,
     checkCompatibility,
     compatContext,
     compatReason,
     destinationKeyOf,
     destinationKeyState,
     destinationLabel,
     destinationPlace,
     routePlace,
     targetForDestination,
     taskKind,
     type Compatibility,
     type KeyState,
     type RouteDestination,
   } from "./destinations.ts";

   type Translate = (key: string, options?: Record<string, unknown>) => string;

   export interface PatchbayBoardDeps {
     routes: ResolvedRoute[];
     snapshot: RouteSettingsSnapshot;
     sealed: boolean;
     providersFor: (id: RouteId) => readonly string[];
     request: (id: RouteId, target: RouteTarget) => Promise<RouteRequestResult>;
     copy: RouteCopy;
     t: Translate;
   }

   export interface PatchbayBoard {
     destinations: RouteDestination[];
     selectedId: RouteId | null;
     message: string | null;
    undo: (() => Promise<void>) | null;
     compatOf: (dest: RouteDestination) => Compatibility | null;
     keyStateOf: (dest: RouteDestination) => KeyState | null;
     selectTask: (id: RouteId) => void;
     pickDestination: (dest: RouteDestination) => Promise<void>;
     clearSelection: () => boolean;
   }

   export function usePatchbayBoard(deps: PatchbayBoardDeps): PatchbayBoard {
     const { routes, snapshot, sealed, providersFor, request, copy, t } = deps;
     const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<RouteId | null>(null);
     const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [undo, setUndo] = useState<(() => Promise<void>) | null>(null);
     const busy = useRef(false);

     const destinations = useMemo(() => buildDestinations(snapshot, routes), [snapshot, routes]);
     const ctx = useMemo(
       () => compatContext(snapshot, sealed, providersFor),
       [snapshot, sealed, providersFor]
     );
     const selected = routes.find((r) => r.id === selectedId) ?? null;
     const taskName = (id: RouteId) => t(`routes.names.${id}`);

     const compatOf = (dest: RouteDestination) =>
       selected ? checkCompatibility(selected.id, dest, ctx) : null;
     const keyStateOf = (dest: RouteDestination) =>
       selected ? destinationKeyState(dest, snapshot.facts, taskKind(selected.id)) : null;

     const selectTask = useCallback(
       (id: RouteId) => {
         const route = routes.find((r) => r.id === id);
         if (!route) return;
         setUndo(null);
         if (route.kind === "support") {
           setSelectedId(null);
           setMessage(t(`patchbay.locked.${id}`));
           return;
         }
         setMessage(null);
         setSelectedId((current) => (current === id ? null : id));
       },
       [routes, t]
     );

     const clearSelection = useCallback((): boolean => {
       if (selectedId === null) return false;
       setSelectedId(null);
       setMessage(null);
       return true;
     }, [selectedId]);

     const runUndo = async (fn: () => Promise<RouteChangeOutcome | "staged" | "superseded" | "save-failed">, task: string) => {
       setUndo(null);
       const result = await fn();
       if (result === "superseded") return;
       if (result === "save-failed") {
         setMessage(t("common.error"));
         return;
       }
       if (result === "staged") setMessage(t("patchbay.hint.undoStaged"));
       else setMessage(result.applied ? t("patchbay.hint.undone", { task }) : t("patchbay.hint.notApplied"));
     };

     const announce = (route: ResolvedRoute, dest: RouteDestination, outcome: RouteChangeOutcome) => {
       const task = taskName(route.id);
       if (outcome.plan.kind === "noop") {
         setMessage(t("patchbay.hint.already", { task, place: destinationPlace(dest, t) }));
         return;
       }
       if (!outcome.applied) {
         setMessage(t("patchbay.hint.notApplied"));
         return;
       }
       const own = outcome.plan.changes.find((c) => c.id === route.id);
       const place = own ? routePlace(own.after, t) : destinationPlace(dest, t);
       let text =
         route.state.status === "off"
           ? t("patchbay.hint.movedOff", { task, place })
           : t("patchbay.hint.moved", { task, place });
       const coupled = outcome.plan.changes.filter((c) => c.coupled);
       if (coupled.length > 0) {
         text += ` ${t("patchbay.hint.movedAlso", { tasks: copy.list(coupled.map((c) => taskName(c.id))) })}`;
       }
       setMessage(text);
       const undoFn = outcome.undo;
       if (undoFn) setUndo(() => () => runUndo(undoFn, task));
     };

     const pickDestination = useCallback(
       async (dest: RouteDestination) => {
         if (busy.current) return;
         if (!selected) {
           setMessage(t("patchbay.hint.pickTaskFirst"));
           return;
         }
         const compat = checkCompatibility(selected.id, dest, ctx);
         if (compat.ok === false) {
           setMessage(compatReason(compat, t));
           return;
         }
         const task = taskName(selected.id);
         if (destinationKeyOf(selected) === dest.id) {
           setMessage(
             selected.state.status === "off"
               ? t("patchbay.hint.off", { task })
               : t("patchbay.hint.already", { task, place: destinationPlace(dest, t) })
           );
           return;
         }
         busy.current = true;
         setUndo(null);
         try {
           const outcome = await request(selected.id, targetForDestination(selected.id, dest));
           setSelectedId(null);
           // Settings closed, Discard ran, or a newer request or an Undo on this route won
           // while this one waited (R2-8):
           // nothing was staged or committed, so say nothing.
           if (outcome === "superseded") return;
           if (outcome === "save-failed") {
             setMessage(t("common.error"));
             return;
           }
           if (outcome === "staged") {
             setMessage(t("patchbay.hint.staged", { task, destination: destinationLabel(dest, t) }));
           } else {
             announce(selected, dest, outcome);
           }
         } catch (error) {
           setMessage(t("patchbay.hint.failed", { error: (error as Error).message }));
         } finally {
           busy.current = false;
         }
       },
       // announce/runUndo only close over t, copy and setters
       // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
       [selected, ctx, request, t, copy]
     );

     return {
       destinations,
       selectedId,
       message,
       undo,
       compatOf,
       keyStateOf,
       selectTask,
       pickDestination,
       clearSelection,
     };
   }
   ```

6. Create `src/components/settings/routing/Patchbay.tsx`. The view is pure props; the container wires the stores, measures cables and owns nothing else:

   ```tsx
   import { useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
   import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
   import {
     routeSnapshotFromSettings,
     useResolvedRoutes,
     useRouteCopy,
     type ResolvedRoute,
     type RouteId,
   } from "../../../lib/routes";
   import { requestRouteChange, useRouteDraftStore } from "../../../stores/routeDraftStore";
   import { ensureSealedSubscribed, useSealedStore } from "../../../stores/sealedStore";
   import { useSettingsStore } from "../../../stores/settingsStore";
   import { ChevronRight, Lock } from "../../icons";
   import { Button } from "../../ui/button";
   import { LocalityRing } from "../../ui/LocalityRing";
   import { RouteDestinationChip, RouteStateChip } from "./RouteChips";
   import {
     cablePath,
     compatReason,
     destinationKeyOf,
     destinationLabel,
     privacyTally,
     routeDestinationLabel,
     type Compatibility,
     type KeyState,
     type RouteDestination,
   } from "./destinations";
   import { providersForRoute } from "./providerCatalog";
   import { usePatchbayBoard } from "./usePatchbayBoard";

   export interface PatchbayCable {
     id: RouteId;
     d: string;
     locality: string;
     paused: boolean;
   }

   export interface PatchbayViewProps {
     routes: ResolvedRoute[];
     destinations: RouteDestination[];
     destinationOf: (route: ResolvedRoute) => string | null;
     compatOf: (dest: RouteDestination) => Compatibility | null;
     keyStateOf: (dest: RouteDestination) => KeyState | null;
     selectedId: RouteId | null;
     stagedRouteId: RouteId | null;
     sealed: boolean;
     message: string | null;
     onUndo: (() => void) | null;
     wide: boolean;
     cables?: PatchbayCable[];
     boardRef?: React.Ref<HTMLDivElement>;
     registerJack?: (key: string) => React.Ref<HTMLSpanElement>;
     onSelectTask: (id: RouteId) => void;
     onPickDestination: (dest: RouteDestination) => void;
     onOpenSettings: (route: ResolvedRoute) => void;
     onEscape?: () => boolean;
   }

   const GROUPS = ["speech", "text", "support"] as const;

   export function PatchbayView(props: PatchbayViewProps) {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     const { routes, destinations, selectedId, wide } = props;
     const selected = routes.find((r) => r.id === selectedId) ?? null;
     const tally = privacyTally(routes);
     const leaving = routes.filter((r) => r.sends !== null);
     const byId = new Map(destinations.map((d) => [d.id, d]));

     return (
       <div
         className="space-y-3"
         data-escape-active={selectedId ? "true" : "false"}
         onKeyDown={(e) => {
           if (e.key === "Escape" && props.onEscape?.()) e.stopPropagation();
         }}
       >
         {props.sealed && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("patchbay.sealed")}</p>}
         <div className="flex min-h-7 items-center gap-2">
           <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
             {props.message ??
               (selected
                 ? t("patchbay.hint.pickDestination", { task: t(`routes.names.${selected.id}`) })
                 : t("patchbay.hint.idle"))}
           </p>
           {props.onUndo && (
             <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="ghost" data-action="undo-route" onClick={props.onUndo}>
               {t("patchbay.undo")}
             </Button>
           )}
         </div>
         <div ref={props.boardRef} data-layout={wide ? "board" : "list"} className="patchbay-board relative">
           {wide && (
             <svg aria-hidden="true" className="patchbay-cables">
               {(props.cables ?? []).map((c) => (
                 <path
                   key={c.id}
                   d={c.d}
                   data-locality={c.locality}
                   data-paused={c.paused ? "true" : "false"}
                   data-dim={selectedId && selectedId !== c.id ? "true" : "false"}
                 />
               ))}
             </svg>
           )}
           <div role="group" aria-label={t("patchbay.tasks")} className="patchbay-tasks">
             {GROUPS.map((group) => (
               <div key={group} className="space-y-1">
                 <p className="px-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
                   {t(`routes.groups.${group}`)}
                 </p>
                 {routes
                   .filter((r) => r.kind === group)
                   .map((route) => {
                     const locked = route.kind === "support";
                     return (
                       <div key={route.id} className="flex items-center gap-1">
                         <button
                           type="button"
                           data-task={route.id}
                           aria-pressed={selectedId === route.id}
                           aria-disabled={locked || undefined}
                           title={locked ? t(`patchbay.locked.${route.id}`) : undefined}
                           onClick={() => props.onSelectTask(route.id)}
                           data-staged={props.stagedRouteId === route.id ? "true" : "false"}
                           className="patchbay-task"
                         >
                           <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-start">
                             <span className="block truncate text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                               {t(`routes.names.${route.id}`)}
                             </span>
                             <RouteDestinationChip route={route} className="h-5" />
                           </span>
                           {locked ? (
                             <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                               <Lock className="h-3 w-3" aria-hidden="true" />
                               <span className="sr-only">{t(`patchbay.locked.${route.id}`)}</span>
                             </span>
                           ) : (
                             <RouteStateChip state={route.state} />
                           )}
                           <span
                             ref={props.registerJack?.(`task:${route.id}`)}
                             className="patchbay-jack"
                             data-locality={route.locality}
                             aria-hidden="true"
                           />
                         </button>
                         <button
                           type="button"
                           onClick={() => props.onOpenSettings(route)}
                           aria-label={t("patchbay.openSettings", { task: t(`routes.names.${route.id}`) })}
                           className="grid h-7 w-7 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-md text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-ring"
                         >
                           <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 rtl:-scale-x-100" aria-hidden="true" />
                         </button>
                       </div>
                     );
                   })}
               </div>
             ))}
           </div>
           <div role="group" aria-label={t("patchbay.destinations")} className="patchbay-destinations">
             {destinations.map((dest) => {
               const compat = props.compatOf(dest);
               const refused = compat !== null && compat.ok === false;
               const reason = compat !== null && compat.ok === false ? compatReason(compat, t) : null;
               const count = routes.filter(
                 (r) => r.state.status !== "off" && props.destinationOf(r) === dest.id
               ).length;
               const name = destinationLabel(dest, t);
               const keyState = props.keyStateOf(dest);
               const http = [dest.urls.speech, dest.urls.text].some((u) => u?.startsWith("http:"));
               return (
                 <button
                   key={dest.id}
                   type="button"
                   data-destination={dest.id}
                   data-compat={compat ? (compat.ok ? "ok" : "no") : undefined}
                   aria-disabled={refused || undefined}
                   title={reason ?? undefined}
                   data-locality={dest.locality}
                   onClick={() => props.onPickDestination(dest)}
                   className="patchbay-destination"
                 >
                   <span
                     ref={props.registerJack?.(`dest:${dest.id}`)}
                     className="patchbay-jack"
                     data-locality={dest.locality}
                     aria-hidden="true"
                   />
                   <span className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                     <span className="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold">
                       <LocalityRing
                         locality={dest.locality}
                         label={dest.locality === "remote" ? t("locality.remote", { provider: name }) : name}
                         provider={dest.locality === "remote" ? name : null}
                         size={16}
                       />
                       <span className="truncate">{name}</span>
                     </span>
                     {dest.kind !== "addServer" && (
                       <span className="shrink-0 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                         {t("patchbay.taskCount", { count })}
                       </span>
                     )}
                   </span>
                   {dest.host && (
                     <span className="block truncate font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground" dir="ltr">
                       {dest.host}
                     </span>
                   )}
                   <span className="block text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                     {dest.kind === "device"
                       ? t("patchbay.dest.nothingLeaves")
                       : dest.kind === "addServer"
                         ? t("patchbay.dest.addServerHint")
                         : dest.kind === "server"
                           ? http
                             ? t("patchbay.dest.unencrypted")
                             : t("patchbay.dest.yourServer")
                           : dest.kind === "custom"
                             ? http
                               ? t("patchbay.dest.unencrypted")
                               : t("patchbay.dest.hosted")
                             : keyState === "saved"
                               ? t("patchbay.dest.keySaved")
                               : keyState === "missing"
                                 ? t("patchbay.dest.noKey")
                                 : keyState === "rejected"
                                   ? t("patchbay.dest.keyRejected")
                                   : keyState === "unknown"
                                     ? t("patchbay.dest.keyUnknown")
                                     : t("patchbay.dest.hosted")}
                   </span>
                   {reason && <span className="sr-only">{reason}</span>}
                 </button>
               );
             })}
           </div>
         </div>
         <div className="grid gap-3 rounded-lg border border-border/70 bg-muted/30 p-3 sm:grid-cols-[minmax(240px,1fr)_1.4fr]">
           <div>
             <div
               role="img"
               aria-label={t("patchbay.meter.label", { count: tally.stay, total: tally.total })}
               className="flex gap-1"
             >
               {routes.map((r) => (
                 <span
                   key={r.id}
                   className="patchbay-meter-seg"
                   data-locality={r.sends === null ? "device" : r.locality}
                 />
               ))}
             </div>
             <p className="mt-2 text-xs">
               {t("patchbay.meter.headline", { count: tally.stay, total: tally.total })}
               {tally.network > 0 && ` · ${t("patchbay.meter.network", { count: tally.network })}`}
             </p>
           </div>
           <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
             {leaving.length === 0
               ? t("patchbay.leaves.none")
               : `${t("patchbay.leaves.prefix")} ${leaving
                   .map((r) => {
                     const key = props.destinationOf(r);
                     const dest = key ? byId.get(key) : undefined;
                     return t("patchbay.leaves.item", {
                       task: t(`routes.names.${r.id}`),
                       destination: dest ? destinationLabel(dest, t) : routeDestinationLabel(r, t),
                     });
                   })
                   .join(" · ")}`}
           </p>
         </div>
       </div>
     );
   }

   export function Patchbay({ onNavigateToPath }: { onNavigateToPath?: (path: string) => void }) {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     const routes = useResolvedRoutes();
     // Task 3's hook: memoised on t and the language, so `request` stays stable between renders.
     const copy = useRouteCopy();
     const sealed = useSealedStore((s) => s.sealed);
     const draft = useRouteDraftStore((s) => s.draft);
     const [wide, setWide] = useState(true);
     const [cables, setCables] = useState<PatchbayCable[]>([]);
     const boardRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
     const jacks = useRef(new Map<string, HTMLElement>());

     useEffect(() => {
       ensureSealedSubscribed();
     }, []);

     // `routes` is rebuilt whenever settings, facts, sealed state or language
     // change, so the snapshot used for destinations is rebuilt with it.
     // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
     const snapshot = useMemo(() => routeSnapshotFromSettings(useSettingsStore.getState()), [routes]);
     const request = useCallback(
       (id: RouteId, target: Parameters<typeof requestRouteChange>[1]) => requestRouteChange(id, target, copy),
       [copy]
     );
     const board = usePatchbayBoard({
       routes,
       snapshot,
       sealed,
       providersFor: providersForRoute,
       request,
       copy,
       t,
     });

     const registerJack = useCallback(
       (key: string) => (el: HTMLElement | null) => {
         if (el) jacks.current.set(key, el);
         else jacks.current.delete(key);
       },
       []
     );

     const measure = useCallback(() => {
       const el = boardRef.current;
       if (!el) return;
       const box = el.getBoundingClientRect();
       setWide(box.width >= 720);
       const centre = (key: string) => {
         const jack = jacks.current.get(key);
         if (!jack) return null;
         const r = jack.getBoundingClientRect();
         return { x: r.left + r.width / 2 - box.left, y: r.top + r.height / 2 - box.top };
       };
       const rtl = getComputedStyle(el).direction === "rtl";
       const next: PatchbayCable[] = [];
       for (const route of routes) {
         // A drafted route has no cable until Apply; an off route sends nothing.
         if (route.state.status === "off" || draft?.routeId === route.id) continue;
         const destId = destinationKeyOf(route);
         if (destId === null) continue;
         const from = centre(`task:${route.id}`);
         const to = centre(`dest:${destId}`);
         if (!from || !to) continue;
         const [a, b] = rtl ? [to, from] : [from, to];
         next.push({ id: route.id, d: cablePath(a, b), locality: route.locality, paused: route.state.status !== "ready" });
       }
       setCables(next);
     }, [routes, draft]);

     useLayoutEffect(() => {
       measure();
       const el = boardRef.current;
       if (!el || typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined") return;
       const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => measure());
       observer.observe(el);
       return () => observer.disconnect();
     }, [measure, board.destinations]);

     return (
       <PatchbayView
         routes={routes}
         destinations={board.destinations}
         destinationOf={destinationKeyOf}
         compatOf={board.compatOf}
         keyStateOf={board.keyStateOf}
         selectedId={board.selectedId}
         stagedRouteId={draft?.routeId ?? null}
         sealed={sealed}
         message={board.message}
         onUndo={board.undo}
         wide={wide}
         cables={cables}
         boardRef={boardRef}
         registerJack={registerJack}
         onSelectTask={board.selectTask}
         onPickDestination={(dest) => void board.pickDestination(dest)}
         onOpenSettings={(route) => onNavigateToPath?.(route.settingsPath)}
         onEscape={board.clearSelection}
       />
     );
   }
   ```

   The staged change itself is reviewed in Task 8's modal-level Apply bar; the board marks the drafted task with `data-staged` (dashed outline) and `RoutingSection` renders the panel below. Every provider name on the board comes from `destinationLabel`, `routeDestinationLabel`, `destinationPlace` or `routePlace`, which call `providerDisplayLabel`; the source guard in the test fails if this file calls `providerDisplayName`.

### Task 11: Keyring health in main: generation-bound Verify and reminders (SET-R5 C)

Closes I11 (a verdict is recorded only if the credential generation it tested is still current; save, removal, undo and reset invalidate in-flight results; concurrent Verify of one identity is coalesced) and the keyring half of I10 (health rows are keyed by authentication identity, so `corti:text` and `corti:speech` have independent verdicts; Corti speech is verified as `transcription` with `clientId/clientSecret: "__stored__"` through the extracted `_runProviderConnectionTest`, Corti text as `reasoning`). It also completes I3's "prior rejected verdict" case: replacing a rejected key resets its row to unverified in main, and main broadcasts `keyring-changed` so every window refreshes.

Round-2 revisions (Codex R2-4, R2-6, R2-7):
- **The value tested is the committed one (R2-4).** Verify calls the authority's `captureCommitted(id)` (Task 2). It is queued behind every save, removal and Undo already requested for that credential. It returns the committed value together with the generation it belongs to, and `_runProviderConnectionTest` tests exactly those values; it never reads `process.env`, which already holds an unacknowledged write (`src/helpers/environment.js:155`). A concurrent replacement therefore either commits first and is tested under its own generation, or commits later and supersedes the verdict. A replacement that fails never moves the generation, but the value tested was the committed one, so no rollback can leave a verdict for the attempted key on the restored key. Tests run over the real `EnvironmentManager` bodies with a deferred filesystem.
- **Verify discloses its real recipient (R2-6/R3-1).** `keyring.describeVerify(identity, options?)` returns `{ hosts, fields }`, computed from the same config and URL builders the request uses. For Corti speech, that is `cortiTokenUrl`, now the single builder `getCortiToken` fetches (`src/helpers/cortiAuth.js:43-52`), so it names `auth.<region>.corti.app`. Every other identity goes through `resolveProviderRequest`. Enterprise disclosures use main's committed settings and `enterpriseRouteFacts(process.env)`: Bedrock endpoint overrides name the actual endpoint host; Vertex follows persisted `vertexAuthSource`, never the presence of a stored or ambient key. ADC uses the location host with no key field. apiKey mode uses the express host, names the captured stored key first or the captured legacy `environmentKey` fallback, and is never silently converted to ADC when the key is missing. Tests check that the described host matches the real SDK/request path under injected environment values.
- **Main's seal predicate (R2-7, owner's ruling).** The production `IPCHandlers` constructor reads `managers.isSealed`, which defaults to `() => false` until Plan 07, and passes it to `createKeyring`. Verify checks it after the save wait (the capture). A sealed refusal thrown by the transport (Plan 07's `SealedModeError` shape) also maps to outcome `sealed`, with health unchanged, so the renderer's sequential Verify all stops (Task 12). The tests drive the registered `keyring-verify` handler of a really constructed `IPCHandlers`.

Verifying a key sends it to the provider, which is a network event (`docs/PRIVACY.md:51`). So verification is always an explicit request from the renderer, runs in main with the stored credential and returns only a verdict. A save never verifies, and a rejected key is never deleted (preserve content). The renderer awaits `flushSecretSaves()` (Task 2) before it asks main to verify, so Verify always tests what main has stored.

  Health follows the authority: a `save` or `undo` that leaves the identity present resets its row to `unverified` (clearing the error, and restarting the 90-day clock when a reminder is on); any change that leaves it absent deletes the row. Every row change broadcasts `keyring-changed` `{ id }`. `isSealed` defaults to `() => false`. The production constructor passes `() => this.isSealed()`, where `this.isSealed` is `managers.isSealed` or `() => false`. Plan 07 supplies main's authoritative predicate as `new IPCHandlers({ …, isSealed })` in `main.js`; that is the Task 18 handoff. Verify checks the predicate after the capture (the save wait). A sealed refusal thrown by `runTest` also resolves `{ outcome: "sealed", entry: <unchanged row> }` and writes no row.
- Produces (`src/types/electron.ts`, `window.electronAPI.keyring`):

  ```ts
  export type KeyringIdentity =
    | "openai" | "anthropic" | "gemini" | "groq" | "xai" | "mistral" | "openrouter" | "tinfoil"
    | "deepgram" | "assemblyai" | "corti:text" | "corti:speech";
  export type KeyHealthStatus = "unverified" | "verified" | "rejected" | "unreachable";
  export interface KeyringEntry {
    id: KeyringIdentity;             // a CredentialId: RouteFacts.rejected is the ids of entries with status "rejected"
    providerId: string;              // "corti" for both Corti identities; pass to providerDisplayLabel
    status: KeyHealthStatus;
    lastVerifiedAt: number | null;   // ms epoch of the last recorded verdict
    lastErrorCode: string | null;    // errorCode from providerConnectionTest.js / the Corti branch
    lastErrorStatus: number | null;  // HTTP status when known
    reminderDueAt: number | null;
  }
  export type KeyringVerifyOutcome = "recorded" | "superseded" | "missing" | "sealed" | "invalidOptions";
  export interface KeyringVerifyResult { outcome: KeyringVerifyOutcome; entry: KeyringEntry | null }
  export interface KeyringVerifyOptions { cortiEnvironment?: string; cortiTenant?: string }
  /** Keyring identities plus the enterprise credentials whose Test connection names its recipient (Task 9). */
  export type CredentialIdentity = KeyringIdentity | "bedrock" | "azure" | "vertex";
  export interface VerifyTargetDescription { hosts: string[]; fields: string[] } // declared by Task 9's forward declaration; this task keeps it
  export interface KeyringAPI {
    list: () => Promise<KeyringEntry[]>;
    verify: (identity: KeyringIdentity, options?: KeyringVerifyOptions) => Promise<KeyringVerifyResult>;
    /** R2-6: hosts and credential slot names (never values) the request would send to, from main. */
    describeVerify: (identity: CredentialIdentity, options?: KeyringVerifyOptions) => Promise<VerifyTargetDescription>;
    setReminder: (identity: KeyringIdentity, enabled: boolean) => Promise<KeyringEntry | null>;
    onChanged: (callback: (change: { id: KeyringIdentity }) => void) => () => void;
  }
  ```

  IPC channels: `keyring-list`, `keyring-verify`, `keyring-describe-verify`, `keyring-set-reminder`; broadcast `keyring-changed`.

  **`describeVerify` contract (R2-6).** `options` matters only for `corti:speech`, whose region and tenant live only in the renderer (`src/stores/settingsStore.ts:1034`, `:1404`). Its keys are the ones `keyring.verify` takes, and a caller must pass the same object to both.
  - `corti:speech` gives `{ hosts: ["auth.<env>.corti.app"], fields: ["clientId", "clientSecret"] }`.
  - With invalid Corti options it gives `hosts: []`, and Verify answers `invalidOptions`.
  - Every other keyring identity gives the hosts of `resolveProviderRequest(config).endpoints` with `fields: ["key"]`. For example, `corti:text` gives `ai.eu.corti.app` (`providerConnectionTest.js:9`), and `openai` honours `LOQUI_OPENAI_BASE_URL`.
  - Enterprise identities ignore `options` and read main's committed enterprise config plus `routeFacts`, Task 1's `enterpriseRouteFacts(process.env)` (`src/helpers/enterpriseRouteFacts.js`, re-read on every call). The rules are Task 1's `enterpriseRequestHost`, and `hosts` is `[]` wherever that gives `null`.
    - azure: `[endpoint host]`; `[]` when the endpoint is empty, invalid, not HTTPS or carries credentials (`enterpriseAiProviders.js:73-77`). No environment variable redirects Azure.
    - bedrock: when `routeFacts.bedrockEndpoint.set` (main has `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_BEDROCK_RUNTIME`, else `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL`), `[bedrockEndpoint.host]`, or `[]` when that host is `null`. Otherwise `bedrock-runtime.<region||us-east-1>.<partition suffix>`, following `@ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock` 5.0.94 (`[]` if that URL does not parse). Fields are `["profile"]`, or else the stored key fields.
    - vertex: the persisted `vertexAuthSource` selects the host. `adc` uses the location-derived regional/global host and `fields: []`, even when a stored or ambient API key exists. `apiKey` uses `aiplatform.googleapis.com`; the fields are `["key"]` when the committed slot contains a key, otherwise `["environmentKey"]` when the supported legacy fallback is committed, otherwise `["key"]` to show the required missing slot. Missing key never selects ADC. An unknown source fails closed with `hosts: []`.
    - `environmentKey` is a disclosure name, not a credential slot. This task adds its locale strings `keyring.fields.environmentKey` and `reasoning.enterprise.field.environmentKey` (Step 3.10), so Task 9's `enterpriseTestDisclosure` and Task 12's `verifyTargetText` translate it unchanged.
  - An unknown identity rejects.
  - Renderers re-query it on `credentials.onChanged`, on `keyring.onChanged`, and whenever the option or setting it depends on changes. They never memoize it once (Task 12; Task 9 for enterprise).

  **`verify` result contract (Task 12 consumes it).** `keyring.verify` always resolves to `{ outcome, entry }`; it never carries a `superseded` flag or any other field, and it rejects only for an identity outside `KEYRING_IDS`. `entry` is main's row for that identity *after* the call, or `null` when no credential is stored for it now:

  | `outcome` | Request sent? | Row written? | `entry` |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `"recorded"` | yes | yes, the verdict | the row carrying the new verdict |
  | `"superseded"` | yes | no (the key changed while the request was out) | the current row (the replacement's, normally `unverified`), or `null` if the key was removed or reset |
  | `"missing"` | no | no | `null` |
  | `"sealed"` | no, or refused by the gated transport (Plan 07) | no | the current row, unchanged |
  | `"invalidOptions"` | no | no (Corti region or tenant malformed) | the current row, unchanged |

  Only `"recorded"` is a verdict. A consumer tests `result.outcome === "superseded"` to explain a discarded check and keeps taking row content from `list()`.
- For Task 12 (Keyring panel): before every `keyring.verify` call the panel must `await flushSecretSaves()` (Task 2), so a just-typed key is in main before it is tested. Pass `{ cortiEnvironment, cortiTenant }` from settings for `corti:speech`, the same object to `describeVerify` and `verify`. Display `describeVerify`'s hosts and fields, re-queried when the region or tenant changes, on `keyring-changed` and on `credentials-changed`. **Verify all** is a sequential loop over `keyring.list()` in the renderer (one IPC call per identity, so it can show progress); main makes each call safe on its own, so a key changed mid-loop yields `superseded` for that identity and `missing` for one removed before its turn. Show `superseded` as "Key changed while checking — verify again", never as a verdict. Verify buttons stay disabled while `getSealed()` is true.

const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const test = require("node:test");

  KEYRING_IDS,

  createKeyring,
  enterpriseVerifyTarget,
  keyringDisplayName,
  startRotationReminders,
  testConfigFor,
} = require("../../src/helpers/keyring.js");

const DAY = 86_400_000;
const tick = () => new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
const REJECTED = { success: false, errorCode: "credentialsRejected", status: 401 };

function fakeStore() {
  const rows = new Map();
  return {
    rows,
    all: () => [...rows.values()],
    save: (row) => rows.set(row.identity, { ...row }),
    remove: (identity) => rows.delete(identity),
  };
}

// A real credential authority over an in-memory environment, so replacement,
// removal and reset go through exactly the generation logic main uses.
function setup({
  initial = { OPENAI_API_KEY: "sk-a", GROQ_API_KEY: "gsk-a" },
  runTest,
  isSealed,
  enterprise = {},
} = {}) {
  const env = fakeCredentialEnv(initial);
  let clock = 1_000_000;
  const credentials = createCredentialAuthority({
    env,
    fs: fakeCodexFs(),
    codexHome: "/profile/codex",
    now: () => clock,
    setTimer: () => {},
  });
  const store = fakeStore();
  const calls = [];
  const captured = [];
  const pending = [];
  const changes = [];
  const keyring = createKeyring({
    store,
    credentials,
    runTest:
      runTest ||
      ((config, values) => {
        calls.push(config);
        captured.push(values);
        const gate = deferred();
        pending.push(gate);
        return gate.promise;
      }),
    now: () => clock,
    broadcast: (channel, payload) => changes.push({ channel, payload }),
    isSealed,
    enterpriseConfig: () => enterprise,
  });
  const status = (identity) => keyring.list().find((e) => e.id === identity)?.status;
  return {
    keyring,
    credentials,
    env,
    store,
    calls,
    captured,
    pending,
    changes,
    status,
    advance: (ms) => (clock += ms),
    now: () => clock,
  };
}

// change-driving (I11): concurrent Verify of one credential is one request.
test("concurrent Verify of the same credential is coalesced into one request", async () => {
  const { keyring, calls, pending } = setup();
  const a = keyring.verify("groq");
  const b = keyring.verify("groq");
  await tick();
  assert.equal(calls.length, 1);
  pending[0].resolve({ success: true });
  assert.equal(await a, await b);
  const again = keyring.verify("groq");
  await tick();
  assert.equal(calls.length, 2, "a later Verify runs again");
  pending[1].resolve({ success: true });
  await again;
});

// change-driving (I11): Verify all (sequential verify over list()) interrupted by changes.
test("Verify all interrupted by a replacement and a removal records only current verdicts", async () => {
  const providers = [];
  let credentials;
  const ctx = setup({
    initial: { OPENAI_API_KEY: "sk-a", GROQ_API_KEY: "gsk-a", MISTRAL_API_KEY: "mk-a" },
    runTest: async (config) => {
      providers.push(config.provider);
      if (config.provider === "groq") {
        await credentials.save("groq", "key", "gsk-new");
        await credentials.remove("mistral");
      }
      return { success: true };
    },
  });
  credentials = ctx.credentials;
  const outcomes = [];
  for (const entry of ctx.keyring.list()) {
    outcomes.push([entry.id, (await ctx.keyring.verify(entry.id)).outcome]);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(outcomes, [
    ["openai", "recorded"],
    ["groq", "superseded"],
    ["mistral", "missing"],
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual(providers, ["openai", "groq"], "a removed key is never sent");
  assert.equal(ctx.status("openai"), "verified");
  assert.equal(ctx.status("groq"), "unverified");
  assert.equal(ctx.store.rows.has("mistral"), false);
});

// change-driving (I3): a rejected verdict does not outlive the key it judged.
test("replacing a rejected key resets it to unverified and tells every window", async () => {
  const { keyring, credentials, changes, status } = setup({ runTest: async () => REJECTED });
  await keyring.verify("groq");
  assert.equal(status("groq"), "rejected");
  changes.length = 0;
  await credentials.save("groq", "key", "gsk-fixed");
  assert.equal(status("groq"), "unverified");
  const entry = keyring.list().find((e) => e.id === "groq");
  assert.equal(entry.lastErrorCode, null);
  assert.deepEqual(changes, [{ channel: "keyring-changed", payload: { id: "groq" } }]);
});

// change-driving (I11): reset invalidates everything in flight.
test("reset drops health rows and discards in-flight verdicts", async () => {
  const { keyring, credentials, pending, store, env } = setup();
  const first = keyring.verify("groq");
  await tick();
  pending[0].resolve({ success: true });
  await first;
  assert.equal(store.rows.has("groq"), true);
  const running = keyring.verify("openai");
  await tick();
  // cleanup-app erases the credential store inside the authority's reset barrier.
  await credentials.reset(async () => env.values.clear());
  pending[1].resolve({ success: true });
  assert.deepEqual(await running, { outcome: "superseded", entry: null });
  assert.equal(store.rows.size, 0);
});

// change-driving: no request leaves without a stored credential, a known identity or while sealed.
test("unknown identities, missing credentials and sealed mode make no request", async () => {
  const { keyring, calls } = setup({ initial: {} });
  await assert.rejects(keyring.verify("evil"), /Unknown keyring identity/);
  await assert.rejects(keyring.verify("codex"), /Unknown keyring identity/);
  assert.deepEqual(await keyring.verify("openai"), { outcome: "missing", entry: null });
  assert.equal(calls.length, 0);
  const sealed = setup({ isSealed: () => true });
  assert.equal((await sealed.keyring.verify("openai")).outcome, "sealed");
  assert.equal(sealed.calls.length, 0);
});

// change-driving (R2-7): Plan 07's gated transport throws a sealed refusal;
// v1 caught it as "network" and recorded the key unreachable.
test("a sealed refusal thrown by the transport is outcome sealed and leaves health unchanged", async () => {
  let mode = "ok";
  const { keyring, store } = setup({
    runTest: async () => {
      if (mode === "sealed") {
        throw Object.assign(new Error("[SEALED_MODE] Sealed mode is on"), { code: "SEALED_MODE" });
      }
      if (mode === "wrapped") {
        throw new Error("fetch failed", { cause: new Error("[SEALED_MODE:interrupted] stopped") });
      }
      return { success: true };
    },
  });
  await keyring.verify("groq");
  const before = { ...store.rows.get("groq") };
  for (mode of ["sealed", "wrapped"]) {
    const result = await keyring.verify("groq");
    assert.equal(result.outcome, "sealed", mode);
    assert.equal(result.entry.status, "verified");
    assert.deepEqual(store.rows.get("groq"), before, `${mode}: no row write`);
  }
});

// change-driving (R2-7): sealing while the save wait is pending still refuses.
test("isSealed is checked after the save wait", async () => {
  let sealedNow = false;
  const { keyring, credentials, env, calls } = setup({ isSealed: () => sealedNow });
  const gate = deferred();
  env.persistImpl = () => gate.promise;
  const saving = credentials.save("groq", "key", "gsk-new");
  const verifying = keyring.verify("groq"); // queued behind the save
  sealedNow = true;
  gate.resolve();
  await saving;
  assert.equal((await verifying).outcome, "sealed");
  assert.equal(calls.length, 0);
});

// change-driving (R2-6): the disclosure comes from the request's own builders.
test("describeVerify names the hosts and slot names each Verify sends to", async () => {
  const { keyring } = setup({
    initial: { BEDROCK_ACCESS_KEY_ID: "AKIA", BEDROCK_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: "s", VERTEX_API_KEY: "" },
    enterprise: { bedrockRegion: "cn-north-1", azureEndpoint: "https://acme.openai.azure.com/openai", vertexLocation: "eu" },
  });
  assert.deepEqual(
    await keyring.describeVerify("corti:speech", { cortiEnvironment: "eu", cortiTenant: "acme" }),
    { hosts: ["auth.eu.corti.app"], fields: ["clientId", "clientSecret"] },
    "the token endpoint, not the speech API host"
  );
  assert.deepEqual(await keyring.describeVerify("corti:speech"), {
    hosts: ["auth.us.corti.app"],
    fields: ["clientId", "clientSecret"],
  });
  assert.deepEqual(await keyring.describeVerify("corti:speech", { cortiEnvironment: "mars" }), {
    hosts: [],
    fields: ["clientId", "clientSecret"],
  });
  assert.deepEqual(await keyring.describeVerify("corti:text"), { hosts: ["ai.eu.corti.app"], fields: ["key"] });
  assert.deepEqual(await keyring.describeVerify("groq"), { hosts: ["api.groq.com"], fields: ["key"] });
  assert.deepEqual(await keyring.describeVerify("deepgram"), { hosts: ["api.deepgram.com"], fields: ["key"] });
  assert.deepEqual(await keyring.describeVerify("azure"), { hosts: ["acme.openai.azure.com"], fields: ["key"] });
  assert.deepEqual(await keyring.describeVerify("bedrock"), {
    hosts: ["bedrock-runtime.cn-north-1.amazonaws.com.cn"],
    fields: ["accessKeyId", "secretAccessKey"],
  });
  assert.deepEqual(await keyring.describeVerify("vertex"), {
    hosts: ["aiplatform.eu.rep.googleapis.com"],
    fields: [],
  });
  assert.deepEqual(
    enterpriseVerifyTarget("vertex", { vertexAuthSource: "adc", vertexLocation: "europe-west4" }, { key: true }),
    { hosts: ["europe-west4-aiplatform.googleapis.com"], fields: [] },
    "ADC keeps the configured recipient and sends no API key even if one is stored"
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    enterpriseVerifyTarget("vertex", { vertexAuthSource: "apiKey", routeFacts: { vertexApiKeyEnv: true } }, { key: false }),
    { hosts: ["aiplatform.googleapis.com"], fields: ["environmentKey"] },
    "apiKey mode preserves the committed legacy fallback"
  );
  await assert.rejects(keyring.describeVerify("codex"), /Unknown credential identity/);
});

test("enterprise disclosure follows the enterprise SDK rules", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(enterpriseVerifyTarget("azure", { azureEndpoint: "http://acme.example" }, {}), {
    hosts: [],
    fields: ["key"],
  });
  assert.deepEqual(enterpriseVerifyTarget("azure", { azureEndpoint: "https://u:p@acme.example" }, {}).hosts, []);
  assert.deepEqual(enterpriseVerifyTarget("bedrock", { bedrockProfile: "work" }, { accessKeyId: true }), {
    hosts: ["bedrock-runtime.us-east-1.amazonaws.com"],
    fields: ["profile"],
  });
  assert.deepEqual(enterpriseVerifyTarget("vertex", { vertexAuthSource: "apiKey" }, { key: true }), {
    hosts: ["aiplatform.googleapis.com"],
    fields: ["key"],
  });
  assert.deepEqual(enterpriseVerifyTarget("vertex", { vertexAuthSource: "adc", vertexLocation: "global" }, { key: true }).hosts, ["aiplatform.googleapis.com"]);
  assert.deepEqual(enterpriseVerifyTarget("vertex", { vertexAuthSource: "adc" }, { key: true }), {
    hosts: ["us-central1-aiplatform.googleapis.com"],
    fields: [],
  });
  assert.deepEqual(enterpriseVerifyTarget("vertex", { vertexAuthSource: "apiKey" }, { key: false }), {
    hosts: ["aiplatform.googleapis.com"], fields: ["key"],
  }, "missing apiKey never falls back to ADC");
  // Hosts no request can reach are not named (Task 1's requestHost rule).
  assert.deepEqual(enterpriseVerifyTarget("vertex", { vertexAuthSource: "adc", vertexLocation: "bad location" }, {}).hosts, []);
  assert.deepEqual(enterpriseVerifyTarget("bedrock", { bedrockRegion: "us east" }, {}).hosts, []);
});

// change-driving (R2-6 enterprise): main's environment overrides, as Task 1's
// enterpriseRouteFacts reports them, move the host the same way enterpriseRequestHost does.
test("enterprise disclosure follows main's environment overrides", () => {
  const facts = (over) => ({
    bedrockEndpoint: { set: false, host: null }, bedrockProfile: false,
    vertexApiKeyEnv: false,
    vertexProjectEnv: false,
    ...over,
  });
  const proxy = facts({ bedrockEndpoint: { set: true, host: "bedrock-proxy.corp.example:8443" } });
  assert.deepEqual(
    enterpriseVerifyTarget("bedrock", { bedrockRegion: "eu-west-1", routeFacts: proxy }, { accessKeyId: true, secretAccessKey: true }),
    { hosts: ["bedrock-proxy.corp.example:8443"], fields: ["accessKeyId", "secretAccessKey"] },
    "the endpoint override wins over the region"
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    enterpriseVerifyTarget("bedrock", { bedrockRegion: "eu-west-1", routeFacts: facts({ bedrockEndpoint: { set: true, host: null } }) }, {}),
    { hosts: [], fields: [] },
    "set but unusable: no request can be made"
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    enterpriseVerifyTarget("vertex", { vertexAuthSource: "adc", vertexProject: "acme", vertexLocation: "europe-west4", routeFacts: facts({ vertexApiKeyEnv: true }) }, { key: true }),
    { hosts: ["europe-west4-aiplatform.googleapis.com"], fields: [] },
    "ADC ignores both the stored key and ambient fallback"
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    enterpriseVerifyTarget("vertex", { vertexAuthSource: "apiKey", routeFacts: facts({ vertexApiKeyEnv: true }) }, { key: false }),
    { hosts: ["aiplatform.googleapis.com"], fields: ["environmentKey"] },
    "apiKey mode preserves the committed legacy fallback"
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    enterpriseVerifyTarget("vertex", { vertexAuthSource: "apiKey", routeFacts: facts({ vertexApiKeyEnv: true }) }, { key: true }),
    { hosts: ["aiplatform.googleapis.com"], fields: ["key"] },
    "a stored key wins over the fallback"
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    enterpriseVerifyTarget("azure", { azureEndpoint: "https://acme.openai.azure.com/openai", routeFacts: proxy }, {}).hosts,
    ["acme.openai.azure.com"],
    "no environment variable redirects Azure"
  );
});

// baseline semantics carried over from v1 (change-driving only because the module is new).
test("a rejection keeps its code; a network failure or a throw is unreachable", async () => {
  assert.deepEqual(classifyResult({ success: true }), {
    status: "verified",
    errorCode: null,
    httpStatus: null,
  });
  assert.deepEqual(classifyResult(REJECTED), {
    status: "rejected",
    errorCode: "credentialsRejected",
    httpStatus: 401,
  });
  assert.deepEqual(classifyResult({ success: false, errorCode: "timeout" }), {
    status: "unreachable",
    errorCode: "timeout",
    httpStatus: null,
  });
  const { keyring, status } = setup({
    runTest: async () => {
      throw new Error("socket hang up");
    },
  });
  const result = await keyring.verify("openai");
  assert.equal(result.entry.status, "unreachable");
  assert.equal(result.entry.lastErrorCode, "network");
  assert.equal(status("openai"), "unreachable");
});

// change-driving.
test("reminders fire once when due, restart when the key is replaced, and can be switched off", async () => {
  const { keyring, credentials, advance, now } = setup();
  assert.equal(keyring.setReminder("anthropic", true), null, "no reminder without a key");
  const entry = keyring.setReminder("groq", true);
  assert.equal(entry.reminderDueAt, now() + ROTATION_DAYS * DAY);
  assert.deepEqual(keyring.takeDueReminders(), []);
  advance(ROTATION_DAYS * DAY);
  assert.deepEqual(keyring.takeDueReminders(), ["groq"]);
  assert.deepEqual(keyring.takeDueReminders(), [], "only once");
  await credentials.save("groq", "key", "gsk-rotated");
  const rotated = keyring.list().find((e) => e.id === "groq");
  assert.equal(rotated.reminderDueAt, now() + ROTATION_DAYS * DAY, "rotation restarts the clock");
  keyring.setReminder("groq", false);
  assert.equal(keyring.list().find((e) => e.id === "groq").reminderDueAt, null);
});

// change-driving.
test("the reminder loop notifies per due identity, survives a failing check and stops cleanly", () => {
  const notified = [];
  let intervalFn;
  let timeoutFn;
  let failNext = true;
  const stop = startRotationReminders({
    keyring: {
      takeDueReminders: () => {
        if (failNext) {
          failNext = false;
          throw new Error("Database not initialized");
        }
        return ["corti:speech"];
      },
    },
    notify: (identity) => notified.push(identity),
    intervalMs: 1000,
    setIntervalImpl: (fn) => ((intervalFn = fn), 7),
    setTimeoutImpl: (fn) => ((timeoutFn = fn), 8),
    clearIntervalImpl: () => {},
    clearTimeoutImpl: () => {},
  });
  timeoutFn();
  intervalFn();
  assert.deepEqual(notified, ["corti:speech"]);
  stop();
});
