   ```tsx
   import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
   import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
   import { providerDisplayLabel } from "../../../lib/locality";
   import { useResolvedRoutes, type CredentialId, type ResolvedRoute, type RouteId } from "../../../lib/routes";
   import { getSealed, useSealedStore } from "../../../stores/sealedStore";
   import { flushSecretSaves, useSettingsStore } from "../../../stores/settingsStore";
   import type {
     KeyHealthStatus,
     KeyringAPI,
     KeyringEntry,
     KeyringIdentity,
     KeyringVerifyOptions,
     KeyringVerifyOutcome,
     VerifyTargetDescription,
   } from "../../../types/electron";
   import { formatRelativeTime } from "../../../utils/dateFormatting";
   import { Loader2 } from "../../icons";
   import { Button } from "../../ui/button";
   import { Toggle } from "../../ui/toggle";
   import { credentialIdFor } from "./destinations";

   type Tr = (key: string, options?: Record<string, unknown>) => string;

   // Shape and words carry status first; the dot is a third channel. Amber is
   // the locality-remote token (4.9:1 on every Settings surface), never bg-warning.
   export const STATUS_DOT: Record<KeyHealthStatus, string> = {
     verified: "bg-locality-device",
     unverified: "bg-locality-remote",
     unreachable: "bg-locality-remote",
     rejected: "bg-destructive",
   };

   // Rows exist only for Task 11's 12 keyring identities; the provider name
   // always comes from the entry's providerId.
   export function keyringIdentityLabel(entry: Pick<KeyringEntry, "id" | "providerId">, t: Tr): string {
     const provider = providerDisplayLabel(entry.providerId, t);
     if (entry.id === "corti:text") return t("keyring.identity.cortiText", { provider });
     if (entry.id === "corti:speech") return t("keyring.identity.cortiSpeech", { provider });
     return provider;
   }

   // R2-6: what Verify sends and to whom, exactly as main's describeVerify
   // computed it from the request's own config (Task 11). Never derived from
   // inference-route hosts: Corti speech verifies at auth.<region>.corti.app,
   // not at its speech API host.
   export function verifyTargetText(
     disclosure: VerifyTargetDescription | null,
     t: Tr
   ): { host: string | null; fields: string } {
     const hosts = disclosure?.hosts ?? [];
     return {
       host: hosts.length > 0 ? hosts.join(", ") : null,
       fields: (disclosure?.fields ?? []).map((field) => t(`keyring.fields.${field}`)).join(", "),
     };
   }

   // Task 11's testConfigFor reads options only for Corti speech (the auth
   // server depends on region and tenant). Copy when describing, never written.
   export function keyringVerifyOptions(
     id: KeyringIdentity,
     settings: { cortiEnvironment: string; cortiTenant: string }
   ): KeyringVerifyOptions | undefined {
     if (id !== "corti:speech") return undefined;
     return { cortiEnvironment: settings.cortiEnvironment, cortiTenant: settings.cortiTenant };
   }

   export function pausedTasksByCredential(
     routes: Pick<ResolvedRoute, "id" | "kind" | "providerId" | "state">[]
   ): Partial<Record<CredentialId, RouteId[]>> {
     const map: Partial<Record<CredentialId, RouteId[]>> = {};
     for (const route of routes) {
       if (route.state.status !== "needsKey") continue;
       const id = credentialIdFor(route.providerId, route.kind);
       if (id === null) continue;
       (map[id] ??= []).push(route.id);
     }
     return map;
   }

   export function keyringStatusLine(
     entry: KeyringEntry,
     pausedTaskNames: string[],
     t: Tr,
     locale: string,
     host: string | null
   ): { text: string; tone: "muted" | "error" } {
     if (!entry.lastVerifiedAt) return { text: t("keyring.never"), tone: "muted" };
     const when = formatRelativeTime(new Date(entry.lastVerifiedAt).toISOString(), t, locale);
     const parts = [t("keyring.lastVerified", { when })];
     if (entry.status === "rejected") {
       parts.push(
         entry.lastErrorStatus !== null
           ? t("keyring.rejected", { status: entry.lastErrorStatus })
           : t("keyring.rejectedNoStatus")
       );
     }
     if (entry.status === "unreachable") {
       parts.push(host ? t("keyring.unreachable", { host }) : t("keyring.unreachableNoHost"));
     }
     if (pausedTaskNames.length > 0 && entry.status === "rejected") {
       parts.push(t("keyring.paused", { tasks: pausedTaskNames.join(", ") }));
     }
     return { text: parts.join(" · "), tone: entry.status === "rejected" ? "error" : "muted" };
   }

   // ---- controller -------------------------------------------------------

   // Task 11's KeyringAPI; onChanged is optional so the browser preview and
   // tests can omit it.
   export type KeyringApi = Pick<KeyringAPI, "list" | "verify" | "setReminder"> &
     Partial<Pick<KeyringAPI, "onChanged" | "describeVerify">>;

   export type KeyringNotice =
     | { kind: "superseded" }
     | { kind: "sealed" }
     | { kind: "invalidOptions"; environment: string; tenant: string }
     | { kind: "failed"; message: string };

   export interface KeyringController {
     entries: KeyringEntry[];
     loadError: boolean;
     checking: KeyringIdentity | null;
     progress: { current: number; total: number } | null;
     notices: Partial<Record<KeyringIdentity, KeyringNotice>>;
     disclosures: Partial<Record<KeyringIdentity, VerifyTargetDescription>>;
     verify: (id: KeyringIdentity) => Promise<void>;
     verifyAll: () => Promise<void>;
     setReminder: (id: KeyringIdentity, enabled: boolean) => Promise<void>;
   }

   export function useKeyringController(deps: {
     api: KeyringApi | undefined;
     flush: () => Promise<void>;
     getSealed: () => boolean;
     verifyOptions?: (id: KeyringIdentity) => KeyringVerifyOptions | undefined;
     /** Changes whenever a setting verifyOptions reads changes (Corti region/tenant). */
     optionsKey?: string;
     /** Main's credentials-changed subscription (Task 2). */
     onCredentialsChanged?: (callback: () => void) => () => void;
   }): KeyringController {
     const [entries, setEntries] = useState<KeyringEntry[]>([]);
     const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState(false);
     const [checking, setChecking] = useState<KeyringIdentity | null>(null);
     const [progress, setProgress] = useState<{ current: number; total: number } | null>(null);
     const [notices, setNotices] = useState<Partial<Record<KeyringIdentity, KeyringNotice>>>({});
     type Description = {
       target: VerifyTargetDescription;
       options: KeyringVerifyOptions | undefined;
       optionsKey: string;
       credentialEpoch: number;
       api: KeyringApi;
     };
     const [described, setDescribed] = useState<Partial<Record<KeyringIdentity, Description>>>({});
     const credentialEpoch = useRef(0);
     const describeSeq = useRef(0);
     const live = useRef(deps);
     live.current = deps;
     const entriesRef = useRef<KeyringEntry[]>([]);
     const requestSeq = useRef(0);
     const running = useRef(false);
     const alive = useRef(true);
     const api = deps.api;
     const optionsFor = (id: KeyringIdentity) => {
       const value = live.current.verifyOptions?.(id);
       return value ? Object.freeze({ ...value }) : undefined;
     };
     const sameOptions = (a: KeyringVerifyOptions | undefined, b: KeyringVerifyOptions | undefined) =>
       a?.cortiEnvironment === b?.cortiEnvironment && a?.cortiTenant === b?.cortiTenant;
     const stillCurrent = (id: KeyringIdentity, item: Description | undefined): item is Description =>
       Boolean(item && item.api === live.current.api && item.optionsKey === (live.current.optionsKey ?? "") &&
         item.credentialEpoch === credentialEpoch.current && sameOptions(item.options, optionsFor(id)));
     // A new render hides old labels immediately, before its effect/IPC resolves.
     const disclosures = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(described)
       .filter(([id, item]) => stillCurrent(id as KeyringIdentity, item))
       .map(([id, item]) => [id, item!.target])) as Partial<Record<KeyringIdentity, VerifyTargetDescription>>;

     const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
       const current = live.current.api;
       if (!current) return;
       const seq = ++requestSeq.current;
       try {
         const next = await current.list();
         if (!alive.current || seq !== requestSeq.current) return; // the latest request wins
         entriesRef.current = next;
         setEntries(next);
         setLoadError(false);
       } catch {
         if (!alive.current || seq !== requestSeq.current) return;
         setLoadError(true); // keep the rows we already have
       }
     }, []);

     useEffect(() => {
       alive.current = true;
       void refresh();
       const unsubscribe = api?.onChanged?.(() => {
         void refresh();
       });
       return () => {
         alive.current = false;
         unsubscribe?.();
       };
     }, [api, refresh]);

     // R2-6: ask main who each row's Verify would reach, with the same options
     // verify() will send. Re-run on every list refresh (keyring-changed), on
     // credentials-changed and when an option changes; the latest answer wins.
     const describeAll = useCallback(async () => {
       const current = live.current.api;
       const seq = ++describeSeq.current;
       setDescribed({});
       if (!current?.describeVerify) return; // unknown target never authorises Verify
       const optionsKey = live.current.optionsKey ?? "";
       const epoch = credentialEpoch.current;
       const pairs = await Promise.all(
         entriesRef.current.map(async (entry) => {
           const options = optionsFor(entry.id);
           try {
             const target = await current.describeVerify!(entry.id, options);
             return [entry.id, { target, options, optionsKey, credentialEpoch: epoch, api: current }] as const;
           } catch {
             return [entry.id, null] as const;
           }
         })
       );
       if (!alive.current || seq !== describeSeq.current) return;
       const next = Object.fromEntries(pairs.filter(([id, item]) => stillCurrent(id, item ?? undefined))) as
         Partial<Record<KeyringIdentity, Description>>;
       setDescribed(next);
     }, []);

     useEffect(() => {
       void describeAll();
     }, [entries, deps.optionsKey, describeAll]);

     const onCredentialsChanged = deps.onCredentialsChanged;
     useEffect(() => onCredentialsChanged?.(() => {
       credentialEpoch.current++;
       void describeAll();
     }), [onCredentialsChanged, describeAll]);

     const setNotice = (id: KeyringIdentity, notice: KeyringNotice | null) =>
       setNotices((current) => {
         const next = { ...current };
         if (notice) next[id] = notice;
         else delete next[id];
         return next;
       });

     // One credential: saves are acknowledged first, then the request goes out.
     // Only `outcome` is read; row content always comes from list(), so a
     // verdict main discarded (superseded) can never paint a replaced key.
     const runVerify = async (id: KeyringIdentity, admitted = described[id]): Promise<KeyringVerifyOutcome | null> => {
       if (!stillCurrent(id, admitted) || admitted.target.hosts.length === 0) return null;
       // The same immutable options that produced the visible label survive flush.
       const options = admitted.options;
       setNotice(id, null);
       setChecking(id);
       try {
         await live.current.flush();
         if (!alive.current || !stillCurrent(id, admitted)) {
           setNotice(id, { kind: "superseded" });
           return null;
         }
         if (live.current.getSealed()) {
           setNotice(id, { kind: "sealed" });
           return "sealed";
         }
         const { outcome } = await admitted.api.verify(id, options);
         if (outcome === "superseded") setNotice(id, { kind: "superseded" });
         if (outcome === "sealed") setNotice(id, { kind: "sealed" });
         if (outcome === "invalidOptions") {
           setNotice(id, {
             kind: "invalidOptions",
             environment: options?.cortiEnvironment ?? "",
             tenant: options?.cortiTenant ?? "",
           });
         }
         // "recorded": the verdict arrives through list(). "missing": the
         // credential was removed, so its row disappears on the refresh below.
         return outcome;
       } catch (error) {
         setNotice(id, { kind: "failed", message: (error as Error).message });
         return null;
       } finally {
         setChecking(null);
         await refresh();
       }
     };

     const verify = async (id: KeyringIdentity) => {
       if (running.current || !live.current.api || live.current.getSealed()) return;
       running.current = true;
       try {
         await runVerify(id);
       } finally {
         running.current = false;
       }
     };

     const verifyAll = async () => {
       if (running.current || !live.current.api || live.current.getSealed()) return;
       running.current = true;
       try {
         const ids = entriesRef.current.map((e) => e.id);
         const admissions = new Map(ids.map((id) => [id, described[id]]));
         if (ids.some((id) => !stillCurrent(id, admissions.get(id)) || !admissions.get(id)?.target.hosts.length)) return;
         for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
           // Sealed mode can turn on between requests; so can a removal.
           if (live.current.getSealed()) break;
           if (!entriesRef.current.some((e) => e.id === ids[i])) continue;
           setProgress({ current: i + 1, total: ids.length });
           // Main's own sealed check (Plan 07) refused: stop the run.
           const outcome = await runVerify(ids[i], admissions.get(ids[i]));
           if (outcome === "sealed" || outcome === null) break;
         }
       } finally {
         setProgress(null);
         running.current = false;
       }
     };

     const setReminder = async (id: KeyringIdentity, enabled: boolean) => {
       try {
         await live.current.api?.setReminder(id, enabled);
       } catch (error) {
         setNotice(id, { kind: "failed", message: (error as Error).message });
       } finally {
         await refresh();
       }
     };

     return { entries, loadError, checking, progress, notices, disclosures, verify, verifyAll, setReminder };
   }

   // ---- view -------------------------------------------------------------

   export interface KeyringPanelViewProps {
     entries: KeyringEntry[];
     paused: Partial<Record<CredentialId, string[]>>; // translated task names
     notices: Partial<Record<KeyringIdentity, KeyringNotice>>;
     disclosureOf: (entry: KeyringEntry) => VerifyTargetDescription | null;
     checking: KeyringIdentity | null;
     progress: { current: number; total: number } | null;
     sealed: boolean;
     loadError: boolean;
     onVerify: (id: KeyringIdentity) => void;
     onVerifyAll: () => void;
     onReminder: (id: KeyringIdentity, enabled: boolean) => void;
   }

   export function KeyringPanelView(props: KeyringPanelViewProps) {
     const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();
     const busy = props.checking !== null || props.progress !== null;
     return (
       <section aria-labelledby="keyring-title" className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border/70 bg-background">
         <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 border-b border-border/70 px-4 py-3">
           <div>
             <h3 id="keyring-title" className="text-sm font-semibold">
               {t("keyring.title")}
             </h3>
             <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("keyring.subtitle")}</p>
             {props.sealed && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("keyring.sealed")}</p>}
             {props.loadError && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("keyring.loadFailed")}</p>}
           </div>
           <Button
             size="sm"
             variant="outline"
             onClick={props.onVerifyAll}
             disabled={busy || props.sealed || props.entries.length === 0 || props.entries.some((entry) => !props.disclosureOf(entry)?.hosts.length)}
             title={t("keyring.verifyAllTooltip")}
           >
             {props.progress ? t("keyring.verifyingAll", props.progress) : t("keyring.verifyAll")}
           </Button>
         </div>
         {props.entries.length === 0 ? (
           <p className="px-4 py-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("keyring.empty")}</p>
         ) : (
           <ul>
             {props.entries.map((entry) => {
               const identity = keyringIdentityLabel(entry, t);
               const target = verifyTargetText(props.disclosureOf(entry), t);
               const host = target.host;
               const isChecking = props.checking === entry.id;
               const notice = props.notices[entry.id];
               const line = keyringStatusLine(entry, props.paused[entry.id] ?? [], t, i18n.language, host);
               return (
                 <li
                   key={entry.id}
                   data-credential={entry.id}
                   data-checking={isChecking ? "true" : "false"}
                   className="grid grid-cols-[20px_1fr_auto] items-center gap-3 border-b border-border/50 px-4 py-2.5 last:border-b-0"
                 >
                   {isChecking ? (
                     <span role="img" aria-label={t("keyring.checking")}>
                       <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
                     </span>
                   ) : (
                     <span
                       role="img"
                       aria-label={t(`keyring.status.${entry.status}`)}
                       className={`h-2 w-2 rounded-full ${STATUS_DOT[entry.status]}`}
                     />
                   )}
                   <div className="min-w-0">
                     <p className="text-xs font-semibold">{identity}</p>
                     <p className={`text-xs ${line.tone === "error" ? "text-destructive" : "text-muted-foreground"}`}>
                       {isChecking ? t("keyring.checking") : line.text}
                     </p>
                     <p data-verify-target={host ?? ""} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                       {host
                         ? t("keyring.verifyTarget", { host, fields: target.fields })
                         : t("keyring.verifyTargetUnknown")}
                     </p>
                     {notice && (
                       <p role="status" className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                         {notice.kind === "superseded"
                           ? t("keyring.superseded")
                           : notice.kind === "sealed"
                             ? t("keyring.sealed")
                             : notice.kind === "invalidOptions"
                               ? t("keyring.invalidCortiOptions", {
                                   environment: notice.environment,
                                   tenant: notice.tenant,
                                 })
                               : t("keyring.verifyFailed", { error: notice.message })}
                       </p>
                     )}
                   </div>
                   <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                     <Button
                       size="sm"
                       variant="ghost"
                       onClick={() => props.onVerify(entry.id)}
                       disabled={busy || props.sealed || host === null}
                       aria-label={t("keyring.verifyLabel", { identity })}
                       title={
                         host
                           ? t("keyring.verifyTooltip", { identity, host, fields: target.fields })
                           : t("keyring.verifyTooltipNoHost", { identity })
                       }
                     >
                       {t("keyring.verify")}
                     </Button>
                     <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                       <Toggle
                         checked={entry.reminderDueAt !== null}
                         onChange={(on) => props.onReminder(entry.id, on)}
                         aria-label={t("keyring.remindLabel", { identity })}
                       />
                       <span aria-hidden="true">{t("keyring.remind")}</span>
                     </label>
                   </div>
                 </li>
               );
             })}
           </ul>
         )}
       </section>
     );
   }

   export function KeyringPanel() {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     const routes = useResolvedRoutes();
     const sealed = useSealedStore((s) => s.sealed);
     // R2-6: Corti speech's verification host depends on these, so a change
     // re-asks main (never a host map frozen at mount).
     const cortiEnvironment = useSettingsStore((s) => s.cortiEnvironment);
     const cortiTenant = useSettingsStore((s) => s.cortiTenant);
     const controller = useKeyringController({
       api: window.electronAPI?.keyring as KeyringApi | undefined,
       flush: flushSecretSaves,
       getSealed,
       // Read-only: the keyring never writes provider/model/endpoint or Corti
       // region fields; those change only through the route planner. The same
       // options go to describeVerify and to verify.
       verifyOptions: (id) => keyringVerifyOptions(id, useSettingsStore.getState()),
       optionsKey: `${cortiEnvironment}|${cortiTenant}`,
       onCredentialsChanged: window.electronAPI?.credentials?.onChanged,
     });
     const paused = useMemo(() => {
       const byCredential = pausedTasksByCredential(routes);
       return Object.fromEntries(
         Object.entries(byCredential).map(([id, ids]) => [id, ids.map((rid) => t(`routes.names.${rid}`))])
       ) as Partial<Record<CredentialId, string[]>>;
     }, [routes, t]);
     return (
       <KeyringPanelView
         entries={controller.entries}
         paused={paused}
         notices={controller.notices}
         disclosureOf={(entry) => controller.disclosures[entry.id] ?? null}
         checking={controller.checking}
         progress={controller.progress}
         sealed={sealed}
         loadError={controller.loadError}
         onVerify={(id) => void controller.verify(id)}
         onVerifyAll={() => void controller.verifyAll()}
         onReminder={(id, on) => void controller.setReminder(id, on)}
       />
     );
   }
   ```

   The spinner uses `animate-spin`, which runs only while a row is being checked (the loop is gated to its active state). Reduced motion already stops the transform globally, and the "Checking…" text and the labelled `role="img"` still announce the state. The section sets `bg-background` explicitly: `text-destructive` is 4.83:1 on white and only 4.43:1 on `#f5f5f5`, so the panel never sits on `muted`, `secondary` or `surface-3`.

### Task 13: Cartridge model cards (SET-R4 B, SET-Q8, SET-Q9)

Closes M1 (real keyboard tests for the cartridge grid, its action buttons and RTL, through the repo's mounted-probe harness; provider-tab and card a11y are Plan 02's and are a hard preflight below), M2 (context length and curated tiers are forwarded by a tested mapper), M3 (shared `--motion-*` tokens and logical properties only) and I13 for the cartridge (contrast measured in both themes).

**Commits stay on Task 9's path.** This task changes only how local models are shown. Task 9 runs first and already sends every local pick through the planner: `TranscriptionModelPicker`'s `handleWhisperModelSelect` and `handleParakeetModelSelect`, and `ReasoningModelSelector`'s `handleModelSelect` (the `onModelSelect` it passes to `LocalModelPicker`), call `onCommit(target)`. The settings callers supply that callback as Task 8's `useRouteCommit(routeId)`, which calls `useRouteChange().request` and then Task 7's `requestRouteChange`, so an instant on-device pick shows the Task 8 toast with Undo. The grids call those same handlers, including the auto-select after a download and the imported-model "test load then select". This task adds no second commit path and no route prop.

Local models become **cartridges**: a 2-column grid of cards, each showing:
- the name;
- three 5-pip meters (Speed, Quality, Memory use), always labelled in words;
- size and context length;
- the state: Ready, Download, Downloading with a real `role="progressbar"`, or Too large for this device;
- "In use by" chips that show which tasks already run on the model.

The grid is a `role="radiogroup"` with one tab stop:
- Arrows, Home and End move **focus** (←/→ swap in RTL, ↑/↓ move a row). They never choose a model, because choosing changes a route. This matches Plan 02's SET-Q2 ("moving focus must never switch where audio goes") and Task 5's mode selector.
- Enter, Space or a click chooses a downloaded card. An undownloaded card is `aria-disabled` and stays focusable, so a screen-reader user finds it next to its Download button. **A download starts only from that button.** This deliberately narrows the v1 text ("Enter starts the download"): a stray keypress should never begin a multi-gigabyte download, and today's cards behave the same way.
- Each card's action button (Download, Cancel or Delete) and its model-card link are tabbable only on the card that holds the tab stop, so Tab goes radio, then that card's controls, then out. Arrows pressed on those controls move to the next card's radio.
- Sorting is Recommended first, then by size ascending, collapsed after 5 with "Show all 13" (Q8). The toggle stays in place and becomes "Show fewer", so focus is never lost.
- Download buttons use the outline variant except on the Recommended card (Q9).

This supersedes Plan 02's SET-Q2 markup for local models only; cloud model lists keep `ModelCardList`.

Pips are estimates derived from size unless the registry carries curated `speedTier` and `qualityTier`; the caption "estimate" shows only while a visible meter is size-derived. No card is dimmed with `opacity-*`: at 70% muted text on white is 3.6:1, and the reason a model is too large must stay readable.

**Preflight (hard).** Plan 02 owns the provider-tab and cloud-card accessibility this page still uses (`ProviderTabs` tablist/tab roles and arrow keys, Plan 02 Task 15; keyboard-selectable `ModelCardList`, Task 16). Before starting:
- `grep -n 'role="tablist"' src/components/ui/ProviderTabs.tsx` and `grep -n 'selectionRole' src/components/ui/ModelCardList.tsx` must both match.
- `npm test -- test/components/settingsNavigation.test.js test/components/modelCardKeyboard.test.js` must pass.
- If either fails, stop and merge Plan 02 first. Task 18 repeats this check for the whole plan. This task adds no fallback for those two components and does not touch their markup.

```js
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const test = require("node:test");
const React = require("react");
const { createRoot } = require("react-dom/client");
const {
  createRendererServer,
  installBrowserGlobals,
  installHookDom,
} = require("../lib/rendererTestHarness");
const { withI18nMock } = require("../lib/i18nTestMock");

const GB = 1_000_000_000;

// Mounted-behaviour pattern from personalWorkspace.test.js. The grid is called as
// a function inside a probe that returns null and its handler props are invoked
// under React.act. In React 19 a host element's ref is an ordinary prop, so each
// radio gets a fake element whose focus() is recorded: that is what makes
// keyboard focus observable without a DOM. Sorted and collapsed, the first five
// cards are: qwen-2b (recommended), qwen-4b, qwen-9b, extra0, extra1.
function walk(node, visit) {
  if (Array.isArray(node)) return node.forEach((child) => walk(child, visit));
  if (!node || typeof node !== "object") return;
  visit(node);
  walk(node.props?.children, visit);
}
const findAll = (tree, predicate) => {
  const out = [];
  walk(tree, (node) => predicate(node) && out.push(node));
  return out;
};
const textOf = (tree) => {
  const parts = [];
  const collect = (node) => {
    if (Array.isArray(node)) return node.forEach(collect);
    if (typeof node === "string") return parts.push(node);
    if (node && typeof node === "object") collect(node.props?.children);
  };
  collect(tree);
  return parts.join("|");
};

const models = [
  { id: "qwen-2b", name: "Qwen3.5 2B", sizeBytes: 1.3 * GB, contextLength: 262144, recommended: true, isDownloaded: true, isDownloading: false },
  { id: "qwen-4b", name: "Qwen3.5 4B", sizeBytes: 2.7 * GB, contextLength: 262144, isDownloaded: true, isDownloading: false },
  { id: "qwen-9b", name: "Qwen3.5 9B", sizeBytes: 5.5 * GB, isDownloaded: false, isDownloading: true, progress: 42 },
  { id: "extra0", name: "Extra 0", sizeBytes: 6 * GB, isDownloaded: false, isDownloading: false, href: "https://example.test/card", hrefLabel: "Model card" },
  { id: "extra1", name: "Extra 1", sizeBytes: 7 * GB, isDownloaded: false, isDownloading: true, progress: 90, isInstalling: true },
  { id: "extra2", name: "Extra 2", sizeBytes: 8 * GB, isDownloaded: false, isDownloading: false },
  { id: "extra3", name: "Extra 3", sizeBytes: 9 * GB, isDownloaded: false, isDownloading: false },
  { id: "big", name: "Huge 70B", sizeBytes: 40 * GB, isDownloaded: false, isDownloading: false },
];
const SHOWN = ["qwen-2b", "qwen-4b", "qwen-9b", "extra0", "extra1"];

async function mount(t, over = {}) {
  let root;
  t.after(async () => {
    if (root) await React.act(async () => root.unmount());
  });
  installBrowserGlobals(t);
  const container = installHookDom(t);
  const vite = await createRendererServer(t, withI18nMock({ cachePrefix: "loqui-cartridge-test-" }, { withOptions: true }));
  const { ModelCartridgeGrid } = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/components/ui/ModelCartridgeGrid.tsx");
  const calls = { select: [], download: [], cancel: [], delete: [] };
  const props = () => ({
    label: "Language model",
    models,
    selectedId: "qwen-2b",
    totalMemoryBytes: 16 * GB,
    usedBy: { "qwen-2b": ["Chat", "Cleanup"], "qwen-4b": ["Translation"] },
    onSelect: (id) => calls.select.push(id),
    onDownload: (id) => calls.download.push(id),
    onCancel: (id) => calls.cancel.push(id),
    onDelete: (id) => calls.delete.push(id),
    ...over,
  });
  let tree;
  function Probe() {
    tree = ModelCartridgeGrid(props());
    return null;
  }
  root = createRoot(container);
  await React.act(async () => root.render(React.createElement(Probe)));
  const focused = [];
  const group = () => findAll(tree, (n) => n.props?.role === "radiogroup")[0];
  const radios = () => findAll(tree, (n) => n.props?.role === "radio");
  const actions = () => findAll(tree, (n) => n.props?.["data-model-action"]);
  const ids = () => radios().map((r) => r.props["data-model"]);
  const attach = () => radios().forEach((radio) => radio.props.ref({ focus: () => focused.push(radio.props["data-model"]) }));
  attach();
  const key = async (node, k) => {
    let prevented = false;
    await React.act(async () => node.props.onKeyDown({ key: k, preventDefault: () => (prevented = true) }));
    attach();
    return prevented;
  };
  const radio = (id) => radios().find((r) => r.props["data-model"] === id);
  const action = (id) => actions().find((a) => a.props["data-model-action"] === id);
  const stops = () => ({
    radio: radios().filter((r) => r.props.tabIndex === 0).map((r) => r.props["data-model"]),
    action: actions().filter((a) => a.props.tabIndex === 0).map((a) => a.props["data-model-action"]),
  });
  return { tree: () => tree, group, radios, actions, ids, radio, action, key, stops, focused, calls };
}

test("cartridge grid", async (t) => {
  await t.test("it is a radiogroup named for the task with one checked radio and one tab stop (change-driving)", async (t) => {
    const h = await mount(t);
    assert.equal(h.group().props["aria-label"], "Language model");
    assert.deepEqual(h.ids(), SHOWN, "Recommended first, then by size, collapsed to five");
    assert.deepEqual(h.radios().map((r) => r.props["aria-checked"]), [true, false, false, false, false]);
    assert.deepEqual(h.stops().radio, ["qwen-2b"]);
    assert.ok(h.radio("qwen-2b").props["aria-labelledby"] && h.radio("qwen-2b").props["aria-describedby"]);
  });

  await t.test("arrows move focus in a 2-column grid by row, clamp at the ends, and never select (change-driving)", async (t) => {
    const h = await mount(t);
    assert.equal(await h.key(h.radio("qwen-2b"), "ArrowRight"), true);
    assert.equal(h.focused.at(-1), "qwen-4b");
    await h.key(h.radio("qwen-4b"), "ArrowDown");
    assert.equal(h.focused.at(-1), "extra0", "down from the right column lands in the next row's right column");
    await h.key(h.radio("extra0"), "ArrowDown");
    assert.equal(h.focused.at(-1), "extra1", "clamps to the last card in a short final row");
    assert.equal(await h.key(h.radio("extra1"), "ArrowDown"), false, "at the end the key is left to the page");
    await h.key(h.radio("extra1"), "Home");
    assert.equal(h.focused.at(-1), "qwen-2b");
    await h.key(h.radio("qwen-2b"), "End");
    assert.equal(h.focused.at(-1), "extra1");
    await h.key(h.radio("qwen-9b"), "ArrowUp");
    assert.equal(h.focused.at(-1), "qwen-2b");
    assert.deepEqual(h.calls.select, [], "moving focus never changes a route");
    assert.deepEqual(h.calls.download, []);
  });

  await t.test("the tab stop follows focus and returns to the checked card when focus leaves (change-driving)", async (t) => {
    const h = await mount(t);

    assert.deepEqual(h.stops(), { radio: ["qwen-4b"], action: ["qwen-4b"] });
    await React.act(async () => h.group().props.onBlur({ currentTarget: { contains: () => false }, relatedTarget: null }));
    assert.deepEqual(h.stops(), { radio: ["qwen-2b"], action: ["qwen-2b"] });
    await React.act(async () => h.group().props.onBlur({ currentTarget: { contains: () => true }, relatedTarget: {} }));
    assert.deepEqual(h.stops().radio, ["qwen-2b"], "focus moving inside the grid keeps the stop");
  });

  await t.test("in right-to-left layouts left and right swap and rows still move down (M1, change-driving)", async (t) => {
    const h = await mount(t, { dir: "rtl" });

    assert.equal(h.focused.at(-1), "qwen-4b", "left is forward in RTL");
    await h.key(h.radio("qwen-4b"), "ArrowRight");
    assert.equal(h.focused.at(-1), "qwen-2b");
    await h.key(h.radio("qwen-2b"), "ArrowDown");
    assert.equal(h.focused.at(-1), "qwen-9b");
```

```js
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const fs = require("node:fs");

const test = require("node:test");
const { resolveTokens } = require("../helpers/harness/cssTokens");

const css = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, "../..", "src/index.css"), "utf8");
const load = () => import("../../src/utils/contrast.ts");

// The cartridge draws on opaque fills only: a bg-card card on the content pane
// (bg-background | dark:bg-surface-1, SidebarModal.tsx:243), with bg-muted chips
// and a 2px border-ring when checked. Text must clear 4.5:1 and the selected
// border 3:1 against both the card and the pane it touches, in both themes.
const THEMES = [
  ["light", (t) => t.light, "--color-background"],
  ["dark", (t) => t.dark, "--color-surface-1"],
];

test("cartridge text meets 4.5:1 on the card and its chips in both themes (I13)", async () => {
  const { contrastRatio } = await load();
  const tokens = resolveTokens(css);
  for (const [theme, pick] of THEMES) {
    const t = pick(tokens);
    for (const role of ["--color-foreground", "--color-muted-foreground", "--color-link", "--color-link-hover", "--color-locality-device"]) {
      const ratio = contrastRatio(t[role], t["--color-card"]);
      assert.ok(ratio >= 4.5, `${theme}: ${role} on card is ${ratio.toFixed(2)}:1`);
    }
    const chip = contrastRatio(t["--color-foreground"], t["--color-muted"]);
    assert.ok(chip >= 4.5, `${theme}: in-use chip text is ${chip.toFixed(2)}:1`);
  }
});

test("the checked card's ring border meets 3:1 against the card and the pane (I13)", async () => {
  const { contrastRatio } = await load();
  const tokens = resolveTokens(css);
  for (const [theme, pick, pane] of THEMES) {
    const t = pick(tokens);
    for (const [name, surface] of [["card", t["--color-card"]], ["pane", t[pane]]]) {
      const ratio = contrastRatio(t["--color-ring"], surface);
      assert.ok(ratio >= 3, `${theme}: ring against ${name} is ${ratio.toFixed(2)}:1`);
    }
  }
});
```

1. Append `stepGrid` to `src/components/ui/rovingNav.ts` (Task 5's file), after `stepLinear`:

   ```ts
   // Grid navigation over `count` items laid out `columns` per row, in reading
   // order. Left and right follow the reading direction, so they swap when `rtl`
   // is true; up and down move by a row and stop at the ends rather than wrapping.
   export function stepGrid(
     index: number,
     key: string,
     opts: { columns: number; count: number; rtl: boolean }
   ): number {
     const { columns, count, rtl } = opts;
     if (count === 0) return index;
     const last = count - 1;
     const forward = rtl ? "ArrowLeft" : "ArrowRight";
     const backward = rtl ? "ArrowRight" : "ArrowLeft";
     switch (key) {
       case forward:
         return Math.min(last, index + 1);
       case backward:
         return Math.max(0, index - 1);
       case "ArrowDown":
         return Math.min(last, index + columns);
       case "ArrowUp":
         return index - columns >= 0 ? index - columns : index;
       case "Home":
         return 0;
       case "End":
         return last;
       default:
         return index;
     }
   }
   ```

2. Create `src/components/ui/cartridgeMath.ts`:

   ```ts
   // Pure helpers for model cartridges (SET-R4 B). Tiers are estimates from file
   // size unless the registry carries curated speedTier/qualityTier.

   export interface CartridgeModel {
     id: string;
     name: string;
     sizeBytes?: number;
     contextLength?: number;
     recommended?: boolean;
     isDownloaded: boolean;
     isDownloading: boolean;
     isCancelling?: boolean;
     /** The archive is downloaded and unpacking: cancelling is no longer possible. */
     isInstalling?: boolean;
     progress?: number;
     speedTier?: number;
     qualityTier?: number;
     /** Short extra fact, already translated (for example an import's load status). */
     badge?: string;
     /** Model card or documentation link, with its already-translated label. */
     href?: string;
     hrefLabel?: string;
   }

   export type Fit = "comfortable" | "tight" | "tooLarge" | "unknown";

   const GB = 1_000_000_000;
   const bucket = (bytes: number, edges: number[]) => {
     const i = edges.findIndex((edge) => bytes <= edge * GB);
     return i === -1 ? edges.length + 1 : i + 1;
   };

   export function estimateTiers(m: Pick<CartridgeModel, "sizeBytes" | "speedTier" | "qualityTier">) {
     const size = m.sizeBytes;
     const memory = size ? bucket(size, [1.5, 3, 5, 8]) : null;
     const sizeSpeed = size ? 6 - bucket(size, [1, 2, 4, 8]) : null;
     const sizeQuality = size ? Math.min(5, bucket(size, [1, 2, 4, 8]) + 1) : null;
     const curated = m.speedTier !== undefined && m.qualityTier !== undefined;
     return {
       speed: m.speedTier ?? sizeSpeed,
       quality: m.qualityTier ?? sizeQuality,
       memory,
       estimated: !curated,
     };
   }

   export function estimateRamBytes(sizeBytes: number): number {
     return sizeBytes * 1.15;
   }

   export function fitFor(sizeBytes: number | undefined, totalMemoryBytes: number | null): Fit {
     if (!sizeBytes || !totalMemoryBytes) return "unknown";
     const share = estimateRamBytes(sizeBytes) / totalMemoryBytes;
     if (share < 0.4) return "comfortable";
     return share <= 0.7 ? "tight" : "tooLarge";
   }

   export function sortForDisplay<T extends Pick<CartridgeModel, "recommended" | "sizeBytes">>(
     models: T[]
   ): T[] {
     return models
       .map((m, i) => ({ m, i }))
       .sort((a, b) => {
         if (!!a.m.recommended !== !!b.m.recommended) return a.m.recommended ? -1 : 1;
         const sa = a.m.sizeBytes ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
         const sb = b.m.sizeBytes ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
         return sa === sb ? a.i - b.i : sa - sb;
       })
       .map(({ m }) => m);
   }

   export function visibleModels<T extends Pick<CartridgeModel, "id">>(
     sorted: T[],
     selectedId: string,
     expanded: boolean,
     limit = 5
   ): T[] {
     if (expanded || sorted.length <= limit) return sorted;
     const head = sorted.slice(0, limit);
     const selected = sorted.find((m) => m.id === selectedId);
     return selected && !head.includes(selected) ? [...head, selected] : head;
   }

   export interface LocalModelFacts {
     id: string;
     name: string;
     sizeBytes?: number;
     contextLength?: number;
     recommended?: boolean;
     speedTier?: number;
     qualityTier?: number;
   }

   export interface CartridgeState {
     downloaded: boolean;
     downloading: boolean;
     cancelling?: boolean;
     installing?: boolean;
     progress?: number;
     badge?: string;
     href?: string;
     hrefLabel?: string;
   }

   // The one place a picker's model becomes a cartridge, so context length and
   // curated tiers cannot be dropped by a hand-written mapper.
   export function cartridgeFromLocalModel(
     model: LocalModelFacts,
     state: CartridgeState
   ): CartridgeModel {
     return {
       id: model.id,
       name: model.name,
       sizeBytes: model.sizeBytes,
       contextLength: model.contextLength,
       recommended: model.recommended,
       speedTier: model.speedTier,
       qualityTier: model.qualityTier,
       isDownloaded: state.downloaded,
       isDownloading: state.downloading,
       isCancelling: state.cancelling,
       isInstalling: state.installing,
       progress: state.progress,
       badge: state.badge,
       href: state.href,
       hrefLabel: state.hrefLabel,
     };
   }

   // Which tasks already run on each model: device routes that are not turned off,
   // matched by display name or id (the resolver reports the model it resolved).
   export function usedByMap(
     models: readonly Pick<CartridgeModel, "id" | "name">[],
     routes: readonly {
       id: string;
       locality: string;
       model: string | null;
       state: { status: string };
     }[],
     taskName: (routeId: string) => string
   ): Record<string, string[]> {
     const map: Record<string, string[]> = {};
     for (const model of models) {
       const tasks = routes
         .filter(
           (route) =>
             route.locality === "device" &&
             route.state.status !== "off" &&
             (route.model === model.name || route.model === model.id)
         )
         .map((route) => taskName(route.id));
       if (tasks.length) map[model.id] = tasks;
     }
     return map;
   }
   ```

   Check the numbers against the tests:
   - Speed buckets are at most 1, 2, 4 and 8 GB. The bucket index for 1.3 GB is 2, so speed is 6 - 2 = 4. 2.7 GB gives index 3, so speed 3. 5.5 GB gives index 4, so speed 2.
   - Quality is the bucket index + 1: 3, 4 and 5.
   - Memory edges are 1.5, 3, 5 and 8 GB: 1.3 GB gives 1, 2.7 GB gives 2, and 5.5 GB gives 4.

3. Create `src/components/ui/ModelCartridgeGrid.tsx`:

   ```tsx
   import { useId, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
   import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
   import { createExternalLinkHandler } from "../../utils/externalLinks";
   import { formatDecimalBytes } from "../../utils/formatBytes";
   import { cn } from "../lib/utils";
   import { Download, Trash2, X } from "../icons";
   import { Button } from "./button";
   import {
     estimateRamBytes,
     estimateTiers,
     fitFor,
     sortForDisplay,
     visibleModels,
     type CartridgeModel,
   } from "./cartridgeMath";
   import { stepGrid } from "./rovingNav";

   // The grid is always two columns, so the arrow-key model (stepGrid columns: 2)
   // matches what is on screen.
   const COLUMNS = 2;

   export interface ModelCartridgeGridProps {
     label: string;
     models: CartridgeModel[];
     selectedId: string;
     totalMemoryBytes: number | null;
     /** Model id -> translated names of the tasks that already run on it. */
     usedBy?: Record<string, string[]>;
     /** Reading direction; defaults to the active UI language's. */
     dir?: "ltr" | "rtl";
     onSelect: (id: string) => void;
     onDownload: (id: string) => void;
     onCancel?: (id: string) => void;
     onDelete?: (id: string) => void;
   }

   function Pips({ label, value }: { label: string; value: number }) {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     return (
       <>
         <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
         <span role="img" aria-label={t("cartridge.meter", { label, value })} className="flex gap-0.5">
           {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => (
             <span
               key={n}
               className={cn("h-2.5 w-1.5 rounded-sm", n <= value ? "bg-foreground/70" : "bg-border")}
             />
           ))}
         </span>
       </>
     );
   }

   export function ModelCartridgeGrid(props: ModelCartridgeGridProps) {
     const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();
     const baseId = useId();
     const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
     // null = nothing inside the grid has focus; the checked card is the tab stop.
     const [focusIndex, setFocusIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
     const radios = useRef<(HTMLDivElement | null)[]>([]);
     const sorted = sortForDisplay(props.models);
     const shown = visibleModels(sorted, props.selectedId, expanded);
     const checkedIndex = shown.findIndex((m) => m.id === props.selectedId);
     const anchor = checkedIndex >= 0 ? checkedIndex : 0;
     const tabStop = focusIndex !== null && focusIndex < shown.length ? focusIndex : anchor;
     const rtl = (props.dir ?? i18n?.dir?.() ?? "ltr") === "rtl";
     // The "estimate" caption only appears while a visible meter is size-derived.
     const anyEstimated = shown.some((m) => {
       const tiers = estimateTiers(m);
       return tiers.estimated && tiers.speed !== null;
     });

     // Arrows, Home and End move focus between cards, from the radio or from the
     // card's own action button. They never select: choosing a model changes a
     // route, so it takes Enter, Space or a click on a downloaded card.
     const move = (event: KeyboardEvent, from: number) => {
       const next = stepGrid(from, event.key, { columns: COLUMNS, count: shown.length, rtl });
       if (next === from) return;
       event.preventDefault();
       setFocusIndex(next);
       radios.current[next]?.focus();
     };

     // Only a downloaded model can be chosen. A download starts from the card's
     // Download button and nowhere else.
     const choose = (m: CartridgeModel) => {
       if (m.isDownloaded && m.id !== props.selectedId) props.onSelect(m.id);
     };

     return (
       <div className="space-y-2">
         <div
           role="radiogroup"
           aria-label={props.label}
           className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5"
           onBlur={(event) => {
             if (!event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget as Node | null))
               setFocusIndex(null);
           }}
         >
           {shown.map((m, i) => {
             const tiers = estimateTiers(m);
             const fit = fitFor(m.sizeBytes, props.totalMemoryBytes);
             const tooLarge = fit === "tooLarge" && !m.isDownloaded;
             const checked = m.id === props.selectedId;
             const usedBy = props.usedBy?.[m.id] ?? [];
             const nameId = `${baseId}-name-${i}`;
             const factsId = `${baseId}-facts-${i}`;
             const stop = i === tabStop ? 0 : -1;
             const onFocus = () => setFocusIndex(i);
             return (
               <div
                 key={m.id}
                 data-card={m.id}
                 className={cn(
                   "relative rounded-[10px] border bg-card p-3 transition-[border-color,translate] duration-[var(--motion-fast)] motion-safe:hover:-translate-y-px dark:hover:translate-y-0",
                   checked ? "border-2 border-ring p-[11px]" : "border-border"
                 )}
               >
                 <div
                   role="radio"
                   aria-checked={checked}
                   aria-disabled={!m.isDownloaded || undefined}
                   aria-labelledby={nameId}
                   aria-describedby={factsId}
                   tabIndex={stop}
                   data-model={m.id}
                   ref={(el) => {
                     radios.current[i] = el;
                   }}
                   onFocus={onFocus}
                   onClick={() => choose(m)}
                   onKeyDown={(event) => {
                     if (event.key === " " || event.key === "Enter") {
                       event.preventDefault();
                       choose(m);
                       return;
                     }
                     move(event, i);
                   }}
                   className="cursor-pointer rounded-md outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-card"
                 >
                   <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                     <span id={nameId} className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">
                       {m.name}
                     </span>
                     {m.recommended && (
                       <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                         {t("common.recommended")}
                       </span>
                     )}
                   </div>
                   <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-[82px_1fr] items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1">
                     {tiers.speed !== null && (
                       <Pips label={t("cartridge.speed")} value={tiers.speed} />
                     )}
                     {tiers.quality !== null && (
                       <Pips label={t("cartridge.quality")} value={tiers.quality} />
                     )}
                     {tiers.memory !== null && (
                       <Pips label={t("cartridge.memory")} value={tiers.memory} />
                     )}
                   </div>
                   <p id={factsId} className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                     {[
                       m.sizeBytes ? formatDecimalBytes(m.sizeBytes) : null,
                       m.contextLength
                         ? t("cartridge.context", { k: Math.round(m.contextLength / 1024) })
                         : null,
                       m.badge ?? null,
                       tooLarge
                         ? t("cartridge.tooLarge", {
                             needs: formatDecimalBytes(estimateRamBytes(m.sizeBytes!)),
                             total: formatDecimalBytes(props.totalMemoryBytes!),
                           })
                         : fit === "tight" && !m.isDownloaded
                           ? t("cartridge.tight")
                           : null,
                       !m.isDownloaded && !m.isDownloading && !tooLarge
                         ? t("cartridge.notDownloaded")
                         : null,
                     ]
                       .filter(Boolean)
                       .join(" · ")}
                   </p>
                 </div>
                 <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                   {m.isDownloading ? (
                     <div className="flex flex-1 items-center gap-2">
                       <div
                         role="progressbar"
                         aria-valuenow={Math.round(m.progress ?? 0)}
                         aria-valuemin={0}
                         aria-valuemax={100}
                         aria-label={t("cartridge.downloading", { name: m.name })}
                         className="h-1.5 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full border border-border bg-muted"
                       >
                         <div
                           className="h-full bg-foreground/70 transition-[inline-size] duration-[var(--motion-base)]"
                           style={{ inlineSize: `${m.progress ?? 0}%` }}
                         />
                       </div>
                       {props.onCancel && (
                         <Button
                           size="sm"
                           variant="outline"
                           tabIndex={stop}
                           data-model-action={m.id}
                           disabled={m.isCancelling || m.isInstalling}
                           onFocus={onFocus}
                           onKeyDown={(event) => move(event, i)}
                           onClick={() => props.onCancel!(m.id)}
                           aria-label={t("cartridge.cancel", { name: m.name })}
                         >
                           <X size={12} aria-hidden="true" />
                         </Button>
                       )}
                     </div>
                   ) : m.isDownloaded ? (
                     <>
                       <span className="text-xs font-medium text-locality-device">
                         {t("routes.state.ready")}
                       </span>
                       {props.onDelete && (
                         <Button
                           size="sm"
                           variant="ghost"
                           tabIndex={stop}
                           data-model-action={m.id}
                           onFocus={onFocus}
                           onKeyDown={(event) => move(event, i)}
                           onClick={() => props.onDelete!(m.id)}
                           aria-label={t("cartridge.delete", { name: m.name })}
                         >
                           <Trash2 size={12} aria-hidden="true" />
                         </Button>
                       )}
                     </>
                   ) : (
                     <Button
                       size="sm"
                       variant={m.recommended ? "default" : "outline"}
                       tabIndex={stop}
                       data-model-action={m.id}
                       disabled={tooLarge}
                       onFocus={onFocus}
                       onKeyDown={(event) => move(event, i)}
                       onClick={() => props.onDownload(m.id)}
                       aria-label={t("cartridge.downloadNamed", { name: m.name })}
                     >
                       <Download size={12} className="me-1" aria-hidden="true" />
                       {t("cartridge.download")}
                     </Button>
                   )}
                 </div>
                 {m.href && m.hrefLabel && (
                   <a
                     href={m.href}
                     tabIndex={stop}
                     onFocus={onFocus}
                     onKeyDown={(event) => move(event, i)}
                     onClick={createExternalLinkHandler(m.href)}
                     className="mt-2 inline-block text-[11px] text-link underline underline-offset-2 hover:text-link-hover"
                   >
                     {m.hrefLabel}
                   </a>
                 )}
                 {usedBy.length > 0 && (
                   <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 text-[11px]">
                     <span className="text-muted-foreground">{t("cartridge.inUseBy")}</span>
                     {usedBy.map((task) => (
                       <span
                         key={task}
                         className="rounded-full bg-muted px-1.5 py-px font-semibold text-foreground"
                       >
                         {task}
                       </span>
                     ))}
                   </div>
                 )}
               </div>
             );
           })}
         </div>
         <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
           {anyEstimated ? (
             <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{t("cartridge.estimate")}</p>
           ) : (
             <span />
           )}
           {sorted.length > 5 && (
             <Button
               size="sm"
               variant="ghost"
               aria-expanded={expanded}
               onClick={() => setExpanded((open) => !open)}
             >
               {expanded ? t("cartridge.showFewer") : t("cartridge.showAll", { count: sorted.length })}
             </Button>
           )}
         </div>
       </div>
     );
   }
   ```

   The pips use `bg-foreground/70`, never orange. Orange is only the selected border (`border-ring`, D1). Motion uses `duration-[var(--motion-fast)]` and `duration-[var(--motion-base)]`; the hover lift is `motion-safe:` only and is cancelled in Plum Night, as the R4 B card specifies. The progress fill is measured with `inlineSize` so it grows from the inline start in RTL.

4. **Total memory.**
   - Create `src/hooks/useTotalMemory.ts`:

     ```ts
     import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

     // Total system memory in bytes, for the "too large for this device" check on
     // model cartridges. null until main answers, and null if it cannot (browser
     // preview, older preload): the grid then makes no fit claim at all.
     export function useTotalMemory(): number | null {
       const [totalMemory, setTotalMemory] = useState<number | null>(null);
       useEffect(() => {
         let mounted = true;
         const read = window.electronAPI?.getTotalMemory?.();
         if (read) {
           read.then(
             (bytes) => {
               if (mounted) setTotalMemory(Number.isFinite(bytes) && bytes > 0 ? bytes : null);
             },
             () => {
               if (mounted) setTotalMemory(null);
             }
           );
         }
         return () => {
           mounted = false;
         };
       }, []);
       return totalMemory;
     }
     ```

     ```ts
     import type { LocalProvider } from "../components/LocalModelPicker";

     // The registry's local model shape, reduced to what the pickers read. Every
     // field the cartridge shows has to be named here and copied below, because the
     // mapping is explicit: a field that is not forwarded never reaches the grid.
     export interface RegistryLocalModel {
       id: string;
       name: string;
       size: string;
       sizeBytes: number;
       description: string;
       descriptionKey?: string;
       hfRepo?: string;
       recommended?: boolean;
       contextLength?: number;
       speedTier?: number;
       qualityTier?: number;
     }

     export interface RegistryLocalProvider {
       id: string;
       name: string;
       models: readonly RegistryLocalModel[];
     }

     export function toLocalProviders(providers: readonly RegistryLocalProvider[]): LocalProvider[] {
       return providers.map((provider) => ({
         id: provider.id,
         name: provider.name,
         models: provider.models.map((model) => ({
           id: model.id,
           name: model.name,
           size: model.size,
           sizeBytes: model.sizeBytes,
           description: model.description,
           descriptionKey: model.descriptionKey,
           specUrl: model.hfRepo ? `https://huggingface.co/${model.hfRepo}` : undefined,
           recommended: model.recommended,
           contextLength: model.contextLength,
           speedTier: model.speedTier,
           qualityTier: model.qualityTier,
         })),
       }));
     }
     ```

### Task 14: Storage list with main-owned counts and typed outcomes (SET-R7 A)

Closes **C2** (history and audio confirmations count exactly what is deleted, because main owns one predicate per deletion and refuses a delete whose set changed after review), **I12** (typed `{ ok, deleted, remaining, errors }` outcomes from main; unreadable counts are errors, never zero; the dialog keeps the reviewed snapshot while it runs; success is never inferred from a recount; reset checks `cleanupApp()`'s `success` and keeps its errors visible; main's reset leaves Task 2's reset-barrier call `await this.credentials.reset(() => this.environmentManager?.clearAllPersistedData())` untouched and adds no second reset), **I13** for Storage (destructive outline triggers sit on and hover to `bg-background`, never `#f5f5f5`) and **M4** (the partial-failure check is an automated test with a main fake returning a partial result; there is no manual `tail -f` step).

Privacy & Data gains one **Storage** list:

```
Storage                                                   [Count again]  (only when a row could not be counted)
Dictation audio      214 files · 1.2 GB                    [Delete…]
Downloaded models    3 models · 9.8 GB              [Open] [Delete…]
Transcript history   1482 transcripts, including 15 discarded or deleted   [Delete…]
── Danger zone ──
Reset Loqui          Deletes settings, history, audio, models and keys.   [Reset…]
```

Every "Delete…" opens a confirm built from a **snapshot** taken when the dialog opens: count, size and folder (monospace, `dir="ltr"`), and a button that repeats the count. The history confirm counts and names both sets, e.g. "Delete 1482 transcripts (12 discarded, 3 deleted) and 214 audio files (1.2 GB)", because the existing clear deletes every row and every recording (`src/helpers/ipcHandlers.js:1287-1298` deletes all audio first; `src/helpers/database.js:551-560` runs an unfiltered `DELETE FROM transcriptions`; `src/helpers/audioStorage.js:167-185` unlinks every `.webm`). Main receives the reviewed counts plus separate opaque SHA-256 `audioIdentity` and `historyIdentity` digests and refuses with `"stale"` if either set changed, including a same-count replacement; the dialog then shows the current items and counts for a fresh review. Digests are computed only in main from sorted transcript rows (all persisted identity/state fields) and sorted recording names plus stat identity/version metadata; transcript contents and file identities never cross IPC. Missing or malformed digests are `"invalid-request"`, with no unchecked deletion path. A stat failure leaves audio identity unknown and blocks confirmation/deletion even when the folder count is readable. A failure keeps the dialog open with `role="alert"`, main's exact numbers and the raw error list. Reset requires typing the localized word and only relaunches after `cleanupApp()` reports `success: true`.

What changes from v1 (old Task 11), and why:
- v1 counted visible transcripts (`deleted_at IS NULL AND status != 'discarded'`) but deleted every row and every recording (C2). v2 moves the count and the delete into `src/helpers/storageOps.js` in main, uses the same predicate for both, checks the reviewed counts and both identity digests inside the synchronous delete transaction before touching any row or recording and rolls back if `clearTranscriptions` ever removes a different number of rows than the count.
- v1 decided success from a recount that turned unreadable state into zero and ignored resolved failure results (I12). Plan 02 (spec §5.6, its Task 19) already fixed the base for the single "Clear All Audio" row: `getStorageUsage()` returns `{ fileCount, totalBytes, readable }`, `deleteAllAudio()` returns `{ deleted, failed, readable }`, main has `remainingAudioIds()` and `clearFlagsForDeletedAudio()` (`src/helpers/audioFlagReconcile.js`), and the renderer has `resolveClearAudioOutcome` (`src/utils/audioDeletion.ts`) and `useAudioStorageUsage`. v2 builds on that contract instead of a parallel one: the new `listStoredAudio()` is the by-name form of `getStorageUsage()` with the same `readable` flag (it never throws; `getStorageUsage()` is derived from it, so Plan 02's shape and tests are unchanged), `storageOps` maps `readable: false` to a typed `count-failed`/`recount-failed` error, flag reconciliation is Plan 02's `clearFlagsForDeletedAudio`, every audio result carries Plan 02's `failed` and `readable`, the Storage list's audio row takes its count, bytes and unavailable state from Plan 02's `useAudioStorageUsage` hook (unchanged), and the renderer grants audio success only when `resolveClearAudioOutcome` says `"cleared"` (plus `ok`, no errors and `remaining === 0`). An unreadable zero is never shown as "cleared".
- v1's dialog read live row state, so a retry lost the reviewed count. v2 stores the snapshot in the dialog state; row refreshes never touch it.
- v1's reset toasted success after any resolved `cleanupApp()` and relaunched, although main returns `{ success: false, errors }` instead of throwing (`src/helpers/ipcHandlers.js:3277-3281`). v2 keeps the reset dialog open with the errors and never relaunches on failure. Main's reset also stopped swallowing per-file audio failures (`deleteAllAudio` catches each unlink at `src/helpers/audioStorage.js:171-179`, so its `try` at `ipcHandlers.js:3164-3168` never fired). The credential reset in `cleanup-app` is Task 2's reset barrier (`await this.credentials.reset(() => this.environmentManager?.clearAllPersistedData());`, which replaced the `clearAllPersistedData` try/catch body, R2-2); this task leaves that call untouched and must not add another reset.
- v1's triggers used the outline variant, which hovers to `bg-muted` (`src/components/ui/button.tsx:49-59`), where `--color-destructive` `#dc2626` is 4.43:1 (I13). v2's `DESTRUCTIVE_OUTLINE` keeps them on `bg-background` (4.83:1).
- Model deletion stays renderer-orchestrated (three existing family IPCs), but each family returns a typed outcome, success needs every family's `success === true` and a recount of zero, and local selections are cleared only when the recount proves every model file is gone.

Model-cache clearing and reset move here from System. Plan 02's one-click "Clear All Audio" row (`AudioStorageRow`, its SET-Q5 confirm) is replaced by the Storage list's audio row, as spec §5.6 anticipates; only that row component is retired. Plan 02's `useAudioStorageUsage` hook is a published §5.6 contract and stays exactly as Plan 02 wrote it, with its tests: `StorageList` calls `useAudioStorageUsage(true)` and maps its `loading | known | unavailable` state onto the audio row (`audioRowFromUsage`), and every `load()` also calls the hook's `refresh()`, so the row re-reads with the rest of the list. The hook's `clearAll()` is not used, because the counted delete goes through `storage.deleteAudio(expected)`. What the old row guaranteed carries over: the unavailable state (Plan 02's `settingsPage.privacy.audioStorageUnavailable` copy, with "Count again" as the Retry), a fresh re-read before any confirmation opens (a failed read opens none), `readable` and `failed` on every audio result, and "cleared" only through `resolveClearAudioOutcome`. Plan 02's tests stay as they are (`test/helpers/audioStorageClear.test.js`, `test/hooks/useAudioStorageUsage.test.js`, and `clearAllAudio.test.js`'s `resolveClearAudioOutcome` case); only `audioStorageRow.test.js`'s markup cases are ported into `storageList.test.js` (Step 6) before that file and the component are deleted. Solid destructive buttons appear only inside dialogs.

  ```js
    deleteHistory(opts: { expected: { total: number; files: number; audioIdentity: string; historyIdentity: string } }): StorageHistoryDeleteResult;
  };
  // audio: { audioDir, listStoredAudio(): StoredAudioList, removeFiles(names): { deleted: number; failed: { file: string; error: string }[] }, remainingAudioIds() /* Plan 02 */ }
  // database: { db /* better-sqlite3 */, clearTranscriptions(), clearAudioFlags(ids) }
  // Flags: Plan 02's clearFlagsForDeletedAudio({ audioStorage: audio, database }), only after a readable recount.
  // readable: false from listStoredAudio maps to "count-failed: …" / "recount-failed: …".
  // expected is required, including every digest: absent, null or malformed is "invalid-request".
  // Main's reset still uses Plan 02's deleteAllAudio(), never this counted-delete interface.
  // errors are stable strings: "stale", "invalid-request", "count-failed: …", "delete-failed: <file>: …",
  // "recount-failed: …", "flags-failed: …", "history-failed: …".
  ```

- Produces, `AudioStorageManager.listStoredAudio(): StoredAudioList` where `StoredAudioList = { files: string[]; totalBytes: number; readable: boolean; directory: string; identity: string | null; error?: string; identityError?: string }`. It is the by-name form of Plan 02's `getStorageUsage()`, with the same predicate and the same `readable` rule: it never throws, and any folder read error (missing included) is `readable: false` with `files: []`, never an empty store. A file that cannot be stat'd still counts, without its size, as in Plan 02, but yields `identity: null` and `identityError`, so Storage preview/deletion fails closed. The identity hashes sorted names and bigint stat `dev`, `ino`, `mode`, `size`, `mtimeNs`, `ctimeNs`, `birthtimeNs`; a same-name overwrite/replacement changes it. `getStorageUsage()` becomes `{ fileCount: files.length, totalBytes, readable }` of it, so Plan 02's shape and tests are unchanged. Also `AudioStorageManager.removeFiles(names)` (never throws; refuses names that are not plain recordings; an already-missing file is neither deleted nor failed).
- Produces, IPC: `storage-preview` → `StoragePreview`; `storage-delete-audio(expected: { files, audioIdentity })` → `StorageDeleteResult`; `storage-delete-history(expected: { total, files, audioIdentity, historyIdentity })` → `StorageHistoryDeleteResult`. Preload `window.electronAPI.storage.{ preview, deleteAudio, deleteHistory }`.
- Produces, `src/types/electron.ts`:

  ```ts
  export interface StorageAudioPreview { files: number; bytes: number; directory: string; audioIdentity: string }
  export interface StorageHistoryPreview { total: number; discarded: number; softDeleted: number; withAudio: number; historyIdentity: string }
  export interface StoragePreview { audio: StorageAudioPreview | { error: string }; history: StorageHistoryPreview | { error: string } }
  // failed and readable are Plan 02's fields (spec §5.6): failed = recordings that could not be unlinked;
  // readable = the folder could be read to count them (false also when nothing was read, e.g. "invalid-request").
  export interface StorageAudioErase { deleted: number; failed: number; readable: boolean; remaining: number | null }
  export interface StorageDeleteResult extends StorageAudioErase { ok: boolean; errors: string[] }
  export interface StorageHistoryDeleteResult { ok: boolean; deleted: number; remaining: number | null; errors: string[]; audio: StorageAudioErase }
  ```

  `discarded` counts `status = 'discarded' AND deleted_at IS NULL`; `softDeleted` counts `deleted_at IS NOT NULL`; the two never overlap.

Create `test/helpers/storageOps.test.js`. It requires `./harness/db` in exactly that form, so `scripts/run-tests.js:25-28` runs it in the native lane:

```js
const test = require("node:test");
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const fs = require("node:fs");
const os = require("node:os");
const path = require("node:path");
const { createDb } = require("./harness/db");
const { setUserDataDir } = require("./harness/electronStub.js");
const AudioStorageManager = require("../../src/helpers/audioStorage.js");
const { createStorageOps } = require("../../src/helpers/storageOps.js");

// A real DatabaseManager and AudioStorageManager in one throwaway profile.
function setup(t, wrap = {}) {
  const db = createDb(t);
  if (!db) return null;
  const audio = new AudioStorageManager(); // createDb pointed userData at its tmpdir
  const broadcasts = [];
  const ops = createStorageOps({
    audio: wrap.audio ? wrap.audio(audio) : audio,
    database: wrap.database ? wrap.database(db) : db,
    broadcast: (channel, payload) => broadcasts.push([channel, payload]),
  });
  return { db, audio, ops, broadcasts };
}

// Five rows: one visible with audio, one visible without, one discarded with
// audio, one soft-deleted with audio, one discarded and soft-deleted. Four
// recordings: three linked, one orphan no row points to. Plus a non-audio file.
function seed({ db, audio }) {
  const insert = db.db.prepare(
    "INSERT INTO transcriptions (text, status, deleted_at, has_audio) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)"
  );
  const kept = insert.run("visible", "completed", null, 1).lastInsertRowid;
  insert.run("visible, no audio", "completed", null, 0);
  const discarded = insert.run("discarded", "discarded", null, 1).lastInsertRowid;
  const softDeleted = insert.run("soft-deleted", "completed", "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z", 1)
    .lastInsertRowid;
  insert.run("discarded, then deleted", "discarded", "2026-01-02T00:00:00.000Z", 0);
  for (const id of [kept, discarded, softDeleted]) {
    assert.equal(audio.saveAudio(Number(id), Buffer.alloc(10, 1), null).success, true);
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(audio.audioDir, "OpenWhispr-9999.webm"), "orphan!");
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(audio.audioDir, "notes.txt"), "not a recording");
}

const reviewedAudio = (preview) => ({ files: preview.audio.files, audioIdentity: preview.audio.audioIdentity });
const reviewedHistory = (preview) => ({
  total: preview.history.total, ...reviewedAudio(preview), historyIdentity: preview.history.historyIdentity,
});

const rowCount = (db) => db.db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM transcriptions").get().n;
const flagged = (db) =>
  db.db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM transcriptions WHERE has_audio = 1").get().n;

      s.db.db.prepare("INSERT INTO transcriptions (text, has_audio) VALUES (?, 1)").run("new transcript");

test("equal-count audio rename, same-name replacement and overwrite block audio AND history deletion", (t) => {
  const s = setup(t);
  if (!s) return;
  seed(s);
  const orphan = path.join(s.audio.audioDir, "OpenWhispr-9999.webm");
  const renamed = path.join(s.audio.audioDir, "OpenWhispr-10000.webm");
  for (const change of [
    () => fs.renameSync(orphan, renamed),
    () => { // atomic same-name replacement, same bytes; inode/version differs
      const replacement = path.join(s.audio.audioDir, "replacement.tmp");
      fs.writeFileSync(replacement, "replace");
      fs.renameSync(replacement, renamed);
    },
    () => { // overwrite same inode and size; force a deterministic version change
      fs.writeFileSync(renamed, "updated");
      fs.utimesSync(renamed, new Date(0), new Date("2030-01-01T00:00:00Z"));
    },
  ]) {
    const before = s.ops.preview();
    change();
    const after = s.ops.preview();
    assert.equal(after.audio.files, before.audio.files);
    assert.equal(after.audio.bytes, before.audio.bytes);
    assert.notEqual(after.audio.audioIdentity, before.audio.audioIdentity);
    assert.deepEqual(s.ops.deleteAudio({ expected: reviewedAudio(before) }).errors, ["stale"]);
    assert.deepEqual(s.ops.deleteHistory({ expected: reviewedHistory(before) }).errors, ["stale"]);
    assert.equal(rowCount(s.db), 5, "history checks audio identity before clearing rows");
    assert.equal(s.ops.preview().audio.audioIdentity, after.audio.audioIdentity, "no recording touched");
    assert.deepEqual(s.broadcasts, []);
  }
});
```

`transcriptions.text` is the only `NOT NULL` column without a default (`src/helpers/localDatabaseSchema.js:4-20`; `status` defaults to `'completed'`, `has_audio` to `0`), so the inserts are valid. `saveAudio(id, buffer, null)` names files `OpenWhispr-<id>.webm` (`test/helpers/audioStorageTraversal.test.js:58-63`). Three 10-byte recordings plus the 7-byte orphan make 37 bytes.
