1. Create `src/helpers/storageOps.js`:

   ```js
   // Main-owned storage counts and deletions for Settings > Privacy & Data.
   // Each preview counts with the predicate its deletion uses, and each
   // deletion refuses to run when the set changed after the user reviewed it,
   // so a confirmation never promises less than the delete removes.
   // Built on Plan 02's stored-audio contract (spec §5.6): the folder listing
   // carries `readable`, which this module maps to a typed error (an unreadable
   // folder is never zero), every audio result keeps `failed` and `readable`,
   // and has_audio flags go through Plan 02's clearFlagsForDeletedAudio.
   const { createHash } = require("node:crypto");
   const { clearFlagsForDeletedAudio } = require("./audioFlagReconcile");

   // Callers supply deterministically ordered arrays/rows. Only digests leave main.
   const identityDigest = (value) => createHash("sha256").update(JSON.stringify(value)).digest("hex");

   /** Audio predicate: every recording in the audio folder, linked to a transcript or not. */
   function isStoredAudioFile(name) {
     return typeof name === "string" && name.endsWith(".webm");
   }

   /**
    * History predicate: every row of `transcriptions` -- completed, discarded
    * and soft-deleted alike. DatabaseManager.clearTranscriptions deletes the
    * same set (`DELETE FROM transcriptions`, database.js:553); deleteHistory
    * compares the two inside one transaction and rolls back on any mismatch.
    */
   const HISTORY_COUNT_SQL = `SELECT
     COUNT(*) AS total,
     COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'discarded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS discarded,
     COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS softDeleted,
     COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN has_audio = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS withAudio
   FROM transcriptions`;

   const describe = (error) => String(error?.message || error);
   const isCount = (value) => Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 0;
   const isIdentity = (value) => typeof value === "string" && /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(value);
   const validExpected = (expected, counts, identities) =>
     !!expected && typeof expected === "object" &&
     counts.every((key) => isCount(expected[key])) && identities.every((key) => isIdentity(expected[key]));

   class AudioCountError extends Error {}

   class StaleHistoryError extends Error {
     constructor(total) {
       super("stale");
       this.total = total;
     }
   }

   function createStorageOps({ audio, database, broadcast = () => {} }) {
     const countHistory = () => {
       const row = database.db.prepare(HISTORY_COUNT_SQL).get();
       return {
         total: row.total,
         discarded: row.discarded,
         softDeleted: row.softDeleted,
         withAudio: row.withAudio,
         // SELECT * binds all persisted identity/state, including same-id edits.
         // Raw rows remain in main; ORDER BY id makes the digest deterministic.
         historyIdentity: identityDigest(database.db.prepare("SELECT * FROM transcriptions ORDER BY id").all()),
       };
     };

     const unreadable = (listed) => listed.error || `unreadable: ${listed.directory}`;
     const audioCountError = (listed) => !listed.readable ? unreadable(listed)
       : !isIdentity(listed.identity) ? (listed.identityError || "unknown audio identity") : null;

     function preview() {
       const listed = audio.listStoredAudio();
       const audioError = audioCountError(listed);
       const audioPreview = audioError === null
         ? { files: listed.files.length, bytes: listed.totalBytes, directory: listed.directory, audioIdentity: listed.identity }
         : { error: audioError };
       let history;
       try {
         history = countHistory();
       } catch (error) {
         history = { error: describe(error) };
       }
       return { audio: audioPreview, history };
     }

     // Unlinks exactly the counted names, then re-reads the folder to learn how
     // many of them are still there. An unreadable re-read leaves `remaining`
     // unknown (null), which is never success.
     function removeCounted(names) {
       const errors = [];
       const { deleted, failed } = audio.removeFiles(names);
       for (const failure of failed) errors.push(`delete-failed: ${failure.file}: ${failure.error}`);
       const after = audio.listStoredAudio();
       if (!after.readable) {
         errors.push(`recount-failed: ${unreadable(after)}`);
         return { deleted, failed: failed.length, remaining: null, errors };
       }
       const present = new Set(after.files);
       return { deleted, failed: failed.length, remaining: names.filter((name) => present.has(name)).length, errors };
     }

     // Plan 02's reconciler: clears has_audio only for rows whose recording is
     // provably gone, and nothing when the folder is unreadable.
     function reconcileAudioFlags(errors) {
       try {
         clearFlagsForDeletedAudio({ audioStorage: audio, database });
       } catch (error) {
         errors.push(`flags-failed: ${describe(error)}`);
       }
     }

     // `readable: false` with no read at all ("invalid-request") is still never success.
     const notRead = (error) => ({ ok: false, deleted: 0, failed: 0, readable: false, remaining: null, errors: [error] });

     function deleteAudio({ expected } = {}) {
       if (!validExpected(expected, ["files"], ["audioIdentity"])) return notRead("invalid-request");
       const counted = audio.listStoredAudio();
       const countError = audioCountError(counted);
       if (countError !== null) return notRead(`count-failed: ${countError}`);
       if (counted.files.length !== expected.files || counted.identity !== expected.audioIdentity) {
         return { ok: false, deleted: 0, failed: 0, readable: true, remaining: counted.files.length, errors: ["stale"] };
       }
       const result = removeCounted(counted.files);
       // Unknown disk state never clears flags.
       if (result.remaining !== null) reconcileAudioFlags(result.errors);
       return {
         ok: result.errors.length === 0 && result.failed === 0 && result.remaining === 0,
         deleted: result.deleted,
         failed: result.failed,
         readable: true,
         remaining: result.remaining,
         errors: result.errors,
       };
     }

     function deleteHistory({ expected } = {}) {
       const untouched = (files) => ({ deleted: 0, failed: 0, readable: files !== null, remaining: files });
       if (!validExpected(expected, ["total", "files"], ["audioIdentity", "historyIdentity"])) {
         return { ok: false, deleted: 0, remaining: null, errors: ["invalid-request"], audio: untouched(null) };
       }
       // No await or callback turn between identity recheck and deletion. Read
       // both sets inside the transaction, before any row or recording is touched.
       let counted;
       let cleared;
       try {
         cleared = database.db.transaction(() => {
           counted = audio.listStoredAudio();
           const countError = audioCountError(counted);
           if (countError !== null) throw new AudioCountError(countError);
           const rows = countHistory();
           if (
             rows.total !== expected.total || counted.files.length !== expected.files ||
             rows.historyIdentity !== expected.historyIdentity || counted.identity !== expected.audioIdentity
           ) {
             throw new StaleHistoryError(rows.total);
           }
           const result = database.clearTranscriptions();
           if (result?.cleared !== rows.total) {
             throw new Error(
               `predicate mismatch: counted ${rows.total} rows, delete removed ${result?.cleared}`
             );
           }
           return result.cleared;
         })();
       } catch (error) {
         if (error instanceof AudioCountError) {
           return { ok: false, deleted: 0, remaining: null, errors: [`count-failed: ${describe(error)}`], audio: untouched(null) };
         }
         if (error instanceof StaleHistoryError) {
           return { ok: false, deleted: 0, remaining: error.total, errors: ["stale"], audio: untouched(counted.files.length) };
         }
         let remaining = null;
         try {
           remaining = countHistory().total;
         } catch {
           // the database itself is unreadable; remaining stays unknown
         }
         return {
           ok: false,
           deleted: 0,
           remaining,
           errors: [`history-failed: ${describe(error)}`],
           audio: untouched(counted?.readable ? counted.files.length : null),
         };
       }
       broadcast("transcriptions-cleared", { cleared });
       broadcast("analytics-changed");
       // Every row is gone, so no has_audio flag is left to reconcile.
       const files = removeCounted(counted.files);
       return {
         ok: files.errors.length === 0 && files.failed === 0 && files.remaining === 0,
         deleted: cleared,
         remaining: 0,
         errors: files.errors,
         audio: { deleted: files.deleted, failed: files.failed, readable: true, remaining: files.remaining },
       };
     }

     return { preview, deleteAudio, deleteHistory };
   }

   module.exports = { createStorageOps, isStoredAudioFile, HISTORY_COUNT_SQL, identityDigest };
   ```

   The digests guard changes between review and this synchronous main-process operation, including equal-count replacements. There is no asynchronous gap in the delete path; this does not claim a cross-process filesystem lock against an external writer during unlink. `clearTranscriptions` opens its own `this.db.transaction(...)()` (`database.js:552`); better-sqlite3 runs a transaction function called inside another as a savepoint, so the outer rollback covers it.

2. `src/helpers/audioStorage.js`, as Plan 02 Task 19 left it (spec §5.6: `deleteAllAudio()` → `{ deleted, failed, readable }`, `getStorageUsage()` → `{ fileCount, totalBytes, readable }`, `remainingAudioIds()`):
   - After `const { parseDbTimestamp } = require("./dbTimestamp");` (`:5`) add `const { isStoredAudioFile, identityDigest } = require("./storageOps");`.
   - In Plan 02's `deleteAllAudio()`, replace `.filter((f) => f.endsWith(".webm"))` with `.filter(isStoredAudioFile)`. Its body and return shape stay Plan 02's.
   - Replace Plan 02's `getStorageUsage()` body with the derived form below, and add `listStoredAudio()` directly above it. `remainingAudioIds()` stays as Plan 02 wrote it.

     ```js
       // The stored recordings behind getStorageUsage(), by name, so Settings >
       // Storage deletes exactly the set it counted. Never throws: like Plan 02's
       // getStorageUsage (spec §5.6), any folder read error is `readable: false`,
       // never an empty store. A stat failure still counts (Plan 02), but leaves
       // identity unknown and blocks Storage preview/deletion.
       listStoredAudio() {
         let files;
         try {
           files = fs.readdirSync(this.audioDir).filter(isStoredAudioFile).sort();
         } catch (error) {
           debugLogger.error("Failed to read the audio folder", { error: error.message }, "audio-storage");
           return { files: [], totalBytes: 0, readable: false, directory: this.audioDir, identity: null, error: error.message };
         }
         let totalBytes = 0;
         const identities = [];
         let identityError;
         for (const file of files) {
           try {
             const stat = fs.statSync(path.join(this.audioDir, file), { bigint: true });
             totalBytes += Number(stat.size);
             identities.push([file, ...[stat.dev, stat.ino, stat.mode, stat.size, stat.mtimeNs, stat.ctimeNs, stat.birthtimeNs].map(String)]);
           } catch (error) {
             // Count remains readable for Plan 02; identity cannot be approved.
             identityError = `stat-failed: ${file}: ${error.message}`;
           }
         }
         return {
           files, totalBytes, readable: true, directory: this.audioDir,
           identity: identityError ? null : identityDigest(identities),
           ...(identityError ? { identityError } : {}),
         };
       }

       // Plan 02's shape, derived from the same listing: one predicate for the
       // row, the count and the delete.
       getStorageUsage() {
         const { files, totalBytes, readable } = this.listStoredAudio();
         return { fileCount: files.length, totalBytes, readable };
       }

       // Unlinks exactly these recordings and reports each failure; never throws.
       // A name that is not a plain recording in this folder is refused.
       removeFiles(names) {
         let deleted = 0;
         const failed = [];
         for (const file of names) {
           if (!isStoredAudioFile(file) || path.basename(file) !== file) {
             failed.push({ file, error: "not a stored recording" });
             continue;
           }
           try {
             fs.unlinkSync(path.join(this.audioDir, file));
             deleted++;
           } catch (error) {
             if (error.code === "ENOENT") continue; // already gone, e.g. the retention sweep
             failed.push({ file, error: error.message });
           }
         }
         if (failed.length > 0) {
           debugLogger.error("Failed to delete audio files", { failed: failed.length }, "audio-storage");
         }
         return { deleted, failed };
       }
     ```

```js
// ---- Mounted container: the real handlers against a fake window.electronAPI ----

function find(node, predicate) {
  if (Array.isArray(node)) return node.map((item) => find(item, predicate)).find(Boolean);
  if (!node || typeof node !== "object") return null;
  return predicate(node) ? node : find(node.props?.children, predicate);
}
const settle = () =>
  React.act(async () => {
    await new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
  });
const wait = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

const UNREADABLE = { fileCount: 0, totalBytes: 0, readable: false }; // Plan 02's unreadable usage
const PREVIEW = {
  audio: { files: 214, bytes: 1_200_000_000, directory: "/tmp/loqui-test/audio", audioIdentity: AUDIO_IDENTITY },
  history: { total: 1482, discarded: 12, softDeleted: 3, withAudio: 199, historyIdentity: HISTORY_IDENTITY },
};

function fakeApi({ storage = {}, ...rest } = {}) {
  const calls = [];
  const disk = { whisper: true, llm: true };
  const api = {
    storage: {
      preview: async () => PREVIEW,
      deleteAudio: async (expected) => {
        calls.push(["deleteAudio", expected]);
        return { ok: true, deleted: 214, failed: 0, readable: true, remaining: 0, errors: [] };
      },
      deleteHistory: async (expected) => {
        calls.push(["deleteHistory", expected]);
        return {
          ok: true,
          deleted: 1482,
          remaining: 0,
          errors: [],
          audio: { deleted: 214, failed: 0, readable: true, remaining: 0 },
        };
      },
      ...storage,
    },
    // Plan 02's hook (useAudioStorageUsage) reads this for the audio row.
    getAudioStorageUsage: async () => ({ fileCount: 214, totalBytes: 1_200_000_000, readable: true }),
    listWhisperModels: async () => ({
      success: true,
      models: [{ model: "base", downloaded: disk.whisper, size_bytes: 147_951_465 }],
    }),
    listParakeetModels: async () => ({ success: true, models: [] }),
    modelGetAll: async () => [
      { id: "qwen3.5-2b-q4_k_m", isDownloaded: disk.llm, downloadedSize: 1_329_766_560 },
    ],
    getModelCacheRoot: async () => "/tmp/loqui-test/cache",
    deleteAllWhisperModels: async () => {
      disk.whisper = false;
      return { success: true };
    },
    deleteAllParakeetModels: async () => ({ success: true }),
    modelDeleteAll: async () => {
      disk.llm = false;
      return { success: true };
    },
    cleanupApp: async () => ({ success: true, message: "Cleanup completed", errors: [] }),
    relaunchApp: async () => {
      calls.push(["relaunch"]);
    },
    ...rest,
  };
  return { api, calls };
}

async function mount(t, api) {
  let root;
  t.after(async () => {
    if (root) await React.act(async () => root.unmount());
  });
  const events = [];
  installBrowserGlobals(t, {
    initialStorage: { cleanupMode: "local", cleanupModel: "qwen3.5-2b-q4_k_m" },
    window: {
      electronAPI: api,
      dispatchEvent: (event) => {
        events.push(event.type);
        return true;
      },
    },
  });
  const container = installHookDom(t);
  const vite = await createRendererServer(t, serverOptions("loqui-storage-list-test-"));
  const s = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/components/settings/StorageList.tsx");
  const { ToastContext } = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/components/ui/useToast.ts");
  const { useSettingsStore } = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/stores/settingsStore.ts");
  const toasts = [];
  const toastApi = {
    toast: (props) => {
      toasts.push(props);
      return String(toasts.length);
    },
    dismiss() {},
    toastCount: 0,
    dictationErrorActionCount: 0,
    dismissByPresentation() {},
  };
  let tree;
  function Probe() {
    tree = s.StorageList();
    return null;
  }
  root = createRoot(container);
  await React.act(async () =>
    root.render(React.createElement(ToastContext.Provider, { value: toastApi }, React.createElement(Probe)))
  );
  await settle();
  const part = (type) => find(tree, (node) => node.type === type);
  return {
    s,
    toasts,
    events,
    store: useSettingsStore,
    view: () => part(s.StorageListView).props,
    dialog: () => part(s.CountedDeleteDialog)?.props ?? null,
    reset: () => part(s.ResetDialog)?.props ?? null,
  };
}

async function confirmDelete(h, kind) {
  await React.act(async () => h.view().onDelete(kind));
  await React.act(async () => h.dialog().onConfirm());
  await settle();
}

    const h = await mount(t, api);
    assert.deepEqual(h.view().audio, { status: "error", error: "unavailable" });
    await React.act(async () => h.view().onDelete("audio"));
    assert.equal(h.dialog(), null);
    assert.deepEqual(calls, []);
  }
});

test("Delete… re-reads before confirming; a failed re-read opens nothing (Plan 02, §5.6)", async (t) => {
  let previews = 0;
  let files = 214;
  const { api, calls } = fakeApi({
    storage: {
      preview: async () => {
        previews++;
        if (previews === 3) throw new Error("EACCES");
        return { ...PREVIEW, audio: { ...PREVIEW.audio, files } };
      },
    },
    getAudioStorageUsage: async () =>
      previews >= 3 ? UNREADABLE : { fileCount: files, totalBytes: 1_200_000_000, readable: true },
  });
  const h = await mount(t, api); // read 1
  files = 210;
  await React.act(async () => h.view().onDelete("audio")); // read 2
  assert.equal(h.dialog().snapshot.files, 210, "the confirm shows the fresh count, not the row's older one");
  await React.act(async () => h.dialog().onCancel());
  await React.act(async () => h.view().onDelete("audio")); // read 3 fails
  assert.equal(h.dialog(), null, "no confirmation on a failed read");
  assert.deepEqual(h.view().audio, { status: "error", error: "unavailable" }, "the stale count is not kept");
  assert.deepEqual(calls, []);
});

test("models: selections are cleared only when every model file is gone", async (t) => {
  const { api } = fakeApi();
  const h = await mount(t, api);

  assert.equal(h.dialog(), null);
  assert.equal(h.store.getState().cleanupModel, "");
  assert.deepEqual(
    h.toasts.map((x) => x.title),
    ["storage.models.done(count=2)"]
  );
});

test("a partial reset stays open with its errors and never relaunches (I12)", async (t) => {
  let attempts = 0;
  const { api, calls } = fakeApi({
    cleanupApp: async () => {
      attempts++;
      return attempts === 1
        ? { success: false, message: "Cleanup completed", errors: ["DB file: EBUSY"] }
        : { success: true, message: "Cleanup completed", errors: [] };
    },
  });
  const h = await mount(t, api);
  await React.act(async () => h.view().onReset());
  assert.equal(h.reset().confirmDisabled, true, "the word has not been typed");
  await React.act(async () => h.reset().onConfirm());
  assert.equal(attempts, 0);
  await React.act(async () => h.reset().onTypedChange("storage.reset.word"));
  assert.equal(h.reset().confirmDisabled, false);
  await React.act(async () => h.reset().onConfirm());
  await settle();
  assert.equal(h.reset().phase, "failed");
  assert.deepEqual(h.reset().errors, ["DB file: EBUSY"]);
  const html = renderToStaticMarkup(React.createElement(h.s.ResetContent, h.reset()));
  assert.match(html, /role="alert"/);
  assert.ok(html.includes("DB file: EBUSY"));
  await wait(1100);
  assert.deepEqual(calls, [], "no relaunch after a failed reset");

  await React.act(async () => h.reset().onConfirm()); // "Try again"
  await settle();
  assert.equal(h.reset().phase, "done");
  await wait(1100);
  assert.deepEqual(calls, [["relaunch"]]);
});

test("a rejected reset keeps the dialog open with the IPC error (I12)", async (t) => {
  const { api, calls } = fakeApi({
    cleanupApp: async () => {
      throw new Error("main crashed");
    },
  });
  const h = await mount(t, api);
  await React.act(async () => h.view().onReset());
  await React.act(async () => h.reset().onTypedChange("storage.reset.word"));
  await React.act(async () => h.reset().onConfirm());
  await settle();
  assert.equal(h.reset().phase, "failed");
  assert.deepEqual(h.reset().errors, ["ipc-failed: main crashed"]);
  await wait(1100);
  assert.deepEqual(calls, []);
});
```

1. Create `src/components/settings/storageMath.ts`:

   ```ts
   // Pure helpers for Settings > Storage. Main owns audio and history counts
   // (src/helpers/storageOps.js); this module validates what main returns and
   // does the renderer-side model arithmetic. Nothing here turns an unknown
   // into zero or a failure into success. Audio success is Plan 02's rule
   // (spec §5.6): resolveClearAudioOutcome must say "cleared".
   import { resolveClearAudioOutcome } from "../../utils/audioDeletion.ts";
   import type { AudioUsage } from "../../hooks/useAudioStorageUsage.ts";

   export type ModelFamily = "whisper" | "parakeet" | "llm";
   export const MODEL_FAMILIES: readonly ModelFamily[] = ["whisper", "parakeet", "llm"];

   export interface AudioSnapshot { kind: "audio"; files: number; bytes: number; directory: string; audioIdentity: string }
   export interface HistorySnapshot {
     kind: "history";
     total: number;
     discarded: number;
     softDeleted: number;
     files: number;
     bytes: number;
     directory: string;
     audioIdentity: string;
     historyIdentity: string;
   }
   export interface ModelsSnapshot { kind: "models"; count: number; bytes: number; directory: string | null }
   export type StorageSnapshot = AudioSnapshot | HistorySnapshot | ModelsSnapshot;
   export type StorageKind = StorageSnapshot["kind"];
   export type RowState<S extends StorageSnapshot = StorageSnapshot> =
     | { status: "loading" }
     | { status: "error"; error: string }
     | { status: "ready"; snapshot: S };

   export interface FamilyOutcome { family: ModelFamily; ok: boolean; error?: string }
   export interface DeleteOutcome {
     ok: boolean;
     deleted: number | null; // null: main's answer is unknown
     remaining: number | null; // null: could not be recounted
     errors: string[];
     audio?: { deleted: number | null; remaining: number | null }; // history only
     families?: FamilyOutcome[]; // models only
   }

   interface SpeechModelInfo { downloaded?: boolean; size_bytes?: number; size_mb?: number }
   interface LlmModelInfo { isDownloaded?: boolean; sizeBytes?: number; downloadedSize?: number }
   export interface ModelLists {
     whisper?: { models?: SpeechModelInfo[] };
     parakeet?: { models?: SpeechModelInfo[] };
     llm?: LlmModelInfo[];
   }

   type Loose = Record<string, unknown>;
   const isObject = (value: unknown): value is Loose => !!value && typeof value === "object";
   const isCount = (value: unknown): value is number =>
     typeof value === "number" && Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 0;
   const isIdentity = (value: unknown): value is string =>
     typeof value === "string" && /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(value);

   export function errorText(error: unknown): string {
     if (error instanceof Error) return error.message;
     if (isObject(error) && typeof error.error === "string") return error.error;
     return String(error ?? "unknown error");
   }

   export function rowsFromPreview(raw: unknown): {
     audio: RowState<AudioSnapshot>;
     history: RowState<HistorySnapshot>;
   } {
     const audioRaw = isObject(raw) ? raw.audio : undefined;
     const historyRaw = isObject(raw) ? raw.history : undefined;

     let audio: RowState<AudioSnapshot> = { status: "error", error: "invalid-preview" };
     if (isObject(audioRaw) && typeof audioRaw.error === "string") {
       audio = { status: "error", error: audioRaw.error };
     } else if (isObject(audioRaw)) {
       const { files, bytes, directory, audioIdentity } = audioRaw;
       if (isCount(files) && isCount(bytes) && typeof directory === "string" && isIdentity(audioIdentity)) {
         audio = { status: "ready", snapshot: { kind: "audio", files, bytes, directory, audioIdentity } };
       }
     }

     let history: RowState<HistorySnapshot> = { status: "error", error: "invalid-preview" };
     if (isObject(historyRaw) && typeof historyRaw.error === "string") {
       history = { status: "error", error: historyRaw.error };
     } else if (audio.status === "error") {
       // History deletion also deletes every recording, so it can't be counted without them.
       history = { status: "error", error: `audio: ${audio.error}` };
     } else if (isObject(historyRaw) && audio.status === "ready") {
       const { total, discarded, softDeleted, historyIdentity } = historyRaw;
       if (isCount(total) && isCount(discarded) && isCount(softDeleted) && isIdentity(historyIdentity)) {
         const { files, bytes, directory, audioIdentity } = audio.snapshot;
         history = {
           status: "ready",
           snapshot: { kind: "history", total, discarded, softDeleted, files, bytes, directory, audioIdentity, historyIdentity },
         };
       }
     }
     return { audio, history };
   }

   const MIB = 1024 * 1024;

   export function summarizeModels(lists: ModelLists): { count: number; bytes: number } {
     let count = 0;
     let bytes = 0;
     for (const m of [...(lists.whisper?.models ?? []), ...(lists.parakeet?.models ?? [])]) {
       if (!m.downloaded) continue;
       count++;
       // Main reports exact bytes; size_mb is rounded MiB (whisper.js:714-715, parakeet.js:625-626).
       bytes += m.size_bytes ?? (m.size_mb ?? 0) * MIB;
     }
     for (const m of lists.llm ?? []) {
       if (!m.isDownloaded) continue;
       count++;
       bytes += m.downloadedSize || m.sizeBytes || 0;
     }
     return { count, bytes };
   }

   export function countModels(
     settled: Record<ModelFamily, PromiseSettledResult<unknown>>
   ): { ok: true; count: number; bytes: number } | { ok: false; error: string } {
     const errors: string[] = [];
     const read = (family: ModelFamily): unknown => {
       const result = settled[family];
       if (result.status === "rejected") {
         errors.push(`${family}: ${errorText(result.reason)}`);
         return undefined;
       }
       const value = result.value;
       const valid =
         family === "llm"
           ? Array.isArray(value)
           : isObject(value) && value.success === true && Array.isArray(value.models);
       if (!valid) {
         const reason = isObject(value) && typeof value.error === "string" ? value.error : "unreadable model list";
         errors.push(`${family}: ${reason}`);
         return undefined;
       }
       return value;
     };
     const whisper = read("whisper") as ModelLists["whisper"];
     const parakeet = read("parakeet") as ModelLists["parakeet"];
     const llm = read("llm") as ModelLists["llm"];
     if (errors.length > 0) return { ok: false, error: errors.join("; ") };
     return { ok: true, ...summarizeModels({ whisper, parakeet, llm }) };
   }

   export function familyOutcome(family: ModelFamily, settled: PromiseSettledResult<unknown>): FamilyOutcome {
     if (settled.status === "rejected") return { family, ok: false, error: errorText(settled.reason) };
     const value = settled.value;
     if (isObject(value) && value.success === true) return { family, ok: true };
     const error = isObject(value) && typeof value.error === "string" ? value.error : "no success result";
     return { family, ok: false, error };
   }

   export function modelsOutcome(
     before: number,
     families: FamilyOutcome[],
     remaining: number | null,
     recountError: string | null
   ): DeleteOutcome {
     const errors = families
       .filter((f) => f.ok === false)
       .map((f) => `${f.family}: ${f.error ?? "failed"}`);
     if (recountError !== null) errors.push(`recount-failed: ${recountError}`);
     return {
       ok: errors.length === 0 && remaining === 0,
       deleted: remaining === null ? null : Math.max(0, before - remaining),
       remaining,
       errors,
       families,
     };
   }

   function readResult(raw: unknown): DeleteOutcome | null {
     if (!isObject(raw)) return null;
     const { ok, deleted, remaining, errors } = raw;
     if (typeof ok !== "boolean" || !isCount(deleted) || !Array.isArray(errors)) return null;
     if (remaining !== null && !isCount(remaining)) return null;
     const list = errors.map(String);
     return {
       ok: ok === true && list.length === 0 && remaining === 0,
       deleted,
       remaining: remaining as number | null,
       errors: list,
     };
   }

   // Plan 02's audio fields (spec §5.6). Both are required: a result without
   // them is not a result this build understands.
   interface AudioErase { deleted: number; failed: number; readable: boolean; remaining: number | null }
   function readAudioErase(raw: unknown): AudioErase | null {
     if (!isObject(raw)) return null;
     const { deleted, failed, readable, remaining } = raw;
     if (!isCount(deleted) || !isCount(failed) || typeof readable !== "boolean") return null;
     if (remaining !== null && !isCount(remaining)) return null;
     return { deleted, failed, readable, remaining: remaining as number | null };
   }
   // "Cleared" only when nothing failed, the folder was readable, and the
   // counted set reads back readable and empty. An unreadable zero never is.
   const audioCleared = (erase: AudioErase): boolean =>
     resolveClearAudioOutcome(
       { failed: erase.failed, readable: erase.readable },
       erase.remaining === null ? null : { fileCount: erase.remaining, readable: true }
     ) === "cleared";

   const INVALID: DeleteOutcome = { ok: false, deleted: null, remaining: null, errors: ["invalid-result"] };

   export function outcomeFromResult(raw: unknown): DeleteOutcome {
     const rows = readResult(raw);
     const erase = readAudioErase(raw);
     if (!rows || !erase) return { ...INVALID, errors: [...INVALID.errors] };
     return { ...rows, ok: rows.ok === true && audioCleared(erase) };
   }

   export function historyOutcomeFromResult(raw: unknown): DeleteOutcome {
     const rows = readResult(raw);
     const audio = readAudioErase(isObject(raw) ? raw.audio : null);
     if (!rows || !audio) {
       return { ...INVALID, errors: [...INVALID.errors], audio: { deleted: null, remaining: null } };
     }
     return {
       ...rows,
       ok: rows.ok === true && audioCleared(audio),
       audio: { deleted: audio.deleted, remaining: audio.remaining },
     };
   }

   export function outcomeFromRejection(error: unknown, kind: StorageKind): DeleteOutcome {
     const outcome: DeleteOutcome = {
       ok: false,
       deleted: null,
       remaining: null,
       errors: [`ipc-failed: ${errorText(error)}`],
     };
     if (kind === "history") outcome.audio = { deleted: null, remaining: null };
     return outcome;
   }

   export function resetOutcome(raw: unknown): { ok: boolean; errors: string[] } {
     if (!isObject(raw)) return { ok: false, errors: ["reset-failed: no result"] };
     const errors = Array.isArray(raw.errors) ? raw.errors.map(String) : [];
     if (raw.success === true && errors.length === 0) return { ok: true, errors: [] };
     if (errors.length > 0) return { ok: false, errors };
     return {
       ok: false,
       errors: [`reset-failed: ${typeof raw.message === "string" ? raw.message : "unknown"}`],
     };
   }

   export function resetConfirmed(typed: string, word: string): boolean {
     const expected = word.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
     return expected.length > 0 && typed.trim().toLocaleLowerCase() === expected;
   }

   export function snapshotCount(snapshot: StorageSnapshot): number {
     if (snapshot.kind === "audio") return snapshot.files;
     if (snapshot.kind === "history") return snapshot.total;
     return snapshot.count;
   }

   export function isEmptySnapshot(snapshot: StorageSnapshot): boolean {
     if (snapshot.kind === "history") return snapshot.total === 0 && snapshot.files === 0;
     return snapshotCount(snapshot) === 0;
   }

   // The audio row is Plan 02's useAudioStorageUsage state (spec §5.6): unavailable
   // is an error row, never zero. Main must also provide a valid folder identity.
   // Display may use hook counts; confirmation uses load()'s main snapshot.
   export function audioRowFromUsage(
     usage: AudioUsage,
     preview: RowState<AudioSnapshot>
   ): RowState<AudioSnapshot> {
     if (usage.status === "loading") return { status: "loading" };
     if (usage.status === "unavailable") return { status: "error", error: "unavailable" };
     if (preview.status !== "ready") return preview;
     return {
       status: "ready",
       snapshot: { ...preview.snapshot, files: usage.fileCount, bytes: usage.totalBytes },
     };
   }
   ```

2. Create `src/components/settings/StorageList.tsx`:

   ```tsx
   import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
   import type { ElementType, ReactNode } from "react";
   import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
   import { clearMissingLocalModelSelections } from "../../stores/settingsStore";
   import { formatDecimalBytes } from "../../utils/formatBytes";
   import { Button } from "../ui/button";
   import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogTitle } from "../ui/dialog";
   import { Input } from "../ui/input";
   import { useToast } from "../ui/useToast";
   import { useAudioStorageUsage } from "../../hooks/useAudioStorageUsage";
   import {
     audioRowFromUsage,
     countModels,
     errorText,
     familyOutcome,
     historyOutcomeFromResult,
     isEmptySnapshot,
     MODEL_FAMILIES,
     modelsOutcome,
     outcomeFromRejection,
     outcomeFromResult,
     resetConfirmed,
     resetOutcome,
     rowsFromPreview,
     snapshotCount,
     type DeleteOutcome,
     type ModelsSnapshot,
     type RowState,
     type StorageKind,
     type StorageSnapshot,
   } from "./storageMath";

   // I13: Button's outline variant hovers to bg-muted (#f5f5f5), where
   // --color-destructive is 4.43:1. Destructive triggers stay on the page
   // background (4.83:1 light); Plum Night keeps the variant's dark surfaces.
   export const DESTRUCTIVE_OUTLINE =
     "bg-background hover:bg-background text-destructive hover:text-destructive border-destructive/40 hover:border-destructive";
   export const RESET_RELAUNCH_DELAY_MS = 1000;

   export type DeletePhase = "review" | "running" | "failed";
   export type ResetPhase = "review" | "running" | "failed" | "done";
   type T = ReturnType<typeof useTranslation>["t"];
   type Api = Window["electronAPI"] | undefined;
   type Rows = Record<StorageKind, RowState>;
   type Last = { snapshot: StorageSnapshot; outcome: DeleteOutcome };
   type DialogState = { snapshot: StorageSnapshot; phase: DeletePhase; last: Last | null };
   type ResetState = { phase: ResetPhase; typed: string; errors: string[] };

   const LOADING: Rows = {
     audio: { status: "loading" },
     models: { status: "loading" },
     history: { status: "loading" },
   };

   const call = <R,>(fn: (() => Promise<R>) | undefined): Promise<R> =>
     fn ? fn() : Promise.reject(new Error("unavailable in this window"));

   function rowSummary(t: T, kind: StorageKind, row: RowState): string {
     if (row.status === "loading") return t("storage.loading");
     // Plan 02's unavailable state (spec §5.6): an unreadable audio folder is never "no audio".
     if (row.status === "error")
       return kind === "audio" ? t("settingsPage.privacy.audioStorageUnavailable") : t("storage.countFailed");
     const s = row.snapshot;
     if (isEmptySnapshot(s)) return t(`storage.${kind}.empty`);
     if (s.kind === "audio") {
       return t("storage.audio.summary", { count: s.files, size: formatDecimalBytes(s.bytes) });
     }
     if (s.kind === "models") {
       return t("storage.models.summary", { count: s.count, size: formatDecimalBytes(s.bytes) });
     }
     const hidden = s.discarded + s.softDeleted;
     return hidden > 0
       ? t("storage.history.summaryWithHidden", {
           count: s.total,
           hidden: t("storage.history.hidden", { count: hidden }),
         })
       : t("storage.history.summary", { count: s.total });
   }

   export interface StorageListViewProps {
     audio: RowState;
     models: RowState;
     history: RowState;
     onDelete: (kind: StorageKind) => void | Promise<void>;
     onOpenModels: () => void;
     onRefresh: () => void;
     onReset: () => void;
   }

   export function StorageListView(props: StorageListViewProps) {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     const anyError = [props.audio, props.models, props.history].some((r) => r.status === "error");
     const row = (kind: StorageKind, state: RowState, extra?: ReactNode) => (
       <div className="flex min-h-[54px] items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2">
         <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
           <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">{t(`storage.${kind}.title`)}</p>
           <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">{rowSummary(t, kind, state)}</p>
         </div>
         {extra}
         <Button
           size="sm"
           variant="outline"
           data-storage-delete={kind}
           className={DESTRUCTIVE_OUTLINE}
           disabled={state.status !== "ready" || isEmptySnapshot(state.snapshot)}
           onClick={() => void props.onDelete(kind)}
         >
           {t("storage.delete")}
         </Button>
       </div>
     );
     return (
       <section aria-labelledby="storage-title" className="space-y-2">

             {t("storage.title")}
           </h3>
           {anyError && (
             <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" data-storage-action="refresh" onClick={props.onRefresh}>
               {t("storage.countAgain")}
             </Button>
           )}
         </div>
         <div className="divide-y divide-border/60 rounded-lg border border-border/70 bg-card/50 dark:border-border-subtle/70 dark:bg-surface-2/50">
           {row("audio", props.audio)}
           {row(
             "models",
             props.models,
             <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={props.onOpenModels}>
               {t("storage.open")}
             </Button>
           )}
           {row("history", props.history)}
           <div className="flex min-h-[54px] items-center gap-2 border-t border-destructive/30 px-4 py-2">
             <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
               <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-destructive">{t("storage.danger")}</p>
               <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">{t("storage.reset.title")}</p>
               <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("storage.reset.description")}</p>
             </div>
             <Button
               size="sm"
               variant="outline"
               data-storage-reset=""
               className={DESTRUCTIVE_OUTLINE}
               onClick={props.onReset}
             >
               {t("storage.reset.button")}
             </Button>
           </div>
         </div>
       </section>
     );
   }

   function confirmCopy(t: T, s: StorageSnapshot): { title: string; body: string; button: string } {
     if (s.kind === "audio") {
       return {
         title: t("storage.audio.confirmTitle", { count: s.files }),
         body: t("storage.audio.confirmBody", { count: s.files, size: formatDecimalBytes(s.bytes) }),
         button: t("storage.audio.confirmButton", { count: s.files }),
       };
     }
     if (s.kind === "models") {
       return {
         title: t("storage.models.confirmTitle", { count: s.count }),
         body: t("storage.models.confirmBody", { count: s.count, size: formatDecimalBytes(s.bytes) }),
         button: t("storage.models.confirmButton", { count: s.count }),
       };
     }
     const transcripts =
       s.discarded + s.softDeleted > 0
         ? t("storage.history.transcriptsWithHidden", {
             count: s.total,
             discarded: t("storage.history.discarded", { count: s.discarded }),
             deleted: t("storage.history.softDeleted", { count: s.softDeleted }),
           })
         : t("storage.history.transcripts", { count: s.total });
     return {
       title: t("storage.history.confirmTitle"),
       body: t("storage.history.confirmBody", {
         transcripts,
         audio: t("storage.history.audioFiles", { count: s.files, size: formatDecimalBytes(s.bytes) }),
       }),
       button: t("storage.history.confirmButton", {
         transcripts: t("storage.history.transcripts", { count: s.total }),
         audio: t("storage.history.audioFilesShort", { count: s.files }),
       }),
     };
   }

   function outcomeLines(t: T, s: StorageSnapshot, o: DeleteOutcome): string[] {
     if (o.errors.includes("stale")) return [t("storage.failed.stale")];
     const lines: string[] = [];
     for (const f of o.families ?? []) {
       if (f.ok === false) {
         lines.push(t("storage.models.familyFailed", { family: t(`storage.models.families.${f.family}`) }));
       }
     }
     if (o.deleted === null || o.remaining === null) {
       lines.push(t("storage.failed.unknown"));
       return lines;
     }
     if (s.kind !== "history") {
       lines.push(t("storage.failed.partial", { deleted: o.deleted, total: snapshotCount(s), remaining: o.remaining }));
       return lines;
     }
     lines.push(t("storage.failed.historyRows", { deleted: o.deleted, total: s.total }));
     if (o.audio && (o.audio.deleted === null || o.audio.remaining === null)) {
       lines.push(t("storage.failed.historyAudioUnknown"));
     } else if (o.audio) {
       lines.push(
         t("storage.failed.historyAudio", { deleted: o.audio.deleted, total: s.files, remaining: o.audio.remaining })
       );
     }
     return lines;
   }

   function ErrorList({ errors }: { errors: string[] }) {
     if (errors.length === 0) return null;
     return (
       <ul dir="ltr" className="list-disc space-y-0.5 ps-4 font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground break-all">
         {errors.map((error, index) => (
           <li key={`${index}:${error}`}>{error}</li>
         ))}
       </ul>
     );
   }

   function OutcomeAlert({ last }: { last: Last }) {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     return (
       <div role="alert" className="space-y-1 rounded-md border border-destructive/40 bg-background p-2 text-xs">
         {outcomeLines(t, last.snapshot, last.outcome).map((line) => (
           <p key={line} className="font-semibold text-destructive">
             {line}
           </p>
         ))}
         <ErrorList errors={last.outcome.errors.filter((e) => e !== "stale")} />
       </div>
     );
   }

   export interface CountedDeleteProps {
     snapshot: StorageSnapshot;
     phase: DeletePhase;
     last: Last | null;
     onConfirm: () => void;
     onCancel: () => void;
     onRecount: () => void;
   }

   // The dialog body. Title/Description default to plain elements so it
   // renders on the server in tests; the dialog passes Radix's labelled parts.
   export function CountedDeleteContent({
     Title = "h2",
     Description = "p",
     ...props
   }: CountedDeleteProps & { Title?: ElementType; Description?: ElementType }) {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     const copy = confirmCopy(t, props.snapshot);
     const running = props.phase === "running";
     return (
       <div className="space-y-3" aria-busy={running || undefined}>
         <Title className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">{copy.title}</Title>
         <Description className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{copy.body}</Description>
         {props.snapshot.directory && (
           <code dir="ltr" className="block rounded-md bg-muted px-2 py-1 font-mono text-[11px] text-foreground break-all">
             {props.snapshot.directory}
           </code>
         )}
         {props.last && <OutcomeAlert last={props.last} />}
         <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
           <Button variant="outline" disabled={running} onClick={props.onCancel}>
             {t("common.cancel")}
           </Button>
           {props.phase === "failed" ? (
             <Button data-storage-action="recount" onClick={props.onRecount}>
               {t("storage.countAgain")}
             </Button>
           ) : (
             <Button
               variant="destructive"
               data-storage-action="confirm"
               disabled={running || isEmptySnapshot(props.snapshot)}
               onClick={props.onConfirm}
             >
               {running ? t("storage.deleting") : copy.button}
             </Button>
           )}
         </div>
       </div>
     );
   }

   export function CountedDeleteDialog(
     props: CountedDeleteProps & { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void }
   ) {
     return (
       <Dialog open={props.open} onOpenChange={props.onOpenChange}>
         <DialogContent role="alertdialog">
           <CountedDeleteContent {...props} Title={DialogTitle} Description={DialogDescription} />
         </DialogContent>
       </Dialog>
     );
   }

   export interface ResetProps {
     phase: ResetPhase;
     typed: string;
     confirmDisabled: boolean;
     errors: string[];
     onTypedChange: (value: string) => void;
     onConfirm: () => void;
     onCancel: () => void;
   }

   export function ResetContent({
     Title = "h2",
     Description = "p",
     ...props
   }: ResetProps & { Title?: ElementType; Description?: ElementType }) {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     const running = props.phase === "running";
     const failed = props.phase === "failed";
     if (props.phase === "done") {
       return (
         <div className="space-y-3">
           <Title className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">{t("storage.reset.confirmTitle")}</Title>
           <Description role="status" className="text-sm text-foreground">
             {t("storage.reset.done")}
           </Description>
         </div>
       );
     }
     return (
       <div className="space-y-3" aria-busy={running || undefined}>
         <Title className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">{t("storage.reset.confirmTitle")}</Title>
         <Description className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("storage.reset.confirmBody")}</Description>
         <label className="block space-y-1 text-xs text-foreground">
           <span>{t("storage.reset.typeLabel", { word: t("storage.reset.word") })}</span>
           <Input
             value={props.typed}
             disabled={running}
             onChange={(e) => props.onTypedChange(e.target.value)}
             className="h-9"
             autoComplete="off"
             spellCheck={false}
           />
         </label>
         {failed && (
           <div role="alert" className="space-y-1 rounded-md border border-destructive/40 bg-background p-2 text-xs">
             <p className="font-semibold text-destructive">{t("storage.reset.failed")}</p>
             <ErrorList errors={props.errors} />
           </div>
         )}
         <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
           <Button variant="outline" disabled={running} onClick={props.onCancel}>
             {failed ? t("common.close") : t("common.cancel")}
           </Button>
           <Button
             variant="destructive"
             data-storage-action="reset"
             disabled={props.confirmDisabled}
             onClick={props.onConfirm}
           >
             {running ? t("storage.reset.running") : failed ? t("storage.retry") : t("storage.reset.confirmButton")}
           </Button>
         </div>
       </div>
     );
   }

   export function ResetDialog(props: ResetProps & { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void }) {
     return (
       <Dialog open={props.open} onOpenChange={props.onOpenChange}>
         <DialogContent role="alertdialog">
           <ResetContent {...props} Title={DialogTitle} Description={DialogDescription} />
         </DialogContent>
       </Dialog>
     );
   }

   async function loadPreviewRows(api: Api): Promise<Pick<Rows, "audio" | "history">> {
     try {
       return rowsFromPreview(await call(api?.storage?.preview));
     } catch (error) {
       const failed: RowState = { status: "error", error: errorText(error) };
       return { audio: failed, history: failed };
     }
   }

   async function loadModelsRow(api: Api): Promise<RowState<ModelsSnapshot>> {
     const [whisper, parakeet, llm] = await Promise.allSettled([
       call(api?.listWhisperModels),
       call(api?.listParakeetModels),
       call(api?.modelGetAll),
     ]);
     const counted = countModels({ whisper, parakeet, llm });
     if (counted.ok === false) return { status: "error", error: counted.error };
     const directory = await call(api?.getModelCacheRoot).catch(() => null);
     return {
       status: "ready",
       snapshot: { kind: "models", count: counted.count, bytes: counted.bytes, directory: directory || null },
     };
   }

   async function deleteModels(api: Api, s: ModelsSnapshot): Promise<DeleteOutcome> {
     const settled = await Promise.allSettled([
       call(api?.deleteAllWhisperModels),
       call(api?.deleteAllParakeetModels),
       call(api?.modelDeleteAll),
     ]);
     const families = MODEL_FAMILIES.map((family, index) => familyOutcome(family, settled[index]));
     const after = await loadModelsRow(api);
     if (after.status === "ready") return modelsOutcome(s.count, families, after.snapshot.count, null);
     return modelsOutcome(s.count, families, null, after.status === "error" ? after.error : "not counted");
   }

   async function performDelete(api: Api, s: StorageSnapshot): Promise<DeleteOutcome> {
     try {
       if (s.kind === "models") return await deleteModels(api, s);
       const storage = api?.storage;
       if (!storage) throw new Error("unavailable in this window");
       if (s.kind === "audio") return outcomeFromResult(await storage.deleteAudio({ files: s.files, audioIdentity: s.audioIdentity }));
       return historyOutcomeFromResult(await storage.deleteHistory({ total: s.total, files: s.files, audioIdentity: s.audioIdentity, historyIdentity: s.historyIdentity }));
     } catch (error) {
       return outcomeFromRejection(error, s.kind);
     }
   }

   const doneTitle = (t: T, s: StorageSnapshot, o: DeleteOutcome) =>
     t(`storage.${s.kind}.done`, { count: o.deleted ?? 0 });

   export function StorageList() {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     const { toast } = useToast();
     const [rows, setRows] = useState<Rows>(LOADING);
     const [dialog, setDialog] = useState<DialogState | null>(null);
     const [reset, setReset] = useState<ResetState | null>(null);
     const busy = useRef(false);
     const word = t("storage.reset.word");

     // Plan 02's hook (spec §5.6) owns the audio row's count, bytes and
     // unavailable state; load() re-reads it with the rest of the list.
     const audioUsage = useAudioStorageUsage(true);
     const refreshAudioUsage = audioUsage.refresh;

     const load = useCallback(async (): Promise<Rows> => {
       const api = window.electronAPI;
       const [preview, models] = await Promise.all([
         loadPreviewRows(api),
         loadModelsRow(api),
         refreshAudioUsage(),
       ]);
       const next: Rows = { audio: preview.audio, history: preview.history, models };
       setRows(next);
       return next;
     }, [refreshAudioUsage]);

     useEffect(() => {
       void load();
     }, [load]);

     const runDelete = async () => {
       if (!dialog || dialog.phase !== "review" || busy.current) return;
       busy.current = true;
       const reviewed = dialog.snapshot;
       setDialog({ ...dialog, phase: "running" });
       const outcome = await performDelete(window.electronAPI, reviewed);
       if (reviewed.kind === "models") {
         // Clear local selections only when the recount proves every model file
         // is gone; after a partial delete the survivors stay selectable and
         // route facts mark the missing ones (the event refreshes them).
         if (outcome.remaining === 0) clearMissingLocalModelSelections(() => false);
         window.dispatchEvent(new Event("openwhispr-models-cleared"));
       }
       const fresh = await load(); // refreshes the rows; never decides the outcome
       busy.current = false;
       if (outcome.ok === true) {
         setDialog(null);
         toast({ title: doneTitle(t, reviewed, outcome), variant: "success", duration: 4500 });
         return;
       }
       const last = { snapshot: reviewed, outcome };
       const row = fresh[reviewed.kind];
       if (outcome.errors.includes("stale") && row.status === "ready") {
         setDialog({ snapshot: row.snapshot, phase: "review", last });
       } else {
         setDialog({ snapshot: reviewed, phase: "failed", last });
       }
     };

     // Plan 02 (spec §5.6): count again before confirming. A failed read turns
     // the row unavailable and opens no confirmation, so a stale count is never
     // presented as current.
     const openDelete = async (kind: StorageKind) => {
       if (dialog || busy.current) return;
       const row = (await load())[kind];
       if (row.status === "ready" && !isEmptySnapshot(row.snapshot)) {
         setDialog({ snapshot: row.snapshot, phase: "review", last: null });
       }
     };

     const recount = async () => {
       if (!dialog || dialog.phase !== "failed") return;
       const current = dialog;
       const row = (await load())[current.snapshot.kind];
       if (row.status === "ready") {
         setDialog({ snapshot: row.snapshot, phase: "review", last: current.last });
       } else if (row.status === "error" && current.last) {
         const outcome = { ...current.last.outcome, errors: [...current.last.outcome.errors, `count-failed: ${row.error}`] };
         setDialog({ ...current, last: { ...current.last, outcome } });
       }
     };

     const runReset = async () => {
       if (!reset || reset.phase === "running" || reset.phase === "done") return;
       if (!resetConfirmed(reset.typed, word)) return;
       const typed = reset.typed;
       setReset({ phase: "running", typed, errors: [] });
       let result: { ok: boolean; errors: string[] };
       try {
         result = resetOutcome(await call(window.electronAPI?.cleanupApp));
       } catch (error) {
         result = { ok: false, errors: [`ipc-failed: ${errorText(error)}`] };
       }
       if (result.ok === false) {
         setReset({ phase: "failed", typed, errors: result.errors });
         return;
       }
       setReset({ phase: "done", typed, errors: [] });
       setTimeout(() => void window.electronAPI?.relaunchApp?.(), RESET_RELAUNCH_DELAY_MS);
     };

     const closeDialog = () => {
       if (dialog && dialog.phase !== "running") setDialog(null);
     };
     const closeReset = () => {
       if (reset && reset.phase !== "running" && reset.phase !== "done") setReset(null);
     };

     return (
       <>
         <StorageListView
           audio={audioRowFromUsage(audioUsage.usage, rows.audio)}
           models={rows.models}
           history={rows.history}
           onDelete={(kind) => openDelete(kind)}
           onOpenModels={() => void window.electronAPI?.openWhisperModelsFolder?.()}
           onRefresh={() => void load()}
           onReset={() => setReset({ phase: "review", typed: "", errors: [] })}
         />
         {dialog && (
           <CountedDeleteDialog
             open
             snapshot={dialog.snapshot}
             phase={dialog.phase}
             last={dialog.last}
             onConfirm={() => void runDelete()}
             onRecount={() => void recount()}
             onCancel={closeDialog}
             onOpenChange={(open) => {
               if (!open) closeDialog();
             }}
           />
         )}
         {reset && (
           <ResetDialog
             open
             phase={reset.phase}
             typed={reset.typed}
             errors={reset.errors}
             confirmDisabled={
               reset.phase === "running" || reset.phase === "done" || !resetConfirmed(reset.typed, word)
             }
             onTypedChange={(typed) =>
               setReset((current) => (current && current.phase !== "running" ? { ...current, typed } : current))
             }
             onConfirm={() => void runReset()}
             onCancel={closeReset}
             onOpenChange={(open) => {
               if (!open) closeReset();
             }}
           />
         )}
       </>
     );
   }
   ```

   Notes on the container:
   - The audio row shown is `audioRowFromUsage(audioUsage.usage, rows.audio)`: Plan 02's `useAudioStorageUsage` decides its count, bytes and unavailable state, and `rows.audio` (main's preview) supplies only the folder path. Confirm snapshots always come from the preview that `openDelete` re-reads, because main checks those counts.
   - The reviewed snapshot lives in `dialog.snapshot` and is set only when the dialog opens (from a fresh `load()`, Plan 02's re-read-before-confirm rule), after a `"stale"` refusal, or after "Count again" in the failed state. Row refreshes (`onRefresh`, the post-delete `load()`) only touch `rows`.
   - `busy` (a ref) and `phase !== "review"` both guard `runDelete`, so a double click sends one request.
   - Success is `outcome.ok === true`, which `storageMath` grants only for a typed result with `ok: true`, no errors, `remaining === 0` and Plan 02's `resolveClearAudioOutcome` returning `"cleared"` for the audio part (`failed === 0`, `readable`, and nothing left; for history the `audio` part). The post-delete recount never decides it.
   - The reset dialog never closes itself (unlike `ConfirmDialog`, which calls `onOpenChange(false)` after `onConfirm`, `src/components/ui/dialog.tsx:138-141`), so failures stay visible.

```js
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");

} = require("../lib/rendererTestHarness");

const read = (file) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, "../..", file), "utf8");
function findAll(node, predicate, out = []) {
  if (Array.isArray(node)) {
    node.forEach((child) => findAll(child, predicate, out));
    return out;
  }
  if (!node || typeof node !== "object") return out;
  if (predicate(node)) out.push(node);
  findAll(node.props?.children, predicate, out);
  return out;
}

test("[baseline guard] the 70% close icon keeps 3:1 on every title-bar surface, in both themes", async () => {
  const { contrastRatio } = await import("../../src/utils/contrast.ts");
  const { resolveTokens } = require("../helpers/harness/cssTokens");
  const { light, dark } = resolveTokens(read("src/index.css"));
  const channels = (hex) => [1, 3, 5].map((i) => parseInt(hex.slice(i, i + 2), 16));
  const over = (fg, bg, alpha) =>
    "#" +
    channels(fg)
      .map((c, i) => Math.round(alpha * c + (1 - alpha) * channels(bg)[i]).toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
      .join("");
  const cases = [
    [light, ["--color-background", "--color-muted"]], // resting bar, hover fill
    [dark, ["--color-surface-1", "--color-surface-raised"]],
  ];
  for (const [theme, surfaces] of cases) {
    for (const surface of surfaces) {
      const icon = over(theme["--color-muted-foreground"], theme[surface], 0.7);
      assert.ok(contrastRatio(icon, theme[surface]) >= 3, `${surface}: ${icon}`);
    }
  }
});
```

Create `test/components/settingsRehoming.test.js`. These are **source guards**: `SettingsPage.tsx` is too large to mount in a unit test, so they pin where each block lives. The behaviour that matters (selection, sticky title, close) is covered by the mounted test above.

```js
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const test = require("node:test");

const root = path.join(__dirname, "../..");
const src = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, "src/components/SettingsPage.tsx"), "utf8");
const between = (start, end) => {
  const a = src.indexOf(start);
  assert.ok(a >= 0, `${start} exists`);
  const b = src.indexOf(end, a + start.length);
  assert.ok(b > a, `${end} follows ${start}`);
  return src.slice(a, b);
};

test("[source guard, change-driving] dictation controls live in Dictation, not Preferences", () => {
  const general = between('case "general":', 'case "hotkeys":');
  // Task 10 inserts case "routing": directly after the hotkeys case.
  const dictation = between('case "hotkeys":', 'case "routing":');
  for (const marker of [
    "<MicrophoneSettings",
    "keepTranscriptionInClipboard",
    "autoLearnCorrections",
    "settings.language.transcriptionLabel",
    "chineseScriptPreference",
    "ydotoolStatus",
  ]) {
    assert.ok(!general.includes(marker), `${marker} left Preferences`);
    assert.ok(dictation.includes(marker), `${marker} is in Dictation`);
  }
  assert.ok(general.includes("settings.language.uiLabel"), "interface language stays in Preferences");
  assert.ok(general.includes("UI_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS"), "interface language options stay in Preferences");
});

test("[source guard, change-driving] settings primitives are imported, not re-declared (SET-Q18)", () => {
  assert.doesNotMatch(src, /^function SettingsPanel\(/m);
  assert.doesNotMatch(src, /^function SettingsPanelRow\(/m);
  assert.doesNotMatch(src, /^function SectionHeader\(/m);
  for (const name of ["SectionHeader", "SettingsPanel", "SettingsPanelRow"]) {
    assert.match(
      src,
      new RegExp(`import \\{[^}]*\\b${name}\\b[^}]*\\} from "\\.\\/ui\\/SettingsSection"`, "s"),
      `${name} is imported from ./ui/SettingsSection`
    );
  }
});
```

   ```tsx
   import React from "react";

   export interface SidebarItem<T extends string> {
     id: T;
     label: string;
     icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
     group?: string;
     description?: string;
     badge?: string;
     badgeVariant?: "default" | "new" | "update" | "dot";
     shortcut?: string;
   }

   interface SettingsNavProps<T extends string> {
     items: SidebarItem<T>[];
     activeSection: T;
     onSectionChange: (section: T) => void;
     isCompact: boolean;
     ariaLabel: string;
   }

   function renderBadge<T extends string>(item: SidebarItem<T>) {
     if (!item.badge && item.badgeVariant !== "dot") return null;

     if (item.badgeVariant === "dot") {
       return <span className="ms-auto h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary shrink-0" />;
     }

     return (
       <span
         className={`ms-auto text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider px-1.5 py-px rounded-sm shrink-0 ${
           item.badgeVariant === "new"
             ? "bg-primary/10 text-primary dark:bg-primary/15"
             : item.badgeVariant === "update"
               ? "bg-foreground/10 text-foreground"
               : "bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
         }`}
       >
         {item.badge}
       </span>
     );
   }

   export function SettingsNav<T extends string>({
     items,
     activeSection,
     onSectionChange,
     isCompact,
     ariaLabel,
   }: SettingsNavProps<T>) {
     // Group consecutive items by their group property.
     const groupedItems = React.useMemo(() => {
       const groups: { label: string | null; items: SidebarItem<T>[] }[] = [];
       let currentGroup: string | null | undefined = undefined;
       for (const item of items) {
         const group = item.group ?? null;
         if (group !== currentGroup) {
           groups.push({ label: group, items: [item] });
           currentGroup = group;
         } else {
           groups[groups.length - 1].items.push(item);
         }
       }
       return groups;
     }, [items]);

     return (
       <nav
         aria-label={ariaLabel}
         className={`relative flex-1 pb-2 overflow-y-auto ${isCompact ? "px-1.5 pt-4" : "px-2 pt-3"}`}
       >
         {groupedItems.map((group, groupIndex) => (
           <div key={groupIndex} className={groupIndex > 0 ? "mt-4" : ""}>
             {!isCompact && group.label && (
               <div className="px-2 pb-1">
                 <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground/70 dark:text-muted-foreground/65">
                   {group.label}
                 </span>
               </div>
             )}
             <div className="space-y-px">
               {group.items.map((item) => {
                 const Icon = item.icon;
                 const isActive = activeSection === item.id;

                 return (
                   <button
                     key={item.id}
                     type="button"
                     data-section-id={item.id}
                     aria-current={isActive ? "page" : undefined}
                     aria-label={isCompact ? item.label : undefined}
                     onClick={() => onSectionChange(item.id)}
                     title={
                       item.description
                         ? `${item.label} — ${item.description}`
                         : isCompact
                           ? item.label
                           : undefined
                     }
                     className={`group relative w-full flex items-center text-start text-xs rounded-md transition-colors duration-[var(--motion-fast)] outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-inset ${
                       isCompact ? "justify-center px-0 py-2" : "gap-2 px-2 py-1.5"
                     } ${
                       isActive
                         ? "text-foreground bg-muted dark:bg-surface-raised"
                         : "text-muted-foreground dark:text-foreground/75 hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/50 dark:hover:bg-surface-2"
                     }`}
                   >
                     <Icon
                       className={`h-4 w-4 shrink-0 transition-colors duration-[var(--motion-fast)] ${
                         isActive
                           ? "text-primary"
                           : "text-muted-foreground/70 dark:text-foreground/55 group-hover:text-foreground/80"
                       }`}
                     />
                     {!isCompact && (
                       <>
                         <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                           <span
                             className={`block truncate leading-tight ${isActive ? "font-medium" : "font-normal"}`}
                           >
                             {item.label}
                           </span>
                           {item.description && (
                             <span className="block truncate text-[11px] leading-tight text-muted-foreground">
                               {item.description}
                             </span>
                           )}
                         </span>
                         {renderBadge(item)}
                         {item.shortcut && !item.badge && (
                           <kbd dir="ltr" className="ms-auto text-xs text-muted-foreground/70 font-mono shrink-0">
                             {item.shortcut}
                           </kbd>
                         )}
                       </>
                     )}
                     {isCompact && item.badgeVariant === "dot" && (
                       <span className="absolute top-1.5 end-1.5 h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary" />
                     )}
                   </button>
                 );
               })}
             </div>
           </div>
         ))}
       </nav>
     );
   }
   ```

   The description is `text-muted-foreground` at full strength (no `/70`), 11px, one line (`truncate`); the `title` repeats the full text for truncated labels in long locales.

### Task 16: Settings search with live controls (SET-R2 A part 2)

Closes M3 for the search surfaces (the flash duration is a documented token, cleanup waits for `animationend`, spacing is logical) and M5 (each test is labelled; the shortcut, Esc, keyboard and landing logic are tested as mounted hooks or pure functions, not only as static markup). It also closes a gap left open by "search with live controls": a toggle in the results must not become a back door around the route planner (rule 3 in Appendix A).

Settings gets a search field at the top of the sidebar. Cmd+F or Ctrl+F focuses it, and so does `/` when the user is not typing in another field.
- Results replace the content pane, grouped by section, each with a breadcrumb ("Language Models › Voice Assistant").
- Results carry a **live control** only where flipping it in place cannot change who receives the user's data: appearance, sounds, notifications, startup, clipboard and retention toggles, and the theme select. **Anything that is a route input navigates instead**: the cleanup, assistant, translation, screen-context and speaker-label switches and every provider, model or endpoint are `link` entries, and the 11 task entries are `route` entries that show where the task runs right now (read-only chips) and jump to the Patchbay row. Turning a route on or off in place would skip the planner's staging and the Apply bar.
- Up/Down move the active result, Enter jumps to the setting and flashes it once, and Esc clears the query (and only the next Esc closes Settings).
- No results reads: "No setting matches "xyz". Try "mic", "retention" or "cloud"."

The settings page stays mounted (hidden) while search results show, so downloads and IPC listeners survive.

**What changed from the first draft of this task.**
- Labels and descriptions are the **existing translated strings the rows already show** (for example `settingsPage.general.microphone.title`), not a second copy under `settingsSearch.items.*`. Search then shows the same words as the page, in all 11 locales, and a test fails if the file carrying an anchor does not render the entry's label key. Only two descriptions are new.
- The "Notifications" result bound to `notificationsEnabled`, while the page's row is "Disable all notifications" (`checked={!notificationsEnabled}`): the live switch would have shown the opposite state. The registry now mirrors the page, including `disabled` while notifications are off.
- Esc: v1 set `data-escape-active` but nothing read it. Task 10 now ships the reader (`src/components/ui/escapeClaim.ts`, wired into `SidebarModal`'s `onEscapeKeyDown`: while focus is inside an element marked `data-escape-active="true"` the dialog stays open). This task marks the search field and the results pane with that attribute while a query exists, and their Escape handler clears it. It adds no second mechanism.
- The flash animates a registered custom property (DESIGN.md "animate only … registered properties"), is timed by `--motion-flash` and ends on `animationend`; there is no JS timer and no literal `1400`.
- The landing waits for the anchor to mount (up to 24 frames) instead of one `requestAnimationFrame`, because a jump across sections or sub-tabs mounts the target after the state update.
- A jump to the sub-tab that is already the pending request (the user switched tabs by hand since) still switches tabs: `SettingsModal` clears the request for one commit and re-issues it (Step 3.8), which Task 4's `handleNavigateToPath` alone does not.
