```js
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const test = require("node:test");
const { installBrowserGlobals, createRendererServer } = require("../lib/rendererTestHarness");

const root = path.join(__dirname, "../..");
const EN = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, "src/locales/en/translation.json"), "utf8"));
const lookup = (json) => (key) =>
  key.split(".").reduce((o, k) => (o && typeof o === "object" ? o[k] : undefined), json) ?? key;

function walk(dir, out = []) {
  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const full = path.join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isDirectory()) walk(full, out);
    else if (/\.tsx?$/.test(e.name)) out.push({ file: path.relative(root, full), text: fs.readFileSync(full, "utf8") });
  }
  return out;
}

const SECTION_OF = {
  general: "general",
  hotkeys: "hotkeys",
  routing: "routing",
  stt: "speechToText",
  llms: "llms",
  privacyData: "privacyData",
  system: "system",
};

test("settings registry", async (t) => {
  installBrowserGlobals(t);
  const vite = await createRendererServer(t, { cachePrefix: "loqui-settings-registry-test-" });
  const registry = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/components/settings/settingsRegistry.ts");
  const { parseSettingsPath } = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/lib/settingsPaths.ts");
  const { ROUTE_IDS } = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/lib/routeGraph.ts");
  const { useSettingsStore } = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/stores/settingsStore.ts");
  const en = lookup(EN);
  const ids = (groups) => groups.flatMap((g) => g.entries.map((e) => e.id));
  const entries = registry.SETTINGS_REGISTRY;

  await t.test("change-driving: every entry is unique, opens a real place and is labelled in English", () => {
    const seen = new Set();
    const anchors = new Set();
    for (const e of entries) {
      assert.ok(!seen.has(e.id), `duplicate id ${e.id}`);
      seen.add(e.id);
      const anchor = registry.anchorIdFor(e);
      assert.ok(!anchors.has(anchor), `duplicate anchor ${anchor}`);
      anchors.add(anchor);
      const [head, sub] = e.path.split("/");
      const loc = parseSettingsPath(e.path);
      assert.equal(loc.section, SECTION_OF[head], `${e.id}: ${e.path} opens ${SECTION_OF[head]}`);
      assert.equal(loc.subTab, sub, `${e.id}: sub-tab ${sub ?? "(none)"} is a real tab`);
      assert.notEqual(en(e.labelKey), e.labelKey, `${e.labelKey} exists`);
      assert.notEqual(en(e.descriptionKey), e.descriptionKey, `${e.descriptionKey} exists`);
      const subKey = registry.subTabLabelKey(e);
      if (subKey) assert.notEqual(en(subKey), subKey, `${subKey} exists`);
    }
  });

  await t.test("change-driving: the 11 task entries navigate to their Patchbay rows", () => {
    const routes = entries.filter((e) => e.control.kind === "route");
    assert.deepEqual(routes.map((e) => e.control.routeId), [...ROUTE_IDS]);
    for (const e of routes) {
      assert.equal(e.id, `route:${e.control.routeId}`);
      assert.equal(e.path, "routing");
      assert.equal(registry.anchorIdFor(e), `route-${e.control.routeId}`);
      assert.equal(typeof e.control.set, "undefined", "a route entry has no setter");
    }
  });

  await t.test("change-driving: live controls read real store values", () => {
    const state = useSettingsStore.getState();
    for (const e of entries) {
      if (e.control.kind === "toggle") assert.equal(typeof e.control.get(state), "boolean", e.id);
      if (e.control.kind === "select") {
        assert.ok(e.control.options.map((o) => o.value).includes(e.control.get(state)), e.id);
      }
    }
  });

  await t.test("change-driving: the only live writes are non-route settings (planner rule)", () => {
    const writes = [];
    const recorder = new Proxy({}, { get: (_target, name) => () => writes.push(String(name)) });
    for (const e of entries) {
      if (e.control.kind === "toggle") e.control.set(recorder, true);
      if (e.control.kind === "select") e.control.set(recorder, e.control.options[0].value);
    }
    assert.deepEqual([...new Set(writes)].sort(), [
      "setAudioCuesEnabled",
      "setAutoPasteEnabled",
      "setDataRetentionEnabled",
      "setFloatingIconAutoHide",
      "setKeepTranscriptionInClipboard",
      "setNotificationsEnabled",
      "setNotifyCalendarReminders",
      "setNotifyMeetingDetection",
      "setSaveDiscardedTranscriptions",
      "setStartMinimized",
      "setTheme",
    ]);
    // The enable switches feed the route snapshot (enabled.cleanup / voiceAssistant / translation /
    // speakerId / screenContext): they navigate, so enabling a route to a provider stays staged.
    // None of the pinned setters above writes a provider/model/endpoint/mode field, a route switch
    // (useCleanupModel, useDictationTranslation, useDictationAgent, voiceAgentScreenContext,
    // useDictationAgentVisionModel), cortiEnvironment/cortiTenant or providerSearch:<scope>.
    for (const id of ["cleanupEnabled", "assistantEnabled", "screenContext", "translationEnabled", "speakerLabels", "supportModels"]) {
      assert.equal(entries.find((e) => e.id === id).control.kind, "link", id);
    }
  });

  await t.test("[source guard] the registry and results never write provider, model, URL, mode, route-switch, Corti or web-search settings", () => {
    // Owner rule (owner rule 3, I1 follow-up): these keys change only through the planner
    // (Task 7 requestRouteChange/requestRoutePatch, Task 8 useRouteChange). Search offers no live
    // control for them, so it calls none of those entry points either.
    const forbidden =
      /\.set(?:\w*(?:Provider|Model|Url|Mode)\w*|UseCleanupModel|UseDictationAgent\w*|UseDictationTranslation|SpeakerDiarizationEnabled|VoiceAgentScreenContext|CortiEnvironment|CortiTenant)\b|applyRoutePatch|requestRoute(?:Change|Patch)|\brequestPatch\b|useRouteChange|ProviderSearchPreference|providerSearch:|personalWebSearch|updateTranscriptionSettings|updateCleanupSettings/;
    for (const file of ["settingsRegistry.ts", "SettingsSearchResults.tsx"]) {
      const text = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, "src/components/settings", file), "utf8");
      assert.doesNotMatch(text, forbidden, file);
    }
  });

  await t.test("change-driving: search matches label, description and keywords, AND-ing tokens, label hits first", () => {
    assert.equal(ids(registry.searchSettings("mic", en))[0], "microphone");
    const retention = registry.searchSettings("retention", en);
    assert.deepEqual(retention.map((g) => g.section), ["privacyData"]);
    for (const id of ["audioRetention", "transcriptRetention", "dataRetention"]) assert.ok(ids(retention).includes(id), id);
    // Descriptions are real page copy, so "audio retention" also reaches rows that merely mention audio;
    // the row whose label has both words ranks first.
    assert.equal(ids(registry.searchSettings("audio retention", en))[0], "audioRetention");
    assert.ok(ids(registry.searchSettings("cloud", en)).some((id) => id.startsWith("route:")));
    assert.deepEqual(registry.searchSettings("xyzzy", en), []);
    assert.deepEqual(registry.searchSettings("   ", en), []);
  });

  await t.test("change-driving: search works in the user's language and ignores accents", () => {
    const de = (key) => (key === "settingsPage.general.microphone.title" ? "Mikrofon" : en(key));
    assert.equal(ids(registry.searchSettings("mikro", de))[0], "microphone");
    assert.equal(registry.normalizeForSearch("Résumé"), "resume");
  });

  await t.test("change-driving: every non-route entry has an anchor in a file that renders its label", () => {
    const sources = walk(path.join(root, "src"));
    const hits = (id) =>
      sources.filter((s) => s.text.includes(`data-setting-id="${id}"`) || s.text.includes(`settingId="${id}"`));
    for (const e of entries.filter((x) => x.control.kind !== "route")) {
      const found = hits(e.id);
      assert.ok(found.length > 0, `anchor for ${e.id}`);
      assert.ok(
        found.some((s) => s.text.includes(e.labelKey)),
        `${e.id}: the file carrying the anchor (${found.map((s) => s.file).join(", ")}) must render "${e.labelKey}"`
      );
    }
    assert.ok(
      sources.some((s) => s.text.includes("data-setting-id={`route-${route.id}`}")),
      "Patchbay rows are route anchors"
    );
  });
});

```js
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const test = require("node:test");
const { readTokens } = require("../helpers/harness/cssTokens");

const root = path.join(__dirname, "../..");
const read = (file) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, file), "utf8");
const flash = () => import("../../src/components/settings/settingFlash.ts");

function fakeElement(extra = {}) {
  const listeners = new Map();
  const el = {
    dataset: {},
    scrolled: [],
    offsetReads: 0,
    get offsetWidth() {
      el.offsetReads += 1;
      return 0;
    },
    scrollIntoView(options) {
      el.scrolled.push(options);
    },
    addEventListener(type, listener) {
      listeners.set(type, listener);
    },
    removeEventListener(type, listener) {
      if (listeners.get(type) === listener) listeners.delete(type);
    },
    emit(type, event) {
      listeners.get(type)?.(event);
    },
    listening: () => listeners.size > 0,
    ...extra,
  };
  return el;
}
function frames() {
  const queue = [];
  return {
    raf: (cb) => queue.push(cb),
    caf: (handle) => {
      queue[handle - 1] = null;
    },
    step: () => {
      const cb = queue.shift();
      cb?.();
    },
    pending: () => queue.filter(Boolean).length,
  };
}
const rootOf = (find) => ({ querySelector: find });

test("the landing waits for the anchor to mount, scrolls to it and flashes once", async () => {
  const { landOnSetting } = await flash();
  const el = fakeElement();
  const f = frames();
  let present = false;
  const done = [];
  landOnSetting("route-chat", {
    root: rootOf((selector) => (present && selector === '[data-setting-id="route-chat"]' ? el : null)),
    raf: f.raf,
    caf: f.caf,
    onDone: (landed) => done.push(landed),
  });
  f.step();
  f.step();
  assert.equal(el.scrolled.length, 0, "not mounted yet");
  present = true;
  f.step();
  assert.deepEqual(el.scrolled, [{ block: "center" }]);
  assert.equal(el.dataset.flash, "true");
  assert.deepEqual(done, [true]);
});

test("the landing gives up quietly when the anchor never mounts", async () => {
  const { landOnSetting } = await flash();
  const f = frames();
  const done = [];
  landOnSetting("nope", { root: rootOf(() => null), raf: f.raf, caf: f.caf, maxFrames: 3, onDone: (l) => done.push(l) });
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) f.step();
  assert.deepEqual(done, [false]);
});

test("cancelling before the anchor mounts cancels the pending frame", async () => {
  const { landOnSetting } = await flash();
  const el = fakeElement();
  const f = frames();
  const cancel = landOnSetting("x", { root: rootOf(() => el), raf: f.raf, caf: f.caf });
  cancel();
  f.step();
  assert.equal(el.scrolled.length, 0);
  assert.equal(el.dataset.flash, undefined);
});

test("the flash ends on its own animationend, not on a timer, and ignores other animations", async () => {
  const { flashSetting } = await flash();
  const el = fakeElement();
  flashSetting(el);
  assert.equal(el.dataset.flash, "true");
  el.emit("animationend", { target: {}, animationName: "settings-flash" });
  el.emit("animationend", { target: el, animationName: "spin" });
  assert.equal(el.dataset.flash, "true", "a child's or another animation's end does not clear it");
  el.emit("animationend", { target: el, animationName: "settings-flash" });
  assert.equal(el.dataset.flash, undefined);
  assert.equal(el.listening(), false, "the listener is removed");
});

test("flashing a row that is already flashing restarts the animation", async () => {
  const { flashSetting } = await flash();
  const el = fakeElement();
  flashSetting(el);
  const before = el.offsetReads;
  flashSetting(el);
  assert.equal(el.offsetReads, before + 1, "a reflow is forced between removing and re-adding the flag");
  assert.equal(el.dataset.flash, "true");
});

test("an element with no running animation is not left outlined", async () => {
  const { flashSetting } = await flash();
  const el = fakeElement({ getAnimations: () => [] });
  flashSetting(el);
  assert.equal(el.dataset.flash, undefined);
});

test("[source guard] no JS timer and no literal duration", () => {
  for (const file of ["settingFlash.ts", "useSettingsSearch.ts"]) {
    const text = read(`src/components/settings/${file}`);
    assert.doesNotMatch(text, /setTimeout|setInterval/, file);
    assert.doesNotMatch(text, /\b1400\b|1\.4\s*s\b/, file);
  }
});

test("the flash duration is a documented token used by the animation", () => {
  const css = read("src/index.css");
  assert.equal(readTokens(css, ":root")["--motion-flash"], "1400ms");
  assert.equal((css.match(/--motion-flash\s*:/g) ?? []).length, 1, "defined once");
  const rule = css.match(/\[data-setting-id\]\[data-flash="true"\]\s*\{([^}]*)\}/);
  assert.ok(rule, "the flash rule exists");
  assert.match(rule[1], /animation:\s*settings-flash var\(--motion-flash\)/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(rule[1], /\b1\.4s\b|\b1400ms\b/);
  assert.match(css, /@property --settings-flash\s*\{[^}]*syntax:\s*"<number>"/, "animated through a registered property");
  assert.match(css, /@keyframes settings-flash\s*\{[^}]*--settings-flash:\s*1/);
});

test("reduced motion keeps the outline cue and drops the background flash", () => {
  const css = read("src/index.css");
  const blocks = [...css.matchAll(/@media \(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce\)\s*\{/g)].map((m) => {
    let depth = 1;
    let i = m.index + m[0].length;
    for (; i < css.length && depth > 0; i++) depth += css[i] === "{" ? 1 : css[i] === "}" ? -1 : 0;
    return css.slice(m.index, i);
  });
  const block = blocks.find((b) => b.includes('[data-setting-id][data-flash="true"]'));
  assert.ok(block, "the flash is handled inside a reduced-motion block");
  assert.match(block, /background-color:\s*transparent/);
  // The global policy sets animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; this rule must outrank it so the
  // outline fade (and animationend) still run for the documented duration.
  assert.match(block, /animation-duration:\s*var\(--motion-flash\)\s*!important/);
});

// change-driving: src/components/settings/useSettingsSearch.ts does not exist yet (mounted, personalWorkspace pattern).
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const test = require("node:test");
const React = require("react");
const { createRoot } = require("react-dom/client");
const {
  createRendererServer,
  installBrowserGlobals,
  installHookDom,
} = require("../lib/rendererTestHarness");
const { withI18nMock } = require("../lib/i18nTestMock");

test("search state, shortcuts, jump and Esc (mounted)", async (t) => {

  t.after(async () => {
    if (root) await React.act(async () => root.unmount());
  });
  installBrowserGlobals(t);
  const container = installHookDom(t);
  const listeners = [];
  globalThis.document.addEventListener = (type, fn) => listeners.push([type, fn]);
  globalThis.document.removeEventListener = (type, fn) => {
    const i = listeners.findIndex(([ty, f]) => ty === type && f === fn);
    if (i >= 0) listeners.splice(i, 1);
  };
  globalThis.document.querySelector = () => null;
  const english = '(k) => ({ "settingsPage.general.microphone.title": "Microphone" })[k] ?? k';
  const vite = await createRendererServer(

    withI18nMock({ cachePrefix: "loqui-use-settings-search-test-" }, { t: english })
  );
  const { useSettingsSearch } = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/components/settings/useSettingsSearch.ts");

  const navigated = [];
  const landed = [];
  const land = (anchorId) => {
    landed.push(anchorId);
    return () => {};
  };
  let hook;
  function Probe() {
    hook = useSettingsSearch({ open: true, navigateToPath: (p) => navigated.push(p), land });
    return null;
  }
  root = createRoot(container);
  await React.act(async () => root.render(React.createElement(Probe)));
  const press = (key, init = {}) => ({ key, preventDefault() { this.prevented = true; }, ...init });

  await t.test("typing sets the query and finds the microphone first", async () => {
    assert.equal(hook.query, "");
    assert.deepEqual(hook.groups, []);
    await React.act(async () => hook.setQuery("mic"));
    assert.equal(hook.query, "mic");
    assert.equal(hook.activeId, "microphone");
  });

  await t.test("arrow keys move the active result and Enter jumps", async () => {
    await React.act(async () => hook.setQuery("retention"));
    const first = hook.activeId;
    await React.act(async () => hook.onSearchKeyDown(press("ArrowDown")));
    assert.notEqual(hook.activeId, first);
    await React.act(async () => hook.onSearchKeyDown(press("ArrowUp")));
    assert.equal(hook.activeId, first);
    const event = press("Enter");
    await React.act(async () => hook.onSearchKeyDown(event));
    assert.equal(event.prevented, true);
    assert.equal(hook.query, "", "jumping clears the query so the page shows");
    assert.equal(navigated.at(-1), "privacyData");
    assert.equal(landed.at(-1), first, "the landing targets the entry's anchor");
  });

  await t.test("a route result navigates to Routing and lands on its Patchbay row", async () => {
    await React.act(async () => hook.setQuery("cloud"));
    const entry = hook.groups.flatMap((g) => g.entries).find((e) => e.id.startsWith("route:"));
    assert.ok(entry, "a route entry matches 'cloud'");
    await React.act(async () => hook.jump(entry));
    assert.equal(navigated.at(-1), "routing");
    assert.equal(landed.at(-1), `route-${entry.control.routeId}`);
  });

  await t.test("Cmd+F focuses and selects the field", async () => {
    const calls = [];
    hook.searchRef.current = { focus: () => calls.push("focus"), select: () => calls.push("select") };
    const keydown = listeners.filter(([type]) => type === "keydown").at(-1)[1];
    const event = press("f", { metaKey: true, ctrlKey: false, altKey: false, shiftKey: false, target: null });
    keydown(event);
    assert.deepEqual(calls, ["focus", "select"]);
    assert.equal(event.prevented, true);
  });

  await t.test("Esc clears a query first and reports it consumed; with no query it lets the dialog close", async () => {
    await React.act(async () => hook.setQuery("mic"));
    let consumed;
    await React.act(async () => {
      consumed = hook.consumeEscape();
    });
    assert.equal(consumed, true);
    assert.equal(hook.query, "");
    assert.equal(hook.consumeEscape(), false);
  });

  await t.test("clear() empties the query (a section change calls it)", async () => {
    await React.act(async () => hook.setQuery("x"));
    await React.act(async () => hook.clear());
    assert.equal(hook.query, "");
  });
});

  let render = () => null;
  let tree;
  let mounts = 0;
  function Probe() {
    tree = render();
    return null;
  }
  root = createRoot(container);
  const show = (fn) => {
    render = fn;
    return React.act(async () => root.render(React.createElement(Probe, { key: ++mounts })));
  };
  const key = (name) => ({ key: name, stopped: false, stopPropagation() { this.stopped = true; } });
  const inputOf = (node) => {
    if (Array.isArray(node)) return node.map(inputOf).find(Boolean);
    if (!node || typeof node !== "object") return null;
    return node.type === "input" ? node : inputOf(node.props?.children);
  };

  let cleared = 0;
  const onEscape = () => {
    cleared += 1;
    return true;
  };
  await show(() => SettingsSearchResultsView({ query: "x", groups: [], activeId: null, routes: new Map(), onJump() {}, onEscape }));
  const esc = key("Escape");
  tree.props.onKeyDown(esc);
  assert.equal(cleared, 1);
  assert.equal(esc.stopped, true, "a claimed Escape does not travel further");
  const other = key("a");
  tree.props.onKeyDown(other);
  assert.equal(cleared, 1);
  assert.equal(other.stopped, false);

  const passed = [];
  await show(() =>
    SettingsSearchField.render({ value: "mic", onChange() {}, onKeyDown: (e) => passed.push(e.key), onEscape }, null)
  );
  const claimed = key("Escape");
  inputOf(tree).props.onKeyDown(claimed);
  assert.equal(cleared, 2);
  assert.equal(claimed.stopped, true);
  assert.deepEqual(passed, [], "the handler consumed it");
  inputOf(tree).props.onKeyDown(key("ArrowDown"));
  assert.deepEqual(passed, ["ArrowDown"], "other keys reach the arrow/Enter handler");

  await show(() =>
    SettingsSearchField.render({ value: "", onChange() {}, onKeyDown: (e) => passed.push(e.key), onEscape: () => false }, null)
  );
  const unclaimed = key("Escape");
  inputOf(tree).props.onKeyDown(unclaimed);
  assert.equal(unclaimed.stopped, false, "with no query Escape belongs to the dialog");
});

test("live controls write through the real store, mirroring the page's rows (mounted)", async (t) => {
  let root;
  t.after(async () => {
    if (root) await React.act(async () => root.unmount());
  });
  installBrowserGlobals(t);
  const container = installHookDom(t);
  const vite = await createRendererServer(t, withI18nMock({ cachePrefix: "loqui-live-controls-test-" }));
  const { LiveToggle, LiveSelect } = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/components/settings/SettingsSearchResults.tsx");
  const { SETTINGS_REGISTRY } = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/components/settings/settingsRegistry.ts");
  const { useSettingsStore } = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/stores/settingsStore.ts");
  const entry = (id) => SETTINGS_REGISTRY.find((e) => e.id === id);
  const store = () => useSettingsStore.getState();
  const write = (fn) => React.act(async () => fn(store()));

  let render = () => null;
  let tree;
  let mounts = 0;
  function Probe() {
    tree = render();
    return null;
  }
  root = createRoot(container);
  const show = (fn) => {
    render = fn;
    return React.act(async () => root.render(React.createElement(Probe, { key: ++mounts })));
  };
  const toggle = (id) => () => LiveToggle({ entry: entry(id), control: entry(id).control });

  await t.test("a plain toggle flips the store", async () => {
    await write((s) => s.setAudioCuesEnabled(false));
    await show(toggle("audioCues"));

  await t.test("the notifications result mirrors 'Disable all notifications' (inverted)", async () => {
    await write((s) => s.setNotificationsEnabled(true));
    await show(toggle("notifications"));
    assert.equal(tree.props.checked, false, "notifications are on, so 'disable all' is off");
    await React.act(async () => tree.props.onChange(true));
    assert.equal(store().notificationsEnabled, false);
  });

  await t.test("dependent toggles are disabled while notifications are off", async () => {
    await write((s) => s.setNotificationsEnabled(false));
    await show(toggle("meetingDetection"));
    assert.equal(tree.props.disabled, true);
    await write((s) => s.setNotificationsEnabled(true));
    await show(toggle("meetingDetection"));
    assert.equal(tree.props.disabled, false);
  });

  await t.test("saving discarded dictations is disabled when history or audio retention is off", async () => {
    await write((s) => {
      s.setDataRetentionEnabled(true);
      s.setAudioRetentionDays(0);
    });
    await show(toggle("saveDiscarded"));
    assert.equal(tree.props.disabled, true);
  });

  await t.test("the theme select writes the theme", async () => {
    await write((s) => s.setTheme("light"));
    await show(() => LiveSelect({ entry: entry("theme"), control: entry("theme").control }));
    assert.equal(tree.props.value, "light");
    await React.act(async () => tree.props.onChange({ target: { value: "dark" } }));
    assert.equal(store().theme, "dark");
  });
});

   ```ts
   // settingsSearchKeys.ts: keyboard rules for Settings search (SET-R2 A), pure so they are unit-tested.
   export interface KeyLike {
     key: string;
     metaKey: boolean;
     ctrlKey: boolean;
     altKey: boolean;
     shiftKey: boolean;
   }

   export function isSearchShortcut(e: KeyLike, ctx: { typing: boolean; capturing: boolean }): boolean {
     if (ctx.capturing) return false;
     if (e.key.toLowerCase() === "f") return (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && !e.altKey && !e.shiftKey;
     return e.key === "/" && !ctx.typing && !e.metaKey && !e.ctrlKey && !e.altKey;
   }

   const TYPING = "input, textarea, select, [contenteditable='true'], [role='combobox']";

   export function isTypingTarget(target: unknown): boolean {
     const el = target as { closest?: (selector: string) => unknown } | null;
     return !!el?.closest?.(TYPING);
   }

   export function stepActiveIndex(index: number, count: number, key: string): number {
     if (count <= 0) return 0;
     if (key === "ArrowDown") return Math.min(index + 1, count - 1);
     if (key === "ArrowUp") return Math.max(index - 1, 0);
     return Math.min(Math.max(index, 0), count - 1);
   }

2. **`src/components/settings/settingFlash.ts`:**

   ```ts
   // The landing cue for a searched setting (SET-R2 A). The CSS animation is timed by --motion-flash;
   // this module only sets data-flash and removes it when that animation ends.
   export const FLASH_ANIMATION = "settings-flash";

   export function flashSetting(el: HTMLElement): () => void {
     const clear = () => {
       delete el.dataset.flash;
       el.removeEventListener("animationend", onEnd);
     };
     const onEnd = (e: AnimationEvent) => {
       // A descendant's animation also bubbles an animationend; only our own ends the flash.
       if (e.target === el && e.animationName === FLASH_ANIMATION) clear();
     };
     if (el.dataset.flash) {
       // Jumping to a row that is still flashing: force a reflow so the animation restarts.
       delete el.dataset.flash;
       void el.offsetWidth;
     }
     el.dataset.flash = "true";
     el.addEventListener("animationend", onEnd);
     // If the stylesheet did not start an animation, no animationend will ever arrive.
     if (typeof el.getAnimations === "function" && el.getAnimations().length === 0) clear();
     return clear;
   }

   type AnchorRoot = Pick<ParentNode, "querySelector">;

   export function findSettingAnchor(root: AnchorRoot, anchorId: string): HTMLElement | null {
     const escaped =
       typeof CSS !== "undefined" && typeof CSS.escape === "function"
         ? CSS.escape(anchorId)
         : anchorId.replace(/["\\]/g, "\\$&");
     return root.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-setting-id="${escaped}"]`);
   }

   export interface LandOptions {
     raf: (cb: () => void) => number;
     caf: (handle: number) => void;
     root?: AnchorRoot;
     /** Frames to wait for the anchor to mount after a section or sub-tab change. */
     maxFrames?: number;
     onDone?: (landed: boolean) => void;
   }

   /** Scroll to the anchor and flash it once, waiting for it to mount. Returns a cancel function. */
   export function landOnSetting(anchorId: string, options: LandOptions): () => void {
     const { raf, caf, maxFrames = 24, onDone } = options;
     const root = options.root ?? document;
     let frame = 0;
     let handle = 0;
     let cancelled = false;
     const tick = () => {
       if (cancelled) return;
       const el = findSettingAnchor(root, anchorId);
       if (el) {
         el.scrollIntoView({ block: "center" });
         flashSetting(el);
         onDone?.(true);
         return;
       }
       frame += 1;
       if (frame >= maxFrames) {
         onDone?.(false);
         return;
       }
       handle = raf(tick);
     };
     handle = raf(tick);
     return () => {
       cancelled = true;
       caf(handle);
     };
   }
   ```

   Cancelling after the landing leaves the in-flight flash alone: it ends on its own `animationend`.

   export interface SearchGroup {
     section: SettingsSectionType;
     entries: SettingEntry[];
   }

   export function normalizeForSearch(text: string): string {
     return text.normalize("NFKD").replace(/\p{M}/gu, "").toLocaleLowerCase();
   }

   export function anchorIdFor(entry: SettingEntry): string {
     return entry.control.kind === "route" ? `route-${entry.control.routeId}` : entry.id;
   }

   /** The existing tab label for the breadcrumb's second crumb, when the entry sits in a sub-tab. */
   export function subTabLabelKey(entry: SettingEntry): string | null {
     const { section, subTab } = parseSettingsPath(entry.path);
     if (!subTab) return null;
     if (section === "speechToText") return `settingsPage.speechToText.tabs.${subTab}`;
     if (section === "llms") return `settingsPage.llms.tabs.${subTab}`;
     return null;
   }

   export function searchSettings(query: string, translate: (key: string) => string): SearchGroup[] {
     const tokens = normalizeForSearch(query).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
     if (tokens.length === 0) return [];
     const scored = SETTINGS_REGISTRY.map((entry, index) => {
       const section = parseSettingsPath(entry.path).section;
       const label = normalizeForSearch(translate(entry.labelKey));
       const haystack = normalizeForSearch(
         [translate(entry.labelKey), translate(entry.descriptionKey), translate(`settingsModal.sections.${section}.label`), entry.keywords].join(" ")
       );
       if (!tokens.every((tok) => haystack.includes(tok))) return null;
       // Label hits rank above description/keyword hits; registry order breaks ties.
       const score = tokens.filter((tok) => label.includes(tok)).length;
       return { entry, section, index, score };
     }).filter((x): x is NonNullable<typeof x> => x !== null);
     scored.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.index - b.index);
     const groups: SearchGroup[] = [];
     for (const s of scored) {
       const group = groups.find((g) => g.section === s.section);
       if (group) group.entries.push(s.entry);
       else groups.push({ section: s.section, entries: [s.entry] });
     }
     return groups;
   }

4. **`src/components/settings/useSettingsSearch.ts`:**

   ```ts
   import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent as ReactKeyboardEvent, type RefObject } from "react";
   import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
   import { landOnSetting } from "./settingFlash";
   import { isSearchShortcut, isTypingTarget, stepActiveIndex } from "./settingsSearchKeys";
   import { anchorIdFor, searchSettings, type SearchGroup, type SettingEntry } from "./settingsRegistry";

   export interface SettingsSearch {
     query: string;
     setQuery(next: string): void;
     clear(): void;
     groups: SearchGroup[];
     activeId: string | null;
     searchRef: RefObject<HTMLInputElement | null>;
     onSearchKeyDown(e: ReactKeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>): void;
     jump(entry: SettingEntry): void;
     /** Escape handler for the field and the results pane: clears a non-empty query and reports it consumed the key. */
     consumeEscape(): boolean;
   }

   export function useSettingsSearch({
     open,
     navigateToPath,
     land = landOnSetting,
   }: {
     open: boolean;
     navigateToPath: (path: string) => void;
     land?: typeof landOnSetting;
   }): SettingsSearch {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     const [query, setQueryState] = useState("");
     const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0);
     const [pendingAnchor, setPendingAnchor] = useState<string | null>(null);
     const searchRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

     const groups = useMemo(() => searchSettings(query, (key) => t(key)), [query, t]);
     const flat = useMemo(() => groups.flatMap((g) => g.entries), [groups]);
     const activeEntry = flat[Math.min(activeIndex, flat.length - 1)];
     const activeId = activeEntry?.id ?? null;

     const setQuery = useCallback((next: string) => {
       setQueryState(next);
       setActiveIndex(0);
     }, []);
     const clear = useCallback(() => setQuery(""), [setQuery]);

     const jump = useCallback(
       (entry: SettingEntry) => {
         setQuery("");
         navigateToPath(entry.path);
         setPendingAnchor(anchorIdFor(entry));
       },
       [navigateToPath, setQuery]
     );

     // After a jump the target mounts a frame or two later (section and sub-tab switches).
     useEffect(() => {
       if (!pendingAnchor) return;
       return land(pendingAnchor, {
         root: document,
         raf: (cb) => requestAnimationFrame(cb),
         caf: (handle) => cancelAnimationFrame(handle),
         onDone: () => setPendingAnchor(null),
       });
     }, [pendingAnchor, land]);

     useEffect(() => {
       if (!open) return;
       const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
         const capturing = !!document.querySelector("[data-capturing]");
         if (!isSearchShortcut(e, { typing: isTypingTarget(e.target), capturing })) return;
         e.preventDefault();
         searchRef.current?.focus();
         searchRef.current?.select();
       };
       document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
       return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
     }, [open]);

     const onSearchKeyDown = useCallback(
       (e: ReactKeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
         if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "ArrowUp") {
           e.preventDefault();
           setActiveIndex((i) => stepActiveIndex(i, flat.length, e.key));
         } else if (e.key === "Enter" && activeEntry) {
           e.preventDefault();
           jump(activeEntry);
         }
       },
       [flat.length, activeEntry, jump]
     );

     const consumeEscape = useCallback(() => {
       if (!query) return false;
       clear();
       return true;
     }, [query, clear]);

     return { query, setQuery, clear, groups, activeId, searchRef, onSearchKeyDown, jump, consumeEscape };
   }
   ```

   const isMac = () => typeof navigator !== "undefined" && /Mac/.test(navigator.platform);

   export const SettingsSearchField = forwardRef<
     HTMLInputElement,
     {
       value: string;
       onChange: (value: string) => void;

       /** Clears a non-empty query and returns true. While one exists the field claims Escape (Task 10's escapeClaim). */

           className="pointer-events-none absolute start-2.5 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground"

6. **`src/components/settings/SettingsSearchResults.tsx`.** The three live-control components are exported so the mounted test can call them inside a probe. Each toggle or select reads one store value through a selector and writes through the registry's setter at event time:

   ```tsx
   import { useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
   import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
   import { ChevronRight } from "../icons";
   import { useResolvedRoutes, type ResolvedRoute } from "../../lib/routes";
   import type { RouteId } from "../../lib/routeGraph";
   import { useSettingsStore } from "../../stores/settingsStore";
   import { Toggle } from "../ui/toggle";
   import { RouteDestinationChip, RouteStateChip } from "./routing/RouteChips";
   import {
     subTabLabelKey,
     type SearchGroup,
     type SelectControl,
     type SettingEntry,
     type ToggleControl,
   } from "./settingsRegistry";

   export function LiveToggle({ entry, control }: { entry: SettingEntry; control: ToggleControl }) {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     const checked = useSettingsStore((s) => control.get(s));
     const disabled = useSettingsStore((s) => control.disabled?.(s) ?? false);
     return (
       <Toggle
         checked={checked}
         disabled={disabled}
         aria-label={t(entry.labelKey)}
         onChange={(value) => control.set(useSettingsStore.getState(), value)}
       />
     );
   }

   export function LiveSelect({ entry, control }: { entry: SettingEntry; control: SelectControl }) {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     const value = useSettingsStore((s) => control.get(s));
     return (
       <select
         aria-label={t(entry.labelKey)}
         value={value}
         onChange={(e) => control.set(useSettingsStore.getState(), e.target.value)}
         className="h-7 rounded-md border border-border bg-background px-2 text-xs text-foreground focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-ring"
       >
         {control.options.map((option) => (
           <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
             {t(option.labelKey)}
           </option>
         ))}
       </select>
     );
   }

   function LiveControl({ entry, route }: { entry: SettingEntry; route: ResolvedRoute | null }) {
     const control = entry.control;
     if (control.kind === "toggle") return <LiveToggle entry={entry} control={control} />;
     if (control.kind === "select") return <LiveSelect entry={entry} control={control} />;
     if (control.kind === "route" && route) {
       // Read-only: where the task runs right now. Changing it happens in the Patchbay, through the planner.
       return (
         <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
           <RouteDestinationChip route={route} />
           <RouteStateChip state={route.state} />
         </span>
       );
     }
     return <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground rtl:-scale-x-100" aria-hidden="true" />;
   }

   export function SettingsSearchResultsView({
     query,
     groups,
     activeId,
     routes,
     onJump,
     onEscape,
   }: {
     query: string;
     groups: SearchGroup[];
     activeId: string | null;
     routes: ReadonlyMap<RouteId, ResolvedRoute>;
     onJump: (entry: SettingEntry) => void;
     /** Clears the query and returns true. The pane claims Escape while it is showing (Task 10's escapeClaim). */
     onEscape: () => boolean;
   }) {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     const count = groups.reduce((n, g) => n + g.entries.length, 0);
     return (
       <div
         data-escape-active="true"
         onKeyDown={(e) => {
           if (e.key === "Escape" && onEscape()) e.stopPropagation();
         }}
       >
         {count === 0 ? (
           <p role="status" className="py-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
             {t("settingsSearch.none", { query })}
           </p>
         ) : (
           <div className="space-y-4">
             <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
               {t("settingsSearch.count", { count })}
             </p>
             {groups.map((group) => {
               const sectionLabel = t(`settingsModal.sections.${group.section}.label`);
               return (
                 <section key={group.section} className="space-y-1.5">
                   <h3 className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground">{sectionLabel}</h3>
                   {group.entries.map((entry) => {
                     const subKey = subTabLabelKey(entry);
                     const route = entry.control.kind === "route" ? (routes.get(entry.control.routeId) ?? null) : null;
                     return (
                       <div
                         key={entry.id}
                         data-result={entry.id}
                         data-active={activeId === entry.id ? "true" : "false"}
                         className="flex min-h-[52px] items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-2 data-[active=true]:border-ring data-[active=true]:ring-2 data-[active=true]:ring-ring/30"
                       >
                         <button
                           type="button"
                           onClick={() => onJump(entry)}
                           className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-start outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
                         >
                           <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                             {sectionLabel}
                             {subKey && (
                               <>
                                 <ChevronRight className="h-3 w-3 rtl:-scale-x-100" aria-hidden="true" />
                                 {t(subKey)}
                               </>
                             )}
                           </span>
                           <span className="block text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">{t(entry.labelKey)}</span>
                           <span className="block truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t(entry.descriptionKey)}</span>
                         </button>
                         <LiveControl entry={entry} route={route} />
                       </div>
                     );
                   })}
                 </section>
               );
             })}
           </div>
         )}
       </div>
     );
   }

   export function SettingsSearchResults(props: {
     query: string;
     groups: SearchGroup[];
     activeId: string | null;
     onJump: (entry: SettingEntry) => void;
     onEscape: () => boolean;
   }) {
     const routes = useResolvedRoutes();
     const byId = useMemo(() => new Map(routes.map((route) => [route.id, route])), [routes]);
     const { activeId } = props;
     useEffect(() => {
       if (!activeId) return;
       document
         .querySelector(`[data-result="${CSS.escape(activeId)}"]`)
         ?.scrollIntoView?.({ block: "nearest" });
     }, [activeId]);
     return <SettingsSearchResultsView {...props} routes={byId} />;
   }
   ```

10. **CSS.** In `src/index.css`, add the token to the `:root` block, after `--motion-hero: 520ms;`:

    ```css
      /* One-shot landing flash on a searched setting (Settings search). The animation uses this
         duration and JS removes data-flash on animationend, so this is the only place it lives. */
      --motion-flash: 1400ms;
    ```

    Append the flash rule. It animates a registered custom property, which DESIGN.md's Motion rule allows ("only transform, opacity, clip-path, filter and registered properties"); the fill and outline are mixed from that property, so no paint property is animated directly:

    ```css
    /* Settings search landing (SET-R2 A): the row you jumped to flashes once. */
    @property --settings-flash {
      syntax: "<number>";
      inherits: false;
      initial-value: 0;
    }
    [data-setting-id][data-flash="true"] {
      outline: 2px solid
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ring) calc(var(--settings-flash) * 100%), transparent);
      outline-offset: 2px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background-color: color-mix(
        in srgb,
        var(--color-ring) calc(var(--settings-flash) * 16%),
        transparent
      );
      animation: settings-flash var(--motion-flash) var(--motion-ease-std) both;
    }
    @keyframes settings-flash {
      0%,
      40% {
        --settings-flash: 1;
      }
      100% {
        --settings-flash: 0;
      }
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      /* Reduced motion: no background flash, just the outline cue. The global policy sets
         animation-duration to 0.01ms !important on every element; this rule outranks it
         (higher specificity, also !important) so the outline fades over --motion-flash and
         animationend still fires. */
      [data-setting-id][data-flash="true"] {
        background-color: transparent;
        animation-duration: var(--motion-flash) !important;
      }
    }
    ```

const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const test = require("node:test");
const React = require("react");
const { createRoot } = require("react-dom/client");
const { renderToStaticMarkup } = require("react-dom/server");
const {
  createRendererServer,
  installBrowserGlobals,
  installHookDom,
} = require("../lib/rendererTestHarness");
const { withI18nMock } = require("../lib/i18nTestMock");

function findAll(node, predicate, out = []) {
  if (Array.isArray(node)) {
    node.forEach((child) => findAll(child, predicate, out));
    return out;
  }
  if (!node || typeof node !== "object") return out;
  if (predicate(node)) out.push(node);
  findAll(node.props?.children, predicate, out);
  return out;
}
const textOf = (node) =>
  Array.isArray(node)
    ? node.map(textOf).join("")
    : typeof node === "string"
      ? node
      : node && typeof node === "object"
        ? textOf(node.props?.children)
        : "";

test("dictionary actions have visible words and auto-learn is inline", async (t) => {

  const calls = [];

    onExport: () => calls.push("export"),
    onImport: () => calls.push("import"),
    autoLearn: true,
    onAutoLearnChange: (value) => calls.push(`autoLearn:${value}`),
  };

  });

      return null;
    }
    root = createRoot(container);
    await React.act(async () => root.render(React.createElement(Probe)));
    const button = (label) => findAll(tree, (n) => n.type === "button" && textOf(n).includes(label))[0];
    await React.act(async () => button("dictionary.import").props.onClick());
    await React.act(async () => button("dictionary.exportAction").props.onClick());
    await React.act(async () => button("dictionary.clearAll").props.onClick());
    const toggle = findAll(tree, (n) => n.props?.["aria-label"] === "settingsPage.dictionary.autoLearnTitle" && n.props.onChange)[0];
    await React.act(async () => toggle.props.onChange(false));

    // so a bare `transition-*` class bypasses §4's shared motion tokens.
    const source = require("node:fs").readFileSync(
      require("node:path").join(__dirname, "../../src/components/DictionaryHeaderActions.tsx"),
      "utf8"
    );
    const transitions = source.match(/\btransition(?:-[a-z]+)?\b/g) ?? [];
    assert.ok(transitions.length > 0);

    assert.equal(tokened.length, transitions.length, "each transition carries a --motion duration");
    assert.doesNotMatch(source, /\bduration-\d+\b/);

});

Create `test/hooks/useAutoLearnCorrections.test.js`. Settings → Dictation and the Dictionary header each mount the hook; before this, `useLocalStorage` kept per-instance state, so a change in one stayed invisible in the other until remount. Calling the hook twice in one probe stands in for the two mounts:

```js
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const test = require("node:test");
const React = require("react");
const { createRoot } = require("react-dom/client");
const {
  createRendererServer,
  installBrowserGlobals,
  installHookDom,
} = require("../lib/rendererTestHarness");

test("two mounts of the auto-learn switch stay in step and tell main (mounted, change-driving)", async (t) => {
  let root;
  t.after(async () => {
    if (root) await React.act(async () => root.unmount());
  });
  const bus = new EventTarget();
  const toMain = [];
  const { storage } = installBrowserGlobals(t, {
    window: {
      electronAPI: { setAutoLearnEnabled: (enabled) => toMain.push(enabled) },
      addEventListener: bus.addEventListener.bind(bus),
      removeEventListener: bus.removeEventListener.bind(bus),
      dispatchEvent: bus.dispatchEvent.bind(bus),
    },
  });
  const container = installHookDom(t);
  const vite = await createRendererServer(t, { cachePrefix: "loqui-auto-learn-test-" });
  const { useAutoLearnCorrections } = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/hooks/useAutoLearnCorrections.ts");

  let settings;
  let dictionary;
  function Probe() {
    settings = useAutoLearnCorrections();
    dictionary = useAutoLearnCorrections();
    return null;
  }
  root = createRoot(container);
  await React.act(async () => root.render(React.createElement(Probe)));

  assert.deepEqual([settings[0], dictionary[0]], [true, true], "on by default");
  assert.equal(storage.getItem("autoLearnCorrections"), "true", "the default is persisted for direct readers");

  await React.act(async () => dictionary[1](false));
  assert.deepEqual([settings[0], dictionary[0]], [false, false], "the other mount follows");
  assert.equal(storage.getItem("autoLearnCorrections"), "false");
  assert.equal(toMain.at(-1), false, "main is told");

  await React.act(async () => settings[1](true));
  assert.deepEqual([settings[0], dictionary[0]], [true, true]);
  assert.equal(toMain.at(-1), true);
});
```

1. **Q15.** Create `src/components/settings/screenContextCopy.ts`:

   ```ts
   import { providerDisplayLabel } from "../../lib/locality";
   import type { ResolvedRoute } from "../../lib/routes";

   type Translate = (key: string, options?: Record<string, unknown>) => string;

   // SET-Q15: name where the screenshot goes and what rides with it, from the assistantVision route.
   // `sends` is Task 3's translated payload list and already includes the screenshot.
   export function screenContextCopy(
     route: Pick<ResolvedRoute, "locality" | "providerId" | "host" | "model" | "sends">,
     t: Translate
   ): string {
     if (route.locality === "device") {
       return route.model
         ? t("dictationAgent.screenContext.goesToDevice", { model: route.model })
         : t("dictationAgent.screenContext.goesToDeviceNoModel");
     }
     const payload = route.sends ?? t("routes.payload.screenshot");
     if (route.locality === "network") {
       return route.host
         ? t("dictationAgent.screenContext.goesToServer", { host: route.host, payload })
         : t("dictationAgent.screenContext.goesToServerNoHost", { payload });
     }
     const provider = providerDisplayLabel(route.providerId, (key) => t(key));
     return route.host
       ? t("dictationAgent.screenContext.goesToProvider", { provider, host: route.host, payload })
       : t("dictationAgent.screenContext.goesToProviderNoHost", { provider, payload });
   }
   ```

   In `DictationAgentSettings.tsx`:
   - Add `import { useResolvedRoute } from "../../lib/routes";` and `import { screenContextCopy } from "./screenContextCopy";`, and `const visionRoute = useResolvedRoute("assistantVision");` next to the other hooks.
   - Replace `t("dictationAgent.screenContext.enableDescription")` in the screen-context `SettingsRow` with `screenContextCopy(visionRoute, t)`. Keep the `unsupported` branch. The route is computed while screen context is off, so the copy is right before the user turns it on: an off route keeps its destination (`locality`, `providerId`, `host`, `model`; Task 1's `resolveRoute`) and only `sends` is `null`, so the sentence names the recipient and falls back to "a screenshot of your screen", which is exactly what turning the switch on adds. With no vision override, `assistantVision` follows the assistant's route, which is where the screenshot actually goes.
   - Change the Screen Recording relaunch hint's `text-warning/80` to `text-muted-foreground` (`text-warning` measures below 4.5:1 on white, I13).

3. **Q23.** Create `src/hooks/useAutoLearnCorrections.ts`. It is the existing `autoLearnCorrections` state from `useSettings.ts` (persisted default, main-process sync on mount, main-process update on change) plus a window event, so every mount of the switch stays in step:

   ```ts
   import { useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
   import { useLocalStorage } from "./useLocalStorage";

   export const AUTO_LEARN_CHANGED_EVENT = "loqui-auto-learn-changed";

   export function useAutoLearnCorrections() {
     const [enabled, setEnabledRaw] = useLocalStorage("autoLearnCorrections", true, {
       serialize: String,
       deserialize: (value: string) => value !== "false",
     });

     const setEnabled = useCallback(
       (next: boolean) => {
         setEnabledRaw(next);
         window.electronAPI?.setAutoLearnEnabled?.(next);
         window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(AUTO_LEARN_CHANGED_EVENT, { detail: next }));
       },
       [setEnabledRaw]
     );

     // Settings → Dictation and the Dictionary header each mount this hook.
     useEffect(() => {
       const onChanged = (event: Event) => setEnabledRaw((event as CustomEvent<boolean>).detail);
       window.addEventListener(AUTO_LEARN_CHANGED_EVENT, onChanged);
       return () => window.removeEventListener(AUTO_LEARN_CHANGED_EVENT, onChanged);
     }, [setEnabledRaw]);

     // Sync the stored state to the main process on mount.
     useEffect(() => {
       window.electronAPI?.setAutoLearnEnabled?.(enabled);
       // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
     }, []);

     return [enabled, setEnabled] as const;
   }
   ```

   In `src/hooks/useSettings.ts`, replace the `useLocalStorage("autoLearnCorrections", …)` call, the `setAutoLearnCorrections` callback and the "Sync auto-learn state to main process on mount" effect (the block starting at `// Auto-learn corrections from user edits in external apps`) with:

   ```ts
   // Auto-learn corrections from user edits in external apps
   const [autoLearnCorrections, setAutoLearnCorrections] = useAutoLearnCorrections();
   ```

   and add `import { useAutoLearnCorrections } from "./useAutoLearnCorrections";`. The returned `autoLearnCorrections` and `setAutoLearnCorrections` keep their names and types.

   Create `src/components/DictionaryHeaderActions.tsx`:

   ```tsx
   import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
   import { Download, Upload } from "./icons";
   import { Toggle } from "./ui/toggle";

   export function DictionaryHeaderActions(props: {
     onClearAll: () => void;
     onExport: () => void;
     onImport: () => void;
     autoLearn: boolean;
     onAutoLearnChange: (value: boolean) => void;
   }) {
     const { t } = useTranslation();
     const action =
       "inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-sm text-xs text-foreground/60 outline-none transition-colors duration-[var(--motion-fast)] hover:text-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring";
     return (
       <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
         <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-foreground/60">
           <Toggle
             checked={props.autoLearn}
             onChange={props.onAutoLearnChange}
             aria-label={t("settingsPage.dictionary.autoLearnTitle")}
           />
           <span aria-hidden="true">{t("settingsPage.dictionary.autoLearnTitle")}</span>
         </label>
         <button type="button" onClick={props.onImport} className={action}>
           <Upload size={12} aria-hidden="true" />
           <span>{t("dictionary.import")}</span>

```js
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const test = require("node:test");

const root = path.join(__dirname, "../..");
const read = (file) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, file), "utf8");

function sourceFiles(dir, out = []) {
  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(path.join(root, dir), { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const rel = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) sourceFiles(rel, out);
    else if (/\.tsx?$/.test(entry.name)) out.push(rel);
  }
  return out;
}
const stripComments = (src) => src.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, "").replace(/(^|[^:])\/\/.*$/gm, "$1");

// Every Settings component Plan 03 creates or edits: the whole settings/ directory (so new files are
// covered automatically) plus the existing components this plan changes.
// DeveloperSection is not edited by an earlier task, but it renders inside Settings → System, so it is held
// to the same roles (Step 3 fixes its one site).
const EXTRA = [
  "src/components/SettingsPage.tsx", // Tasks 4, 5, 8, 9, 10, 14, 15, 17
  "src/components/SettingsModal.tsx", // Tasks 4, 8, 10, 16
  "src/components/DeveloperSection.tsx",
  "src/components/CodexConnection.tsx", // Task 9
  "src/components/DictionaryHeaderActions.tsx", // Task 17 (new)
  "src/components/DictionaryView.tsx", // Task 17
  "src/components/EnterpriseProviderConfig.tsx", // Tasks 2, 12
  "src/components/LocalModelPicker.tsx", // Task 13
  "src/components/OpenAICompatiblePanel.tsx", // Task 9
  "src/components/ReasoningModelSelector.tsx", // Tasks 9, 12, 13
  "src/components/SelfHostedPanel.tsx", // Task 9
  "src/components/TranscriptionModelPicker.tsx", // Tasks 9, 12, 13, 17
  "src/components/ui/ApiKeyInput.tsx", // Tasks 2, 12
  "src/components/ui/ModelCardList.tsx", // Task 5
  "src/components/ui/ModelCartridgeGrid.tsx", // Task 13 (new)
  "src/components/ui/SettingsNav.tsx", // Task 15 (new)
  "src/components/ui/SettingsSection.tsx", // Tasks 5, 15, 16
  "src/components/ui/SettingsTitleBar.tsx", // Task 15 (new)
  "src/components/ui/SidebarModal.tsx", // Tasks 8, 10, 15, 16
];
const FILES = [
  ...new Set([...sourceFiles("src/components/settings"), ...EXTRA.filter((f) => fs.existsSync(path.join(root, f)))]),
].sort();

// A status glyph on the same line is a graphic (3:1 needed), not text (4.5:1).
const ICON_TAG = /<(?:Check|CheckCircle2?|CircleAlert|CircleCheck|AlertTriangle|AlertCircle|Info)\b/;

// Buttons whose variant paints bg-muted on hover (outline, secondary, ghost), found with a small JSX
// tag scanner because attribute values contain "=>" and braces.
function openingTags(src, name) {
  const tags = [];
  const needle = `<${name}`;
  let i = 0;
  while ((i = src.indexOf(needle, i)) !== -1) {
    if (!/[\s>/]/.test(src[i + needle.length])) {
      i += needle.length;
      continue;
    }
    let depth = 0;
    let quote = null;
    let j = i + needle.length;
    for (; j < src.length; j++) {
      const ch = src[j];
      if (quote) {
        if (ch === quote && src[j - 1] !== "\\") quote = null;
        continue;
      }
      if (ch === '"' || ch === "'" || ch === "`") quote = ch;
      else if (ch === "{") depth++;
      else if (ch === "}") depth--;
      else if (ch === ">" && depth === 0) break;
    }
    tags.push(src.slice(i, j + 1));
    i = j + 1;
  }
  return tags;
}

test("[baseline guard] destructive text never sits on a #f5f5f5 surface class", () => {
  const offenders = [];
  for (const file of FILES) {
    for (const match of read(file).matchAll(/className=(?:"([^"]*)"|\{`([^`]*)`\}|\{"([^"]*)"\})/g)) {
      const cls = match[1] ?? match[2] ?? match[3];
      // Light-theme greys: #f5f5f5 (muted, secondary, surface-3) is 4.43:1 and #f0f0f0 (surface-raised) is 4.24:1
      // for #dc2626. Variants such as dark: and md: are skipped (the lookbehind rejects any other prefix).
      const grey = /(?<![\w:-])(?:hover:)?bg-(?:muted|secondary|surface-3|surface-raised)(?![\w/-])/.test(cls);
      if (grey && /(?<![\w:-])(?:hover:)?text-destructive(?![\w/-])/.test(cls)) offenders.push(`${file}: ${cls}`);
    }
  }
  assert.deepEqual(offenders, []);
});

      if (!["outline", "secondary", "ghost"].includes(variant)) continue;

        offenders.push(`${file}: ${tag.replace(/\s+/g, " ").slice(0, 140)}`);

});

Task 3's behavioural test pins rule 4 at run time; this is the cheap static net over every module that builds, plans or draws the route graph (the files Tasks 1, 3, 6, 7, 8 and 10 create). The explicit-button callers (Task 9's pickers and self-hosted Test, Task 12's `KeyringPanel`) are deliberately not in the list. Its last test is the spec §5.4 sealed-authority guard: it scans all of `src/` (excluding `src/stores/sealedStore.ts` and type declarations) and fails if any other renderer module calls `privacy.getSealed` or `privacy.onSealedChange`:

```js
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const test = require("node:test");

const root = path.join(__dirname, "../..");
const stripComments = (src) => src.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, "").replace(/(^|[^:])\/\/.*$/gm, "$1");
const FORBIDDEN = [
  // Each starts the Codex app server (codexAppServer.js:116-181), whose first start in a session
  // may ask GitHub to verify the release (codexCli.js:309-340).
  [/\bcodexStatus\b/, "starts the Codex client"],
  [/\bcodexRateLimits\b/, "starts the Codex client and asks ChatGPT for quota"],
  [/\bcodexModels\b/, "starts the Codex client and asks ChatGPT for models"],
  [/\bpersonalInference\??\.models\b/, "authenticated model discovery"],
  [/\bkeyring\??\.verify\b/, "sends a stored key to a provider"],
  [/\bprobeSelfHosted\b/, "network probe"],
  [/\btestProviderConnection\b/, "network probe"],
  [/\bfetch\s*\(/, "network request"],
];

test("[source guard, baseline] route facts, the resolver, the planner and the route views make no network call", () => {
  for (const file of [
    "src/lib/routeGraph.ts", // Task 1
    "src/helpers/enterpriseRouteFacts.js", // Task 1 (main; reads process.env only)
    "src/lib/credentialSlots.ts", // Task 2
    "src/stores/routeFactsStore.ts", // Task 3
    "src/stores/sealedStore.ts", // Task 3
    "src/lib/routes.ts", // Task 3
    "src/utils/providerSearch.ts", // Tasks 3, 6
    "src/lib/providerSwitchPlans.ts", // Task 6
    "src/lib/routePlanner.ts", // Task 6
    "src/stores/routeDraftStore.ts", // Task 7
    "src/lib/routeChangeMessage.ts", // Task 7
    "src/components/settings/routing/providerCatalog.ts", // Task 8
    "src/components/settings/routing/stagedTarget.ts", // Task 8
    "src/components/settings/routing/useRouteChange.ts", // Task 8
    "src/components/settings/routing/destinations.ts", // Task 10
    "src/components/settings/routing/usePatchbayBoard.ts", // Task 10
    "src/components/settings/routing/Patchbay.tsx", // Task 10
  ]) {
    const src = stripComments(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, file), "utf8"));
    for (const [pattern, why] of FORBIDDEN) assert.doesNotMatch(src, pattern, `${file}: ${why}`);
  }
});

// Argument text of every `name(` call, found by paren depth (enough for these files' effects).
function callArguments(src, name) {
  const found = [];
  const re = new RegExp(`\\b${name}\\s*\\(`, "g");
  let match;
  while ((match = re.exec(src))) {
    let depth = 1;
    let j = re.lastIndex;
    for (; j < src.length && depth > 0; j++) {
      if (src[j] === "(") depth++;
      else if (src[j] === ")") depth--;
    }
    found.push(src.slice(re.lastIndex, j - 1));
  }
  return found;
}

const CODEX_CALL = /\b(?:refresh|codexStatus|codexRateLimits|codexModels)\s*\(/;

test("[source guard, baseline after Task 9] Settings' Codex views start nothing on mount", () => {
  // C1/I2: CodexConnection read codexStatus/codexRateLimits on mount (v1 :60-62) and CodexModelPicker
  // listed models on mount. Only button handlers and account events (which follow an explicit sign-in
  // or sign-out) may call Codex. Onboarding's opt-in read (`if (checkStatusOnMount) void refresh()`)
  // is the one exception, and ReasoningModelSelector (Settings, NotesOnboarding) never opts in.
  const read = (file) => stripComments(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, file), "utf8"));
  const selector = read("src/components/ReasoningModelSelector.tsx");
  const views = [
    ["src/components/CodexConnection.tsx", read("src/components/CodexConnection.tsx")],
    ["CodexModelPicker (ReasoningModelSelector.tsx)", selector.slice(selector.indexOf("function CodexModelPicker"))],
  ];
  assert.ok(views[1][1].startsWith("function CodexModelPicker"), "CodexModelPicker still lives in ReasoningModelSelector.tsx");
  for (const [file, src] of views) {
    const effects = callArguments(src, "useEffect");
    assert.ok(effects.length > 0, `${file}: effects found`);
    for (const effect of effects) {
      const mountPath = callArguments(effect, "onTextEvent")
        .reduce((rest, handler) => rest.replace(handler, ""), effect)
        .replace(/if \(checkStatusOnMount\) void refresh\(\)/, "");
      assert.doesNotMatch(mountPath, CODEX_CALL, `${file}: an effect calls Codex outside an account event`);
    }
  }
  assert.doesNotMatch(selector, /checkStatusOnMount/, "Settings never opts into the mount read");
});

// Every .ts/.tsx/.js file under src/, recursively.
function sourceFiles(dir) {
  return fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((entry) => {
    const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) return sourceFiles(full);
    return /\.(?:tsx?|jsx?)$/.test(entry.name) ? [full] : [];
  });
}

test("[source guard, baseline] only src/stores/sealedStore.ts reads the privacy seal API (spec §5.4)", () => {
  // §5.4: sealedStore.ts is the one renderer authority. No other renderer module calls
  // privacy.getSealed or privacy.onSealedChange; they read useSealedStore / getSealed() (and, after
  // Plan 07, getSealedSnapshot() / subscribeSealed(cb)) from that module. Type declarations
  // (src/types/**, *.d.ts) describe the preload API and are not readers.
  const READS = /privacy\??\.\s*(?:getSealed|onSealedChange)\b|\bonSealedChange\b/;
  const offenders = [];
  for (const full of sourceFiles(path.join(root, "src"))) {
    const rel = path.relative(root, full).split(path.sep).join("/");
    if (rel === "src/stores/sealedStore.ts" || rel.startsWith("src/types/") || rel.endsWith(".d.ts")) continue;
    if (READS.test(stripComments(fs.readFileSync(full, "utf8")))) offenders.push(rel);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(offenders, [], "read sealed state through src/stores/sealedStore.ts");
});

const read = (file) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, file), "utf8");

// The text of the first `function name(…) { … }`: skip the parameter list by paren depth (defaults
// such as `options = {}` contain braces), then match braces from the body's "{".
function functionBody(src, signature) {
  const start = src.indexOf(signature);
  assert.ok(start !== -1, `${signature} found`);
  let parens = 1;
  let i = start + signature.length;
  for (; i < src.length && parens > 0; i++) {
    if (src[i] === "(") parens++;
    else if (src[i] === ")") parens--;
  }
  let depth = 0;
  for (let j = src.indexOf("{", i); j < src.length; j++) {
    if (src[j] === "{") depth++;
    else if (src[j] === "}" && --depth === 0) return src.slice(start, j + 1);
  }
  assert.fail(`${signature}: unbalanced braces`);
}

Create `test/components/routeWriteGuard.test.js`. Rule 3 of the plan: every provider, model, endpoint, mode, enable switch, Corti region and web-search change goes through the route planner (Tasks 6–9). Task 9's `routePickers.test.js` bans named setters in named files. This is the repo-wide net: any other file that references a route-affecting setter fails, so a new component cannot reintroduce a direct write. It matches any reference, not only calls, so destructuring a setter from `useSettings()` or selecting it from the store is caught too. The allowlist was built by grepping the base commit (`grep -rnoE` over `src/components src/hooks src/services src/utils src/helpers src/lib src/stores` for the names below). Every file that the grep reports and the allowlist does not name is one that Tasks 6–9 rewrite, or a Step 3 row.

```js
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const test = require("node:test");

const root = path.join(__dirname, "../..");
const stripComments = (src) => src.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, "").replace(/(^|[^:])\/\/.*$/gm, "$1");

function sourceFiles(dir, out = []) {
  const abs = path.join(root, dir);
  if (!fs.existsSync(abs)) return out;
  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(abs, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const rel = path.posix.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) sourceFiles(rel, out);
    else if (/\.(?:tsx?|jsx?)$/.test(entry.name) && !entry.name.endsWith(".d.ts")) out.push(rel);
  }
  return out;
}

const SCANNED = ["src/components", "src/hooks", "src/services", "src/utils", "src/helpers", "src/lib", "src/stores"];

// Store actions (src/stores/settingsStore.ts) that change a route's provider, model, host, mode or on/off state.
// Not listed: the secret-key setters (Task 2 owns keys), the *CloudMode setters, *DisableThinking, the
// translation language and target setters, the Azure API version and the Bedrock profile, which do not
// change who receives what (NOTES-route: same host).
const ROUTE_SETTERS = [
  // speech: dictation, meeting, upload
  "setTranscriptionMode", "setMeetingTranscriptionMode", "setUploadTranscriptionMode",
  "setUseLocalWhisper", "setMeetingUseLocalWhisper", "setUploadUseLocalWhisper",
  "setCloudTranscriptionProvider", "setMeetingCloudTranscriptionProvider", "setUploadCloudTranscriptionProvider",
  "setCloudTranscriptionModel", "setMeetingCloudTranscriptionModel", "setUploadCloudTranscriptionModel",
  "setCloudTranscriptionBaseUrl", "setMeetingCloudTranscriptionBaseUrl", "setUploadCloudTranscriptionBaseUrl",
  "setRemoteTranscriptionUrl", "setMeetingRemoteTranscriptionUrl", "setRemoteTranscriptionModel",
  "setLocalTranscriptionProvider", "setMeetingLocalTranscriptionProvider", "setUploadLocalTranscriptionProvider",
  "setWhisperModel", "setMeetingWhisperModel", "setUploadWhisperModel",
  "setParakeetModel", "setMeetingParakeetModel", "setUploadParakeetModel",
  "setCohereModel", "setMeetingCohereModel", "setUploadCohereModel",
  "switchCloudTranscriptionProvider", "setCloudTranscriptionForAllScopes",
  // text: per-scope setters and the shared switch
  "switchReasoningProvider", "setCloudReasoningForAllScopes",
  "setCleanupMode", "setCleanupProvider", "setCleanupModel", "setCleanupCloudBaseUrl", "setCleanupRemoteUrl",
  "setChatAgentMode", "setChatAgentProvider", "setChatAgentModel", "setChatAgentCloudBaseUrl", "setChatAgentRemoteUrl",
  "setDictationAgentMode", "setDictationAgentProvider", "setDictationAgentModel", "setDictationAgentCloudBaseUrl", "setDictationAgentRemoteUrl",
  "setDictationAgentVisionProvider", "setDictationAgentVisionModel", "setDictationAgentVisionCloudBaseUrl",
  "setTranslationMode", "setTranslationProvider", "setTranslationModel", "setTranslationCloudBaseUrl", "setTranslationRemoteUrl",
  "setNoteFormattingModel",
  // switches that turn a route on, and the Corti host and tenant
  "setUseCleanupModel", "setUseDictationTranslation", "setUseDictationAgent", "setVoiceAgentScreenContext",
  "setUseDictationAgentVisionModel", "setCortiEnvironment", "setCortiTenant",
  // R2-1: the enterprise route fields (Task 6's ROUTE_ENTERPRISE_KEYS). Each setter persists to main at once
  // (settingsStore.ts:2033-2038, :2060-2065, :2087-2098); UI edits go through requestRoutePatch (Task 9).
  "setBedrockRegion", "setAzureEndpoint", "setVertexProject", "setVertexLocation",
];
const SETTER_RE = new RegExp(`\\b(?:${ROUTE_SETTERS.join("|")})\\b`, "g");
// setResolvedLLMConfig(scope, patch) is a route write when the patch can carry a route key.
const LLM_ROUTE_KEY = /\b(?:mode|provider|model|remoteUrl|cloudBaseUrl|cloudMode)\b/;

// Files that may write routes, each with the reason it is not a bypass.
const ALLOWLIST = {
  "src/stores/settingsStore.ts": "defines the setters and Task 6's applyRoutePatch, the one writer the planner calls",
  "src/stores/routeDraftStore.ts": "Task 7: commits and Undo apply the planner's patch through applyRoutePatch",
  "src/lib/providerSwitchPlans.ts": "Task 6: the provider-switch planners extracted from switchCloudTranscriptionProvider/switchReasoningProvider",
  "src/lib/routePlanner.ts": "Task 6: builds the patch that preview, commit and Undo share",
  "src/utils/providerSearch.ts": "Task 6: writeProviderSearchPreference is the only personalWebSearch:<scope> writer, called by applyRoutePatch",
  "src/hooks/useSettings.ts": "passthrough object (`setTranscriptionMode: store.setTranscriptionMode`, :328) that calls nothing; every consumer that destructures a setter is scanned here",
  "src/components/OnboardingFlow.tsx": "first-run setup seeds routes (setResolvedLLMConfig :1240; setUseLocalWhisper/setLocalTranscriptionProvider/setParakeetModel :1350-1352); Plan 05 owns onboarding",
  "src/utils/onboardingCleanup.ts": "applyCleanupChoice (setUseCleanupModel :59, :65, :69; cleanup mode/provider/model) for onboarding's cleanup step; Plan 05 owns onboarding",
};

// Argument text of every `name(` call, by paren depth.
function callArguments(src, name) {
  const found = [];
  const re = new RegExp(`\\b${name}\\s*\\(`, "g");
  let match;
  while ((match = re.exec(src))) {
    let depth = 1;
    let j = re.lastIndex;
    for (; j < src.length && depth > 0; j++) {
      if ("([{".includes(src[j])) depth++;
      else if (")]}".includes(src[j])) depth--;
    }
    found.push(src.slice(re.lastIndex, j - 1));
  }
  return found;
}

// The text after the first top-level comma.
function secondArgument(args) {
  let depth = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
    if ("([{".includes(args[i])) depth++;
    else if (")]}".includes(args[i])) depth--;
    else if (args[i] === "," && depth === 0) return args.slice(i + 1).trim();
  }
  return "";
}

const scanned = () => [...new Set(SCANNED.flatMap((dir) => sourceFiles(dir)))].filter((file) => !(file in ALLOWLIST)).sort();

test("[baseline guard] every allowlisted route writer exists", () => {
  for (const file of Object.keys(ALLOWLIST)) assert.ok(fs.existsSync(path.join(root, file)), `${file} (${ALLOWLIST[file]})`);
});

test("[baseline guard after Tasks 6–9] no file outside the planner and the allowlist references a route-affecting setter", () => {
  const offenders = [];
  for (const file of scanned()) {
    const src = stripComments(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, file), "utf8"));
    const names = [...new Set(src.match(SETTER_RE) ?? [])];
    if (names.length) offenders.push(`${file}: ${names.join(", ")}`);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(offenders, [], "commit through useRouteCommit / requestPatch / RouteSwitch (Tasks 7–9), not the store");
});

test("[baseline guard after Tasks 6–9] setResolvedLLMConfig outside the allowlist never carries a route key", () => {
  const offenders = [];
  for (const file of scanned()) {
    const src = stripComments(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, file), "utf8"));
    for (const args of callArguments(src, "setResolvedLLMConfig")) {
      const patch = secondArgument(args);
      // An opaque patch (a variable, a spread or a computed key) could carry any key, so it fails too.
      const opaque = !patch.startsWith("{") || patch.includes("...") || /[{,]\s*\[/.test(patch);
      if (opaque || LLM_ROUTE_KEY.test(patch)) offenders.push(`${file}: setResolvedLLMConfig(${args.replace(/\s+/g, " ")})`);
    }
  }
  assert.deepEqual(offenders, []);
});

test("[baseline guard after Tasks 6–9] only providerSearch.ts touches personalWebSearch:<scope> and nothing bypasses the store's actions", () => {
  const offenders = [];
  for (const file of scanned()) {
    const src = stripComments(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, file), "utf8"));
    // Any literal: localStorage.setItem/removeItem, useLocalStorage(`personalWebSearch:…`) or a read that skips
    // readProviderSearchPreference. Turning web search on stages (Task 6's providerSearch:<scope> patch key).
    if (/personalWebSearch:/.test(src)) offenders.push(`${file}: personalWebSearch:`);
    if (/\buseSettingsStore\.setState\s*\(/.test(src)) offenders.push(`${file}: useSettingsStore.setState(`);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(offenders, []);
});

const read = (file) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, file), "utf8");
const everyScannedFile = () => [...new Set(SCANNED.flatMap((dir) => sourceFiles(dir)))].sort();

// The renderer has one enterprise writer. Environment/IPC implement it, while
// compatibility single-field savers remain inside main's shared transaction.
const ENTERPRISE_SAVER_HOSTS = new Set(["src/helpers/environment.js", "src/helpers/ipcHandlers.js"]);
const ENTERPRISE_SAVERS = /\bsaveEnterpriseRoutePatch\b|\bsave(?:BedrockRegion|AzureEndpoint|VertexProject|VertexLocation|VertexAuthSource)\b/;

const BEDROCK_COUPLING = {

test("[source guard, baseline after Task 3] the startup sync from main never writes main back (R2-1)", () => {
  // reconcileEnterpriseSettingsFromMain writes the store and localStorage only. Main is the source.
  const store = stripComments(read("src/stores/settingsStore.ts"));
  const start = store.indexOf("export function reconcileEnterpriseSettingsFromMain(");
  assert.ok(start !== -1, "Task 3's reconciler exists");
  let parens = 1;
  let i = start + "export function reconcileEnterpriseSettingsFromMain(".length;
  for (; i < store.length && parens > 0; i++) {
    if (store[i] === "(") parens++;
    else if (store[i] === ")") parens--;
  }
  let depth = 0;
  let end = store.indexOf("{", i);
  for (; end < store.length; end++) {
    if (store[end] === "{") depth++;
    else if (store[end] === "}" && --depth === 0) break;
  }
  const body = store.slice(start, end + 1);
  assert.doesNotMatch(body, ENTERPRISE_SAVERS);
  assert.doesNotMatch(body, /\bdebouncedPersistToEnv\b|\belectronAPI\b|\bnoteEnterpriseLocalWrite\b/);
});

// R2-2 and R2-5: credential writes.

test("[baseline guard after Task 12] ApiKeyInput has no empty-save Remove (R2-5)", () => {
  // An empty save is a permanent delete with no Undo; Remove goes through credentials.remove (useUndoableRemoval).
  const input = stripComments(read("src/components/ui/ApiKeyInput.tsx"));
  assert.doesNotMatch(input, /\bsetApiKey\(\s*""\s*\)|\bcommit\(\s*""\s*\)/);
  assert.match(input, /\buseUndoableRemoval\(/, "Remove is Task 12's undoable removal");
});

test("[baseline guard after Task 12] every <ApiKeyInput in src/ passes a credential identity (R2-5)", () => {
  let elements = 0;
  const offenders = [];
  for (const file of sourceFiles("src").filter((f) => f.endsWith(".tsx"))) {
    const src = stripComments(read(file));
    for (let at = src.indexOf("<ApiKeyInput"); at !== -1; at = src.indexOf("<ApiKeyInput", at + 1)) {
      if (!/[\s/>]/.test(src[at + "<ApiKeyInput".length])) continue;
      const element = src.slice(at, src.indexOf("/>", at));
      elements++;
      if (!/\bcredentialId=/.test(element)) offenders.push(`${file}: ${element.split("\n")[0].trim()}`);
    }
  }
  assert.deepEqual(offenders, [], "Remove needs the slot; Task 12's useUndoableRemoval has no fallback");
  // Six in ReasoningModelSelector, five in EnterpriseProviderConfig, two in TranscriptionModelPicker,
  // one each in OpenAICompatiblePanel and StagedRoutePanel (Task 12's count).
  assert.ok(elements >= 15, `found ${elements} ApiKeyInput elements`);
});

test("[baseline guard after Task 2] the app reset erases credentials only inside the authority's reset barrier (R2-2)", () => {
  const ipc = read("src/helpers/ipcHandlers.js");
  const cleanup = ipc.match(/ipcMain\.handle\("cleanup-app"[\s\S]*?ipcMain\.handle\("update-hotkey"/);
  assert.ok(cleanup, "the cleanup-app handler is found");
  assert.match(cleanup[0], /await this\.credentials\.reset\(\(\) => this\.environmentManager\?\.clearAllPersistedData\(\)\)/);
  assert.equal((ipc.match(/\bclearAllPersistedData\b/g) ?? []).length, 1, "ipcHandlers.js erases in one place");
  const offenders = [];
  for (const file of [...everyScannedFile(), "main.js", "preload.js"]) {
    if (file === "src/helpers/ipcHandlers.js" || file === "src/helpers/environment.js") continue;
    if (/\bclearAllPersistedData\b/.test(stripComments(read(file)))) offenders.push(file);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(offenders, [], "no other caller can erase outside the barrier");
});

test("[baseline guard after Task 7] route requests are superseded per route; only Discard and close end the session (R2-8)", () => {
  const store = stripComments(read("src/stores/routeDraftStore.ts"));
  // The session epoch moves in exactly one place, the store's discard(), which endSettingsSession() calls.
  assert.equal((store.match(/requestEpoch:\s*s\.requestEpoch \+ 1/g) ?? []).length, 1, "only discard() bumps requestEpoch");
  assert.match(store, /discard: \(\) => set\(\(s\) => \(\{ draft: null, requestEpoch: s\.requestEpoch \+ 1 \}\)\)/);
  // Requests bump their own route's epoch, never a global one (a request on route A must not supersede route B).
  assert.match(store, /const ticket = takeTicket\(id\);/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(store, /\btakeEpoch\b/, "no global request epoch");
});
```
